aws.cb.wafregional.rule_group_not_empty.description: Flags a regional WAF rule group when the rule group has zero activated rules in a regional resource. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.wafregional.rule_group_not_empty.pass_when: PASS when the rule group has an activated rule in a regional resource.
aws.cb.wafregional.rule_group_not_empty.fail_when: FAIL when the rule group has zero activated rules in a regional resource.

aws.cb.wafregional.rule_has_conditions.description: Flags a regional WAF rule when the rule has no predicates or match conditions in a regional resource. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.wafregional.rule_has_conditions.pass_when: PASS when the rule contains at least one predicate in a regional resource.
aws.cb.wafregional.rule_has_conditions.fail_when: FAIL when the rule has no predicates or match conditions in a regional resource.

aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_associated.description: Flags a regional WAF web ACL when the regional Web ACL has no associated resource ARN in a regional resource. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_associated.pass_when: PASS when at least one resource ARN is associated in a regional resource.
aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_associated.fail_when: FAIL when the regional Web ACL has no associated resource ARN in a regional resource.

aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_has_rules.description: Flags a regional WAF web ACL when the Web ACL has no ordinary rules in a regional resource. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_has_rules.pass_when: PASS when the Web ACL has at least one ordinary rule in a regional resource.
aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_has_rules.fail_when: FAIL when the Web ACL has no ordinary rules in a regional resource.

aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_logging.description: Flags a regional WAF web ACL when the Web ACL logging configuration has no log destination in a regional resource. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_logging.pass_when: PASS when a logging destination is configured in a regional resource.
aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_logging.fail_when: FAIL when the Web ACL logging configuration has no log destination in a regional resource.

aws.cb.wafv2.rule_group_metrics.description: Flags a WAFv2 rule group when the rule group disables CloudWatch metrics in a WAFv2 resource. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.cb.wafv2.rule_group_metrics.pass_when: PASS when CloudWatch metrics are enabled for the rule group in a WAFv2 resource.
aws.cb.wafv2.rule_group_metrics.fail_when: FAIL when the rule group disables CloudWatch metrics in a WAFv2 resource.

aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_has_rules.description: Flags a WAFv2 web ACL when the Web ACL has no ordinary `WebACL.Rules`, even if Firewall Manager groups exist. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_has_rules.pass_when: PASS when at least one ordinary Web ACL rule exists.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_has_rules.fail_when: FAIL when the Web ACL has no ordinary `WebACL.Rules`, even if Firewall Manager groups exist.

aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_has_rules_or_fms_gr.description: Flags a WAFv2 web ACL when the Web ACL has neither ordinary rules nor pre- or post-process Firewall Manager groups. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_has_rules_or_fms_gr.pass_when: PASS when the Web ACL has an ordinary rule or Firewall Manager group.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_has_rules_or_fms_gr.fail_when: FAIL when the Web ACL has neither ordinary rules nor pre- or post-process Firewall Manager groups.

aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_logging.description: Flags a WAFv2 web ACL when the Web ACL logging configuration has no log destination in a WAFv2 resource. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_logging.pass_when: PASS when a logging destination is configured in a WAFv2 resource.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_logging.fail_when: FAIL when the Web ACL logging configuration has no log destination in a WAFv2 resource.

aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_rule_metrics.description: Flags a WAFv2 web ACL when any Web ACL rule or Firewall Manager group lacks `VisibilityConfig.CloudWatchMetricsEnabled=true`. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_rule_metrics.pass_when: PASS when all evaluated rules and groups enable CloudWatch metrics.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_rule_metrics.fail_when: FAIL when any Web ACL rule or Firewall Manager group lacks `VisibilityConfig.CloudWatchMetricsEnabled=true`.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_rule_metrics.not_applicable_when: When the Web ACL has no rules or Firewall Manager groups to inspect.

aws.cb.wellarchitected.no_high_or_medium.description: Flags a wellarchitected workload when RiskCounts contains a positive HIGH or MEDIUM count. High or medium unresolved workload risks can leave known resilience or security weaknesses untreated.
aws.cb.wellarchitected.no_high_or_medium.pass_when: PASS when both HIGH and MEDIUM risk counts are zero or absent.
aws.cb.wellarchitected.no_high_or_medium.fail_when: FAIL when RiskCounts contains a positive HIGH or MEDIUM count.

aws.cb.workspaces.private_subnet_with_na.description: Flags a WorkSpace when the WorkSpace VPC lacks a public subnet, two private subnets, a NAT route, or the WorkSpace subnet is public. Weak subnet layout or volume encryption can expose desktop traffic or persisted user data.
aws.cb.workspaces.private_subnet_with_na.pass_when: PASS when the VPC has those subnet and NAT properties and the WorkSpace subnet is private.
aws.cb.workspaces.private_subnet_with_na.fail_when: FAIL when the WorkSpace VPC lacks a public subnet, two private subnets, a NAT route, or the WorkSpace subnet is public.

aws.cb.workspaces.root_and_user_volume_e.description: Flags a WorkSpace when either root or user WorkSpace volume encryption is disabled or omitted. Weak subnet layout or volume encryption can expose desktop traffic or persisted user data.
aws.cb.workspaces.root_and_user_volume_e.pass_when: PASS when both WorkSpace volume encryption flags are true.
aws.cb.workspaces.root_and_user_volume_e.fail_when: FAIL when either root or user WorkSpace volume encryption is disabled or omitted.

aws.cb.workspaces.root_volume_encryption.description: Flags a WorkSpace when `RootVolumeEncryptionEnabled` is false. Weak subnet layout or volume encryption can expose desktop traffic or persisted user data.

aws.cb.workspaces.user_volume_encryption.description: Flags a WorkSpace when `UserVolumeEncryptionEnabled` is false. Weak subnet layout or volume encryption can expose desktop traffic or persisted user data.

aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.account_has_log.description: Flags an AWS account when the account has no home-region trail with `Status.IsLogging` true. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.account_has_log.pass_when: PASS when at least one home-region trail is logging.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.account_has_log.fail_when: FAIL when the account has no home-region trail with `Status.IsLogging` true.

aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.region_has_logg.description: Checks whether a region is covered by a logging local CloudTrail trail or a logging multi-Region trail. No covering trail fails.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.region_has_logg.pass_when: PASS when a local or multi-Region trail covers the region and is logging.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.region_has_logg.fail_when: FAIL when the region has no logging local trail or logging multi-Region trail.

aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.description: Flags a regional CloudTrail activity window when one identity performs distinct enumeration API actions exceeding the 0.3 fraction of the configured action set in the collected activity window. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.pass_when: PASS when no identity exceeds that action-diversity fraction for enumeration.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.fail_when: FAIL when one identity performs distinct enumeration API actions exceeding the 0.3 fraction of the configured action set in the collected activity window.

aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.description: Flags a regional CloudTrail activity window when one identity performs distinct llm jacking API actions exceeding the 0.4 fraction of the configured action set in the collected activity window. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.pass_when: PASS when no identity exceeds that action-diversity fraction for llm jacking.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.fail_when: FAIL when one identity performs distinct llm jacking API actions exceeding the 0.4 fraction of the configured action set in the collected activity window.

aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.description: Flags a regional CloudTrail activity window when one identity performs distinct privilege escalation API actions exceeding the 0.2 fraction of the configured action set in the collected activity window. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.pass_when: PASS when no identity exceeds that action-diversity fraction for privilege escalation.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.fail_when: FAIL when one identity performs distinct privilege escalation API actions exceeding the 0.2 fraction of the configured action set in the collected activity window.

aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.trail_bucket_mf.description: Flags a CloudTrail trail when the same-account trail bucket versioning response lacks enabled MFA Delete. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.trail_bucket_mf.pass_when: PASS when the trail bucket reports `Versioning.MFADelete=Enabled`.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.trail_bucket_mf.fail_when: FAIL when the same-account trail bucket versioning response lacks enabled MFA Delete.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.trail_bucket_mf.not_applicable_when: When the trail is not its home-region copy; cross-account buckets instead require MANUAL review.

aws.claude2_a.cloudwatch.cross_account_s.description: This AWS account evaluator has no FAIL outcome:  a role named CloudWatch-CrossAccountSharingRole triggers MANUAL review of its trusted principals. The result calls for a human decision about cross-account trust rather than asserting a configuration failure.
aws.claude2_a.cloudwatch.cross_account_s.pass_when: PASS when the named sharing role is absent.
aws.claude2_a.cloudwatch.cross_account_s.fail_when: No collected configuration returns FAIL; a cross-account trust concern returns MANUAL.

aws.claude2_a.config.aggregation_authori.description: This config aggregate authorization evaluator has no FAIL outcome:  authorization of another account triggers MANUAL trust review. The result calls for a human decision about cross-account trust rather than asserting a configuration failure.
aws.claude2_a.config.aggregation_authori.pass_when: PASS when the authorized account equals the audited account.
aws.claude2_a.config.aggregation_authori.fail_when: No collected configuration returns FAIL; a cross-account trust concern returns MANUAL.

aws.claude2_a.config.org_aggregator_all_.description: Flags a config aggregator when the Config aggregator is not an organization aggregator, does not cover all regions, or lacks a delegated administrator. An incomplete Config aggregator can omit account or regional configuration changes from central review.
aws.claude2_a.config.org_aggregator_all_.pass_when: PASS when it is an all-region organization aggregator with a Config delegated administrator.
aws.claude2_a.config.org_aggregator_all_.fail_when: FAIL when the Config aggregator is not an organization aggregator, does not cover all regions, or lacks a delegated administrator.

aws.claude2_a.dlm.snapshot_sharing_trust.description: This dlm policy evaluator has no FAIL outcome:  a snapshot share to another account triggers MANUAL trust review. The result calls for a human decision about cross-account trust rather than asserting a configuration failure.
aws.claude2_a.dlm.snapshot_sharing_trust.pass_when: PASS when no enabled EBS snapshot policy shares to another account.
aws.claude2_a.dlm.snapshot_sharing_trust.fail_when: No collected configuration returns FAIL; a cross-account trust concern returns MANUAL.
aws.claude2_a.dlm.snapshot_sharing_trust.not_applicable_when: When the policy is not EBS snapshot management or its state is DISABLED.

aws.claude2_a.logs.log_group_not_public_.description: Flags a log group when a public CloudWatch Logs resource policy names the log group ARN or `*` as a resource. It can permit an outside principal to invoke or read the service resource without the intended trust boundary.
aws.claude2_a.logs.log_group_not_public_.pass_when: PASS when no public policy statement covers that log group ARN.
aws.claude2_a.logs.log_group_not_public_.fail_when: FAIL when a public CloudWatch Logs resource policy names the log group ARN or `*` as a resource.

aws.claude2_a.logs.resource_policy_not_p.description: Flags a log resource policy when a CloudWatch Logs resource policy has a Turbot-style public Allow statement. It can permit an outside principal to invoke or read the service resource without the intended trust boundary.
aws.claude2_a.logs.resource_policy_not_p.pass_when: PASS when the resource policy has no such public statement.
aws.claude2_a.logs.resource_policy_not_p.fail_when: FAIL when a CloudWatch Logs resource policy has a Turbot-style public Allow statement.

aws.claude_a.accessanalyzer.active_witho.description: Checks the regional IAM Access Analyzer inventory. The evaluator fails when it is empty, any analyzer is not ACTIVE, or any collected Findings row is present. Standard live collection requests only ACTIVE findings; archived or resolved findings outside that filter are not assessed.
aws.claude_a.accessanalyzer.active_witho.pass_when: PASS when at least one analyzer exists, every analyzer has status ACTIVE, and no collected Findings row is present. Standard live collection does not assess archived or resolved findings.
aws.claude_a.accessanalyzer.active_witho.fail_when: FAIL when no analyzer exists, any analyzer has status other than ACTIVE, or any collected Findings row is present regardless of that row's status. Standard live collection normally supplies only ACTIVE findings.

aws.claude_a.cloudtrail.account_has_logg.description: Checks the account's collected CloudTrail inventory for a logging multi-Region trail. It fails when none qualifies, except when an organization trail has unavailable logging status and no other result resolves the check.
aws.claude_a.cloudtrail.account_has_logg.pass_when: PASS when at least one multi-Region trail has logging enabled.
aws.claude_a.cloudtrail.account_has_logg.fail_when: FAIL when the account has no logging multi-Region trail.
aws.claude_a.cloudtrail.account_has_logg.not_applicable_when: When organization trail status is unavailable and no other logging multi-Region trail resolves the result.

aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_delete_on_term.description: Flags an EBS volume when an in-use volume attachment has `DeleteOnTermination` false. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.
aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_delete_on_term.pass_when: PASS when all in-use attachments have `DeleteOnTermination` true.
aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_delete_on_term.fail_when: FAIL when an in-use volume attachment has `DeleteOnTermination` false.
aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_delete_on_term.not_applicable_when: When the EBS volume is not in use.

aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_volume_encrypt.description: Flags an EBS volume when an attached volume has `Encrypted` false. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_volume_encrypt.pass_when: PASS when each attached volume has encryption enabled.
aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_volume_encrypt.fail_when: FAIL when an attached volume has `Encrypted` false.
aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_volume_encrypt.not_applicable_when: When the EBS volume is not in use.

aws.claude_a.ebs.snapshot_encrypted.description: Flags an EBS snapshot when the EBS snapshot has `Encrypted` false. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.claude_a.ebs.snapshot_encrypted.pass_when: PASS when the snapshot is encrypted.
aws.claude_a.ebs.snapshot_encrypted.fail_when: FAIL when the EBS snapshot has `Encrypted` false.

aws.claude_a.ebs.snapshot_not_public.description: Flags an EBS snapshot when the EBS snapshot restore permissions include `all`. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.
aws.claude_a.ebs.snapshot_not_public.pass_when: PASS when the restore permissions exclude `all`.
aws.claude_a.ebs.snapshot_not_public.fail_when: FAIL when the EBS snapshot restore permissions include `all`.

aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_has_snapshot.description: Flags an EBS volume when the complete snapshot inventory has no snapshot with this volume ID. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_has_snapshot.pass_when: PASS when at least one snapshot refers to this volume ID.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_has_snapshot.fail_when: FAIL when the complete snapshot inventory has no snapshot with this volume ID.

aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_backup_plan_r.description: Flags an EBS volume when no backup selection Resources entry matches the volume ARN or accepted volume wildcard. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_backup_plan_r.pass_when: PASS when a selection Resources entry matches the ARN or accepted wildcard.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_backup_plan_r.fail_when: FAIL when no backup selection Resources entry matches the volume ARN or accepted volume wildcard.

aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_backup_select.description: Flags an EBS volume when no backup selection matches the volume ARN or a volume tag key. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_backup_select.pass_when: PASS when a backup selection matches the ARN or a volume tag key.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_backup_select.fail_when: FAIL when no backup selection matches the volume ARN or a volume tag key.

aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_use.description: Flags an EBS volume when the volume state is not `in-use`. An unattached volume may retain sensitive data without a running workload controlling its lifecycle.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_use.pass_when: PASS when the volume state is `in-use`.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_use.fail_when: FAIL when the volume state is not `in-use`.

aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_protected_by_bac.description: Flags an EBS volume when the volume ARN is absent from AWS Backup protected resources. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_protected_by_bac.pass_when: PASS when the volume ARN appears among protected resources.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_protected_by_bac.fail_when: FAIL when the volume ARN is absent from AWS Backup protected resources.

aws.claude_a.ec2.account_imdsv2_default.description: Flags an EC2 regional setting when the regional metadata default `HttpTokens` is not `required`. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.account_imdsv2_default.pass_when: PASS when the regional default requires IMDSv2.
aws.claude_a.ec2.account_imdsv2_default.fail_when: FAIL when the regional metadata default `HttpTokens` is not `required`.
aws.claude_a.ec2.account_imdsv2_default.not_applicable_when: When the region contains no EC2 instances.

aws.claude_a.ec2.active_instance_ssm_man.description: Flags an EC2 instance when an eligible active instance ID is missing from the SSM managed-instance inventory. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.active_instance_ssm_man.pass_when: PASS when the active instance ID appears in the SSM inventory.
aws.claude_a.ec2.active_instance_ssm_man.fail_when: FAIL when an eligible active instance ID is missing from the SSM managed-instance inventory.
aws.claude_a.ec2.active_instance_ssm_man.not_applicable_when: When the instance state is pending, stopped, or terminated.

aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_block_public_access.description: Flags an EC2 regional setting when the regional image block-public-access state is `unblocked`. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_block_public_access.fail_when: FAIL when the regional image block-public-access state is `unblocked`.

aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_ebs_encrypted.description: Flags an ec2 image when any AMI block device mapping lacks `Ebs.Encrypted` true. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_ebs_encrypted.pass_when: PASS when every AMI block device mapping has encrypted EBS.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_ebs_encrypted.fail_when: FAIL when any AMI block device mapping lacks `Ebs.Encrypted` true.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_ebs_encrypted.not_applicable_when: When the AMI has no block device mappings.

aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_not_older_than_90_d.description: Flags an ec2 image when the self-owned AMI creation time precedes the 90-day UTC cutoff. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_not_older_than_90_d.pass_when: PASS when the AMI creation time is within the 90-day cutoff.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_not_older_than_90_d.fail_when: FAIL when the self-owned AMI creation time precedes the 90-day UTC cutoff.

aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_not_public.description: Flags an ec2 image when a self-owned AMI has `Public` true. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_not_public.pass_when: PASS when the self-owned AMI has `Public` false.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_not_public.fail_when: FAIL when a self-owned AMI has `Public` true.

aws.claude_a.ec2.client_vpn_connection_l.description: Flags an ec2 client vpn endpoint when client connection logging is disabled on the VPN endpoint. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude_a.ec2.client_vpn_connection_l.pass_when: PASS when client connection logging is enabled.
aws.claude_a.ec2.client_vpn_connection_l.fail_when: FAIL when client connection logging is disabled on the VPN endpoint.

aws.claude_a.ec2.ebs_encryption_by_defau.description: Flags an EC2 regional setting when regional `EbsEncryptionByDefault` is false. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.

Flags an EC2 regional setting when a region containing EBS volumes has `EbsEncryptionByDefault` false. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ebs_encryption_by_defau.pass_when: PASS when that region has EBS default encryption enabled.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ebs_encryption_by_defau.fail_when: FAIL when a region containing EBS volumes has `EbsEncryptionByDefault` false.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ebs_encryption_by_defau.not_applicable_when: When the region contains no EBS volumes.

aws.claude_a.ec2.eip_associated.description: Flags an ec2 eip when an allocated Elastic IP has no `AssociationId`. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.eip_associated.pass_when: PASS when the Elastic IP has an association ID.
aws.claude_a.ec2.eip_associated.fail_when: FAIL when an allocated Elastic IP has no `AssociationId`.

aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_imdsv2.description: For a Nitro Enclave parent, checks whether MetadataOptions.HttpTokens is required. The pinned predicate fails when tokens are optional even if HttpEndpoint is disabled; a disabled endpoint does not expose IMDSv1, so this is configuration parity rather than proof of IMDSv1 exposure.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_imdsv2.pass_when: An enclave parent declares MetadataOptions.HttpTokens required.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_imdsv2.fail_when: An enclave parent declares another HttpTokens value, including optional when HttpEndpoint is disabled.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_imdsv2.not_applicable_when: When the instance is not a Nitro Enclave parent.

aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_ingress_al.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a Nitro Enclave parent security group allows world-routable TCP or UDP on ports outside 22, 80, and 443. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_ingress_al.pass_when: PASS when its security groups expose no other TCP or UDP port globally.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_ingress_al.fail_when: FAIL when a Nitro Enclave parent security group allows world-routable TCP or UDP on ports outside 22, 80, and 443.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_ingress_al.not_applicable_when: When the instance is not a Nitro Enclave parent.

aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_not_public.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a Nitro Enclave parent has public IPv4, global IPv6 on an attached ENI, or an internet-gateway default route. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_not_public.pass_when: PASS when none of those public reachability indicators exists.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_not_public.fail_when: FAIL when a Nitro Enclave parent has public IPv4, global IPv6 on an attached ENI, or an internet-gateway default route.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_not_public.not_applicable_when: When the instance is not a Nitro Enclave parent.

aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_running.description: Flags an EC2 instance when an Enclave-enabled instance is stopped, shutting down, or terminated. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_running.pass_when: PASS when the Enclave-enabled instance remains in another state.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_running.fail_when: FAIL when an Enclave-enabled instance is stopped, shutting down, or terminated.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_running.not_applicable_when: When the instance is not a Nitro Enclave parent.

aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_vsock_port.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a parent security group allows global TCP ingress on one of the configured vsock-proxy ports. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_vsock_port.pass_when: PASS when no configured vsock-proxy port is open to globally routable ingress.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_vsock_port.fail_when: FAIL when a parent security group allows global TCP ingress on one of the configured vsock-proxy ports.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_vsock_port.not_applicable_when: When the instance is not a Nitro Enclave parent.

aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_in_use.description: Flags an EC2 network interface when a network interface is `available` with no attached instance ID. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_in_use.pass_when: PASS when the interface is attached or its status is not `available`.
aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_in_use.fail_when: FAIL when a network interface is `available` with no attached instance ID.

aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_no_public_ip.description: Flags an EC2 network interface when a network interface has `Association.PublicIp` populated. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.
aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_no_public_ip.pass_when: PASS when the interface has no public IPv4 association.
aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_no_public_ip.fail_when: FAIL when a network interface has `Association.PublicIp` populated.

aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_source_dest_check.description: Flags an EC2 network interface when a supported network interface type has `SourceDestCheck` false. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_source_dest_check.pass_when: PASS when source/destination checking is enabled.
aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_source_dest_check.fail_when: FAIL when a supported network interface type has `SourceDestCheck` false.
aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_source_dest_check.not_applicable_when: When the network interface type is outside the supported source/destination-check types.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_ami_not_deprec.description: Flags an EC2 instance when the Amazon-owned AMI referenced by the instance has a past `DeprecationTime`. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_ami_not_deprec.pass_when: PASS when the referenced Amazon-owned AMI has no past deprecation timestamp.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_ami_not_deprec.fail_when: FAIL when the Amazon-owned AMI referenced by the instance has a past `DeprecationTime`.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_ami_not_deprec.not_applicable_when: When the instance AMI is missing from inventory or is not Amazon owned.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_detailed_monit.description: Flags an EC2 instance when `Monitoring.State` is not `enabled`. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_detailed_monit.pass_when: PASS when detailed monitoring state is `enabled`.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_ebs_delete_on_.description: Flags an EC2 instance when any EBS block device mapping has `DeleteOnTermination` false. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_ebs_optimized.description: Flags an EC2 instance when `EbsOptimized` is false. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_imdsv2_applied.description: Flags an EC2 instance when metadata tokens are not `required` or metadata option state is not `applied`. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_imdsv2_applied.pass_when: PASS when IMDSv2 tokens are required and the option state is applied.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_imdsv2_applied.fail_when: FAIL when metadata tokens are not `required` or metadata option state is not `applied`.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_imdsv2_or_disa.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a non-terminated instance has metadata enabled without required IMDSv2 tokens. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_port_memcached.fail_when: FAIL when an attached security group accepts TCP from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 on memcached port(s) [11211].

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_port_mongodb_n.fail_when: FAIL when an attached security group accepts TCP from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 on mongodb port(s) [27017, 27018].

It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_port_rdp_not_i.fail_when: FAIL when an attached security group accepts TCP from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 on rdp port(s) [3389].

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_port_redis_not.pass_when: PASS when no attached security group accepts all-address TCP on redis port(s) [6379].
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_port_redis_not.fail_when: FAIL when an attached security group accepts TCP from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 on redis port(s) [6379].

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_port_sqlserver.pass_when: PASS when no attached security group accepts all-address TCP on sqlserver port(s) [1433, 1434].
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_port_sqlserver.fail_when: FAIL when an attached security group accepts TCP from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 on sqlserver port(s) [1433, 1434].

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_port_ssh_not_i.pass_when: PASS when no attached security group accepts all-address TCP on ssh port(s) [22].
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_port_ssh_not_i.fail_when: FAIL when an attached security group accepts TCP from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 on ssh port(s) [22].

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_port_telnet_no.pass_when: PASS when no attached security group accepts all-address TCP on telnet port(s) [23].
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_port_telnet_no.fail_when: FAIL when an attached security group accepts TCP from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 on telnet port(s) [23].

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_profile_attach.description: Flags an EC2 instance when the instance lacks an IAM instance profile. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_profile_attach.pass_when: PASS when an IAM instance profile is present.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_profile_attach.fail_when: FAIL when the instance lacks an IAM instance profile.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_profile_attach.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a non-terminated instance lacks an IAM instance profile. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_profile_attach.pass_when: PASS when the non-terminated instance has a profile.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_profile_attach.fail_when: FAIL when a non-terminated instance lacks an IAM instance profile.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_profile_attach.not_applicable_when: When the instance state is terminated.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_protected_by_b.description: Flags an EC2 instance when the instance ARN is not an EC2 protected resource in AWS Backup. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_protected_by_b.pass_when: PASS when the instance ARN is an EC2 protected resource.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_protected_by_b.fail_when: FAIL when the instance ARN is not an EC2 protected resource in AWS Backup.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_single_attacha.description: Flags an EC2 instance when more than one attached ENI has type `efa`, `interface`, or `trunk`. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_single_attacha.pass_when: PASS when at most one attached ENI has those interface types.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_single_attacha.fail_when: FAIL when more than one attached ENI has type `efa`, `interface`, or `trunk`.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_single_eni.description: Flags an EC2 instance when the instance has zero or more than one network interface. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_single_eni.pass_when: PASS when the instance has exactly one network interface.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_single_eni.fail_when: FAIL when the instance has zero or more than one network interface.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_ssm_managed.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a non-stopped instance ID is missing from the SSM managed-instance inventory. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_ssm_managed.pass_when: PASS when the non-stopped instance ID appears in the SSM inventory.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_ssm_managed.fail_when: FAIL when a non-stopped instance ID is missing from the SSM managed-instance inventory.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_ssm_managed.not_applicable_when: When the instance state is stopped.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_termination_pr.description: Flags an EC2 instance when `Attributes.DisableApiTermination` is false. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_termination_pr.pass_when: PASS when termination protection is enabled.

aws.claude_a.ec2.internet_facing_without.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a non-terminated instance has both public IPv4 and an IAM instance profile. If that public instance is compromised, its attached profile credentials can be obtained through the instance metadata service.
aws.claude_a.ec2.internet_facing_without.pass_when: PASS when either public IPv4 or the instance profile is absent.
aws.claude_a.ec2.internet_facing_without.fail_when: FAIL when a non-terminated instance has both public IPv4 and an IAM instance profile.
aws.claude_a.ec2.internet_facing_without.not_applicable_when: When the instance state is terminated.

aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_any_ver.description: For every version in the complete collected launch-template version inventory, checks the explicit MetadataOptions declaration. An enabled endpoint with optional tokens fails; an explicitly disabled endpoint or enabled endpoint with required tokens is safe. Omitted or unrecognized options remain UNKNOWN because effective instance metadata settings can inherit account and AMI defaults. This does not test running instances or the separate default-version predicate.
aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_any_ver.pass_when: The complete version inventory is nonempty and every version explicitly disables the endpoint or enables it with required tokens.
aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_any_ver.fail_when: Any collected version explicitly enables the metadata endpoint with optional tokens, even if another version is safe or a different version is default.

aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_default.description: Flags an EC2 launch template when an EBS mapping in the default template version lacks `Encrypted` true. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_default.pass_when: PASS when all EBS mappings in the default version are encrypted.
aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_default.fail_when: FAIL when an EBS mapping in the default template version lacks `Encrypted` true.
aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_default.not_applicable_when: When the default launch template version has no block device mapping list.

aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_default.description: Flags an EC2 launch template when the default template version does not set `MetadataOptions.HttpTokens` to `required`. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_default.pass_when: PASS when the default version requires IMDSv2 tokens.
aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_default.fail_when: FAIL when the default template version does not set `MetadataOptions.HttpTokens` to `required`.

aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_instanc.description: Flags an EC2 launch template when a tagged instance launched from the template has `LaunchTemplateData.NetworkInterfaces[].AssociatePublicIpAddress` true. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.
aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_instanc.pass_when: PASS when all tagged instances leave public-IP association disabled.
aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_instanc.fail_when: FAIL when a tagged instance launched from the template has `LaunchTemplateData.NetworkInterfaces[].AssociatePublicIpAddress` true.
aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_instanc.not_applicable_when: When no instance is tagged as launched from the template.

aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_no_publ.description: Flags an EC2 launch template when any version explicitly associates a public IP. A referenced existing ENI without joined public-address evidence returns UNKNOWN.
aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_no_publ.pass_when: PASS when no template version explicitly associates a public IP and no network interface references an existing ENI whose public addressing is not joined.
aws.claude_a.ec2.launch_template_no_publ.fail_when: FAIL when any template version sets a network interface to associate a public IP.

aws.claude_a.ec2.public_instance_has_pro.description: Flags an EC2 instance when an instance with public IPv4 has no IAM instance profile. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.
aws.claude_a.ec2.public_instance_has_pro.pass_when: PASS when the public instance has a profile.
aws.claude_a.ec2.public_instance_has_pro.fail_when: FAIL when an instance with public IPv4 has no IAM instance profile.
aws.claude_a.ec2.public_instance_has_pro.not_applicable_when: When the instance has no public IPv4 address.

aws.claude_a.ec2.running_instance_age_18.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a running instance has been launched for more than 180 whole days. Long-lived instances can accumulate outdated software and unreviewed configuration changes.
aws.claude_a.ec2.running_instance_age_18.pass_when: PASS when the running instance age is at most 180 whole days.
aws.claude_a.ec2.running_instance_age_18.fail_when: FAIL when a running instance has been launched for more than 180 whole days.
aws.claude_a.ec2.running_instance_age_18.not_applicable_when: When the instance is not running.

aws.claude_a.ec2.running_instance_no_key.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a running instance has `KeyName` set. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.running_instance_no_key.pass_when: PASS when the running instance has no EC2 key pair name.
aws.claude_a.ec2.running_instance_no_key.fail_when: FAIL when a running instance has `KeyName` set.
aws.claude_a.ec2.running_instance_no_key.not_applicable_when: When the instance is not running.

aws.claude_a.ec2.snapshot_block_public_a.description: Flags an EC2 regional setting when a region with snapshots has snapshot sharing state other than `block-all-sharing`. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.
aws.claude_a.ec2.snapshot_block_public_a.pass_when: PASS when the snapshot sharing state is `block-all-sharing`.
aws.claude_a.ec2.snapshot_block_public_a.fail_when: FAIL when a region with snapshots has snapshot sharing state other than `block-all-sharing`.
aws.claude_a.ec2.snapshot_block_public_a.not_applicable_when: When the region contains no EBS snapshots.

aws.claude_a.ec2.spot_fleet_ebs_encrypte.description: Flags an ec2 spot fleet request when any EBS device in a spot fleet launch specification lacks encryption. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.spot_fleet_ebs_encrypte.pass_when: PASS when each EBS launch-specification device is encrypted.
aws.claude_a.ec2.spot_fleet_ebs_encrypte.fail_when: FAIL when any EBS device in a spot fleet launch specification lacks encryption.
aws.claude_a.ec2.spot_fleet_ebs_encrypte.not_applicable_when: When the spot fleet uses a launch template rather than LaunchSpecifications.

aws.claude_a.ec2.stopped_instance_30_day.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a stopped or stopping instance crossed the 30-day UTC cutoff since its transition. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.stopped_instance_30_day.pass_when: PASS when the stopped or stopping transition is newer than the 30-day cutoff.
aws.claude_a.ec2.stopped_instance_30_day.fail_when: FAIL when a stopped or stopping instance crossed the 30-day UTC cutoff since its transition.
aws.claude_a.ec2.stopped_instance_30_day.not_applicable_when: When the instance is outside the stopped-state population.

aws.claude_a.ec2.stopped_instance_90_day.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a stopped or stopping instance crossed the 90-day UTC cutoff since its transition. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.stopped_instance_90_day.pass_when: PASS when the stopped or stopping transition is newer than the 90-day cutoff.
aws.claude_a.ec2.stopped_instance_90_day.fail_when: FAIL when a stopped or stopping instance crossed the 90-day UTC cutoff since its transition.
aws.claude_a.ec2.stopped_instance_90_day.not_applicable_when: When the instance is outside the stopped-state population.

aws.claude_a.ec2.stopped_instance_more_t.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a stopped instance has been stopped for more than 30 whole days. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.stopped_instance_more_t.pass_when: PASS when it has been stopped for at most 30 whole days.
aws.claude_a.ec2.stopped_instance_more_t.fail_when: FAIL when a stopped instance has been stopped for more than 30 whole days.
aws.claude_a.ec2.stopped_instance_more_t.not_applicable_when: When the instance is outside the stopped-state population.

aws.claude_a.ec2.tgw_no_auto_accept_shar.description: Flags a transit gateway when the transit gateway sets `AutoAcceptSharedAttachments` to `enable`. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.tgw_no_auto_accept_shar.fail_when: FAIL when the transit gateway sets `AutoAcceptSharedAttachments` to `enable`.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.detector_no_findi.description: For an enabled detector, checks collected ListFindings IDs filtered to severity Eq 8 and service.archived Eq false. Historical archived or lower-severity findings are outside this predicate. Remediation: Investigate and remediate active severity-8 findings; archive only after resolution.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.detector_no_findi.pass_when: No active unarchived severity-8 finding ID is returned.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.detector_no_findi.fail_when: At least one active unarchived severity-8 finding ID is returned; denied or malformed filtered reads are UNKNOWN.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.ebs_malware_prote.description: Checks that the GuardDuty detector is ENABLED and its EBS_MALWARE_PROTECTION feature is ENABLED. A disabled detector cannot pass solely because the feature row is enabled.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.ebs_malware_prote.pass_when: Both Configuration.Status and EBS_MALWARE_PROTECTION Status are ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.ebs_malware_prote.fail_when: The detector is disabled or the EBS feature is absent or disabled.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.ec2_runtime_agent.description: Flags a GuardDuty detector when the detector, regardless of its overall status, does not report the RUNTIME_MONITORING / EC2_AGENT_MANAGEMENT feature as ENABLED. It reduces the signals available to detect malicious activity in this account.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.ec2_runtime_agent.pass_when: PASS when the detector, regardless of its overall status, reports RUNTIME_MONITORING / EC2_AGENT_MANAGEMENT as ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.ec2_runtime_agent.fail_when: FAIL when the detector, regardless of its overall status, does not report the RUNTIME_MONITORING / EC2_AGENT_MANAGEMENT feature as ENABLED.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.ecs_runtime_agent.description: Flags a GuardDuty detector when the detector, regardless of its overall status, does not report the RUNTIME_MONITORING / ECS_FARGATE_AGENT_MANAGEMENT feature as ENABLED. It reduces the signals available to detect malicious activity in this account.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.ecs_runtime_agent.pass_when: PASS when the detector, regardless of its overall status, reports RUNTIME_MONITORING / ECS_FARGATE_AGENT_MANAGEMENT as ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.ecs_runtime_agent.fail_when: FAIL when the detector, regardless of its overall status, does not report the RUNTIME_MONITORING / ECS_FARGATE_AGENT_MANAGEMENT feature as ENABLED.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.eks_runtime_monit.description: Flags a GuardDuty detector when the detector, regardless of its overall status, does not report the EKS_RUNTIME_MONITORING feature as ENABLED. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.eks_runtime_monit.pass_when: PASS when the detector, regardless of its overall status, reports EKS_RUNTIME_MONITORING as ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.eks_runtime_monit.fail_when: FAIL when the detector, regardless of its overall status, does not report the EKS_RUNTIME_MONITORING feature as ENABLED.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.finding_archived.description: Flags a GuardDuty finding when the finding has `Service.Archived` false. An unarchived GuardDuty finding may represent active malicious activity awaiting triage.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.finding_archived.fail_when: FAIL when the finding has `Service.Archived` false.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_ai_protec.description: Checks AI_PROTECTION on an enabled GuardDuty detector. An explicit disabled feature fails; a disabled detector or absent AI_PROTECTION report returns MANUAL.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_ai_protec.pass_when: PASS when an enabled detector reports AI_PROTECTION as ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_ai_protec.fail_when: FAIL when an enabled detector reports AI_PROTECTION as disabled; MANUAL when the detector is disabled or the feature is unreported.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_centrally.description: Flags a GuardDuty detector when the detector has neither an administrator account nor member accounts. It reduces the signals available to detect malicious activity in this account.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_centrally.pass_when: PASS when the detector has an administrator or at least one member account.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_centrally.fail_when: FAIL when the detector has neither an administrator account nor member accounts.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_delegated.description: Checks regional GuardDuty inventory for an enabled detector, an enabled delegated administrator, and NEW or ALL organization member auto-enable configuration. Missing any requirement fails.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_delegated.pass_when: PASS when all three regional GuardDuty management conditions hold.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_delegated.fail_when: FAIL when the region lacks an enabled detector, delegated administrator, or required auto-enable configuration.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_ec2_malwa.description: Checks an enabled GuardDuty detector's Configuration.DataSources.MalwareProtection.ScanEc2InstanceWithFindings.EbsVolumes.Status for ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_ec2_malwa.pass_when: PASS when the enabled detector's EbsVolumes data source status is ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_ec2_malwa.fail_when: FAIL when an enabled detector's EbsVolumes data source status is not ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_ec2_malwa.not_applicable_when: When the GuardDuty detector is not ENABLED.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_eks_audit.description: Checks an enabled GuardDuty detector's Configuration.DataSources.Kubernetes.AuditLogs.Status for ENABLED; other detector states are not applicable.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_eks_audit.pass_when: PASS when the enabled detector's Kubernetes.AuditLogs data source status is ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_eks_audit.fail_when: FAIL when an enabled detector's Kubernetes.AuditLogs data source status is not ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_eks_audit.not_applicable_when: When the GuardDuty detector is not ENABLED.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_eks_runti.description: Checks whether an enabled GuardDuty detector reports either EKS_RUNTIME_MONITORING or RUNTIME_MONITORING as ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_eks_runti.pass_when: PASS when an enabled detector has EKS_RUNTIME_MONITORING or RUNTIME_MONITORING with status ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_eks_runti.fail_when: FAIL when an enabled detector has neither EKS_RUNTIME_MONITORING nor RUNTIME_MONITORING enabled.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_eks_runti.not_applicable_when: When the GuardDuty detector is not ENABLED.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_lambda_pr.description: Flags a GuardDuty detector when the enabled detector does not report the LAMBDA_NETWORK_LOGS feature as ENABLED. It reduces the signals available to detect malicious activity in this account.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_lambda_pr.pass_when: PASS when the enabled detector reports LAMBDA_NETWORK_LOGS as ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_lambda_pr.fail_when: FAIL when the enabled detector does not report the LAMBDA_NETWORK_LOGS feature as ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_lambda_pr.not_applicable_when: When the GuardDuty detector is not ENABLED.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_no_high_s.description: Flags a GuardDuty detector when the detector has an active severity-8 finding ID. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_no_high_s.pass_when: PASS when there are no active severity-8 finding IDs.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_no_high_s.fail_when: FAIL when the detector has an active severity-8 finding ID.

aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_rds_prote.description: Flags a GuardDuty detector when the enabled detector does not report the RDS_LOGIN_EVENTS feature as ENABLED. It reduces the signals available to detect malicious activity in this account.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_rds_prote.pass_when: PASS when the enabled detector reports RDS_LOGIN_EVENTS as ENABLED.
aws.claude_a.guardduty.prowler_rds_prote.fail_when: FAIL when the enabled detector does not report the RDS_LOGIN_EVENTS feature as ENABLED.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_group_inline_no.description: Flags an IAM group when an applicable group inline policy contains a known IAM privilege-escalation action combination. It can expand identity privileges, expose credentials, or make unused access available to an attacker.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_group_inline_no.pass_when: PASS when no applicable group inline policy contains a recognized escalation combination.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_group_inline_no.fail_when: FAIL when an applicable group inline policy contains a known IAM privilege-escalation action combination.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_group_inline_no.not_applicable_when: When there are no relevant policy documents on this identity.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_group_no_admini.description: Flags an IAM group when the evaluated IAM group has AdministratorAccess attached. It can expand identity privileges, expose credentials, or make unused access available to an attacker.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_group_no_admini.pass_when: PASS when the evaluated IAM group has no AdministratorAccess attachment.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_group_no_admini.fail_when: FAIL when the evaluated IAM group has AdministratorAccess attached.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_policy_agentcor.description: Flags an IAM managed policy when a customer policy permits AgentCore workload access-token calls outside the workload identity scope required by its policy helper. It can expand identity privileges, expose credentials, or make unused access available to an attacker.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_policy_agentcor.pass_when: PASS when AgentCore token grants are scoped to workload identities.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_policy_agentcor.fail_when: FAIL when a customer policy permits AgentCore workload access-token calls outside the workload identity scope required by its policy helper.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_policy_agentcor.not_applicable_when: When the policy is outside the attached customer managed policy population.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_policy_passrole.description: Flags an IAM managed policy when a customer policy can pass wildcard IAM roles to Bedrock AgentCore without the helper’s role restriction. It can expand identity privileges, expose credentials, or make unused access available to an attacker.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_policy_passrole.pass_when: PASS when the policy does not permit broad `iam:PassRole` to AgentCore.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_policy_passrole.fail_when: FAIL when a customer policy can pass wildcard IAM roles to Bedrock AgentCore without the helper’s role restriction.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_policy_passrole.not_applicable_when: When the policy is outside the attached customer managed policy population.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_confused_d.description: Flags an IAM role when a service role trust policy allows a service principal without the source-account or source-ARN restriction expected by the confused-deputy helper. It can expand identity privileges, expose credentials, or make unused access available to an attacker.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_confused_d.pass_when: PASS when the service trust is constrained to the expected source.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_confused_d.fail_when: FAIL when a service role trust policy allows a service principal without the source-account or source-ARN restriction expected by the confused-deputy helper.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_confused_d.not_applicable_when: When the role is not a service role or is under aws-service-role.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.description: Flags an IAM role when an applicable role inline policy for this role grants administrative access under the Prowler policy expansion test. It can expand identity privileges, expose credentials, or make unused access available to an attacker.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.pass_when: PASS when no applicable role inline policy meets that administrative-access test.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.fail_when: FAIL when an applicable role inline policy for this role grants administrative access under the Prowler policy expansion test.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.not_applicable_when: When there are no relevant policy documents on this identity.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.description: Flags an IAM role when an applicable role inline policy grants all CloudTrail actions on wildcard resources. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.pass_when: PASS when no applicable role inline policy grants all CloudTrail actions on wildcard resources.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.fail_when: FAIL when an applicable role inline policy grants all CloudTrail actions on wildcard resources.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.not_applicable_when: When there are no relevant policy documents on this identity.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.description: Flags an IAM role when an applicable role inline policy grants all KMS actions on wildcard resources. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.pass_when: PASS when no applicable role inline policy grants all KMS actions on wildcard resources.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.fail_when: FAIL when an applicable role inline policy grants all KMS actions on wildcard resources.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.not_applicable_when: When there are no relevant policy documents on this identity.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.description: Flags an IAM role when an applicable role inline policy allows `aws-marketplace:Subscribe` on wildcard resources. It can expand identity privileges, expose credentials, or make unused access available to an attacker.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.pass_when: PASS when no applicable role inline policy allows wildcard Marketplace subscription.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.fail_when: FAIL when an applicable role inline policy allows `aws-marketplace:Subscribe` on wildcard resources.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.not_applicable_when: When there are no relevant policy documents on this identity.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.description: Flags an IAM role when an applicable role inline policy contains a known IAM privilege-escalation action combination. It can expand identity privileges, expose credentials, or make unused access available to an attacker.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.pass_when: PASS when no applicable role inline policy contains a recognized escalation combination.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.fail_when: FAIL when an applicable role inline policy contains a known IAM privilege-escalation action combination.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_inline_no_.not_applicable_when: When there are no relevant policy documents on this identity.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_no_adminis.description: Flags an IAM role when the evaluated non-service IAM role has AdministratorAccess attached. It can expand identity privileges, expose credentials, or make unused access available to an attacker.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_no_adminis.pass_when: PASS when the evaluated non-service IAM role has no AdministratorAccess attachment.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_no_adminis.fail_when: FAIL when the evaluated non-service IAM role has AdministratorAccess attached.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_no_adminis.not_applicable_when: When the role is classified as a service role.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_readonly_n.description: Flags an IAM role when a non-service role with ReadOnlyAccess trusts `*` or an AWS account other than its own. It can expand identity privileges, expose credentials, or make unused access available to an attacker.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_readonly_n.pass_when: PASS when the non-service role has no such external trust.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_readonly_n.fail_when: FAIL when a non-service role with ReadOnlyAccess trusts `*` or an AWS account other than its own.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_readonly_n.not_applicable_when: When the IAM role is a service role.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_service_tr.description: Flags an IAM role when a conditioned service-principal trust statement does not bind the caller to the audited source account. It can expand identity privileges, expose credentials, or make unused access available to an attacker.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_service_tr.pass_when: PASS when conditioned service trust is bound to the audited account.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_service_tr.fail_when: FAIL when a conditioned service-principal trust statement does not bind the caller to the audited source account.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_role_service_tr.not_applicable_when: When the role is AWS service linked, lacks service trust, or has no in-scope conditional service trust.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_root_hardware_m.description: Checks credentialed root's hardware MFA only in the commercial AWS partition. GovCloud root MFA is unsupported, and China IAM has no root-user credentials; these partitions are outside this predicate. A root virtual MFA device or AccountMFAEnabled zero fails.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_root_hardware_m.pass_when: PASS when AccountMFAEnabled is positive and no root virtual MFA device is found.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_root_hardware_m.fail_when: FAIL when credentialed root has AccountMFAEnabled zero or a root virtual MFA device is found.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_root_hardware_m.not_applicable_when: Non-commercial partitions, or a root row without a password or active access key.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_user_hardware_m.description: Flags an IAM user when a user has no MFA device, or a device classified as virtual or SMS by its serial-number ARN. It can expand identity privileges, expose credentials, or make unused access available to an attacker.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_user_hardware_m.pass_when: PASS when the user has an MFA device and all devices classify as hardware.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_user_hardware_m.fail_when: FAIL when a user has no MFA device, or a device classified as virtual or SMS by its serial-number ARN.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_user_inline_no_.description: Flags an IAM user when an applicable user inline policy for this user grants administrative access under the Prowler policy expansion test. It can expand identity privileges, expose credentials, or make unused access available to an attacker.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_user_inline_no_.pass_when: PASS when no applicable user inline policy meets that administrative-access test.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_user_inline_no_.fail_when: FAIL when an applicable user inline policy for this user grants administrative access under the Prowler policy expansion test.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_user_inline_no_.not_applicable_when: When there are no relevant policy documents on this identity.

aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_user_inline_no_.description: Flags an IAM user when an applicable user inline policy grants all CloudTrail actions on wildcard resources. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_user_inline_no_.pass_when: PASS when no applicable user inline policy grants all CloudTrail actions on wildcard resources.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_user_inline_no_.fail_when: FAIL when an applicable user inline policy grants all CloudTrail actions on wildcard resources.
aws.claude_a.iam.prowler_user_inline_no_.not_applicable_when: When there are no relevant policy documents on this identity.
