aws.claude_a.vpc.subnet_no_auto_public_i.description: Flags a subnet when MapPublicIpOnLaunch is true. New instances launched there may automatically receive public IPv4 addresses.
aws.claude_a.vpc.subnet_no_auto_public_i.pass_when: PASS when MapPublicIpOnLaunch is true is false.

aws.claude_a.vpc.subnets_in_multiple_azs.description: Flags a VPC when its subnets span at most one distinct AvailabilityZone. A single zone outage can remove all subnet capacity for the VPC.
aws.claude_a.vpc.subnets_in_multiple_azs.pass_when: PASS when its subnets span at most one distinct AvailabilityZone is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.subnets_in_multiple_azs.fail_when: FAIL when its subnets span at most one distinct AvailabilityZone.

aws.claude_a.vpc.vpc_endpoint_ec2.description: Flags a VPC when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ec2 service. Clients may need public or NAT routes to reach ec2, increasing exposure and dependency on internet egress.
aws.claude_a.vpc.vpc_endpoint_ec2.pass_when: PASS when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ec2 service is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.vpc_endpoint_ec2.fail_when: FAIL when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ec2 service.

aws.claude_a.vpc.vpc_has_subnets.description: Flags a VPC when no subnet has a matching VpcId. The VPC cannot host workload interfaces until a subnet is created.
aws.claude_a.vpc.vpc_has_subnets.pass_when: PASS when no subnet has a matching VpcId is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.vpc_has_subnets.fail_when: FAIL when no subnet has a matching VpcId.

aws.claude_a.vpc.vpcs_in_multiple_region.description: Flags the account VPC inventory when VPCs occur in at most one Region. A regional incident can affect all deployed VPC network capacity.
aws.claude_a.vpc.vpcs_in_multiple_region.pass_when: PASS when VPCs occur in at most one Region is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.vpcs_in_multiple_region.fail_when: FAIL when VPCs occur in at most one Region.

aws.claude_a.vpc.vpn_both_tunnels_up.description: Flags a VPN connection when VpnConnection.Telemetry has two tunnels but fewer than two report Status UP. One failed tunnel removes redundancy; two failures interrupt the private link.
aws.claude_a.vpc.vpn_both_tunnels_up.pass_when: PASS when VpnConnection.Telemetry has two tunnels but fewer than two report Status UP is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.vpn_both_tunnels_up.fail_when: FAIL when VpnConnection.Telemetry has two tunnels but fewer than two report Status UP.

aws.claude_a.vpc.vpn_tunnel_logging.description: Flags a VPN connection when none of its tunnel options has logging enabled. Tunnel failures and negotiation events may be unavailable for diagnosis.
aws.claude_a.vpc.vpn_tunnel_logging.pass_when: PASS when none of its tunnel options has logging enabled is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.vpn_tunnel_logging.fail_when: FAIL when none of its tunnel options has logging enabled.

aws.cloudtrail.kms_encryption.description: Flags a cloudtrail when KmsKeyId is empty. Trail log objects may lack the selected customer KMS key protection.
aws.cloudtrail.kms_encryption.pass_when: PASS when KmsKeyId is empty is false.

aws.cloudtrail.log_validation.description: Flags an cloudtrail when LogFileValidationEnabled is false rather than true. Altered log files may go undetected during forensic review.

aws.cloudtrail.logging.description: Flags an cloudtrail when Status.IsLogging is false rather than true. API activity can go unrecorded while the trail is stopped.

aws.cloudtrail.management_events.description: Flags a CloudTrail trail when none of its basic EventSelectors includes management events with ReadWriteType All and no excluded management event sources. Management API reads or writes can be absent from the audit trail.
aws.cloudtrail.management_events.pass_when: PASS when none of its basic EventSelectors includes management events with ReadWriteType All and no excluded management event sources is false.
aws.cloudtrail.management_events.fail_when: FAIL when no basic selector covers all read and write management events; advanced selectors return MANUAL for review.

aws.cloudtrail.multi_region.description: Flags an cloudtrail when IsMultiRegionTrail is false rather than true. API calls in other Regions can escape this trail.

aws.config.service_linked_role.description: Flags a recording AWS Config recorder when roleARN differs from the expected AWSServiceRoleForConfig ARN for its account. Config may be operating with an unnecessarily broad custom role.
aws.config.service_linked_role.pass_when: PASS when roleARN differs from the expected AWSServiceRoleForConfig ARN for its account is false.
aws.config.service_linked_role.fail_when: FAIL when roleARN differs from the expected AWSServiceRoleForConfig ARN for its account.
aws.config.service_linked_role.not_applicable_when: The configuration recorder is not recording.

aws.ebs.encryption.description: Flags an ebs volume when Encrypted is false rather than true. A copied or exposed volume snapshot can reveal plaintext block data.

aws.ec2.imdsv2.description: Flags an EC2 instance with its metadata endpoint enabled when MetadataOptions.HttpTokens is optional. A server-side request forgery path could fetch instance-role credentials through tokenless IMDSv1.
aws.ec2.imdsv2.pass_when: PASS when the metadata endpoint is disabled or HttpTokens is required.

aws.ec2.restrict_internet_ingress.description: Flags a security group when any ingress IpRanges.CidrIp or Ipv6Ranges.CidrIpv6 has a zero-length prefix. The rule admits the entire IPv4 or IPv6 internet to its declared protocol and ports; actual reachability is not tested.
aws.ec2.restrict_internet_ingress.pass_when: PASS when any ingress IpRanges.CidrIp or Ipv6Ranges.CidrIpv6 has a zero-length prefix is false.
aws.ec2.restrict_internet_ingress.fail_when: FAIL when any ingress IpRanges.CidrIp or Ipv6Ranges.CidrIpv6 has a zero-length prefix.

aws.ecr.immutable_tags.description: Flags an ecr repository when imageTagMutability is MUTABLE rather than IMMUTABLE. A pushed image can replace the bytes behind a trusted deployment tag.

aws.ecr.lifecycle_policy.description: Flags an ECR repository when LifecyclePolicy is explicitly absent or its lifecyclePolicyText is empty. Old images can accumulate and preserve vulnerable code or consume storage.
aws.ecr.lifecycle_policy.pass_when: PASS when LifecyclePolicy is explicitly absent or its lifecyclePolicyText is empty is false.
aws.ecr.lifecycle_policy.fail_when: FAIL when LifecyclePolicy is explicitly absent or its lifecyclePolicyText is empty.

aws.ecr.scan_on_push.description: Flags an ecr repository when imageScanningConfiguration.scanOnPush is false rather than true. New vulnerable container images may reach workloads before any scan.

aws.eks.control_plane_logging.description: Flags an EKS cluster when enabled clusterLogging rows do not collectively contain api, audit, authenticator, controllerManager, and scheduler. Kubernetes API or authentication activity may be missing from incident evidence.
aws.eks.control_plane_logging.pass_when: PASS when enabled clusterLogging rows do not collectively contain api, audit, authenticator, controllerManager, and scheduler is false.
aws.eks.control_plane_logging.fail_when: FAIL when enabled clusterLogging rows do not collectively contain api, audit, authenticator, controllerManager, and scheduler.

aws.eks.private_endpoint.description: Flags an eks cluster when Cluster.cluster.resourcesVpcConfig.endpointPrivateAccess is false rather than true. The Kubernetes API endpoint lacks a private VPC access path.

aws.eks.secrets_encryption.description: Flags an EKS cluster before version 1.28 when its encryptionConfig does not list the secrets resource. Kubernetes Secret values may lack explicit envelope encryption with the chosen key.
aws.eks.secrets_encryption.pass_when: PASS when encryptionConfig lists secrets, or version 1.28+ supplies the reviewed service default.
aws.eks.secrets_encryption.fail_when: FAIL when its encryptionConfig does not list the secrets resource.

aws.elbv2.access_logging.description: Flags a load balancer when Attributes.Attributes has access_logs.s3.enabled set to false. Requests through the application load balancer may not be logged.
aws.elbv2.access_logging.pass_when: PASS when Attributes.Attributes has access_logs.s3.enabled set to false is false.
aws.elbv2.access_logging.fail_when: FAIL when Attributes.Attributes has access_logs.s3.enabled set to false.

aws.elbv2.deletion_protection.description: Flags a load balancer when Attributes.Attributes has deletion_protection.enabled set to false. A mistaken DeleteLoadBalancer call can interrupt traffic.
aws.elbv2.deletion_protection.pass_when: PASS when Attributes.Attributes has deletion_protection.enabled set to false is false.
aws.elbv2.deletion_protection.fail_when: FAIL when Attributes.Attributes has deletion_protection.enabled set to false.

aws.elbv2.desync_mitigation.description: Flags an application load balancer when routing.http.desync_mitigation_mode is neither strictest nor defensive and routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled is false. Ambiguous HTTP requests can be interpreted differently by the load balancer and backend, enabling request smuggling.
aws.elbv2.desync_mitigation.pass_when: PASS when routing.http.desync_mitigation_mode is neither strictest nor defensive and routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled is false is false.
aws.elbv2.desync_mitigation.fail_when: FAIL when routing.http.desync_mitigation_mode is neither strictest nor defensive and routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled is false.
aws.elbv2.desync_mitigation.not_applicable_when: The load balancer Type is not application.

aws.elbv2.drop_invalid_headers.description: Flags an application load balancer when Attributes.Attributes has routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled set to false. Malformed headers can be forwarded to backends and enable request parsing attacks.
aws.elbv2.drop_invalid_headers.pass_when: PASS when Attributes.Attributes has routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled set to false is false.
aws.elbv2.drop_invalid_headers.fail_when: FAIL when Attributes.Attributes has routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled set to false.
aws.elbv2.drop_invalid_headers.not_applicable_when: The load balancer Type is not application.

aws.elbv2.multiple_availability_zones.description: Flags a load balancer when AvailabilityZones contains fewer than two distinct ZoneName values. A zone outage can take down the only serving zone.
aws.elbv2.multiple_availability_zones.pass_when: PASS when AvailabilityZones contains fewer than two distinct ZoneName values is false.
aws.elbv2.multiple_availability_zones.fail_when: FAIL when AvailabilityZones contains fewer than two distinct ZoneName values.

aws.gap.accessanalyzer.no_active_finding.description: Flags an ACTIVE IAM Access Analyzer when its Findings.items include a finding with status ACTIVE. An unresolved analyzer finding may represent external or unused access to an AWS resource.
aws.gap.accessanalyzer.no_active_finding.pass_when: PASS when its Findings.items include a finding with status ACTIVE is false.
aws.gap.accessanalyzer.no_active_finding.fail_when: FAIL when its Findings.items include a finding with status ACTIVE.
aws.gap.accessanalyzer.no_active_finding.not_applicable_when: The analyzer status is not ACTIVE.

aws.gap.account.distinct_primary_billing.description: Flags account contact details when the primary, billing, operations, and security contacts fail the evaluator’s distinct-address or presence checks. A single missing or shared contact can prevent the right team from receiving billing or security notices.

aws.gap.account.distinct_primary_billing.fail_when: FAIL when the primary, billing, operations, and security contacts fail the evaluator’s distinct-address or presence checks.

aws.gap.classic_elb.ssl_listeners_use_ac.description: Flags a Classic Load Balancer with HTTPS/SSL listeners when a secure listener SSLCertificateId does not start with the account’s ACM certificate ARN prefix. aws.htbp.cognito.client_no_writable_auth.description: Flags a Cognito user pool when a collected app client can write an authorization-like custom claim (including plan) that is mutable, or an immutable claim during allowed self-service signup. Omitted WriteAttributes is Cognito broad default access when the client detail is complete. Attribute names are a risk heuristic; the application authorization use must be reviewed. Empty explicit write lists remain UNKNOWN because their response semantics are unverified.
aws.htbp.cognito.client_no_writable_auth.pass_when: PASS only with a complete nonempty client inventory and complete schema when every evaluated client has no writable authorization-like custom claim; explicit safe fields such as email remain allowed.
aws.htbp.cognito.client_no_writable_auth.fail_when: FAIL on any definitively writable mutable authorization-like custom claim, including through omitted default WriteAttributes; an immutable such claim also fails when self-service signup is explicitly allowed. Known failures dominate other incomplete client details.
aws.htbp.cognito.client_no_writable_auth.not_applicable_when: A complete empty client inventory is NOT_APPLICABLE. Missing/malformed/denied schema or client detail, incomplete inventory without a definite failure, and an immutable writable claim without resolved signup/federation conditions are UNKNOWN. An explicit empty WriteAttributes list is UNKNOWN until its API semantics are established.

aws.htbp.cognito.identity_pool_classic_f.description: Flags a Cognito identity pool when Configuration.AllowClassicFlow is true. A client can call AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity directly and bypass enhanced-flow credential scope-down.
aws.htbp.cognito.identity_pool_classic_f.pass_when: PASS when Configuration.AllowClassicFlow is true is false.

aws.htbp.ecr.creation_template_policy_tr.description: Flags an ECR registry when a repository creation template policy has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary. New repositories under the template prefix inherit public or external image access. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.ecr.creation_template_policy_tr.pass_when: PASS when a repository creation template policy has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary is false.
aws.htbp.ecr.creation_template_policy_tr.fail_when: FAIL when a repository creation template policy has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary.

aws.htbp.ecr.registry_policy_trust_bound.description: Flags an ECR registry when RegistryPolicy.policyText has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary. Outside principals may replicate or access registry images. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.ecr.registry_policy_trust_bound.pass_when: PASS when RegistryPolicy.policyText has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary is false.
aws.htbp.ecr.registry_policy_trust_bound.fail_when: FAIL when RegistryPolicy.policyText has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary.

aws.htbp.ecr.replication_destinations_tr.description: Flags an ECR registry when Replication.rules[].destinations[].registryId names a proven account outside the trust boundary. Matching images are copied into an external registry. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.ecr.replication_destinations_tr.pass_when: PASS when Replication.rules[].destinations[].registryId names a proven account outside the trust boundary is false.
aws.htbp.ecr.replication_destinations_tr.fail_when: FAIL when Replication.rules[].destinations[].registryId names a proven account outside the trust boundary.

aws.htbp.ecs.exec_session_logging_not_di.description: Flags an ECS cluster when Configuration.clusters[0].configuration.executeCommandConfiguration.logging equals NONE. Interactive ECS Exec commands may have no retained session transcript; DEFAULT is accepted even though task log configuration is separate.
aws.htbp.ecs.exec_session_logging_not_di.pass_when: PASS when Configuration.clusters[0].configuration.executeCommandConfiguration.logging equals NONE is false.

aws.htbp.ecs.no_sensitive_host_mounts.description: Flags an ECS task definition when a container mountPoints.sourceVolume references a host volume whose sourcePath is /, a Docker/containerd socket, or another listed sensitive host path. Container code may read host files or control the runtime, potentially gaining host-level access.
aws.htbp.ecs.no_sensitive_host_mounts.pass_when: PASS when a container mountPoints.sourceVolume references a host volume whose sourcePath is /, a Docker/containerd socket, or another listed sensitive host path is false.
aws.htbp.ecs.no_sensitive_host_mounts.fail_when: FAIL when a container mountPoints.sourceVolume references a host volume whose sourcePath is /, a Docker/containerd socket, or another listed sensitive host path.

aws.htbp.eks.access_entries_authenticati.description: Flags an EKS cluster when Cluster.cluster.accessConfig.authenticationMode equals CONFIG_MAP. The cluster creator can retain hidden system:masters access through legacy authentication.
aws.htbp.eks.access_entries_authenticati.pass_when: PASS when authenticationMode is API; API_AND_CONFIG_MAP returns MANUAL because legacy mappings remain.

aws.htbp.eks.access_entry_principal_trus.description: Flags an EKS access entry when principalArn belongs to a proven account outside the trust boundary. An outsider IAM principal could authenticate to the cluster using the access entry. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.eks.access_entry_principal_trus.pass_when: PASS when principalArn belongs to a proven account outside the trust boundary is false.
aws.htbp.eks.access_entry_principal_trus.fail_when: FAIL when principalArn belongs to a proven account outside the trust boundary.

aws.htbp.glue.dev_endpoint_not_public.description: Flags a Glue development endpoint when PublicAddress is nonempty. A reachable SSH endpoint can be taken over by someone able to add an SSH public key through Glue.
aws.htbp.glue.dev_endpoint_not_public.pass_when: PASS when PublicAddress is nonempty is false.

aws.htbp.kms.grant_grantee_trust_boundar.description: Flags a KMS grant when GranteePrincipal is an IAM account or ARN from a proven account outside the trust boundary. The grantee can perform granted cryptographic operations until the grant is retired or revoked. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.kms.grant_grantee_trust_boundar.pass_when: PASS when the grantee is a service principal or an account within the trust boundary.
aws.htbp.kms.grant_grantee_trust_boundar.fail_when: FAIL when GranteePrincipal is an IAM account or ARN from a proven account outside the trust boundary.

aws.htbp.lambda.env_var_names_not_creden.description: Flags a Lambda function when EnvironmentVariableNames.names includes a name matching SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, PASSWORD, PASSWD, PRIVATE_KEY, or CLIENT_SECRET without a reference suffix. Configuration readers may obtain literal credentials if the matching variable holds one; only names are collected.
aws.htbp.lambda.env_var_names_not_creden.pass_when: PASS when EnvironmentVariableNames.names includes a name matching SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, PASSWORD, PASSWD, PRIVATE_KEY, or CLIENT_SECRET without a reference suffix is false.
aws.htbp.lambda.env_var_names_not_creden.fail_when: FAIL when EnvironmentVariableNames.names includes a name matching SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, PASSWORD, PASSWD, PRIVATE_KEY, or CLIENT_SECRET without a reference suffix.

aws.htbp.lambda.layer_version_trust_boun.description: Flags a Lambda layer version when Policy.Policy has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary. Outside principals can download the layer code and any bundled secrets. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.lambda.layer_version_trust_boun.pass_when: PASS when Policy.Policy has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary is false.
aws.htbp.lambda.layer_version_trust_boun.fail_when: FAIL when Policy.Policy has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary.

aws.htbp.lambda.runtime_updates_not_pinn.description: Flags a Lambda function when RuntimeManagement.UpdateRuntimeOn equals Manual. A runtime version can stay pinned after security fixes become available.
aws.htbp.lambda.runtime_updates_not_pinn.pass_when: PASS when RuntimeManagement.UpdateRuntimeOn equals Manual is false.
aws.htbp.lambda.runtime_updates_not_pinn.not_applicable_when: RuntimeManagement is explicitly absent, such as for a container-image function.

aws.htbp.opensearch.connection_peer_trus.description: Flags a live OpenSearch cross-cluster connection when the remote peer for outbound or local peer for inbound has AWSDomainInformation.OwnerId in a proven outside account. Queries or indexed data can cross into an untrusted account. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.opensearch.connection_peer_trus.pass_when: PASS when the remote peer for outbound or local peer for inbound has AWSDomainInformation.OwnerId in a proven outside account is false.
aws.htbp.opensearch.connection_peer_trus.fail_when: FAIL when the remote peer for outbound or local peer for inbound has AWSDomainInformation.OwnerId in a proven outside account.
aws.htbp.opensearch.connection_peer_trus.not_applicable_when: StatusCode is validation failed, rejecting, rejected, deleting, or deleted.

aws.htbp.sagemaker.notebook_imdsv2_requi.description: Flags a SageMaker notebook instance when InstanceMetadataServiceConfiguration.MinimumInstanceMetadataServiceVersion equals 1. Tokenless IMDSv1 requests from notebook code or SSRF may expose execution-role credentials.

aws.iam.access_key_count.description: Flags an IAM user when more than one AccessKeys.items row has Status Active. Extra live long-lived credentials expand the set of secrets that can be stolen.
aws.iam.access_key_count.pass_when: PASS when more than one AccessKeys.items row has Status Active is false.
aws.iam.access_key_count.fail_when: FAIL when more than one AccessKeys.items row has Status Active.

aws.iam.console_mfa.description: Flags an IAM user with a LoginProfile when MFADevices is empty. A stolen console password alone can access the user account.
aws.iam.console_mfa.pass_when: PASS when MFADevices is empty is false.
aws.iam.console_mfa.not_applicable_when: The user has no console LoginProfile.

aws.iam.no_full_admin.description: Flags an IAM policy when an unconditional Allow statement combines Action * and Resource *. The policy grants unrestricted administrative API access.
aws.iam.no_full_admin.pass_when: PASS when an unconditional Allow statement combines Action * and Resource * is false.
aws.iam.no_full_admin.fail_when: FAIL for an unconditional Allow Action * on Resource *; conditional wildcard grants return MANUAL.

aws.iam.no_root_keys.description: Flags an iam account summary when SummaryMap.AccountAccessKeysPresent is 1 rather than 0. A root access key provides long-lived unrestricted account credentials.

aws.iam.password_lowercase.description: Flags an iam password policy when PasswordPolicy.RequireLowercaseCharacters is false rather than true. A weaker character policy increases the usefulness of password guessing.

aws.iam.password_max_age.description: Flags the IAM account password policy when PasswordPolicy.MaxPasswordAge is 0 or above 90. Old passwords can stay valid after disclosure.
aws.iam.password_max_age.pass_when: PASS when MaxPasswordAge is between 1 and 90.
aws.iam.password_max_age.fail_when: FAIL when PasswordPolicy.MaxPasswordAge is 0 or above 90.

aws.iam.password_minimum_length.description: Flags the IAM account password policy when PasswordPolicy.MinimumPasswordLength is below 14. Short passwords are easier to brute-force or guess.
aws.iam.password_minimum_length.pass_when: PASS when MinimumPasswordLength is at least 14.

aws.iam.password_numbers.description: Flags an iam password policy when PasswordPolicy.RequireNumbers is false rather than true. A weaker character policy increases the usefulness of password guessing.

aws.iam.password_reuse_prevention.description: Flags the IAM account password policy when PasswordPolicy.PasswordReusePrevention is not 24. Previously compromised passwords can be reused sooner.

aws.iam.password_symbols.description: Flags an iam password policy when PasswordPolicy.RequireSymbols is false rather than true. A weaker character policy increases the usefulness of password guessing.

aws.iam.password_uppercase.description: Flags an iam password policy when PasswordPolicy.RequireUppercaseCharacters is false rather than true. A weaker character policy increases the usefulness of password guessing.

aws.iam.restrict_public_trust.description: Flags an IAM role when AssumeRolePolicyDocument contains an unconditional Allow statement with a wildcard principal. Any principal matched by the trust policy may be able to assume the role.
aws.iam.restrict_public_trust.pass_when: PASS when AssumeRolePolicyDocument contains an unconditional Allow statement with a wildcard principal is false.
aws.iam.restrict_public_trust.fail_when: FAIL for unconditional wildcard-principal Allow statements; conditioned wildcard statements alone return MANUAL.

aws.iam.root_mfa.description: Flags the root row of an IAM credential report when a root password or either access key is active and mfa_active is false. A stolen root credential can control the whole account without a second factor.
aws.iam.root_mfa.pass_when: PASS when a root password or either access key is active and mfa_active is false is false.
aws.iam.root_mfa.fail_when: FAIL when a root password or either access key is active and mfa_active is false.
aws.iam.root_mfa.not_applicable_when: The row is not root, or root has no active password or access key.

aws.kms.no_pending_key_deletion.description: Flags a KMS key when Metadata.KeyMetadata.KeyState is PendingDeletion. When deletion completes, ciphertext protected by the key becomes unrecoverable.
aws.kms.no_pending_key_deletion.pass_when: PASS when Metadata.KeyMetadata.KeyState is PendingDeletion is false.
aws.kms.no_pending_key_deletion.not_applicable_when: KeyManager is AWS or KeyState is Disabled.

aws.kms.rotation.description: Flags a customer managed symmetric AWS_KMS-origin key when Rotation.KeyRotationEnabled is false. Long-lived key material increases the impact of key compromise.
aws.kms.rotation.pass_when: PASS when Rotation.KeyRotationEnabled is false is false.
aws.kms.rotation.not_applicable_when: The key is AWS-managed, external-origin, or not SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT.

aws.lambda.dead_letter_queue.description: Flags a Lambda function when DeadLetterConfig has no nonempty TargetArn. Asynchronous invocation failures may be lost without a durable failure destination.
aws.lambda.dead_letter_queue.pass_when: PASS when DeadLetterConfig has no nonempty TargetArn is false.
aws.lambda.dead_letter_queue.fail_when: FAIL when DeadLetterConfig has no nonempty TargetArn.

aws.lambda.function_url_authentication.description: Flags a Lambda function with a URL when FunctionUrl.AuthType is NONE. The URL itself accepts unauthenticated requests; resource permissions are evaluated separately.
aws.lambda.function_url_authentication.pass_when: PASS when FunctionUrl.AuthType is NONE is false.

aws.lambda.vpc_configuration.description: Flags a lambda function when VpcConfig.VpcId is empty. The function cannot use the intended private VPC resources or egress controls.
aws.lambda.vpc_configuration.pass_when: PASS when VpcConfig.VpcId is empty is false.

aws.logs.retention.description: Flags a CloudWatch log group when retentionInDays is omitted. Logs never expire automatically, increasing storage cost and retained sensitive data.
aws.logs.retention.pass_when: PASS when retentionInDays is omitted is false.

aws.rds.auto_minor_upgrade.description: Flags an rds instance when AutoMinorVersionUpgrade is false rather than true. Known engine defects may remain unpatched on the database instance.

aws.rds.backups.description: Flags a non-replica RDS instance when BackupRetentionPeriod is zero. There is no automated recovery window after accidental deletion or corruption.
aws.rds.backups.pass_when: PASS when BackupRetentionPeriod is zero is false.
aws.rds.backups.not_applicable_when: The instance is a read replica.

aws.rds.cloudwatch_log_exports.description: Flags an RDS instance when EnabledCloudwatchLogsExports is an empty list. Database engine logs may be unavailable for detection and investigation.
aws.rds.cloudwatch_log_exports.pass_when: PASS when EnabledCloudwatchLogsExports is an empty list is false.
aws.rds.cloudwatch_log_exports.fail_when: FAIL when EnabledCloudwatchLogsExports is an empty list.

aws.rds.cluster_copy_snapshot_tags.description: Flags an rds cluster when CopyTagsToSnapshot is false rather than true. Snapshots may lose classification or ownership tags needed for access and inventory controls.

aws.rds.cluster_deletion_protection.description: Flags an rds cluster when DeletionProtection is false rather than true. A mistaken or malicious DeleteDBCluster call can remove the database.

aws.rds.cluster_encryption.description: Flags an rds cluster when StorageEncrypted is false rather than true. Stored cluster data and snapshots may lack the configured at-rest protection.

aws.rds.cluster_iam_authentication.description: Flags an rds cluster when IAMDatabaseAuthenticationEnabled is false rather than true. Database clients may rely only on long-lived database passwords.

aws.rds.cluster_multi_az.description: Flags an rds cluster when MultiAZ is false rather than true. A single Availability Zone failure may interrupt the cluster.

aws.rds.copy_snapshot_tags.description: Flags a non-Aurora RDS instance when CopyTagsToSnapshot is false. Created snapshots may lose ownership or classification tags.
aws.rds.copy_snapshot_tags.pass_when: PASS when CopyTagsToSnapshot is false is false.
aws.rds.copy_snapshot_tags.not_applicable_when: Engine is aurora, aurora-mysql, or aurora-postgresql.

aws.rds.deletion_protection.description: Flags an rds instance when DeletionProtection is false rather than true. A mistaken or malicious DeleteDBInstance call can remove the database.

aws.rds.encryption.description: Flags an rds instance when StorageEncrypted is false rather than true. Stored instance data and snapshots may lack the configured at-rest protection.

aws.rds.enhanced_monitoring.description: Flags a rds instance when EnhancedMonitoringResourceArn is empty. OS-level metrics may be unavailable when diagnosing suspicious database activity.
aws.rds.enhanced_monitoring.pass_when: PASS when EnhancedMonitoringResourceArn is empty is false.

aws.rds.no_public_endpoint.description: Flags an RDS instance when PubliclyAccessible is true. The database endpoint can receive public addressing, increasing exposure if network rules permit access.
aws.rds.no_public_endpoint.pass_when: PASS when PubliclyAccessible is true is false.

aws.rds.snapshot_encryption.description: Flags an rds snapshot when Encrypted is false rather than true. A shared or copied snapshot may expose database data without at-rest encryption.

aws.rds.vpc_configuration.description: Flags a rds instance when DBSubnetGroup.VpcId is empty. The database may lack the intended VPC network isolation.
aws.rds.vpc_configuration.pass_when: PASS when DBSubnetGroup.VpcId is empty is false.

aws.s3.access_logging.description: Flags an S3 bucket when Logging.LoggingEnabled is absent. Server access records may be unavailable to investigate requests to the bucket.
aws.s3.access_logging.pass_when: PASS when Logging.LoggingEnabled is absent is false.

aws.s3.default_encryption.description: The bucket evaluator reads Encryption.ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration.Rules and accepts only AES256, aws:kms, or aws:kms:dsse algorithms. It never emits FAIL: missing or unrecognized encryption evidence becomes UNKNOWN, so this check cannot establish whether new objects lack default encryption.
aws.s3.default_encryption.pass_when: PASS when collected rules contain a recognized encryption algorithm.
aws.s3.default_encryption.fail_when: Never FAIL; missing, absent, or unrecognized rule data returns UNKNOWN.

aws.s3.no_public_acl.description: The bucket ACL evaluator searches Grantee.URI for the AllUsers or AuthenticatedUsers global groups. Such grants can expose objects, but the check returns MANUAL because account and bucket IgnorePublicAcls and Object Ownership determine whether they are effective.
aws.s3.no_public_acl.pass_when: PASS when neither public group URI appears in the ACL.
aws.s3.no_public_acl.fail_when: Never FAIL; a public ACL grant returns MANUAL for effective-access review.

aws.s3.public_access_block.description: Flags an S3 bucket when at least one of the four public-access-block flags is false at both bucket and account levels. A public ACL or policy may be admitted when its corresponding block is disabled.
aws.s3.public_access_block.pass_when: PASS when at least one of the four public-access-block flags is false at both bucket and account levels is false.
aws.s3.public_access_block.fail_when: FAIL when at least one of the four public-access-block flags is false at both bucket and account levels.

aws.s3.versioning.description: Flags an S3 bucket when Versioning.Status is Suspended or absent. Overwritten or deleted objects may not have recoverable prior versions.
aws.s3.versioning.pass_when: PASS when Versioning.Status is Suspended or absent is false.
aws.s3.versioning.fail_when: FAIL when Versioning.Status is Suspended or absent.

aws.secretsmanager.rotation.description: Flags an secret when RotationEnabled is false rather than true. A leaked secret can remain usable until someone rotates it manually.

aws.sns.kms_encryption.description: Flags a sns topic when Attributes.Attributes.KmsMasterKeyId is empty. Messages in the topic may lack the selected KMS key protection.
aws.sns.kms_encryption.pass_when: PASS when Attributes.Attributes.KmsMasterKeyId is empty is false.

aws.sqs.encryption.description: Flags an SQS queue when SqsManagedSseEnabled is false and KmsMasterKeyId is empty. Queued message bodies may lack at-rest encryption.
aws.sqs.encryption.pass_when: PASS when SQS-managed SSE is true or a KMS master key ID is present.
aws.sqs.encryption.fail_when: FAIL when SqsManagedSseEnabled is false and KmsMasterKeyId is empty.

azure.aks.api_server_restricted.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when the API is public and `authorizedIPRanges` is empty or effectively unrestricted. This permits unsolicited access attempts against the Kubernetes control plane.
azure.aks.api_server_restricted.pass_when: PASS when the API endpoint is private or has a non-global authorized IP range.
azure.aks.api_server_restricted.fail_when: FAIL when the API is public and `authorizedIPRanges` is empty or effectively unrestricted.

azure.aks.auto_upgrade.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `upgradeChannel` is none or empty. Kubernetes fixes may wait indefinitely for manual upgrade scheduling.
azure.aks.auto_upgrade.pass_when: PASS when a rapid, stable, patch, or node-image channel is configured.
azure.aks.auto_upgrade.fail_when: FAIL when `upgradeChannel` is none or empty.

azure.aks.azure_rbac.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.aadProfile.enableAzureRBAC` is false. Kubernetes permissions may be governed outside Azure role assignments.

azure.aks.defender_monitoring.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.securityProfile.defender.securityMonitoring.enabled` is false. AKS threats may not generate Defender telemetry.
azure.aks.defender_monitoring.pass_when: PASS when Defender monitoring is enabled.

azure.aks.network_policy.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when the network dataplane is not Cilium and `networkPolicy` is none or empty. Pod-to-pod traffic lacks a configured network policy engine.
azure.aks.network_policy.pass_when: PASS when the dataplane is Cilium or networkPolicy names azure, calico, or cilium.
azure.aks.network_policy.fail_when: FAIL when the network dataplane is not Cilium and `networkPolicy` is none or empty.

azure.aks.no_local_accounts.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.disableLocalAccounts` is false. Local cluster credentials can bypass centralized Entra identity controls.

azure.aks.private_cluster.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.apiServerAccessProfile.enablePrivateCluster` is false. The Kubernetes API endpoint remains reachable from public networks.

azure.aks.rbac.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.enableRBAC` is false. Kubernetes API users can operate without role-based authorization.

azure.app.client_certificates.description: For an App Service app, the evaluator flags FAIL when client certificates are disabled or `clientCertMode` is not Required. Clients can connect without a required certificate.
azure.app.client_certificates.pass_when: PASS when client certificates are enabled and mode is Required.
azure.app.client_certificates.fail_when: FAIL when client certificates are disabled or the recognized client certificate mode is Optional or OptionalInteractiveUser.

azure.app.cors_no_wildcards.description: For an App Service configuration, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.cors.allowedOrigins` includes `*`. Any website can make browser CORS requests to the app if other protections allow it.
azure.app.cors_no_wildcards.pass_when: PASS when the allowed origin list excludes `*`.

azure.app.ftps_only.description: For an App Service configuration, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.ftpsState` is AllAllowed. Plain FTP can expose deployment credentials and files in transit.
azure.app.ftps_only.pass_when: PASS when the state is FtpsOnly or Disabled.

azure.app.http2.description: For an App Service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.http20Enabled` is false. The app remains on the older HTTP/1 transport path configured by this control.

azure.app.https_only.description: For an App Service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.httpsOnly` is false. Clients can send requests over plaintext HTTP.
azure.app.https_only.pass_when: PASS when HTTPS-only routing is enabled.

azure.app.minimum_tls.description: For an App Service configuration, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.minTlsVersion` is 1.0 or 1.1. Clients may negotiate a protocol with known weaknesses.
azure.app.minimum_tls.pass_when: PASS when minimum TLS is 1.2 or 1.3.

azure.app.remote_debugging_off.description: For an App Service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.remoteDebuggingEnabled` is true. A reachable debugger can reveal process state and secrets.
azure.app.remote_debugging_off.pass_when: PASS when remote debugging is disabled.

azure.app.request_logging.description: For an App Service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.httpLoggingEnabled` is false. Requests may leave no record for abuse or incident reconstruction.
azure.app.request_logging.pass_when: PASS when HTTP request logging is enabled.

azure.app.scm_minimum_tls.description: For an App Service configuration, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.scmMinTlsVersion` is 1.0 or 1.1. Deployment credentials and artifacts can traverse weak TLS.
azure.app.scm_minimum_tls.pass_when: PASS when the deployment endpoint requires TLS 1.2 or 1.3.

azure.claude.acr_admin_user_disabled.description: For an Azure Container Registry, the evaluator flags FAIL when `adminUserEnabled` is true. A shared registry credential can be reused outside Entra role controls.
azure.claude.acr_admin_user_disabled.pass_when: PASS when the registry admin user is disabled.

azure.claude.acr_cmk.description: For a container registry, the evaluator checks only properties.encryption.status: enabled passes and disabled fails. It does not inspect the encryption key source or key identity.
azure.claude.acr_cmk.pass_when: PASS when encryption status is enabled.

azure.claude.acr_geo_replication.description: For an Azure Container Registry, the evaluator flags FAIL when a Premium registry reports zero or one replication entry. A regional outage can interrupt image pulls or deployment.
azure.claude.acr_geo_replication.pass_when: PASS when its replication list has at least two entries.
azure.claude.acr_geo_replication.fail_when: FAIL when a Premium registry reports zero or one replication entry.
azure.claude.acr_geo_replication.not_applicable_when: The registry SKU is not Premium.

azure.claude.acr_network_default_deny.description: For an Azure Container Registry, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.networkRuleSet.defaultAction` is 'Allow'. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.

azure.claude.acr_private_endpoint_presen.description: For a container registry, the evaluator requires a privateEndpointConnections entry containing properties.privateEndpoint.id. Approval state is not checked.
azure.claude.acr_private_endpoint_presen.pass_when: PASS when at least one connection references a private endpoint ID, regardless of approval state.
azure.claude.acr_private_endpoint_presen.fail_when: FAIL when the registry has no private endpoint connection with a nonempty endpoint ID.

azure.claude.acr_private_link_approved.description: For an Azure Container Registry, the evaluator flags FAIL when none of the registry private endpoint connections has status `Approved`. An unapproved connection cannot carry private registry traffic.
azure.claude.acr_private_link_approved.pass_when: PASS when at least one private endpoint connection is `Approved`.
azure.claude.acr_private_link_approved.fail_when: FAIL when none of the registry private endpoint connections has status `Approved`.

azure.claude.acr_public_network_access_d.description: For an Azure Container Registry, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.publicNetworkAccess` is 'Enabled'. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.

azure.claude.acr_quarantine_policy.description: For an Azure Container Registry, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.policies.quarantinePolicy.status` is 'disabled'. Security defects can remain undetected or unpatched.

azure.claude.acr_retention_policy.description: For an Azure Container Registry, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.policies.retentionPolicy.status` is 'disabled'. An outage or deletion can leave data unavailable or unrecoverable.

azure.claude.acr_trust_policy.description: For an Azure Container Registry, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.policies.trustPolicy.status` is 'disabled'. Security defects can remain undetected or unpatched.

azure.claude.acr_vnet_service_endpoint.description: For an Azure Container Registry, the evaluator flags FAIL when the registry default action is Allow or it has no virtual network rule IDs. Registry access is not confined to the declared subnet allowlist.
azure.claude.acr_vnet_service_endpoint.pass_when: PASS when default action is Deny and at least one virtual network rule has a subnet ID.
azure.claude.acr_vnet_service_endpoint.fail_when: FAIL when the registry default action is Allow or it has no virtual network rule IDs.

azure.claude.activity_log_alert_nsg_dele.description: For the complete activity log alert inventory, the evaluator passes if any enabled alert has an operationName condition for either current or Classic Network NSG deletion. It does not require Global location or subscription scope.

azure.claude.activity_log_storage_privat.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when `index.storage_account[].data.properties.allowBlobPublicAccess` is true. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.

azure.claude.aks_authorized_ip_ranges.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when a public API endpoint has no `authorizedIPRanges`. Unrestricted API reachability increases the chance of credential attacks against the control plane.
azure.claude.aks_authorized_ip_ranges.pass_when: PASS when a public API endpoint has at least one authorized IP range.
azure.claude.aks_authorized_ip_ranges.fail_when: FAIL when a public API endpoint has no `authorizedIPRanges`.
azure.claude.aks_authorized_ip_ranges.not_applicable_when: The AKS API endpoint is private.

azure.claude.aks_azure_policy_addon.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when the `azurepolicy` add-on is absent or disabled. Kubernetes policy assignments cannot be enforced in the cluster by that add-on.
azure.claude.aks_azure_policy_addon.pass_when: PASS when the `azurepolicy` add-on is enabled.
azure.claude.aks_azure_policy_addon.fail_when: FAIL when the `azurepolicy` add-on is absent or disabled.

azure.claude.aks_container_insights_logg.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when the `omsagent` add-on is disabled or lacks a non-null config object. Cluster logs and metrics may not be sent to monitoring.
azure.claude.aks_container_insights_logg.pass_when: PASS when `omsagent` is enabled and has a config object.
azure.claude.aks_container_insights_logg.fail_when: FAIL when the `omsagent` add-on is disabled or lacks a non-null config object.

azure.claude.aks_disk_encryption_set.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.diskEncryptionSetID` is null or absent. AKS node disks lack a specified customer-managed encryption key.
azure.claude.aks_disk_encryption_set.pass_when: PASS when a nonempty disk encryption set ID is configured.
azure.claude.aks_disk_encryption_set.fail_when: FAIL when `properties.diskEncryptionSetID` is null or absent.

azure.claude.aks_encryption_at_host.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when any agent pool lacks `enableEncryptionAtHost=true`. Node temporary disks and cache data can remain outside host encryption protection.
azure.claude.aks_encryption_at_host.pass_when: PASS when every agent pool enables encryption at host.
azure.claude.aks_encryption_at_host.fail_when: FAIL when any agent pool lacks `enableEncryptionAtHost=true`.

azure.claude.aks_http_application_routin.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator passes when the httpApplicationRouting add-on is absent or disabled and fails when it is enabled.
azure.claude.aks_http_application_routin.pass_when: PASS when the add-on is absent or disabled.
azure.claude.aks_http_application_routin.fail_when: FAIL when the HTTP application routing add-on is enabled.

azure.claude.aks_max_pods_at_least_50.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when any agent pool sets `maxPods` below 50. Low pod density can force unnecessary node expansion and reduce workload placement flexibility.
azure.claude.aks_max_pods_at_least_50.pass_when: PASS when every agent pool permits at least 50 pods per node.
azure.claude.aks_max_pods_at_least_50.fail_when: FAIL when any agent pool sets `maxPods` below 50.

azure.claude.aks_network_plugin_azure.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.networkProfile.networkPlugin` is 'kubenet' or 'none'. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.

azure.claude.aks_network_policy_configur.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator reads networkProfile.networkPolicy. Azure, Calico, or Cilium passes; none or an omitted field fails when networkProfile is present.
azure.claude.aks_network_policy_configur.pass_when: PASS when the declared network policy engine is `azure`, `calico`, or `cilium`.
azure.claude.aks_network_policy_configur.fail_when: FAIL when networkPolicy is none or omitted from a collected networkProfile.

azure.claude.aks_node_public_ip_disabled.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.agentPoolProfiles[].enableNodePublicIP` is true. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.

azure.claude.aks_paid_sku_tier.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator accepts Standard, Premium, and Paid SKU tiers and fails the Free tier; other tier strings are UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.aks_paid_sku_tier.pass_when: PASS when sku.tier is Standard, Premium, or Paid.

azure.claude.aks_secret_store_rotation.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.addonProfiles.azureKeyvaultSecretsProvider.config.enableSecretRotation` is 'false'. Security defects can remain undetected or unpatched.

azure.claude.aks_version_not_cve_2019_99.description: For an AKS cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when the Kubernetes version is 1.10 or older, 1.11 through patch 8, 1.12 through patch 6, or 1.13 through patch 4. The cluster may retain the known CVE-2019-9946 exposure.
azure.claude.aks_version_not_cve_2019_99.pass_when: PASS when the parsed version is outside those affected ranges.
azure.claude.aks_version_not_cve_2019_99.fail_when: FAIL when the Kubernetes version is 1.10 or older, 1.11 through patch 8, 1.12 through patch 6, or 1.13 through patch 4.

azure.claude.bastion_host_exists.description: For a bastion host, the evaluator flags FAIL when the complete subscription inventory contains zero Bastion hosts. Administrators may rely on public SSH or RDP paths to reach VMs.
azure.claude.bastion_host_exists.pass_when: PASS when at least one Bastion host is inventoried.
azure.claude.bastion_host_exists.fail_when: FAIL when the complete subscription inventory contains zero Bastion hosts.
