azure.claude.container_group_cmk.pass_when: PASS when the encryption properties include a Key Vault URL and key name.
azure.claude.container_group_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when `properties.encryptionProperties` is null or lacks a nonempty Key Vault URL or key name.

azure.claude.container_group_managed_ide.description: For a container group with a collected containers list, the evaluator passes when identity.type declares any system- or user-assigned managed identity and fails when it declares none.
azure.claude.container_group_managed_ide.pass_when: PASS when identity.type includes SystemAssigned or UserAssigned.
azure.claude.container_group_managed_ide.fail_when: FAIL when identity.type is None or no identity is declared.

azure.claude.container_group_secure_envi.description: For a container group, the evaluator flags FAIL when any container environment variable has a non-null plain `value`. Secrets supplied as plain values can appear in container configuration and diagnostics.
azure.claude.container_group_secure_envi.pass_when: PASS when no environment variable uses the plain value field.
azure.claude.container_group_secure_envi.fail_when: FAIL when any container environment variable has a non-null plain `value`.

azure.claude.container_group_virtual_net.description: For a container group, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.subnetIds` is null or contains no subnet ID. The container group has no declared private subnet placement.
azure.claude.container_group_virtual_net.pass_when: PASS when at least one subnet ID is present.
azure.claude.container_group_virtual_net.fail_when: FAIL when `properties.subnetIds` is null or contains no subnet ID.

azure.claude.cosmos_automatic_failover.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.enableAutomaticFailover` is false. An outage or deletion can leave data unavailable or unrecoverable.

azure.claude.cosmos_cmk.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator checks whether properties.keyVaultKeyUri is a nonempty string. An omitted or null URI fails only when databaseAccountOfferType proves the properties object was returned; otherwise the result is UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.cosmos_cmk.pass_when: PASS when properties.keyVaultKeyUri is a nonempty string.
azure.claude.cosmos_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when keyVaultKeyUri is null or omitted from an otherwise returned account properties object.

azure.claude.cosmos_continuous_backup.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.backupPolicy.type` is 'Periodic'. An outage or deletion can leave data unavailable or unrecoverable.

azure.claude.cosmos_cors_no_wildcard.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator flags FAIL when any CORS entry includes `*` in allowedOrigins. Untrusted websites can read browser-accessible responses when credentials and server rules permit it.
azure.claude.cosmos_cors_no_wildcard.pass_when: PASS when no CORS entry allows the wildcard origin.
azure.claude.cosmos_cors_no_wildcard.fail_when: FAIL when any CORS entry includes `*` in allowedOrigins.

azure.claude.cosmos_key_based_metadata_w.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator flags FAIL when `disableKeyBasedMetadataWriteAccess` is false. A leaked account key can change Cosmos DB metadata without Entra authorization.
azure.claude.cosmos_key_based_metadata_w.pass_when: PASS when key-based metadata writes are disabled.

azure.claude.cosmos_local_auth_disabled.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator flags FAIL when `disableLocalAuth` is false. Anyone with an account key can authenticate outside Entra identity policy.
azure.claude.cosmos_local_auth_disabled.pass_when: PASS when local key authentication is disabled.

azure.claude.cosmos_minimum_tls12.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.minimalTlsVersion` is 'Tls' or 'Tls11'. Connections can use weaker transport protection.

azure.claude.cosmos_network_restricted.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator flags FAIL when public access is Enabled while `isVirtualNetworkFilterEnabled=false` and `ipRules` is empty. Any Internet source can reach the account endpoint and attempt authentication.
azure.claude.cosmos_network_restricted.pass_when: PASS when public access is disabled, the VNet filter is enabled, or an IP rule exists.
azure.claude.cosmos_network_restricted.fail_when: FAIL when public access is Enabled while `isVirtualNetworkFilterEnabled=false` and `ipRules` is empty.

azure.claude.cosmos_private_endpoint_pre.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator passes when at least one privateEndpointConnections entry has a privateEndpoint.id. Connection approval is not tested.
azure.claude.cosmos_private_endpoint_pre.pass_when: PASS when at least one private endpoint connection has a privateEndpoint.id, regardless of approval status.
azure.claude.cosmos_private_endpoint_pre.fail_when: FAIL when no private endpoint connection has an ID.

azure.claude.cosmos_public_network_acces.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator fails when publicNetworkAccess is Enabled or SecuredByPerimeter; only Disabled passes. This checks the configured public access mode.
azure.claude.cosmos_public_network_acces.pass_when: PASS when public network access is Disabled.
azure.claude.cosmos_public_network_acces.fail_when: FAIL when properties.publicNetworkAccess is Enabled or SecuredByPerimeter.

azure.claude.cosmos_public_network_acces.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator passes when publicNetworkAccess is Disabled or SecuredByPerimeter and fails when it is Enabled.
azure.claude.cosmos_public_network_acces.pass_when: PASS when properties.publicNetworkAccess is Disabled or SecuredByPerimeter.

azure.claude.cosmos_virtual_network_filt.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.isVirtualNetworkFilterEnabled` is false. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.

azure.claude.cosmos_vnet_service_endpoin.description: For a Cosmos DB account, the evaluator checks properties.virtualNetworkRules for at least one rule with an id. It does not test whether the service endpoint is effective.
azure.claude.cosmos_vnet_service_endpoin.pass_when: PASS when at least one virtual network rule contains a subnet id.
azure.claude.cosmos_vnet_service_endpoin.fail_when: FAIL when the virtual network rules list is empty.

azure.claude.databox_edge_double_encrypt.description: For a databox edge device, the evaluator flags FAIL when `sku.name` is outside the evaluator’s supported double-encryption SKU list. The selected device model may lack the hardware-backed second encryption layer.
azure.claude.databox_edge_double_encrypt.pass_when: PASS when `sku.name` is one of the explicitly listed supported SKUs.
azure.claude.databox_edge_double_encrypt.fail_when: FAIL when `sku.name` is outside the evaluator’s supported double-encryption SKU list.

azure.claude.databricks_diagnostic_log_d.description: For a databricks workspace, the evaluator flags FAIL when a Premium workspace lacks any of the six enabled categories: clusters, accounts, jobs, notebook, workspace, or sqlPermissions. Missing categories leave cluster actions or notebook and workspace changes outside the audit trail.
azure.claude.databricks_diagnostic_log_d.pass_when: PASS when all six categories are enabled, directly or through `allLogs`.
azure.claude.databricks_diagnostic_log_d.fail_when: FAIL when a Premium workspace lacks any of the six enabled categories: clusters, accounts, jobs, notebook, workspace, or sqlPermissions.
azure.claude.databricks_diagnostic_log_d.not_applicable_when: The workspace SKU is standard or trial.

azure.claude.databricks_managed_disk_cmk.description: For a databricks workspace, the evaluator flags FAIL when the workspace has no nonempty `managedDisk.keyVaultProperties` object. Workspace managed disks lack a declared customer key reference.
azure.claude.databricks_managed_disk_cmk.pass_when: PASS when the managed disk encryption entity has a nonempty Key Vault properties object.
azure.claude.databricks_managed_disk_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when the workspace has no nonempty `managedDisk.keyVaultProperties` object.

azure.claude.databricks_subnet_nsg.description: For a databricks workspace, the evaluator flags FAIL when either named customer VNet subnet has no associated network security group. Traffic into the Databricks host or container subnet can bypass intended network rules.
azure.claude.databricks_subnet_nsg.pass_when: PASS when both named customer VNet subnets have NSG references.
azure.claude.databricks_subnet_nsg.fail_when: FAIL when either named customer VNet subnet has no associated network security group.
azure.claude.databricks_subnet_nsg.not_applicable_when: The workspace uses a Databricks-managed virtual network.

azure.claude.databricks_vnet_injection_v.description: For a Databricks workspace, the evaluator requires a nonempty customVirtualNetworkId.value. It fails when that parameter is empty, null, or omitted from a populated parameters object.
azure.claude.databricks_vnet_injection_v.pass_when: PASS when properties.parameters.customVirtualNetworkId.value is any nonempty string.
azure.claude.databricks_vnet_injection_v.fail_when: FAIL when customVirtualNetworkId.value is empty or null, or the parameter is omitted from a populated parameters object.

azure.claude.defender_alert_notification.description: For a subscription, the evaluator independently looks for any contact with role notifications On and any contact with an Alert source whose minimalSeverity is exactly High. The two conditions may be met by different contacts.
azure.claude.defender_alert_notification.pass_when: PASS when a contact has role notifications On and a contact has an Alert source with `minimalSeverity=High`.
azure.claude.defender_alert_notification.fail_when: FAIL when no contact combination has role notifications on and an Alert source at exactly `High` severity.
azure.claude.defender_alert_notification.not_applicable_when: The anchor is not a subscription.

azure.claude.defender_alerts_to_owner.description: For a security contact, the evaluator flags FAIL when no security contact has notificationsByRole On with Owner in its roles. Owners may miss Defender alerts requiring account-level response.
azure.claude.defender_alerts_to_owner.pass_when: PASS when a contact enables notifications for the Owner role.
azure.claude.defender_alerts_to_owner.fail_when: FAIL when no security contact has notificationsByRole On with Owner in its roles.
azure.claude.defender_alerts_to_owner.not_applicable_when: The anchor is not a subscription.

azure.claude.defender_assessment_endpoin.description: For a security assessment, the evaluator flags FAIL when the named endpoint protection assessment has any `Unhealthy` status. Machines without endpoint protection can run malware without detection.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_endpoin.pass_when: PASS when the named assessment exists and all statuses are Healthy or NotApplicable.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_endpoin.fail_when: FAIL when the named endpoint protection assessment has any `Unhealthy` status.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_endpoin.not_applicable_when: The named assessment is not reported for this subscription.

azure.claude.defender_assessment_running.description: For a security assessment, the evaluator flags FAIL when the running container image assessment reports any `Unhealthy` status. Known flaws in deployed container images can remain exploitable.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_running.pass_when: PASS when the assessment is reported and no applicable image is Unhealthy.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_running.fail_when: FAIL when the running container image assessment reports any `Unhealthy` status.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_running.not_applicable_when: The assessment is absent or all reported statuses are NotApplicable.

azure.claude.defender_assessment_system_.description: For a security assessment, the evaluator flags FAIL when any of the three named agent, update-check, or missing-update assessments is `Unhealthy`. Missing updates or update telemetry can leave exploitable host flaws in place.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_system_.pass_when: PASS when all three named assessments are present without an Unhealthy status.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_system_.fail_when: FAIL when any of the three named agent, update-check, or missing-update assessments is `Unhealthy`.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_system_.not_applicable_when: Any named assessment is not reported for this subscription.

azure.claude.defender_assessment_vulnera.description: For a security assessment, the evaluator flags FAIL when the named machine vulnerability assessment solution has any `Unhealthy` status. Missing vulnerability tooling can leave machine flaws unknown.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_vulnera.pass_when: PASS when the named assessment exists without Unhealthy statuses.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_vulnera.fail_when: FAIL when the named machine vulnerability assessment solution has any `Unhealthy` status.
azure.claude.defender_assessment_vulnera.not_applicable_when: The named assessment is not reported for this subscription.

azure.claude.defender_attack_path_notifi.description: For a Defender security contact, the evaluator examines AttackPath notification sources and passes if any has a minimum risk level of Low, Medium, or High. It fails if no such source exists or all are Critical.
azure.claude.defender_attack_path_notifi.pass_when: PASS when an AttackPath source accepts Low, Medium, or High risk.
azure.claude.defender_attack_path_notifi.fail_when: FAIL when there is no AttackPath source or every AttackPath source requires Critical risk.

azure.claude.defender_contact_has_email.description: For a Defender security contact, the evaluator splits properties.emails on semicolons and requires at least one nonblank entry.
azure.claude.defender_contact_has_email.pass_when: PASS when properties.emails contains at least one nonblank semicolon-delimited entry.
azure.claude.defender_contact_has_email.fail_when: FAIL when properties.emails has no nonblank entry.

azure.claude.defender_container_registry.description: For a Defender pricing plans, the evaluator flags FAIL when the `ContainerRegistry` Defender pricing row is `Free`. Registry threats and vulnerabilities may lack Defender coverage.
azure.claude.defender_container_registry.fail_when: FAIL when the `ContainerRegistry` Defender pricing row is `Free`.
azure.claude.defender_container_registry.not_applicable_when: The `ContainerRegistry` pricing row is absent or marked deprecated.

azure.claude.defender_container_registry.description: For a Defender pricing plans, the evaluator flags FAIL when the Containers plan is Free or its ContainerRegistriesVulnerabilityAssessments extension is not enabled. Vulnerable registry images may not be identified before deployment.
azure.claude.defender_container_registry.pass_when: PASS when the Containers plan is Standard and that extension is enabled.
azure.claude.defender_container_registry.fail_when: FAIL when the Containers plan is Free or its ContainerRegistriesVulnerabilityAssessments extension is not enabled.
azure.claude.defender_container_registry.not_applicable_when: The Containers plan is absent from the complete pricing inventory.

azure.claude.defender_database_plans_sta.description: For a Defender pricing plans, the evaluator flags FAIL when any of SqlServers, SqlServerVirtualMachines, OpenSourceRelationalDatabases, or CosmosDbs has `pricingTier=Free`. Database threat alerts may be absent for the free plan.
azure.claude.defender_database_plans_sta.pass_when: PASS when all four listed database plans are `Standard`.
azure.claude.defender_database_plans_sta.fail_when: FAIL when any of SqlServers, SqlServerVirtualMachines, OpenSourceRelationalDatabases, or CosmosDbs has `pricingTier=Free`.
azure.claude.defender_database_plans_sta.not_applicable_when: Any of the four database plan rows is absent.

azure.claude.defender_default_initiative.description: For a subscription, the evaluator finds SecurityCenterBuiltIn assignments in the complete policy-assignment inventory and fails if any parameter value is Disabled. It skips non-subscription anchors.
azure.claude.defender_default_initiative.pass_when: PASS when no parameter on the matching initiative assignments is Disabled.
azure.claude.defender_default_initiative.fail_when: FAIL when any SecurityCenterBuiltIn assignment parameter has `value=Disabled`.
azure.claude.defender_default_initiative.not_applicable_when: The anchor is not a subscription.

azure.claude.defender_default_policy_enf.description: For a complete policy-assignment inventory, the evaluator selects SecurityCenterBuiltIn assignments. It passes if none has DoNotEnforce, fails if any does, and skips when there are no such assignments.
azure.claude.defender_default_policy_enf.pass_when: PASS when the default initiative assignments are enforced.
azure.claude.defender_default_policy_enf.fail_when: FAIL when a SecurityCenterBuiltIn policy assignment has `enforcementMode=DoNotEnforce`.
azure.claude.defender_default_policy_enf.not_applicable_when: No SecurityCenterBuiltIn assignment is visible in the complete scope inventory.

azure.claude.defender_dns_plan_standard.description: For a Defender pricing plans, the evaluator flags FAIL when the `Dns` Defender pricing row is `Free`. Suspicious DNS activity may go undetected.
azure.claude.defender_dns_plan_standard.fail_when: FAIL when the `Dns` Defender pricing row is `Free`.
azure.claude.defender_dns_plan_standard.not_applicable_when: The `Dns` pricing row is absent or marked deprecated.

azure.claude.defender_iot_security_solut.description: For a subscription, the evaluator fails if any collected Defender for IoT security solution is Disabled and passes when all collected solutions are Enabled. An empty inventory yields MANUAL.
azure.claude.defender_iot_security_solut.pass_when: PASS when all collected IoT security solutions are Enabled.
azure.claude.defender_iot_security_solut.fail_when: FAIL when any collected IoT security solution is Disabled.
azure.claude.defender_iot_security_solut.not_applicable_when: The anchor scope is not a subscription; an empty solution inventory instead yields MANUAL.

azure.claude.defender_kubernetes_plan_st.description: For a Defender pricing plans, the evaluator flags FAIL when the `KubernetesService` Defender pricing row is `Free`. Cluster threat detection may be unavailable.
azure.claude.defender_kubernetes_plan_st.fail_when: FAIL when the `KubernetesService` Defender pricing row is `Free`.
azure.claude.defender_kubernetes_plan_st.not_applicable_when: The `KubernetesService` pricing row is absent or marked deprecated.

azure.claude.defender_plan_standard_any.description: For a Defender pricing plans, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.pricingTier` is 'Free'. Security defects can remain undetected or unpatched.
azure.claude.defender_plan_standard_any.not_applicable_when: The pricing row is marked deprecated by Microsoft.

azure.claude.defender_security_contact_e.description: For a subscription, the evaluator passes if exactly one default security contact has a nonblank email or any non-default contact exists. It fails otherwise.
azure.claude.defender_security_contact_e.pass_when: PASS when the default contact has an email or any non-default contact exists.
azure.claude.defender_security_contact_e.fail_when: FAIL when the default contact has no email and no non-default contact exists.
azure.claude.defender_security_contact_e.not_applicable_when: The anchor is not a subscription.

azure.claude.disk_access_private_link.description: For a disk access, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointConnections` is empty; `properties.privateEndpointConnections[].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status` is absent. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.
azure.claude.disk_access_private_link.fail_when: FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointConnections` is empty; `properties.privateEndpointConnections[].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status` is absent.

azure.claude.disk_attached_cmk.description: For a disk, the evaluator flags FAIL when an attached or reserved disk has `properties.encryption.type` outside EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey, EncryptionAtRestWithPlatformAndCustomerKeys. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.
azure.claude.disk_attached_cmk.pass_when: PASS when an attached or reserved disk uses EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey or EncryptionAtRestWithPlatformAndCustomerKeys.
azure.claude.disk_attached_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when an attached or reserved disk has `properties.encryption.type` outside EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey, EncryptionAtRestWithPlatformAndCustomerKeys.
azure.claude.disk_attached_cmk.not_applicable_when: The disk is not in Attached or Reserved state.

azure.claude.disk_attached_customer_key.description: For a disk, the evaluator flags FAIL when an Attached or Reserved disk does not use exactly EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey. Platform-only encryption leaves the disk outside direct customer key control.
azure.claude.disk_attached_customer_key.pass_when: PASS when an Attached or Reserved disk uses exactly EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey.
azure.claude.disk_attached_customer_key.fail_when: FAIL when an Attached or Reserved disk does not use exactly EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey.
azure.claude.disk_attached_customer_key.not_applicable_when: The disk is not Attached or Reserved.

azure.claude.disk_attached_double_encryp.description: For a disk, the evaluator flags FAIL when an attached or reserved disk has `properties.encryption.type` outside EncryptionAtRestWithPlatformAndCustomerKeys. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.
azure.claude.disk_attached_double_encryp.pass_when: PASS when an attached or reserved disk uses EncryptionAtRestWithPlatformAndCustomerKeys.
azure.claude.disk_attached_double_encryp.fail_when: FAIL when an attached or reserved disk has `properties.encryption.type` outside EncryptionAtRestWithPlatformAndCustomerKeys.
azure.claude.disk_attached_double_encryp.not_applicable_when: The disk is not in Attached or Reserved state.

azure.claude.disk_unattached_cmk.description: For a disk, the evaluator flags FAIL when an unattached disk has `properties.encryption.type` outside EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey, EncryptionAtRestWithPlatformAndCustomerKeys. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.
azure.claude.disk_unattached_cmk.pass_when: PASS when an unattached disk uses EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey or EncryptionAtRestWithPlatformAndCustomerKeys.
azure.claude.disk_unattached_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when an unattached disk has `properties.encryption.type` outside EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey, EncryptionAtRestWithPlatformAndCustomerKeys.
azure.claude.disk_unattached_cmk.not_applicable_when: The disk is Attached or Reserved.

azure.claude.disk_unattached_customer_ke.description: For a disk, the evaluator flags FAIL when an unattached disk does not use exactly EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey. A copied idle disk may remain decryptable through provider-managed keys.
azure.claude.disk_unattached_customer_ke.pass_when: PASS when an unattached disk uses exactly EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey.
azure.claude.disk_unattached_customer_ke.fail_when: FAIL when an unattached disk does not use exactly EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey.
azure.claude.disk_unattached_customer_ke.not_applicable_when: The disk is Attached or Reserved.

azure.claude.entra_app_credential_not_ex.description: For a directory application, the evaluator flags FAIL when any password or key credential has no end date or expires within 30 days of the snapshot. An expired credential can break automation; one without an end date can persist after compromise.
azure.claude.entra_app_credential_not_ex.pass_when: PASS when every credential has an end date more than 30 days away.
azure.claude.entra_app_credential_not_ex.fail_when: FAIL when any password or key credential has no end date or expires within 30 days of the snapshot.
azure.claude.entra_app_credential_not_ex.not_applicable_when: The application has no password or key credentials.

azure.claude.entra_auth_methods_strong_r.description: For an authentication methods policy, the evaluator flags FAIL when the registration campaign is not enabled or no enabled strong method is present. Users may remain unregistered for phishing-resistant or stronger MFA.
azure.claude.entra_auth_methods_strong_r.pass_when: PASS when the campaign is enabled and at least one strong method is enabled.
azure.claude.entra_auth_methods_strong_r.fail_when: FAIL when the registration campaign is not enabled or no enabled strong method is present.

azure.claude.entra_ca_mfa_admin_portals.description: For an Entra tenant, the evaluator flags FAIL when no enabled Conditional Access policy includes All users, MicrosoftAdminPortals, and an MFA grant. Admin portal credentials can be used without a declared MFA requirement.
azure.claude.entra_ca_mfa_admin_portals.pass_when: PASS when an enabled policy matches that user, app, and grant combination.
azure.claude.entra_ca_mfa_admin_portals.fail_when: FAIL when no enabled Conditional Access policy includes All users, MicrosoftAdminPortals, and an MFA grant.
azure.claude.entra_ca_mfa_admin_portals.not_applicable_when: The policy inventory belongs to another tenant.

azure.claude.entra_ca_mfa_management_api.description: For an Entra tenant, the evaluator flags FAIL when no enabled Conditional Access policy includes All users, the Azure management API app, and an MFA grant. Stolen credentials can call Azure management APIs without a declared MFA gate.
azure.claude.entra_ca_mfa_management_api.pass_when: PASS when an enabled policy matches that user, app, and grant combination.
azure.claude.entra_ca_mfa_management_api.fail_when: FAIL when no enabled Conditional Access policy includes All users, the Azure management API app, and an MFA grant.
azure.claude.entra_ca_mfa_management_api.not_applicable_when: The policy inventory belongs to another tenant.

azure.claude.entra_ca_policy_requires_mf.description: For a Conditional Access policy, the evaluator passes when grantControls.builtInControls includes the literal mfa and fails otherwise. It reads policy state for evidence but does not require the policy to be enabled.
azure.claude.entra_ca_policy_requires_mf.pass_when: PASS when builtInControls includes mfa, regardless of policy state.
azure.claude.entra_ca_policy_requires_mf.fail_when: FAIL when builtInControls does not include mfa.

azure.claude.entra_global_admin_fewer_th.description: For an Entra tenant, the evaluator flags FAIL when five or more distinct principals hold active tenant-root Global Administrator assignments. Each extra Global Administrator is another path to tenant-wide compromise.
azure.claude.entra_global_admin_fewer_th.pass_when: PASS when fewer than five distinct principals hold those active assignments.
azure.claude.entra_global_admin_fewer_th.fail_when: FAIL when five or more distinct principals hold active tenant-root Global Administrator assignments.
azure.claude.entra_global_admin_fewer_th.not_applicable_when: The assignment inventory belongs to another tenant.

azure.claude.entra_guest_access_restrict.description: For Entra directory authorization policy, the evaluator compares guestUserRoleId with the restricted guest role GUID. Other recognized guest role GUIDs fail.
azure.claude.entra_guest_access_restrict.pass_when: PASS when guestUserRoleId is the restricted guest role GUID 2af84b1e-32c8-42b7-82bc-daa82404023b.
azure.claude.entra_guest_access_restrict.fail_when: FAIL when guestUserRoleId is another recognized guest role GUID.

azure.claude.entra_guest_invites_admins_.description: For Entra directory authorization policy, the evaluator accepts allowInvitesFrom=none or adminsAndGuestInviters and fails adminsGuestInvitersAndAllMembers or everyone.
azure.claude.entra_guest_invites_admins_.pass_when: PASS when allowInvitesFrom is none or adminsAndGuestInviters.
azure.claude.entra_guest_invites_admins_.fail_when: FAIL when allowInvitesFrom is adminsGuestInvitersAndAllMembers or everyone.

azure.claude.entra_m365_group_creation_r.description: For an Entra tenant, the evaluator flags FAIL when Group.Unified is absent or its EnableGroupCreation value is `true`. Ordinary users can create groups that add collaboration and data-sharing surfaces.
azure.claude.entra_m365_group_creation_r.pass_when: PASS when the unique Group.Unified setting has EnableGroupCreation set to false.
azure.claude.entra_m365_group_creation_r.fail_when: FAIL when Group.Unified is absent or its EnableGroupCreation value is `true`.
azure.claude.entra_m365_group_creation_r.not_applicable_when: The directory setting inventory belongs to another tenant.

azure.claude.entra_named_location_truste.description: For a named location, the evaluator flags FAIL when an IP named location has `isTrusted=false`. Conditional Access policies relying on trusted locations may treat corporate ranges incorrectly.
azure.claude.entra_named_location_truste.pass_when: PASS when the IP named location has `isTrusted=true`.
azure.claude.entra_named_location_truste.fail_when: FAIL when an IP named location has `isTrusted=false`.
azure.claude.entra_named_location_truste.not_applicable_when: The item is a country named location.

azure.claude.entra_non_privileged_user_m.description: For an Entra user, the evaluator flags FAIL when an enabled user without an active directory role has `isMfaCapable=false`. A stolen password may be enough to access the nonprivileged account.
azure.claude.entra_non_privileged_user_m.pass_when: PASS when that user is MFA capable.
azure.claude.entra_non_privileged_user_m.fail_when: FAIL when an enabled user without an active directory role has `isMfaCapable=false`.
azure.claude.entra_non_privileged_user_m.not_applicable_when: The user is disabled or holds an active directory role.

azure.claude.entra_privileged_user_mfa.description: For an Entra user, the evaluator flags FAIL when a user with an active directory role has `isMfaCapable=false`. A stolen password may grant privileged directory access.
azure.claude.entra_privileged_user_mfa.pass_when: PASS when that role holder is MFA capable.
azure.claude.entra_privileged_user_mfa.fail_when: FAIL when a user with an active directory role has `isMfaCapable=false`.
azure.claude.entra_privileged_user_mfa.not_applicable_when: The user has no active directory role.

azure.claude.entra_security_defaults_ena.description: For a directory security defaults, the evaluator flags FAIL when `isEnabled` is false. An identity can gain or retain unintended access.

azure.claude.entra_trusted_named_locatio.description: For an Entra tenant, the evaluator flags FAIL when the tenant has no trusted IP named location with at least one IP range. Conditional Access cannot use a defined trusted corporate source location.
azure.claude.entra_trusted_named_locatio.pass_when: PASS when an IP named location is trusted and declares a range.
azure.claude.entra_trusted_named_locatio.fail_when: FAIL when the tenant has no trusted IP named location with at least one IP range.
azure.claude.entra_trusted_named_locatio.not_applicable_when: The named-location inventory belongs to another tenant.

azure.claude.entra_user_consent_disabled.description: Checks the Entra default role policy assignments for any recognized, nonempty ManagePermissionGrantsForSelf grant class, case insensitively. Existing application consents are outside this test. Remediation: Remove self-consent policy assignments from the default role and use an admin consent workflow; review existing grants separately.
azure.claude.entra_user_consent_disabled.pass_when: No recognized nonempty self-consent grant is assigned.
azure.claude.entra_user_consent_disabled.fail_when: At least one recognized nonempty self-consent grant is assigned; malformed assignments without a definitive grant are UNKNOWN.

azure.claude.entra_user_consent_not_lega.description: Checks default role self-consent assignments for the exact legacy grant policy, case insensitively. The reviewed low-risk or disabled policy passes; custom or malformed policies need review. Existing consents are not revoked by this setting. Remediation: Replace the legacy self-consent policy with the reviewed low-risk policy or disable self-consent; inspect custom policies and existing grants separately.
azure.claude.entra_user_consent_not_lega.pass_when: No self-consent grant or only the reviewed low-risk self-consent grant is assigned.
azure.claude.entra_user_consent_not_lega.fail_when: The exact legacy self-consent grant is assigned, even if another custom grant is also present; other custom or malformed grants alone are UNKNOWN.

azure.claude.entra_user_recent_sign_in.description: For an Entra user, the evaluator flags FAIL when an enabled user has no recorded sign-in or last signed in more than 90 days before the snapshot. Dormant accounts can be hijacked without an active owner noticing.
azure.claude.entra_user_recent_sign_in.pass_when: PASS when the enabled user signed in within 90 days.
azure.claude.entra_user_recent_sign_in.fail_when: FAIL when an enabled user has no recorded sign-in or last signed in more than 90 days before the snapshot.

azure.claude.entra_users_cannot_create_a.description: For a directory authorization policy, the evaluator flags FAIL when `defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToCreateApps` is true. An identity can gain or retain unintended access.

azure.claude.entra_users_cannot_create_s.description: For a directory authorization policy, the evaluator flags FAIL when `defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToCreateSecurityGroups` is true. An identity can gain or retain unintended access.

azure.claude.entra_users_cannot_create_t.description: For a directory authorization policy, the evaluator flags FAIL when `defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToCreateTenants` is true. An identity can gain or retain unintended access.

azure.claude.entra_vm_access_user_mfa.description: For an Azure role assignment, the evaluator flags FAIL when a User principal holding an Owner, Contributor, or VM login role has `isMfaCapable=false`. A stolen password can enable VM administration or sign-in.
azure.claude.entra_vm_access_user_mfa.pass_when: PASS when the qualifying user is MFA capable.
azure.claude.entra_vm_access_user_mfa.fail_when: FAIL when a User principal holding an Owner, Contributor, or VM login role has `isMfaCapable=false`.
azure.claude.entra_vm_access_user_mfa.not_applicable_when: The assignment is not for a User principal in a VM-access role.

azure.claude.eventgrid_domain_managed_id.description: For an Event Grid domain, the evaluator passes for SystemAssigned, UserAssigned, or their combined identity type and fails for None.
azure.claude.eventgrid_domain_managed_id.pass_when: PASS when identity.type includes SystemAssigned or UserAssigned.

azure.claude.eventgrid_domain_private_li.description: For an eventgrid domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when no approved private endpoint exists while public access is enabled. Event Grid delivery remains reachable over public network paths.
azure.claude.eventgrid_domain_private_li.pass_when: PASS when an endpoint is approved or public network access is disabled.
azure.claude.eventgrid_domain_private_li.fail_when: FAIL when no approved private endpoint exists while public access is enabled.

azure.claude.eventgrid_domain_public_acc.description: For an eventgrid domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.publicNetworkAccess` is 'Enabled'. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.

azure.claude.eventgrid_topic_managed_ide.description: For an Event Grid topic, the evaluator passes for SystemAssigned, UserAssigned, or their combined identity type and fails for None.
azure.claude.eventgrid_topic_managed_ide.pass_when: PASS when identity.type includes SystemAssigned or UserAssigned.

azure.claude.eventgrid_topic_private_lin.description: For an eventgrid topic, the evaluator flags FAIL when no approved private endpoint exists while public access is enabled. Event topic publishers can use a public endpoint.
azure.claude.eventgrid_topic_private_lin.pass_when: PASS when an endpoint is approved or public network access is disabled.
azure.claude.eventgrid_topic_private_lin.fail_when: FAIL when no approved private endpoint exists while public access is enabled.

azure.claude.eventhub_namespace_cmk.description: For an eventhub namespace, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.encryption.keySource` is 'Microsoft.EventHub'. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.

azure.claude.eventhub_namespace_logging.description: For an eventhub namespace, the evaluator flags FAIL when `diagnosticSettings[].properties.logs[].enabled` is false. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.

azure.claude.eventhub_namespace_private_.description: For an eventhub namespace, the evaluator flags FAIL when a non-Basic Event Hubs namespace has no approved private endpoint. Clients must rely on public or other network paths to reach the namespace.
azure.claude.eventhub_namespace_private_.pass_when: PASS when at least one endpoint connection is Approved.
azure.claude.eventhub_namespace_private_.fail_when: FAIL when a non-Basic Event Hubs namespace has no approved private endpoint.

azure.claude.eventhub_namespace_vnet_rul.description: For an eventhub namespace, the evaluator flags FAIL when the namespace has no virtual network rule naming a subnet. The namespace has no subnet-restricted access path.
azure.claude.eventhub_namespace_vnet_rul.pass_when: PASS when a virtual network rule references a subnet.
azure.claude.eventhub_namespace_vnet_rul.fail_when: FAIL when the namespace has no virtual network rule naming a subnet.

azure.claude.fhir_cmk.description: For a healthcare fhir service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.cosmosDbConfiguration.keyVaultKeyUri` is empty or absent. FHIR patient data remains encrypted only with provider-managed keys.
azure.claude.fhir_cmk.pass_when: PASS when a nonempty Key Vault key URI is configured.
azure.claude.fhir_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when `properties.cosmosDbConfiguration.keyVaultKeyUri` is empty or absent.

azure.claude.fhir_private_link.description: For a healthcare fhir service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointConnections` is empty; `properties.privateEndpointConnections[].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status` is absent. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.
azure.claude.fhir_private_link.fail_when: FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointConnections` is empty; `properties.privateEndpointConnections[].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status` is absent.

azure.claude.flow_log_enabled.description: For a flow log, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.enabled` is false. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.

azure.claude.flow_log_traffic_analytics.description: For a flow log, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.flowAnalyticsConfiguration.networkWatcherFlowAnalyticsConfiguration.enabled` is false. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.

azure.claude.frontdoor_waf_policy_linked.description: For a classic Front Door, the evaluator passes when any frontend endpoint has a webApplicationFirewallPolicyLink.id. It fails when no endpoint has such a link; it does not require every endpoint to be linked.
azure.claude.frontdoor_waf_policy_linked.pass_when: PASS when at least one frontend endpoint links a WAF policy ID.
azure.claude.frontdoor_waf_policy_linked.fail_when: FAIL when no frontend endpoint links a WAF policy ID.

azure.claude.gateway_subnet_no_nsg.description: For a subnet, the evaluator flags FAIL when the `GatewaySubnet` has a `networkSecurityGroup` reference. A custom NSG on this reserved subnet can break VPN or ExpressRoute gateway connectivity.
azure.claude.gateway_subnet_no_nsg.pass_when: PASS when `GatewaySubnet` has no NSG reference.
azure.claude.gateway_subnet_no_nsg.fail_when: FAIL when the `GatewaySubnet` has a `networkSecurityGroup` reference.

azure.claude.hdinsight_cmk.description: For a hdinsight cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when no Key Vault URI and key name identify a customer-managed disk key. Cluster data may lack the intended encryption layer.
azure.claude.hdinsight_cmk.pass_when: PASS when the disk encryption properties name a Key Vault key.
azure.claude.hdinsight_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when no Key Vault URI and key name identify a customer-managed disk key.

azure.claude.hdinsight_encryption_at_hos.description: For a hdinsight cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `diskEncryptionProperties.encryptionAtHost` is false. Cluster data may lack the intended encryption layer.
azure.claude.hdinsight_encryption_at_hos.pass_when: PASS when host encryption is enabled.

azure.claude.hdinsight_encryption_in_tra.description: For a hdinsight cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `encryptionInTransitProperties.isEncryptionInTransitEnabled` is false. Cluster data may lack the intended encryption layer.
azure.claude.hdinsight_encryption_in_tra.pass_when: PASS when in-transit encryption is enabled.

azure.claude.hpc_cache_cmk.description: For a hpc cache, the evaluator flags FAIL when no nonempty Key Vault key URL and source vault ID are configured. Cache data has no declared customer-managed key.
azure.claude.hpc_cache_cmk.pass_when: PASS when both key URL and source vault ID are present.
azure.claude.hpc_cache_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when no nonempty Key Vault key URL and source vault ID are configured.

azure.claude.iam_custom_role_administers.description: For a subscription and complete role-definition inventory, the evaluator passes when any CustomRole action starts with Microsoft.Authorization/locks/ and fails otherwise.
azure.claude.iam_custom_role_administers.pass_when: PASS when any CustomRole action starts with Microsoft.Authorization/locks/.
azure.claude.iam_custom_role_administers.fail_when: FAIL when no CustomRole action starts with Microsoft.Authorization/locks/.

azure.claude.iam_custom_role_no_wildcard.description: For a custom role definition, the evaluator fails on a literal * or *:* control-plane action and passes when neither appears. Built-in roles are skipped.
azure.claude.iam_custom_role_no_wildcard.pass_when: PASS when the custom role has no literal `*` action.
azure.claude.iam_custom_role_no_wildcard.fail_when: FAIL when a CustomRole actions list contains the literal * or *:* action.
azure.claude.iam_custom_role_no_wildcard.not_applicable_when: The role definition is built in.

azure.claude.iam_disabled_user_no_owner.description: For an Azure subscription, the evaluator flags FAIL when a disabled directory user still has a subscription-covering Owner assignment. Re-enabling a dormant identity could restore full control over the subscription.
azure.claude.iam_disabled_user_no_owner.pass_when: PASS when no disabled user holds an Owner assignment covering the subscription.
azure.claude.iam_disabled_user_no_owner.fail_when: FAIL when a disabled directory user still has a subscription-covering Owner assignment.

azure.claude.iam_disabled_user_no_role_a.description: For an Azure subscription, the evaluator flags FAIL when a disabled directory user retains any subscription-covering Azure role assignment. A re-enabled identity may immediately regain resource access.
azure.claude.iam_disabled_user_no_role_a.pass_when: PASS when no disabled user retains such a role.
azure.claude.iam_disabled_user_no_role_a.fail_when: FAIL when a disabled directory user retains any subscription-covering Azure role assignment.

azure.claude.iam_external_user_no_owner.description: For an Azure subscription, the evaluator flags FAIL when a guest user has a subscription-covering Owner assignment. An external identity could change any subscription resource or access policy.
azure.claude.iam_external_user_no_owner.pass_when: PASS when no guest user holds Owner at the subscription.
azure.claude.iam_external_user_no_owner.fail_when: FAIL when a guest user has a subscription-covering Owner assignment.

azure.claude.iam_external_user_no_reader.description: For an Azure subscription, the evaluator flags FAIL when a guest user has a subscription-covering Reader assignment. External users could enumerate resource configuration and metadata.
azure.claude.iam_external_user_no_reader.pass_when: PASS when no guest user holds Reader at the subscription.
azure.claude.iam_external_user_no_reader.fail_when: FAIL when a guest user has a subscription-covering Reader assignment.

azure.claude.iam_external_user_no_write.description: For an Azure subscription, the evaluator flags FAIL when a guest user has a subscription-covering Owner or Contributor assignment. An external identity could modify subscription resources.
azure.claude.iam_external_user_no_write.pass_when: PASS when no guest user holds those write-capable roles.
azure.claude.iam_external_user_no_write.fail_when: FAIL when a guest user has a subscription-covering Owner or Contributor assignment.

azure.claude.iam_no_custom_role.description: For a subscription and complete role-definition inventory, the evaluator fails if any definition has properties.type=CustomRole and passes when none does.
azure.claude.iam_no_custom_role.pass_when: PASS when no collected role definition has properties.type=CustomRole.
azure.claude.iam_no_custom_role.fail_when: FAIL when at least one collected role definition has properties.type=CustomRole.

azure.claude.iam_no_user_access_administ.description: For a role assignment, the evaluator extracts the role definition GUID and fails only for the built-in User Access Administrator role; other role GUIDs pass.
azure.claude.iam_no_user_access_administ.pass_when: PASS when the role definition GUID differs from the built-in User Access Administrator GUID.
azure.claude.iam_no_user_access_administ.fail_when: FAIL when the role definition GUID is 18d7d88d-d35e-4fb5-a5c3-7773c20a72d9.

azure.claude.iam_root_custom_role_no_wil.description: For a custom role definition, the evaluator fails only when assignableScopes includes / and actions contains * or *:*. A role without either part passes; built-in roles are skipped.
azure.claude.iam_root_custom_role_no_wil.pass_when: PASS when the custom role lacks a root assignable scope or lacks literal * and *:* actions.
azure.claude.iam_root_custom_role_no_wil.fail_when: FAIL when the custom role has / as an assignable scope and grants * or *:*.
azure.claude.iam_root_custom_role_no_wil.not_applicable_when: The role definition is built in.

azure.claude.iam_subscription_owner_betw.description: For an Azure subscription, the evaluator flags FAIL when the number of distinct Owner principals covering the subscription falls outside 2 through 3. An identity can gain or retain unintended access.
azure.claude.iam_subscription_owner_betw.pass_when: PASS when the Owner principal count is between 2 and 3.
azure.claude.iam_subscription_owner_betw.fail_when: FAIL when the number of distinct Owner principals covering the subscription falls outside 2 through 3.

azure.claude.iam_subscription_owner_max_.description: For an Azure subscription, the evaluator flags FAIL when the number of distinct Owner principals covering the subscription falls outside 0 through 3. An identity can gain or retain unintended access.
azure.claude.iam_subscription_owner_max_.pass_when: PASS when the Owner principal count is between 0 and 3.
azure.claude.iam_subscription_owner_max_.fail_when: FAIL when the number of distinct Owner principals covering the subscription falls outside 0 through 3.

azure.claude.iam_subscription_owner_more.description: For an Azure subscription, the evaluator flags FAIL when the number of distinct Owner principals covering the subscription falls outside 2 through unbounded. An identity can gain or retain unintended access.
azure.claude.iam_subscription_owner_more.pass_when: PASS when the Owner principal count is between 2 and any higher number.
azure.claude.iam_subscription_owner_more.fail_when: FAIL when the number of distinct Owner principals covering the subscription falls outside 2 through unbounded.

azure.claude.iam_subscription_tenant_tra.description: For a subscription tenant policy, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.blockSubscriptionsLeavingTenant` is false. An identity can gain or retain unintended access.

azure.claude.iam_user_no_contributor_ass.description: For an Azure role assignment, the evaluator flags FAIL when a User principal has the built-in Contributor role. A standing Contributor grant permits broad resource changes.
azure.claude.iam_user_no_contributor_ass.pass_when: PASS when the user assignment is to another role.
azure.claude.iam_user_no_contributor_ass.fail_when: FAIL when a User principal has the built-in Contributor role.
azure.claude.iam_user_no_contributor_ass.not_applicable_when: The assignment principal is not a User.

azure.claude.insights_activity_logs_cont.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when the account holding `insights-activity-logs` uses Microsoft.Storage encryption keys. Provider-managed keys limit the customer’s ability to revoke encryption access to exported logs.
azure.claude.insights_activity_logs_cont.fail_when: FAIL when the account holding `insights-activity-logs` uses Microsoft.Storage encryption keys.

azure.claude.insights_activity_logs_cont.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when the `insights-activity-logs` blob container has public access and the account does not block blob public access. Exported log records can be read anonymously when container access is public.
azure.claude.insights_activity_logs_cont.pass_when: PASS when that container is private or the account blocks blob public access.
azure.claude.insights_activity_logs_cont.fail_when: FAIL when the `insights-activity-logs` blob container has public access and the account does not block blob public access.

azure.claude.insights_operational_logs_c.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when the account holding `insights-logs-operationlogs` uses Microsoft.Storage encryption keys. Provider-managed keys limit the customer’s ability to revoke encryption access to exported logs.
azure.claude.insights_operational_logs_c.fail_when: FAIL when the account holding `insights-logs-operationlogs` uses Microsoft.Storage encryption keys.

azure.claude.insights_operational_logs_c.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when the `insights-logs-operationlogs` blob container has public access and the account does not block blob public access. Exported log records can be read anonymously when container access is public.
azure.claude.insights_operational_logs_c.pass_when: PASS when that container is private or the account blocks blob public access.
azure.claude.insights_operational_logs_c.fail_when: FAIL when the `insights-logs-operationlogs` blob container has public access and the account does not block blob public access.

azure.claude.iot_hub_logging.description: For an iot hub, the evaluator flags FAIL when `diagnosticSettings[].properties.logs[].enabled` is false. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.

azure.claude.iot_hub_private_link.description: For an iot hub, the evaluator flags FAIL when a non-Basic IoT Hub has no approved private endpoint. Device and backend traffic has no approved private route to the hub.
azure.claude.iot_hub_private_link.pass_when: PASS when at least one endpoint connection is Approved.
azure.claude.iot_hub_private_link.fail_when: FAIL when a non-Basic IoT Hub has no approved private endpoint.
azure.claude.iot_hub_private_link.not_applicable_when: The IoT Hub uses Basic tier.

azure.claude.keyvault_audit_and_alllogs_.description: For a Key Vault, the evaluator collects enabled diagnostic category groups across its settings and passes when both audit and allLogs occur; otherwise it fails.
azure.claude.keyvault_audit_and_alllogs_.pass_when: PASS when both category groups are enabled.
azure.claude.keyvault_audit_and_alllogs_.fail_when: FAIL when the vault lacks an enabled `audit` or `allLogs` diagnostic category group.

azure.claude.keyvault_audit_logging.description: For a Key Vault, the evaluator passes when a single diagnostic setting enables AuditEvent or enables both audit and allLogs category groups. Otherwise it fails.
azure.claude.keyvault_audit_logging.pass_when: PASS when one diagnostic setting enables AuditEvent or both audit and allLogs groups.
azure.claude.keyvault_audit_logging.fail_when: FAIL when no individual diagnostic setting has AuditEvent or both required groups enabled.

azure.claude.keyvault_certificate_validi.description: For a key vault certificate policy, the evaluator flags FAIL when `x509_props.validity_months` exceeds 12. An exposed private key can remain trusted for an unnecessarily long period.
azure.claude.keyvault_certificate_validi.pass_when: PASS when certificate validity is 12 months or less.

azure.claude.keyvault_firewall_ip_rules.description: For a Key Vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when the vault network ACL has no IP rules. There is no explicit source-IP allowlist on the vault firewall.
azure.claude.keyvault_firewall_ip_rules.pass_when: PASS when at least one IP rule exists.
azure.claude.keyvault_firewall_ip_rules.fail_when: FAIL when the vault network ACL has no IP rules.

azure.claude.keyvault_key_automatic_rota.description: For a Key Vault key, the evaluator flags FAIL when no `Rotate` lifetime action has a `timeAfterCreate` trigger. Keys may remain in use indefinitely after creation.
azure.claude.keyvault_key_automatic_rota.pass_when: PASS when a `Rotate` action has a `timeAfterCreate` trigger.
azure.claude.keyvault_key_automatic_rota.fail_when: FAIL when no `Rotate` lifetime action has a `timeAfterCreate` trigger.

azure.claude.keyvault_key_expiration_set.description: For a Key Vault key, the evaluator flags FAIL when an enabled key has `properties.attributes.exp=null`. A cryptographic key can stay valid without a planned end date.
azure.claude.keyvault_key_expiration_set.pass_when: PASS when an enabled key has a positive expiration timestamp.
azure.claude.keyvault_key_expiration_set.fail_when: FAIL when an enabled key has `properties.attributes.exp=null`.

azure.claude.keyvault_key_rotation_polic.description: For a Key Vault key rotation policy, the evaluator passes if at least one lifetime action has action.type=Rotate and fails otherwise.
azure.claude.keyvault_key_rotation_polic.pass_when: PASS when a `Rotate` lifetime action exists.
azure.claude.keyvault_key_rotation_polic.fail_when: FAIL when the rotation policy has no lifetime action with action `Rotate`.

azure.claude.keyvault_non_rbac_key_expir.description: For a Key Vault key, the evaluator flags FAIL when a key in an access-policy vault has no `exp` timestamp. A stale key can remain usable indefinitely.
azure.claude.keyvault_non_rbac_key_expir.pass_when: PASS when the key declares an expiration timestamp.
azure.claude.keyvault_non_rbac_key_expir.fail_when: FAIL when a key in an access-policy vault has no `exp` timestamp.
azure.claude.keyvault_non_rbac_key_expir.not_applicable_when: The parent vault uses Azure RBAC authorization. The key or secret is disabled.

azure.claude.keyvault_non_rbac_secret_ex.description: For a Key Vault secret metadata, the evaluator flags FAIL when secret metadata in an access-policy vault has no `exp` timestamp. An old secret can continue authenticating clients indefinitely.
azure.claude.keyvault_non_rbac_secret_ex.pass_when: PASS when the secret declares an expiration timestamp.
azure.claude.keyvault_non_rbac_secret_ex.fail_when: FAIL when secret metadata in an access-policy vault has no `exp` timestamp.
azure.claude.keyvault_non_rbac_secret_ex.not_applicable_when: The parent vault uses Azure RBAC authorization. The key or secret is disabled.

azure.claude.keyvault_private_endpoint_e.description: For a Key Vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when the vault has no private endpoint connection of any state. The vault lacks a private network path for clients.
azure.claude.keyvault_private_endpoint_e.pass_when: PASS when at least one private endpoint connection exists.
azure.claude.keyvault_private_endpoint_e.fail_when: FAIL when the vault has no private endpoint connection of any state.

azure.claude.keyvault_private_endpoint_o.description: For a Key Vault with at least one private endpoint connection in any state, the evaluator requires publicNetworkAccess=Disabled. It skips vaults with no connections.
azure.claude.keyvault_private_endpoint_o.pass_when: PASS when public network access is `Disabled`.
azure.claude.keyvault_private_endpoint_o.not_applicable_when: The vault has no private endpoint connection.

azure.claude.keyvault_rbac_key_expiratio.description: For a Key Vault key, the evaluator flags FAIL when a key in an RBAC-enabled vault has no `exp` timestamp. A stale key can remain usable indefinitely.
azure.claude.keyvault_rbac_key_expiratio.pass_when: PASS when the key declares an expiration timestamp.
azure.claude.keyvault_rbac_key_expiratio.fail_when: FAIL when a key in an RBAC-enabled vault has no `exp` timestamp.
azure.claude.keyvault_rbac_key_expiratio.not_applicable_when: The parent vault does not use Azure RBAC authorization. The key or secret is disabled.

azure.claude.keyvault_rbac_secret_expira.description: For a Key Vault secret metadata, the evaluator flags FAIL when secret metadata in an RBAC-enabled vault has no `exp` timestamp. An old secret can continue authenticating clients indefinitely.
azure.claude.keyvault_rbac_secret_expira.pass_when: PASS when the secret declares an expiration timestamp.
azure.claude.keyvault_rbac_secret_expira.fail_when: FAIL when secret metadata in an RBAC-enabled vault has no `exp` timestamp.
azure.claude.keyvault_rbac_secret_expira.not_applicable_when: The parent vault does not use Azure RBAC authorization. The key or secret is disabled.

azure.claude.keyvault_vnet_service_endpo.description: For a Key Vault, the evaluator requires networkAcls.defaultAction=Deny and at least one virtualNetworkRules entry with an id. Either an Allow default or an empty rule list fails.
azure.claude.keyvault_vnet_service_endpo.pass_when: PASS when the default action is Deny and at least one virtual network rule has a subnet id.
azure.claude.keyvault_vnet_service_endpo.fail_when: FAIL when the default action is Allow or no virtual network rule id is present.

azure.claude.kusto_cmk.description: For a kusto cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `keyVaultProperties` is null or lacks a nonempty vault URI and key name. The analytics cluster has no declared customer-managed key.
azure.claude.kusto_cmk.pass_when: PASS when a Key Vault URI and key name are configured.
azure.claude.kusto_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when `keyVaultProperties` is null or lacks a nonempty vault URI and key name.

azure.claude.kusto_disk_encryption.description: For a kusto cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.enableDiskEncryption` is false. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.

azure.claude.kusto_double_encryption.description: For a kusto cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.enableDoubleEncryption` is false. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.

azure.claude.kusto_sku_with_sla.description: For a kusto cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when `sku.name` begins with the development/no-SLA SKU family. A development tier can leave production analytics without an availability commitment.
azure.claude.kusto_sku_with_sla.pass_when: PASS when the SKU is outside the development/no-SLA family.
azure.claude.kusto_sku_with_sla.fail_when: FAIL when `sku.name` begins with the development/no-SLA SKU family.

azure.claude.log_analytics_local_auth_di.description: For a log analytics workspace, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.features.disableLocalAuth` is false. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.

azure.claude.log_analytics_public_ingest.description: For a log analytics workspace, the evaluator flags FAIL when either publicNetworkAccessForIngestion or publicNetworkAccessForQuery is Enabled. Log telemetry or queries remain reachable over public network paths.
azure.claude.log_analytics_public_ingest.pass_when: PASS when neither setting is Enabled.
azure.claude.log_analytics_public_ingest.fail_when: FAIL when either publicNetworkAccessForIngestion or publicNetworkAccessForQuery is Enabled.

azure.claude.logic_app_workflow_diagnost.description: For a logic app workflow, the evaluator flags FAIL when `diagnosticSettings[].properties.logs[].enabled` is false. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.

azure.claude.managed_hsm_audit_logging.description: For a managed hsm, the evaluator flags FAIL when no diagnostic setting enables AuditEvent with a storage account destination and retention days. HSM key operations may lack a retained audit archive.
azure.claude.managed_hsm_audit_logging.pass_when: PASS when at least one such diagnostic setting exists.
azure.claude.managed_hsm_audit_logging.fail_when: FAIL when no diagnostic setting enables AuditEvent with a storage account destination and retention days.

azure.claude.managed_hsm_purge_protectio.description: For a managed hsm, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.enablePurgeProtection` is false. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.

azure.claude.ml_workspace_cmk.description: For a ml workspace, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.encryption.status` is 'Disabled'. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.

azure.claude.mssql_managed_instance_tde_.description: For SQL Managed Instance, the evaluator passes if any encryption protector has serverKeyType=AzureKeyVault and a nonempty uri. It fails when protectors exist but none qualifies and all have recognized key types; an empty list is UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.mssql_managed_instance_tde_.pass_when: PASS when at least one AzureKeyVault protector has a nonempty uri.
azure.claude.mssql_managed_instance_tde_.fail_when: FAIL when all collected protectors have recognized key types but none is an AzureKeyVault protector with a nonempty uri.

azure.claude.mssql_managed_instance_vuln.description: For a SQL Managed Instance, the evaluator checks collected vulnerability assessment rows and passes if any has recurringScans.isEnabled=true; it fails if none does.
azure.claude.mssql_managed_instance_vuln.pass_when: PASS when at least one vulnerability assessment row has recurringScans.isEnabled=true.
azure.claude.mssql_managed_instance_vuln.fail_when: FAIL when no vulnerability assessment row has recurringScans.isEnabled=true.

azure.claude.mysql_flexible_audit_log_co.description: For a MySQL flexible server, the evaluator splits audit_log_events on commas and requires a CONNECTION event, regardless of other events.
azure.claude.mysql_flexible_audit_log_co.fail_when: FAIL when audit_log_events does not include CONNECTION.

azure.claude.mysql_flexible_audit_log_en.description: For a mysql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when configuration `audit_log_enabled` has value 'off'. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.
azure.claude.mysql_flexible_audit_log_en.not_applicable_when: The named server parameter is not offered by this engine version.

azure.claude.mysql_flexible_geo_redundan.description: For a mysql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.backup.geoRedundantBackup` is 'Disabled'. An outage or deletion can leave data unavailable or unrecoverable.

azure.claude.mysql_flexible_high_availab.description: For a non-Burstable MySQL flexible server, the evaluator passes when highAvailability.mode is ZoneRedundant or SameZone and fails when Disabled.
azure.claude.mysql_flexible_high_availab.pass_when: PASS when properties.highAvailability.mode is ZoneRedundant or SameZone.
azure.claude.mysql_flexible_high_availab.not_applicable_when: The flexible server uses the Burstable SKU tier.

azure.claude.mysql_flexible_min_tls_12.description: For a MySQL flexible server, the evaluator parses the tls_version list. It fails if any TLSv1, TLSv1.0, or TLSv1.1 is allowed, and passes when every listed version is TLSv1.2 or TLSv1.3.
azure.claude.mysql_flexible_min_tls_12.pass_when: PASS when the nonempty tls_version list contains only TLSv1.2 and/or TLSv1.3.
azure.claude.mysql_flexible_min_tls_12.fail_when: FAIL when tls_version includes TLSv1, TLSv1.0, or TLSv1.1.

azure.claude.mysql_flexible_secure_trans.description: For a mysql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when configuration `require_secure_transport` has value 'off'. Connections can use weaker transport protection.

azure.claude.network_watcher_flow_logs_r.description: For a network watcher, the evaluator flags FAIL when the watcher has an inactive flow log or a flow log with positive retention below 90 days. Traffic evidence can be absent or expire before incident investigation.

azure.claude.network_watcher_flow_logs_r.fail_when: FAIL when the watcher has an inactive flow log or a flow log with positive retention below 90 days.

azure.claude.network_watcher_flow_logs_t.description: For a Network Watcher, the evaluator requires at least one flow log and requires every collected flow log to be enabled with Traffic Analytics enabled. A missing flow log list yields UNKNOWN; an empty list fails.

azure.claude.network_watcher_flow_logs_t.fail_when: FAIL when the collected flowLogs list is empty or any flow log is disabled or lacks enabled Traffic Analytics.

azure.claude.network_watcher_in_vnet_reg.description: For a virtual network, the evaluator flags FAIL when the complete Network Watcher inventory has no watcher in the virtual network’s region. Flow monitoring and network diagnostics may be unavailable in that region.

azure.claude.nic_no_public_ip.description: For a network interface, the evaluator flags FAIL when any NIC IP configuration references a public IP resource. A workload interface can be reached directly from the Internet.

azure.claude.nsg_associated_with_subnet.fail_when: FAIL when the NSG has no associated subnet entries.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_connect.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when the `connection_throttle.enable` server configuration is `off`. An attacker can sustain high connection rates and exhaust server capacity.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_connect.fail_when: FAIL when the `connection_throttle.enable` server configuration is `off`.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_connect.not_applicable_when: The server does not offer the parameter in this engine version.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_entra_a.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when the server has no collected Entra administrator. Database administration remains dependent on local credentials.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_entra_a.pass_when: PASS when at least one Entra administrator is configured.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_entra_a.fail_when: FAIL when the server has no collected Entra administrator.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_geo_red.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.backup.geoRedundantBackup` is 'Disabled'. An outage or deletion can leave data unavailable or unrecoverable.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_high_av.description: For a non-Burstable PostgreSQL flexible server, the evaluator passes when highAvailability.mode is ZoneRedundant or SameZone and fails when Disabled.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_high_av.pass_when: PASS when properties.highAvailability.mode is ZoneRedundant or SameZone.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_high_av.not_applicable_when: The flexible server uses the Burstable SKU tier.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_che.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when configuration `log_checkpoints` has value 'off'. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_che.not_applicable_when: The named server parameter is not offered by this engine version.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_con.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when configuration `log_connections` has value 'off'. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_con.not_applicable_when: The named server parameter is not offered by this engine version.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_dis.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when configuration `log_disconnections` has value 'off'. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_dis.not_applicable_when: The named server parameter is not offered by this engine version.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_ret.description: For a PostgreSQL flexible server, the evaluator parses logfiles.retention_days as an integer and requires a value greater than 3.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_ret.pass_when: PASS when logfiles.retention_days parses to an integer greater than 3.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_log_ret.fail_when: FAIL when logfiles.retention_days is an integer of 3 or less.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_no_azur.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when a firewall rule uses `0.0.0.0` for both start and end address. Resources in other Azure tenants may be able to try database authentication.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_no_azur.pass_when: PASS when no rule uses the Azure-services-wide `0.0.0.0` exception.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_no_azur.fail_when: FAIL when a firewall rule uses `0.0.0.0` for both start and end address.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_no_zero.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when a firewall rule spans `0.0.0.0` through `255.255.255.255`. The database endpoint can be reached from any IPv4 source.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_no_zero.pass_when: PASS when no firewall rule spans the full IPv4 address space.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_no_zero.fail_when: FAIL when a firewall rule spans `0.0.0.0` through `255.255.255.255`.

azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_secure_.description: For a postgresql flexible server, the evaluator flags FAIL when configuration `require_secure_transport` has value 'off'. Connections can use weaker transport protection.
azure.claude.postgresql_flexible_secure_.not_applicable_when: The named server parameter is not offered by this engine version.

azure.claude.recovery_vault_backup_reten.description: For a recovery vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when any collected daily backup policy retains recovery points for fewer than 30 days. An incident discovered late can outlast the available restore points.
azure.claude.recovery_vault_backup_reten.pass_when: PASS when all applicable daily policies retain recovery points for at least 30 days.
azure.claude.recovery_vault_backup_reten.fail_when: FAIL when any collected daily backup policy retains recovery points for fewer than 30 days.
azure.claude.recovery_vault_backup_reten.not_applicable_when: No applicable backup policy exists in the collected vault inventory.

azure.claude.recovery_vault_has_protecte.description: For a recovery vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when the vault protects no collected backup items. A backup vault with no protected workload offers no recovery point for those workloads.
azure.claude.recovery_vault_has_protecte.pass_when: PASS when at least one protected item is present.
azure.claude.recovery_vault_has_protecte.fail_when: FAIL when the vault protects no collected backup items.

azure.claude.recovery_vault_managed_iden.description: For a recovery vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when `identity.type` is None. Backup automation may depend on long-lived credentials instead of managed identity.
azure.claude.recovery_vault_managed_iden.pass_when: PASS when a system- or user-assigned identity is present.

azure.claude.recovery_vault_private_endp.description: For a recovery vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointStateForBackup` is 'None'. An outage or deletion can leave data unavailable or unrecoverable.
For a recovery vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointStateForSiteRecovery` is 'None'. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.

azure.claude.search_service_logging_enab.description: For a search service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `diagnosticSettings[].properties.logs[].enabled` is false. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.

azure.claude.search_service_replica_coun.description: For a search service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.replicaCount` is 3 or fewer. Too few replicas reduce availability during node or zone failures.
azure.claude.search_service_replica_coun.pass_when: PASS when the search service has more than 3 replicas.

azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_local_.description: For an Active Service Bus namespace, the evaluator passes when disableLocalAuth is true and fails when false. Other namespace states are skipped.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_local_.not_applicable_when: The namespace status is not Active.

azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_loggin.description: For a servicebus namespace, the evaluator flags FAIL when `diagnosticSettings[].properties.logs[].enabled` is false. Security events can be missed during incident investigation.

azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_networ.description: For an Active Premium Service Bus namespace, evaluates declared public-network restrictions, including default action, IPv4 allow coverage and virtual-network rules; trusted-service bypass and reachability remain separate.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_networ.pass_when: Public network access is Disabled, or Enabled with Deny and bounded nonempty IP or VNet allow rules.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_networ.fail_when: Enabled with Allow, Enabled with Deny and no rules, or IPv4 allow rules collectively covering all IPv4 addresses.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_networ.not_applicable_when: Outside the pinned Active Premium criterion; unknown provider status or incomplete facts are UNKNOWN.

azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_privat.description: For a servicebus namespace, the evaluator flags FAIL when the namespace has no approved private endpoint connection. Messages have no approved private network route.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_privat.pass_when: PASS when an endpoint connection is Approved.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_privat.fail_when: FAIL when the namespace has no approved private endpoint connection.
azure.claude.servicebus_namespace_privat.not_applicable_when: The Service Bus namespace is not Premium.

azure.claude.servicebus_premium_namespac.description: For a servicebus namespace, the evaluator flags FAIL when a Premium namespace lacks Key Vault as its encryption key source. Messaging data remains under provider-managed keys.
azure.claude.servicebus_premium_namespac.pass_when: PASS when the Premium namespace uses a Key Vault key source.
azure.claude.servicebus_premium_namespac.fail_when: FAIL when a Premium namespace lacks Key Vault as its encryption key source.

azure.claude.servicebus_premium_namespac.description: For a Premium Service Bus namespace, the evaluator requires at least one virtualNetworkRule and a nonempty subnet.id on every rule. Non-Premium namespaces are skipped.
azure.claude.servicebus_premium_namespac.pass_when: PASS when at least one virtual network rule exists and every rule has a nonempty subnet.id.
azure.claude.servicebus_premium_namespac.fail_when: FAIL when there are no virtual network rules or any rule lacks a nonempty subnet.id.

azure.claude.servicefabric_cluster_encry.description: For a Service Fabric cluster, the evaluator scans all fabricSettings parameter values and passes if any equals EncryptAndSign. It does not restrict the match to a named section or parameter.
azure.claude.servicefabric_cluster_encry.pass_when: PASS when any fabricSettings parameter has value EncryptAndSign.
azure.claude.servicefabric_cluster_encry.fail_when: FAIL when no fabricSettings parameter has value EncryptAndSign.

azure.claude.servicefabric_cluster_entra.description: For a service fabric cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when the cluster lacks a tenant ID or cluster application ID in azureActiveDirectory. Clients may authenticate through certificates alone instead of central directory policy.
azure.claude.servicefabric_cluster_entra.pass_when: PASS when both Entra identifiers are present.
azure.claude.servicefabric_cluster_entra.fail_when: FAIL when the cluster lacks a tenant ID or cluster application ID in azureActiveDirectory.

azure.claude.signalr_service_no_free_tie.description: For a signalr service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `sku.tier` is `Free`. The free tier has tighter capacity limits that can interrupt real-time delivery.
azure.claude.signalr_service_no_free_tie.pass_when: PASS when the tier is Standard or Premium.

azure.claude.signalr_service_private_lin.description: For a signalr service, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointConnections` is empty; `properties.privateEndpointConnections[].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status` is absent. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.
azure.claude.signalr_service_private_lin.fail_when: FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointConnections` is empty; `properties.privateEndpointConnections[].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status` is absent.
azure.claude.signalr_service_private_lin.not_applicable_when: The SignalR service uses the Free tier.

azure.claude.spring_cloud_service_vnet_i.description: For a Standard Azure Spring Apps service, the evaluator requires a nonempty serviceRuntimeSubnetId. Other SKU tiers are skipped.
azure.claude.spring_cloud_service_vnet_i.pass_when: PASS when the service runtime subnet ID is nonempty.
azure.claude.spring_cloud_service_vnet_i.fail_when: FAIL when `networkProfile.serviceRuntimeSubnetId` is empty or absent.
azure.claude.spring_cloud_service_vnet_i.not_applicable_when: The service SKU tier is not Standard.

azure.claude.sql_audit_retention_over_90.description: For a SQL audit setting, the evaluator flags FAIL when auditing is disabled or positive retention is 90 days or less. Audit records may disappear before delayed incident review.
azure.claude.sql_audit_retention_over_90.pass_when: PASS when auditing is enabled and retention is 0 (unlimited) or greater than 90 days.
azure.claude.sql_audit_retention_over_90.fail_when: FAIL when auditing is disabled or positive retention is 90 days or less.

azure.claude.sql_audit_storage_retention.description: For an enabled SQL audit setting with a nonempty storageEndpoint, the evaluator checks retentionDays. Zero means unlimited and passes; values below 90 fail.
azure.claude.sql_audit_storage_retention.pass_when: PASS when retention is 0 (unlimited) or at least 90 days.
azure.claude.sql_audit_storage_retention.fail_when: FAIL when audit retention is positive and below 90 days.
azure.claude.sql_audit_storage_retention.not_applicable_when: Auditing is disabled or no nonempty storageEndpoint is configured.
