azure.claude.sql_database_long_term_rete.description: For a sql database ltr policy, the evaluator flags FAIL when weekly, monthly, and yearly retention all equal `PT0S`. Deleted database data may have no long-term restore point.
azure.claude.sql_database_long_term_rete.pass_when: PASS when at least one long-term retention interval is configured.
azure.claude.sql_database_long_term_rete.fail_when: FAIL when weekly, monthly, and yearly retention all equal `PT0S`.
azure.claude.sql_database_long_term_rete.not_applicable_when: The policy belongs to the system master database.

azure.claude.sql_database_va_findings_re.description: For a SQL database, the evaluator flags FAIL when the latest assessment scan reports at least one failed security check. Known database weaknesses remain unresolved.
azure.claude.sql_database_va_findings_re.pass_when: PASS when the latest scan reports zero failed checks.
azure.claude.sql_database_va_findings_re.fail_when: FAIL when the latest assessment scan reports at least one failed security check.
azure.claude.sql_database_va_findings_re.not_applicable_when: The database name is master. With no scans on another database, the evaluator returns MANUAL.

azure.claude.sql_firewall_no_full_range.description: For a SQL firewall rule, the evaluator flags FAIL when the rule spans `0.0.0.0` through `255.255.255.255`. Any Internet host can reach the SQL endpoint and attempt authentication.
azure.claude.sql_firewall_no_full_range.pass_when: PASS when it does not span the full IPv4 address space.
azure.claude.sql_firewall_no_full_range.fail_when: FAIL when the rule spans `0.0.0.0` through `255.255.255.255`.

azure.claude.sql_firewall_no_internet_or.description: For a SQL firewall rule, the evaluator flags FAIL when a firewall rule uses `0.0.0.0` as both start and end address or spans the full IPv4 range. Other Azure tenants or arbitrary Internet hosts can attempt SQL authentication.
azure.claude.sql_firewall_no_internet_or.pass_when: PASS when neither broad rule is present.
azure.claude.sql_firewall_no_internet_or.fail_when: FAIL when a firewall rule uses `0.0.0.0` as both start and end address or spans the full IPv4 range.

azure.claude.sql_server_entra_admin.description: For an Azure SQL server, the evaluator flags FAIL when no server administrator has `administratorType=ActiveDirectory`. Administration can remain tied to SQL-only credentials.
azure.claude.sql_server_entra_admin.pass_when: PASS when at least one Entra administrator is present.
azure.claude.sql_server_entra_admin.fail_when: FAIL when no server administrator has `administratorType=ActiveDirectory`.

azure.claude.sql_server_minimal_tls_12.description: Checks Azure SQL minimum TLS declaration or the reviewed current provider default; it does not probe negotiated TLS. An explicit-setting policy remains separate.
azure.claude.sql_server_minimal_tls_12.pass_when: Explicit 1.2 or 1.3, or string None observed within the reviewed 2026-10-12 through 2027-10-12 provider-default window.
azure.claude.sql_server_minimal_tls_12.fail_when: Explicit 1.0 or 1.1 is a stale below-1.2 declaration, without proving Azure currently negotiates retired TLS.

azure.claude.sql_server_private_link.description: For an Azure SQL server, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointConnections` is empty; `properties.privateEndpointConnections[].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status` is absent. Untrusted network paths can reach the service or workload.
azure.claude.sql_server_private_link.fail_when: FAIL when `properties.privateEndpointConnections` is empty; `properties.privateEndpointConnections[].properties.privateLinkServiceConnectionState.status` is absent.

azure.claude.sql_server_vnet_rules.description: For an Azure SQL server, the evaluator flags FAIL when the SQL server has no virtual network rule referencing a subnet. The server has no explicit subnet-level network allowlist.
azure.claude.sql_server_vnet_rules.pass_when: PASS when at least one rule references a subnet.
azure.claude.sql_server_vnet_rules.fail_when: FAIL when the SQL server has no virtual network rule referencing a subnet.

azure.claude.sql_server_vulnerability_as.description: For a SQL vulnerability assessment, the evaluator passes when a classic storageContainerPath is configured or expressVulnerabilityAssessment.state is Enabled. If neither classic nor express facts are collected, it returns MANUAL.
azure.claude.sql_server_vulnerability_as.pass_when: PASS when classic storage-based VA is configured or express VA is Enabled.
azure.claude.sql_server_vulnerability_as.fail_when: FAIL when classic storageContainerPath is absent or empty and collected express vulnerability assessment state is Disabled.

azure.claude.sql_tde_protector_cmk.description: For a sql encryption protector, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.serverKeyType` is 'ServiceManaged'. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.

azure.claude.sql_va_notify_admins.description: For a sql vulnerability assessment, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.recurringScans.emailSubscriptionAdmins` is false. An identity can gain or retain unintended access.
azure.claude.sql_va_notify_admins.not_applicable_when: Classic storage-based vulnerability assessment is not configured.

azure.claude.sql_va_recurring_scans.description: For a sql vulnerability assessment, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.recurringScans.isEnabled` is false. New database weaknesses may remain undiscovered between manual assessments.
azure.claude.sql_va_recurring_scans.pass_when: PASS when recurring scans are enabled.
azure.claude.sql_va_recurring_scans.not_applicable_when: Classic storage-based vulnerability assessment is not configured.

azure.claude.sql_va_report_emails.description: For classic storage-based SQL vulnerability assessment, the evaluator passes when recurringScans.emails contains a nonblank string and fails otherwise; other VA configurations are skipped.
azure.claude.sql_va_report_emails.pass_when: PASS when the recipient list contains an email address.
azure.claude.sql_va_report_emails.fail_when: FAIL when the vulnerability assessment email recipient list is empty.
azure.claude.sql_va_report_emails.not_applicable_when: Classic storage-based vulnerability assessment is not configured.

azure.claude.sql_va_reports_configured.description: For classic storage-based SQL vulnerability assessment, the evaluator passes when recurringScans.emailSubscriptionAdmins is true or recurringScans.emails has a nonblank address; it fails only when both are absent or false.
azure.claude.sql_va_reports_configured.pass_when: PASS when subscription-admin email is enabled or at least one nonblank report email is listed.
azure.claude.sql_va_reports_configured.fail_when: FAIL when subscription-admin email is false and no nonblank report email is listed.
azure.claude.sql_va_reports_configured.not_applicable_when: Classic storage-based vulnerability assessment is not configured.

azure.claude.storage_access_keys_rotated.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when any reported access key creation time is more than 90 days before the scan. A copied account key can provide durable access to storage data.
azure.claude.storage_access_keys_rotated.pass_when: PASS when every reported key is at most 90 days old.
azure.claude.storage_access_keys_rotated.fail_when: FAIL when any reported access key creation time is more than 90 days before the scan.
azure.claude.storage_access_keys_rotated.not_applicable_when: The account reports no access-key creation times.

azure.claude.storage_account_cmk.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.encryption.keySource` is 'Microsoft.Storage'. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.

azure.claude.storage_account_geo_redunda.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when `sku.name` is a recognized local or zone-only replication SKU. A regional outage can make replicated data unavailable.
azure.claude.storage_account_geo_redunda.pass_when: PASS when the SKU is GRS, RA-GRS, GZRS, or RA-GZRS.
azure.claude.storage_account_geo_redunda.fail_when: FAIL when `sku.name` is a recognized local or zone-only replication SKU.

azure.claude.storage_blob_and_container_.description: For a storage service, the evaluator flags FAIL when either blob or container soft delete is disabled or outside 7 through 365 days. Accidental or malicious blob deletion can become permanent too soon.
azure.claude.storage_blob_and_container_.pass_when: PASS when both policies are enabled with 7 through 365 days of retention.
azure.claude.storage_blob_and_container_.fail_when: FAIL when either blob or container soft delete is disabled or outside 7 through 365 days.
azure.claude.storage_blob_and_container_.not_applicable_when: The resource is not a blob service.

azure.claude.storage_blob_classic_loggin.description: For a non-exempt storage account, the evaluator requires classic blob analytics logging for read, write, and delete. Premium StorageV2 and FileStorage accounts are skipped.
azure.claude.storage_blob_classic_loggin.pass_when: PASS when all three classic blob logging operations are enabled.
azure.claude.storage_blob_classic_loggin.fail_when: FAIL when classic blob logging disables any of read, write, or delete.
azure.claude.storage_blob_classic_loggin.not_applicable_when: The account is a Premium StorageV2 or FileStorage account.

azure.claude.storage_blob_diagnostic_log.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when blob diagnostic logs lack an enabled StorageRead, StorageWrite, or StorageDelete category. Blob reads or mutations may be absent from audit records.
azure.claude.storage_blob_diagnostic_log.pass_when: PASS when all three categories are enabled directly or through allLogs.
azure.claude.storage_blob_diagnostic_log.fail_when: FAIL when blob diagnostic logs lack an enabled StorageRead, StorageWrite, or StorageDelete category.
azure.claude.storage_blob_diagnostic_log.not_applicable_when: The account is a Premium StorageV2 or FileStorage account.

azure.claude.storage_blob_soft_delete_en.description: For a storage service, the evaluator flags FAIL when blob soft delete is disabled. Deleted blobs cannot be restored through the retention policy.
azure.claude.storage_blob_soft_delete_en.pass_when: PASS when blob soft delete is enabled.
azure.claude.storage_blob_soft_delete_en.fail_when: FAIL when blob soft delete is disabled.
azure.claude.storage_blob_soft_delete_en.not_applicable_when: The resource is not a blob service.

azure.claude.storage_container_no_public.description: For a blob container, the evaluator passes only when properties.publicAccess=None and fails when it is Blob or Container.
azure.claude.storage_container_no_public.fail_when: FAIL when properties.publicAccess is Blob or Container.

azure.claude.storage_encryption_scope_cm.description: For a storage encryption scope, the evaluator flags FAIL when `properties.source` is 'Microsoft.Storage'. Data or keys remain under weaker encryption and recovery controls.

azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.description: For a storage service, the evaluator flags FAIL when the file service has shares but share soft delete is off or retention is outside 1 through 365 days. Deleted file shares may be permanently lost before recovery.
azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.pass_when: PASS when share soft delete is on with retention of 1 through 365 days.
azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.fail_when: FAIL when the file service has shares but share soft delete is off or retention is outside 1 through 365 days.
azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.not_applicable_when: The resource is not a file service or the account has no file shares.

azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.description: For a storage service, the evaluator flags FAIL when file-share soft delete is disabled. Accidentally deleted shares may have no restore window.
azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.pass_when: PASS when file-share soft delete is enabled.
azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.fail_when: FAIL when file-share soft delete is disabled.
azure.claude.storage_file_share_soft_del.not_applicable_when: The resource is not a file service.

azure.claude.storage_key_expiration_poli.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when the storage account key expiration policy is absent or is not exactly 90 days. Long-lived account keys can remain valid after exposure or employee departure.
azure.claude.storage_key_expiration_poli.fail_when: FAIL when the storage account key expiration policy is absent or is not exactly 90 days.

azure.claude.storage_key_expiration_poli.description: For a storage account, the evaluator flags FAIL when the storage key expiration policy is absent, zero, or above 90 days. A leaked Shared Key can remain usable for too long.
azure.claude.storage_key_expiration_poli.fail_when: FAIL when the storage key expiration policy is absent, zero, or above 90 days.

azure.claude.storage_private_endpoint_pr.description: For a storage account, the evaluator requires at least one Approved private endpoint connection; other states and an empty connection list fail.
azure.claude.storage_private_endpoint_pr.pass_when: PASS when an approved private endpoint connection exists.
azure.claude.storage_private_endpoint_pr.fail_when: FAIL when no storage private endpoint connection is `Approved`.

azure.claude.storage_private_link_all_ap.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when it has no private endpoint connections or any connection is not Approved. Unapproved or absent private connections leave the intended private access path unavailable.
azure.claude.storage_private_link_all_ap.pass_when: PASS when at least one private endpoint exists and every connection is Approved.
azure.claude.storage_private_link_all_ap.fail_when: FAIL when it has no private endpoint connections or any connection is not Approved.

azure.claude.storage_queue_classic_loggi.description: For a standard storage account’s queue service, FAIL is reported when any of the read, write, or delete classic log categories is not enabled. Missing queue classic records can hide unauthorized reads or destructive writes.
azure.claude.storage_queue_classic_loggi.pass_when: PASS when all three classic log categories are enabled.
azure.claude.storage_queue_classic_loggi.fail_when: FAIL when any of the read, write, or delete classic log categories is not enabled.

azure.claude.storage_queue_diagnostic_lo.description: For a non-Premium storage account’s queue service, FAIL means the diagnostic settings do not collectively enable read, write and delete logs, including via allLogs. Missing categories can leave queue operations unaudited.
azure.claude.storage_queue_diagnostic_lo.pass_when: PASS when enabled StorageRead, StorageWrite and StorageDelete categories (or enabled allLogs groups) cover all three operations across the service diagnostic settings.
azure.claude.storage_queue_diagnostic_lo.fail_when: FAIL when at least one of read, write and delete lacks an enabled matching category or allLogs group.

azure.claude.storage_smb_channel_encrypt.description: For a file storage service, FAIL means the normalized channelEncryption value set differs from the sole value AES-256-GCM. Duplicate values and a missing trailing semicolon are accepted; unset values fail.
azure.claude.storage_smb_channel_encrypt.pass_when: PASS when the semicolon-separated channelEncryption string contains only AES-256-GCM after normalization.
azure.claude.storage_smb_channel_encrypt.fail_when: FAIL when channelEncryption is unset or its normalized value set contains a different value.
azure.claude.storage_smb_channel_encrypt.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the resource is not a file service.

azure.claude.storage_smb_version_3_1_1.description: For a file storage service, FAIL means the normalized versions value set differs from the sole value SMB3.1.1. Duplicate values and a missing trailing semicolon are accepted; unset values fail.
azure.claude.storage_smb_version_3_1_1.pass_when: PASS when the semicolon-separated versions string contains only SMB3.1.1 after normalization.
azure.claude.storage_smb_version_3_1_1.fail_when: FAIL when versions is unset or its normalized value set contains a different value.
azure.claude.storage_smb_version_3_1_1.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the resource is not a file service.

azure.claude.storage_sync_private_link.description: For a Storage Sync service, FAIL is reported when incomingTrafficPolicy is AllowAllTraffic or no private endpoint connection is Approved. The service may receive traffic over an unrestricted path.
azure.claude.storage_sync_private_link.pass_when: PASS when incomingTrafficPolicy is AllowVirtualNetworksOnly and an approved private endpoint exists.
azure.claude.storage_sync_private_link.fail_when: FAIL when incomingTrafficPolicy is AllowAllTraffic or no private endpoint connection is Approved.

azure.claude.storage_table_classic_loggi.description: For a standard storage account’s table service, FAIL is reported when any of the read, write, or delete classic log categories is not enabled. Missing table classic records can hide unauthorized reads or destructive writes.
azure.claude.storage_table_classic_loggi.pass_when: PASS when all three classic log categories are enabled.
azure.claude.storage_table_classic_loggi.fail_when: FAIL when any of the read, write, or delete classic log categories is not enabled.

azure.claude.storage_table_diagnostic_lo.description: For a non-Premium storage account’s table service, FAIL means the diagnostic settings do not collectively enable read, write and delete logs, including via allLogs. Missing categories can leave table operations unaudited.
azure.claude.storage_table_diagnostic_lo.pass_when: PASS when enabled StorageRead, StorageWrite and StorageDelete categories (or enabled allLogs groups) cover all three operations across the service diagnostic settings.
azure.claude.storage_table_diagnostic_lo.fail_when: FAIL when at least one of read, write and delete lacks an enabled matching category or allLogs group.

azure.claude.storage_trusted_azure_servi.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when networkAcls.bypass does not include AzureServices. Trusted Azure services may be unable to reach storage through restrictive network ACLs.
azure.claude.storage_trusted_azure_servi.pass_when: PASS when the bypass list includes AzureServices.
azure.claude.storage_trusted_azure_servi.fail_when: FAIL when networkAcls.bypass does not include AzureServices.

azure.claude.storage_vhd_accounts_cmk.description: For a subscription, FAIL is reported when a VM unmanaged OS VHD resolves to a storage account whose encryption.keySource is Microsoft.Storage. Unmanaged OS VHDs on a platform-key account lack customer control of the storage encryption key.
azure.claude.storage_vhd_accounts_cmk.pass_when: PASS when every resolved VHD host account uses a non-platform key source.
azure.claude.storage_vhd_accounts_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when a VM unmanaged OS VHD resolves to a storage account whose encryption.keySource is Microsoft.Storage.
azure.claude.storage_vhd_accounts_cmk.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the anchor is not a subscription.

azure.claude.storage_vnet_service_endpoi.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when networkAcls.defaultAction is not Deny or virtualNetworkRules is empty. Traffic may be admitted without an explicit subnet allowlist.
azure.claude.storage_vnet_service_endpoi.pass_when: PASS when the default action is Deny and at least one virtual network rule exists.
azure.claude.storage_vnet_service_endpoi.fail_when: FAIL when networkAcls.defaultAction is not Deny or virtualNetworkRules is empty.

azure.claude.stream_analytics_job_loggin.description: For a Stream Analytics job, FAIL means no diagnostic setting has any enabled resource-log category. Its job events may be absent from diagnostic exports.
azure.claude.stream_analytics_job_loggin.pass_when: PASS when at least one diagnostic setting contains at least one enabled resource-log category.
azure.claude.stream_analytics_job_loggin.fail_when: FAIL when no setting contains an enabled resource-log category.

azure.claude.subnet_nsg_associated.description: For a workload subnet, FAIL is reported when properties.networkSecurityGroup has no NSG ID. Subnet traffic has no attached NSG rule boundary.
azure.claude.subnet_nsg_associated.pass_when: PASS when an NSG ID is associated.
azure.claude.subnet_nsg_associated.fail_when: FAIL when properties.networkSecurityGroup has no NSG ID.
azure.claude.subnet_nsg_associated.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the subnet name is an Azure managed exclusion such as GatewaySubnet.

azure.claude.subscription_diagnostic_set.description: For a subscription, FAIL is reported when no single diagnostic setting enables all Administrative, Security, Alert, and Policy log categories. Activity from a missing category may be absent from subscription audit exports.
azure.claude.subscription_diagnostic_set.pass_when: PASS when one diagnostic setting enables all four categories.
azure.claude.subscription_diagnostic_set.fail_when: FAIL when no single diagnostic setting enables all Administrative, Security, Alert, and Policy log categories.

azure.claude.subscription_diagnostic_set.description: For a subscription diagnostic setting, FAIL is reported when any of Administrative, Security, Alert, or Policy is absent from enabled log categories. Activity in a missing category may never reach the configured diagnostic destination.
azure.claude.subscription_diagnostic_set.pass_when: PASS when all four categories have enabled log entries.
azure.claude.subscription_diagnostic_set.fail_when: FAIL when any of Administrative, Security, Alert, or Policy is absent from enabled log categories.

azure.claude.subscription_diagnostic_set.description: For a subscription, FAIL is reported when the complete scoped inventory contains no subscription diagnostic setting. Subscription activity may lack a diagnostic export.
azure.claude.subscription_diagnostic_set.pass_when: PASS when at least one scoped diagnostic setting exists.
azure.claude.subscription_diagnostic_set.fail_when: FAIL when the complete scoped inventory contains no subscription diagnostic setting.

azure.claude.synapse_workspace_cmk.description: For a Synapse workspace, FAIL means properties.encryption.cmk.key.name is absent, empty or whitespace. The workspace does not declare a customer-managed encryption key.
azure.claude.synapse_workspace_cmk.pass_when: PASS when the CMK key name is a nonblank string.
azure.claude.synapse_workspace_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when no nonblank CMK key name is declared.

azure.claude.synapse_workspace_exfiltrat.description: For a Synapse workspace, FAIL means managedVirtualNetworkSettings.preventDataExfiltration is absent or not true. The declared managed network does not enforce this exfiltration switch.
azure.claude.synapse_workspace_exfiltrat.fail_when: FAIL when the managed VNet settings are absent or preventDataExfiltration is false.

azure.claude.synapse_workspace_private_l.description: For a Synapse workspace, FAIL is reported when no private endpoint connection has Approved status. The workspace has no approved private network path.
azure.claude.synapse_workspace_private_l.pass_when: PASS when at least one connection is Approved.
azure.claude.synapse_workspace_private_l.fail_when: FAIL when no private endpoint connection has Approved status.

azure.claude.synapse_workspace_vulnerabi.description: For a Synapse workspace, FAIL is reported when no SQL vulnerability assessment has recurringScans.isEnabled true. SQL configuration drift and known weaknesses may go unscanned.
azure.claude.synapse_workspace_vulnerabi.pass_when: PASS when at least one assessment has recurring scans enabled.
azure.claude.synapse_workspace_vulnerabi.fail_when: FAIL when no SQL vulnerability assessment has recurringScans.isEnabled true.

azure.claude.vm_antimalware_auto_upgrade.description: For a Windows VM, FAIL means no Microsoft.Azure.Security IaaSAntimalware extension has autoUpgradeMinorVersion true. ProvisioningState is not tested.
azure.claude.vm_antimalware_auto_upgrade.pass_when: PASS when a matching IaaSAntimalware extension has autoUpgradeMinorVersion true, regardless of provisioningState.
azure.claude.vm_antimalware_auto_upgrade.fail_when: FAIL when no matching extension has autoUpgradeMinorVersion true.
azure.claude.vm_antimalware_auto_upgrade.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Linux.

azure.claude.vm_antimalware_extension.description: For a VM, FAIL means no extension has publisher Microsoft.Azure.Security and type IaaSAntimalware. ProvisioningState is not tested.
azure.claude.vm_antimalware_extension.pass_when: PASS when a matching IaaSAntimalware extension is declared, regardless of provisioningState.
azure.claude.vm_antimalware_extension.fail_when: FAIL when no matching publisher/type extension is declared.

azure.claude.vm_backup_daily_retention_7.description: For a VM protected by Azure Backup, FAIL is reported when its matched backup policy retains daily recovery points for fewer than seven days. An incident discovered after several days may outlive all usable daily recovery points.
azure.claude.vm_backup_daily_retention_7.pass_when: PASS when daily retention is at least seven days.
azure.claude.vm_backup_daily_retention_7.fail_when: FAIL when its matched backup policy retains daily recovery points for fewer than seven days.
azure.claude.vm_backup_daily_retention_7.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM is unprotected or the policy has no daily schedule.

azure.claude.vm_backup_protected.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when the complete backup inventory has no protected VM item with its sourceResourceId. A lost or corrupted VM may have no Azure Backup restore point.
azure.claude.vm_backup_protected.pass_when: PASS when a protected item references the VM.
azure.claude.vm_backup_protected.fail_when: FAIL when the complete backup inventory has no protected VM item with its sourceResourceId.

azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_linux.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when a successfully provisioned DependencyAgentLinux extension is absent. Dependency telemetry for linux processes may be missing.
azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_linux.pass_when: PASS when the required extension exists and reports Succeeded.
azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_linux.fail_when: FAIL when a successfully provisioned DependencyAgentLinux extension is absent.
azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_linux.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Windows.

azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_windows.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when a successfully provisioned DependencyAgentWindows extension is absent. Dependency telemetry for windows processes may be missing.
azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_windows.pass_when: PASS when the required extension exists and reports Succeeded.
azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_windows.fail_when: FAIL when a successfully provisioned DependencyAgentWindows extension is absent.
azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_windows.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Linux.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.description: For a VM, FAIL means no Microsoft.GuestConfiguration extension reports provisioningState Succeeded. The predicate does not require a specific Guest Configuration type or extension name.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.pass_when: PASS when any Microsoft.GuestConfiguration extension reports Succeeded.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.fail_when: FAIL when no Microsoft.GuestConfiguration extension reports Succeeded.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when a successfully provisioned Linux Guest Configuration extension is absent. Linux guest policy compliance cannot be assessed.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.pass_when: PASS when a Microsoft.GuestConfiguration extension of type ConfigurationforLinux with a name ending AzurePolicyforLinux reports Succeeded.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.fail_when: FAIL when no Microsoft.GuestConfiguration extension of type ConfigurationforLinux with a name ending AzurePolicyforLinux reports Succeeded.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Windows.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when a successfully provisioned Windows Guest Configuration extension is absent. Windows guest policy compliance cannot be assessed.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.pass_when: PASS when a Microsoft.GuestConfiguration extension of type ConfigurationforWindows with a name ending AzurePolicyforWindows reports Succeeded.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.fail_when: FAIL when no Microsoft.GuestConfiguration extension of type ConfigurationforWindows with a name ending AzurePolicyforWindows reports Succeeded.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Linux.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_mana.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when its Guest Configuration extension is installed but neither system nor user managed identity is assigned. Guest Configuration may lack the identity needed to report and remediate assigned policy.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_mana.pass_when: PASS when the extension is installed and either managed identity type is assigned.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_mana.fail_when: FAIL when its Guest Configuration extension is installed but neither system nor user managed identity is assigned.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_mana.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the Guest Configuration extension is absent.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_syst.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when its Guest Configuration extension is installed without a system-assigned identity. Guest Configuration may lack the identity needed to report and remediate assigned policy.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_syst.pass_when: PASS when the extension is installed with a system-assigned identity.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_syst.fail_when: FAIL when its Guest Configuration extension is installed without a system-assigned identity.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_syst.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the Guest Configuration extension is absent.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_user.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when a user-assigned identity exists with the extension but no system-assigned identity is present. Guest Configuration may lack the identity needed to report and remediate assigned policy.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_user.pass_when: PASS when both user and system identities are assigned.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_user.fail_when: FAIL when a user-assigned identity exists with the extension but no system-assigned identity is present.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_user.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the Guest Configuration extension is absent or no user-assigned identity exists.

azure.claude.vm_jit_access.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no Defender just in time network access policy contains the VM ID. Management access may remain open without time bounded approval.
azure.claude.vm_jit_access.pass_when: PASS when a JIT policy lists the VM.
azure.claude.vm_jit_access.fail_when: FAIL when no Defender just in time network access policy contains the VM ID.

azure.claude.vm_linux_no_passwordless_ac.description: For a Linux virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no `PasswordPolicy_msid232` guest configuration assignment reports Compliant. Linux accounts without passwords can permit unauthenticated local access.
azure.claude.vm_linux_no_passwordless_ac.pass_when: PASS when at least one `PasswordPolicy_msid232` assignment reports Compliant.
azure.claude.vm_linux_no_passwordless_ac.fail_when: FAIL when no matching PasswordPolicy_msid232 assignment exists or all matching evaluated assignments are NonCompliant. Pending-only assignments yield UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.vm_linux_no_passwordless_ac.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Windows.

azure.claude.vm_linux_remote_requires_pa.description: For a Linux virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no `PasswordPolicy_msid110` guest configuration assignment reports Compliant. Remote logins to passwordless Linux accounts may be possible.
azure.claude.vm_linux_remote_requires_pa.pass_when: PASS when at least one `PasswordPolicy_msid110` assignment reports Compliant.
azure.claude.vm_linux_remote_requires_pa.fail_when: FAIL when no matching PasswordPolicy_msid110 assignment exists or all matching evaluated assignments are NonCompliant. Pending-only assignments yield UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.vm_linux_remote_requires_pa.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Windows.

azure.claude.vm_linux_security_baseline.description: For a Linux virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no `AzureLinuxBaseline` guest configuration assignment reports Compliant. Linux baseline deviations may remain on the guest.
azure.claude.vm_linux_security_baseline.pass_when: PASS when at least one `AzureLinuxBaseline` assignment reports Compliant.
azure.claude.vm_linux_security_baseline.fail_when: FAIL when no matching AzureLinuxBaseline assignment exists or all matching evaluated assignments are NonCompliant. Pending-only assignments yield UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.vm_linux_security_baseline.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Windows.

azure.claude.vm_nic_nsg_internet_tcp_ing.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when an attached NIC NSG declares an inbound internet Allow rule for TCP traffic. Internet hosts may reach TCP services on the VM.
azure.claude.vm_nic_nsg_internet_tcp_ing.pass_when: PASS when no NIC NSG has such a rule.
azure.claude.vm_nic_nsg_internet_tcp_ing.fail_when: FAIL when an attached NIC NSG declares an inbound internet Allow rule for TCP traffic.

azure.claude.vm_no_public_ip.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when any referenced network interface has a public IP configuration. The machine may be directly reachable from the internet.
azure.claude.vm_no_public_ip.pass_when: PASS when none of the VM network interfaces references a public IP.
azure.claude.vm_no_public_ip.fail_when: FAIL when any referenced network interface has a public IP configuration.

azure.claude.vm_nsg_internet_management_.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when a NIC or subnet NSG permits internet ingress on port 22, 3389, 53, 123, 161, 389, or 1900. Remote administration or amplification services may be exposed to internet hosts.
azure.claude.vm_nsg_internet_management_.pass_when: PASS when no associated NSG permits those ports from internet sources.
azure.claude.vm_nsg_internet_management_.fail_when: FAIL when a NIC or subnet NSG permits internet ingress on port 22, 3389, 53, 123, 161, 389, or 1900.

azure.claude.vm_os_managed_disk.description: For a VM with a persistent OS disk, FAIL means managedDisk is explicitly null or absent while an unmanaged VHD object is present. An absent storage type or missing managedDisk ID yields UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.vm_os_managed_disk.pass_when: PASS when the OS disk has a nonempty managedDisk.id.
azure.claude.vm_os_managed_disk.fail_when: FAIL when managedDisk is null or an unmanaged VHD object is declared.
azure.claude.vm_os_managed_disk.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the OS disk is ephemeral with diffDiskSettings.option Local.

azure.claude.vm_site_recovery_enabled.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no resource link named ASR-Protect-* refers to its resource ID. Regional failure may leave the VM without a recovery replica.
azure.claude.vm_site_recovery_enabled.pass_when: PASS when a matching ASR protection link exists.
azure.claude.vm_site_recovery_enabled.fail_when: FAIL when no resource link named ASR-Protect-* refers to its resource ID.

azure.claude.vm_windows_automatic_update.description: For the virtual machine, FAIL means `properties.osProfile.windowsConfiguration.enableAutomaticUpdates` is false. Windows security patches may wait for manual installation.
azure.claude.vm_windows_automatic_update.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM OS is Linux.

azure.claude.vm_windows_exploit_guard.description: For a Windows virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no `WindowsDefenderExploitGuard` guest configuration assignment reports Compliant. Exploit mitigation failures may persist on Windows guests.
azure.claude.vm_windows_exploit_guard.pass_when: PASS when at least one `WindowsDefenderExploitGuard` assignment reports Compliant.
azure.claude.vm_windows_exploit_guard.fail_when: FAIL when no matching WindowsDefenderExploitGuard assignment exists or all matching evaluated assignments are NonCompliant. Pending-only assignments yield UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.vm_windows_exploit_guard.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Linux.

azure.claude.vm_windows_max_password_age.description: For a Windows virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no `MaximumPasswordAge` guest configuration assignment reports Compliant. Windows passwords may remain valid longer than the assigned policy.
azure.claude.vm_windows_max_password_age.pass_when: PASS when at least one `MaximumPasswordAge` assignment reports Compliant.
azure.claude.vm_windows_max_password_age.fail_when: FAIL when no matching MaximumPasswordAge assignment exists or all matching evaluated assignments are NonCompliant. Pending-only assignments yield UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.vm_windows_max_password_age.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Linux.

azure.claude.vm_windows_min_password_age.description: For a Windows virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no `MinimumPasswordAge` guest configuration assignment reports Compliant. Windows passwords may be changed rapidly to cycle through history.
azure.claude.vm_windows_min_password_age.pass_when: PASS when at least one `MinimumPasswordAge` assignment reports Compliant.
azure.claude.vm_windows_min_password_age.fail_when: FAIL when no matching MinimumPasswordAge assignment exists or all matching evaluated assignments are NonCompliant. Pending-only assignments yield UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.vm_windows_min_password_age.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Linux.

azure.claude.vm_windows_min_password_len.description: For a Windows virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no `MinimumPasswordLength` guest configuration assignment reports Compliant. Short Windows passwords may be easier to guess.
azure.claude.vm_windows_min_password_len.pass_when: PASS when at least one `MinimumPasswordLength` assignment reports Compliant.
azure.claude.vm_windows_min_password_len.fail_when: FAIL when no matching MinimumPasswordLength assignment exists or all matching evaluated assignments are NonCompliant. Pending-only assignments yield UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.vm_windows_min_password_len.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Linux.

azure.claude.vm_windows_no_reversible_pa.description: For a Windows virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no `StorePasswordsUsingReversibleEncryption` guest configuration assignment reports Compliant. Reversibly stored Windows passwords can be recovered after host compromise.
azure.claude.vm_windows_no_reversible_pa.pass_when: PASS when at least one `StorePasswordsUsingReversibleEncryption` assignment reports Compliant.
azure.claude.vm_windows_no_reversible_pa.fail_when: FAIL when no matching StorePasswordsUsingReversibleEncryption assignment exists or all matching evaluated assignments are NonCompliant. Pending-only assignments yield UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.vm_windows_no_reversible_pa.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Linux.

azure.claude.vm_windows_password_complex.description: For a Windows virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no `PasswordMustMeetComplexityRequirements` guest configuration assignment reports Compliant. Simple Windows passwords may be easier to guess.
azure.claude.vm_windows_password_complex.pass_when: PASS when at least one `PasswordMustMeetComplexityRequirements` assignment reports Compliant.
azure.claude.vm_windows_password_complex.fail_when: FAIL when no matching PasswordMustMeetComplexityRequirements assignment exists or all matching evaluated assignments are NonCompliant. Pending-only assignments yield UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.vm_windows_password_complex.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Linux.

azure.claude.vm_windows_password_history.description: For a Windows virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no `EnforcePasswordHistory` guest configuration assignment reports Compliant. Windows users may reuse recently compromised passwords.
azure.claude.vm_windows_password_history.pass_when: PASS when at least one `EnforcePasswordHistory` assignment reports Compliant.
azure.claude.vm_windows_password_history.fail_when: FAIL when no matching EnforcePasswordHistory assignment exists or all matching evaluated assignments are NonCompliant. Pending-only assignments yield UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.vm_windows_password_history.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Linux.

azure.claude.vm_windows_secure_boot.description: For a Windows virtual machine, FAIL is reported when its security profile is Standard or uefiSettings.secureBootEnabled is false. Boot tampering may go undetected before the operating system starts.
azure.claude.vm_windows_secure_boot.pass_when: PASS when a supported security profile enables UEFI secure boot.
azure.claude.vm_windows_secure_boot.fail_when: FAIL when its security profile is Standard or uefiSettings.secureBootEnabled is false.
azure.claude.vm_windows_secure_boot.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM is non-Windows or the image offer is not Windows.

azure.claude.vm_windows_secure_protocol_.description: For a Windows VM, this checks the AuditSecureProtocol guest configuration assignment, including MinimumTLSVersion=1.3. It does not read live web-server TLS settings.
azure.claude.vm_windows_secure_protocol_.pass_when: PASS when a matching assignment is Compliant and its MinimumTLSVersion parameter includes 1.3.
azure.claude.vm_windows_secure_protocol_.fail_when: FAIL when no matching assignment exists, or evaluated assignments are NonCompliant or have a different MinimumTLSVersion. A missing parameter or pending-only status yields UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.vm_windows_secure_protocol_.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Linux.

azure.claude.vm_windows_security_baselin.description: For a Windows virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no `AzureWindowsBaseline` guest configuration assignment reports Compliant. Windows baseline deviations may persist on the guest.
azure.claude.vm_windows_security_baselin.pass_when: PASS when at least one `AzureWindowsBaseline` assignment reports Compliant.
azure.claude.vm_windows_security_baselin.fail_when: FAIL when no matching AzureWindowsBaseline assignment exists or all matching evaluated assignments are NonCompliant. Pending-only assignments yield UNKNOWN.
azure.claude.vm_windows_security_baselin.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Linux.

azure.claude.vmss_automatic_upgrade_mode.description: For a VM scale set, FAIL means upgrades are configured as Manual or Rolling instead of Automatic.

azure.claude.vmss_boot_diagnostics.description: For a VM scale set, FAIL means bootDiagnostics.enabled is false, so boot diagnostics are not configured for scale set instances.

azure.claude.vmss_linux_ssh_keys.description: For the virtual machine scale set, FAIL means `properties.virtualMachineProfile.osProfile.linuxConfiguration.disablePasswordAuthentication` is false. Password based SSH remains possible on scale set instances.
azure.claude.vmss_linux_ssh_keys.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the scale set OS is Windows.

azure.claude.vmss_load_balancer_backend.description: For a virtual machine scale set, FAIL is reported when no NIC IP configuration declares a load balancer backend address pool. Scale set instances may lack the intended load balanced ingress path.
azure.claude.vmss_load_balancer_backend.pass_when: PASS when at least one backend pool ID is declared.
azure.claude.vmss_load_balancer_backend.fail_when: FAIL when no NIC IP configuration declares a load balancer backend address pool.

azure.claude.vmss_managed_disks.description: For a VM scale set, FAIL means the OS disk declares nonempty vhdContainers. A missing or malformed managedDisk declaration yields UNKNOWN, including on data disks.
azure.claude.vmss_managed_disks.pass_when: PASS when the OS and all data disks have managedDisk objects and the OS disk has no nonempty vhdContainers.
azure.claude.vmss_managed_disks.fail_when: FAIL when the OS disk has nonempty vhdContainers.

azure.claude.vmss_not_empty.description: For a virtual machine scale set, FAIL is reported when sku.capacity is zero. No instances can serve workload traffic at zero capacity.

azure.claude.vnet_gateway_entra_only.description: For a VPN gateway with point to site clients, FAIL is reported when vpnAuthenticationTypes contains anything other than the sole AAD value. Certificate or RADIUS sign in may bypass the intended Entra policy.
azure.claude.vnet_gateway_entra_only.pass_when: PASS when the authentication type list is exactly [AAD].
azure.claude.vnet_gateway_entra_only.fail_when: FAIL when vpnAuthenticationTypes contains anything other than the sole AAD value.
azure.claude.vnet_gateway_entra_only.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the gateway is not VPN or has no point to site authentication types.

azure.claude.vnet_gateway_no_basic_sku.description: For a virtual network gateway, FAIL means properties.sku.name is Basic. The check compares a reviewed SKU list; it does not inspect network exposure.
azure.claude.vnet_gateway_no_basic_sku.pass_when: PASS when `properties.sku.name` is `VpnGw1` or `VpnGw2` or `VpnGw3` or `VpnGw4` or `VpnGw5` or `VpnGw1AZ` or `VpnGw2AZ` or `VpnGw3AZ` or `VpnGw4AZ` or `VpnGw5AZ` or `Standard` or `HighPerformance` or `UltraPerformance` or `ErGw1AZ` or `ErGw2AZ` or `ErGw3AZ` or `ErGwScale`.

azure.claude.vnet_peering_connected.description: For a virtual network, FAIL is reported when any declared peering has peeringState Disconnected. Expected cross network routes may silently fail.
azure.claude.vnet_peering_connected.pass_when: PASS when no declared peering is Disconnected.
azure.claude.vnet_peering_connected.fail_when: FAIL when any declared peering has peeringState Disconnected.

azure.claude.waf_policy_bot_protection.description: For a WAF policy, FAIL is reported when no Microsoft_BotManagerRuleSet exists or a rule in that set is disabled. Automated abusive traffic may bypass the policy’s bot rules.
azure.claude.waf_policy_bot_protection.pass_when: PASS when a Bot Manager rule set exists with no disabled rules.
azure.claude.waf_policy_bot_protection.fail_when: FAIL when no Microsoft_BotManagerRuleSet exists or a rule in that set is disabled.

azure.claude.waf_policy_request_body_ins.description: For a WAF policy, FAIL means requestBodyCheck is false, so the policy is not configured to inspect request bodies.

azure.claude2.activity_log_alert_service.description: For a subscription, FAIL is reported when no enabled Service Health activity log alert covers the subscription. Operators may miss Azure service incidents that affect the subscription.
azure.claude2.activity_log_alert_service.pass_when: PASS when a matching enabled alert exists.
azure.claude2.activity_log_alert_service.fail_when: FAIL when no enabled Service Health activity log alert covers the subscription.
azure.claude2.activity_log_alert_service.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the anchor is not a subscription.

azure.claude2.aks_azure_monitor_metrics_.description: For an AKS cluster, FAIL is reported when azureMonitorProfile.metrics.enabled is absent or false. Cluster metrics may not reach Azure Monitor.
azure.claude2.aks_azure_monitor_metrics_.pass_when: PASS when the metrics profile exists with enabled true.
azure.claude2.aks_azure_monitor_metrics_.fail_when: FAIL when azureMonitorProfile.metrics.enabled is absent or false.

azure.claude2.aks_private_cluster_nodes_.description: For an AKS cluster, FAIL means it has no privateFQDN or no agent pool has node public IP disabled. The evaluator accepts one private node pool even when other pools expose public IPs.
azure.claude2.aks_private_cluster_nodes_.pass_when: PASS when privateFQDN is truthy and at least one agent pool has enableNodePublicIP false or omitted.
azure.claude2.aks_private_cluster_nodes_.fail_when: FAIL when privateFQDN is absent or false, or every agent pool has public node IP enabled.

azure.claude2.api_app_client_certificate.description: For an App Service API app, FAIL is reported when properties.clientCertEnabled is false. Requests can arrive without the configured client certificate gate.
azure.claude2.api_app_client_certificate.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element ending in api.

azure.claude2.api_app_cors_no_wildcard.description: For an API app, FAIL means its configured CORS allowedOrigins list contains *. Missing CORS settings or an origin list without * pass.
azure.claude2.api_app_cors_no_wildcard.pass_when: PASS when CORS is absent or allowedOrigins does not contain *.
azure.claude2.api_app_cors_no_wildcard.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element ending in api.

azure.claude2.api_app_ftps_required.description: For an App Service API app, FAIL is reported when configuration.properties.ftpsState is AllAllowed. Plain FTP can expose deployment credentials and content.
azure.claude2.api_app_ftps_required.pass_when: PASS when the state is FtpsOnly or Disabled.
azure.claude2.api_app_ftps_required.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element ending in api.

azure.claude2.api_app_https_only.description: For an API app, FAIL means properties.httpsOnly is false, so HTTP requests are not redirected to HTTPS.
azure.claude2.api_app_https_only.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element ending in api.

azure.claude2.api_app_managed_identity.description: For an App Service API app, FAIL is reported when identity.type is None or no identity is declared. The app may rely on long lived secrets to call Azure services.
azure.claude2.api_app_managed_identity.pass_when: PASS when a system or user assigned identity is declared.
azure.claude2.api_app_managed_identity.fail_when: FAIL when identity.type is None or no identity is declared.
azure.claude2.api_app_managed_identity.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element ending in api.

azure.claude2.api_app_min_tls_12.description: For an API app, FAIL means the configured minimum inbound TLS version is below 1.2.
azure.claude2.api_app_min_tls_12.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element ending in api.

azure.claude2.api_app_remote_debugging_d.description: For an App Service API app, FAIL is reported when configuration.properties.remoteDebuggingEnabled is true. A remote debugger may expose process state and secrets.
azure.claude2.api_app_remote_debugging_d.pass_when: PASS when remote debugging is false.
azure.claude2.api_app_remote_debugging_d.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind is exactly api.

azure.claude2.apim_consumption_client_ce.description: For a Consumption API Management service, FAIL is reported when properties.enableClientCertificate is absent or false. Clients may call APIs without presenting the configured certificate.
azure.claude2.apim_consumption_client_ce.fail_when: FAIL when properties.enableClientCertificate is absent or false.
azure.claude2.apim_consumption_client_ce.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the SKU is not Consumption.

azure.claude2.app_gateway_http2_enabled.description: For an Application Gateway, FAIL means enableHttp2 is false; clients cannot use HTTP/2 through its configured frontend.

azure.claude2.app_gateway_min_tls_12.description: For an Application Gateway, FAIL is reported when its configured custom or predefined SSL policy permits TLS 1.0 or 1.1. Older TLS clients can negotiate weaker transport protection.
azure.claude2.app_gateway_min_tls_12.pass_when: PASS when no SSL policy is set or its policy minimum is TLS 1.2 or 1.3.
azure.claude2.app_gateway_min_tls_12.fail_when: FAIL when its configured custom or predefined SSL policy permits TLS 1.0 or 1.1.

azure.claude2.app_gateway_waf_enabled.description: For an Application Gateway, FAIL is reported when neither a firewallPolicy ID nor an enabled webApplicationFirewallConfiguration exists. HTTP attacks may reach backends without the declared WAF filter.
azure.claude2.app_gateway_waf_enabled.pass_when: PASS when a firewall policy is attached or the inline WAF configuration is enabled.
azure.claude2.app_gateway_waf_enabled.fail_when: FAIL when neither a firewallPolicy ID nor an enabled webApplicationFirewallConfiguration exists.

azure.claude2.app_gateway_waf_mode_speci.description: For an Application Gateway, FAIL means neither an attached WAF policy nor inline WAF configuration exists. Detection and Prevention both pass when read from the attached policy or inline mode; Detection does not block requests.
azure.claude2.app_gateway_waf_mode_speci.pass_when: PASS when the attached policy or inline configuration reports Detection or Prevention mode.
azure.claude2.app_gateway_waf_mode_speci.fail_when: FAIL when neither WAF policy nor inline WAF configuration exists; an unrecognized mode yields UNKNOWN.

azure.claude2.app_service_environment_in.description: For an App Service environment, FAIL is reported when clusterSettings lacks InternalEncryption with value true. Internal environment traffic or storage may lack the requested encryption setting.
azure.claude2.app_service_environment_in.pass_when: PASS when the InternalEncryption cluster setting is true.
azure.claude2.app_service_environment_in.fail_when: FAIL when clusterSettings lacks InternalEncryption with value true.

azure.claude2.app_service_plan_minimum_s.description: For an App Service plan, FAIL is reported when sku.name is F1, D1, B1, B2, or B3. The plan may lack higher tier isolation and capacity features.
azure.claude2.app_service_plan_minimum_s.pass_when: PASS when the SKU is outside those low tier names.
azure.claude2.app_service_plan_minimum_s.fail_when: FAIL when sku.name is F1, D1, B1, B2, or B3.

azure.claude2.app_workers_more_than_one.description: For an App Service site, FAIL means numberOfWorkers is one or fewer; it has no declared multiple-worker capacity.
azure.claude2.app_workers_more_than_one.pass_when: PASS when numberOfWorkers is greater than one.
azure.claude2.app_workers_more_than_one.fail_when: FAIL when numberOfWorkers is one or fewer.

azure.claude2.application_insights_confi.description: For a subscription, FAIL is reported when no Application Insights component appears in the complete scoped inventory. Application telemetry may be absent for incident triage.
azure.claude2.application_insights_confi.pass_when: PASS when at least one component is collected.
azure.claude2.application_insights_confi.fail_when: FAIL when no Application Insights component appears in the complete scoped inventory.
azure.claude2.application_insights_confi.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the subscription has no App Service or Functions app.

azure.claude2.application_insights_publi.description: For an Application Insights component, FAIL means public ingestion or public query access remains Enabled. Both declared access modes must be Disabled.
azure.claude2.application_insights_publi.pass_when: PASS when both ingestion and query public network access are Disabled.
azure.claude2.application_insights_publi.fail_when: FAIL when either publicNetworkAccessForIngestion or publicNetworkAccessForQuery is Enabled.

azure.claude2.application_insights_works.description: For the application insights, FAIL means `properties.WorkspaceResourceId` is null. Telemetry may lack the retention and access controls of a linked Log Analytics workspace.
azure.claude2.application_insights_works.pass_when: PASS when WorkspaceResourceId is a nonempty string.
azure.claude2.application_insights_works.fail_when: FAIL when WorkspaceResourceId is null or empty.

azure.claude2.automation_variable_encryp.description: For an Automation variable, FAIL means isEncrypted is false, so the variable is not marked for encrypted storage.

azure.claude2.batch_account_customer_man.description: For a Batch account, FAIL means encryption.keySource is Microsoft.Batch rather than Microsoft.KeyVault; no customer-managed key is declared.

azure.claude2.batch_account_managed_iden.description: For a Batch account, FAIL is reported when identity is absent, null, or has type None. The Batch account may need stored credentials for dependent Azure resources.
azure.claude2.batch_account_managed_iden.pass_when: PASS when identity.type is SystemAssigned or UserAssigned.
azure.claude2.batch_account_managed_iden.fail_when: FAIL when identity is absent, null, or has type None.

azure.claude2.batch_account_resource_log.description: For a Batch account, FAIL means no diagnostic setting has an enabled log entry with usable retention metadata. An enabled retention policy missing days does not count.
azure.claude2.batch_account_resource_log.pass_when: PASS when at least one setting has an enabled log entry that is not excluded by enabled retention with missing days.
azure.claude2.batch_account_resource_log.fail_when: FAIL when no eligible enabled log entry exists.

azure.claude2.defender_attack_path_setti.description: For a subscription, FAIL is reported when attack path alert setting or a matching alert notification contact is absent. Attack path findings may not be delivered to responders.
azure.claude2.defender_attack_path_setti.pass_when: PASS when attack path notifications and an alert contact are configured.
azure.claude2.defender_attack_path_setti.fail_when: FAIL when attack path alert setting or a matching alert notification contact is absent.
azure.claude2.defender_attack_path_setti.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the anchor is not a subscription or no AttackPath Defender setting exists.

azure.claude2.entra_ca_mfa_all_users_or_.description: For an Entra tenant, FAIL means no enabled Conditional Access policy requires MFA, excludes no users, and includes either All users or an activated directory role template.
azure.claude2.entra_ca_mfa_all_users_or_.pass_when: PASS when one enabled MFA policy has no excluded users and includes All users or at least one activated directory role template.
azure.claude2.entra_ca_mfa_all_users_or_.fail_when: FAIL when no policy meets all those conditions.
azure.claude2.entra_ca_mfa_all_users_or_.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when directory facts belong to a different tenant.

azure.claude2.entra_custom_banned_passwo.description: For the Entra tenant, this evaluates customized EnableBannedPasswordCheck directory setting values. FAIL when not every customized value parses true; an absent customization is NOT_APPLICABLE.
azure.claude2.entra_custom_banned_passwo.pass_when: PASS when every customized value parses true.
azure.claude2.entra_custom_banned_passwo.fail_when: FAIL when at least one does not satisfy the rule that every customized value parses true.
azure.claude2.entra_custom_banned_passwo.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when no directory setting customizes EnableBannedPasswordCheck. Also when directory facts belong to a different tenant.

azure.claude2.entra_device_join_requires.description: For the Entra tenant, FAIL means its unique device registration policy says MFA is notRequired for device join or registration.
azure.claude2.entra_device_join_requires.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when directory facts belong to a different tenant.

azure.claude2.entra_global_admin_between.description: For the Entra tenant, FAIL means fewer than two or more than four distinct principals have an active tenant-wide Global Administrator role assignment. Eligible PIM roles are not counted.
azure.claude2.entra_global_admin_between.pass_when: PASS when two to four distinct principals have active Global Administrator assignments at directoryScopeId /.
azure.claude2.entra_global_admin_between.fail_when: FAIL when the count of active Global Administrator role assignments is below two or above four.
azure.claude2.entra_global_admin_between.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when directory facts belong to a different tenant.

azure.claude2.entra_lockout_duration_min.description: For the Entra tenant, this evaluates customized LockoutDurationInSeconds directory setting values. FAIL when not every customized value is at least 60 seconds; an absent customization is NOT_APPLICABLE.
azure.claude2.entra_lockout_duration_min.pass_when: PASS when every customized value is at least 60 seconds.
azure.claude2.entra_lockout_duration_min.fail_when: FAIL when at least one does not satisfy the rule that every customized value is at least 60 seconds.
azure.claude2.entra_lockout_duration_min.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when no directory setting customizes LockoutDurationInSeconds. Also when directory facts belong to a different tenant.

azure.claude2.entra_lockout_threshold_ma.description: For the Entra tenant, this evaluates customized LockoutThreshold directory setting values. FAIL when not every customized value is at most 10; an absent customization is NOT_APPLICABLE.
azure.claude2.entra_lockout_threshold_ma.pass_when: PASS when every customized value is at most 10.
azure.claude2.entra_lockout_threshold_ma.fail_when: FAIL when at least one does not satisfy the rule that every customized value is at most 10.
azure.claude2.entra_lockout_threshold_ma.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when no directory setting customizes LockoutThreshold. Also when directory facts belong to a different tenant.

azure.claude2.entra_user_mfa_registered.description: For a user registration detail with a principal name, FAIL means isMfaRegistered is false; no MFA method is recorded for that user.
azure.claude2.entra_user_mfa_registered.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when Upstream skips registration rows without a user principal name.

azure.claude2.function_app_authenticatio.description: For an App Service function app, FAIL is reported when authSettingsV2.properties.platform.enabled is false or omitted. Unauthenticated callers can reach app endpoints if no other gate exists.
azure.claude2.function_app_authenticatio.pass_when: PASS when the authentication platform switch is true.
azure.claude2.function_app_authenticatio.fail_when: FAIL when authSettingsV2.properties.platform.enabled is false or omitted.
azure.claude2.function_app_authenticatio.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has a functionapp element.

azure.claude2.function_app_client_certif.description: For an App Service function app, FAIL is reported when properties.clientCertEnabled is false. Requests can arrive without the configured client certificate gate.
azure.claude2.function_app_client_certif.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has a functionapp element.

azure.claude2.function_app_ftps_required.description: For an App Service function app, FAIL is reported when configuration.properties.ftpsState is AllAllowed. Plain FTP can expose deployment credentials and content.
azure.claude2.function_app_ftps_required.pass_when: PASS when the state is FtpsOnly or Disabled.
azure.claude2.function_app_ftps_required.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has a functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element starting with functionapp.

azure.claude2.function_app_linux_http2.description: For a Linux function app, FAIL means http20Enabled is false, so the endpoint is not configured for HTTP/2.
azure.claude2.function_app_linux_http2.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has a functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated functionapp element and a linux element.

azure.claude2.function_app_managed_ident.description: For an App Service function app, FAIL is reported when identity.type is None or no identity is declared. The app may rely on long lived secrets to call Azure services.
azure.claude2.function_app_managed_ident.pass_when: PASS when a system or user assigned identity is declared.
azure.claude2.function_app_managed_ident.fail_when: FAIL when identity.type is None or no identity is declared.
azure.claude2.function_app_managed_ident.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has a functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element starting with functionapp.

azure.claude2.function_app_restrict_publ.description: For a function app, FAIL means a site access restriction explicitly allows ipAddress Any. An absent restriction list passes this predicate.
azure.claude2.function_app_restrict_publ.pass_when: PASS when no restriction has both ipAddress Any and action Allow, including when the list is absent.
azure.claude2.function_app_restrict_publ.fail_when: FAIL when at least one restriction has ipAddress Any and action Allow.
azure.claude2.function_app_restrict_publ.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has a functionapp element.

azure.claude2.iam_no_custom_owner_roles.description: For a subscription, FAIL means a custom role definition declares * or *:* in its actions. The evaluator does not account for notActions or effective assignment.
azure.claude2.iam_no_custom_owner_roles.pass_when: PASS when no custom role declares * or *:* in actions.
azure.claude2.iam_no_custom_owner_roles.fail_when: FAIL when any custom role declares * or *:* in actions.
azure.claude2.iam_no_custom_owner_roles.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the anchor is not a subscription.

azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_configured.description: For an NSG attached to a subnet or NIC, FAIL is reported when neither a direct NSG flow log nor an enabled covering VNet flow log exists. Network traffic to the NSG may have no flow record.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_configured.pass_when: PASS when a direct flow log or enabled covering VNet log exists.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_configured.fail_when: FAIL when neither a direct NSG flow log nor an enabled covering VNet flow log exists.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_configured.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the NSG has no subnet or NIC attachment.

azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_retention_90.description: For an NSG with direct NSG flow logs, FAIL means any direct log is disabled or retains fewer than 90 days. Without direct logs, covering VNet logs pass when enabled with at least 90 days or zero for indefinite retention.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_retention_90.pass_when: PASS when direct logs meet 90 days, or covering VNet logs meet their 90 day or unlimited zero rule.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_retention_90.fail_when: FAIL when any direct NSG flow log is disabled or retains fewer than 90 days; when no direct log exists, a covering VNet log fails its 90 day or unlimited zero retention rule.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_retention_90.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when neither a direct NSG log nor covering VNet log is present.

azure.claude2.nsg_flow_logs_to_log_analy.description: For a subscription containing an NSG or VNet, FAIL means no NSG, VNet or NIC flow log has Traffic Analytics enabled with a Log Analytics workspace ID.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_logs_to_log_analy.pass_when: PASS when at least one targeted NSG, VNet or NIC flow log has enabled Traffic Analytics and a workspace ID.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_logs_to_log_analy.fail_when: FAIL when no such targeted flow log exists.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_logs_to_log_analy.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the subscription inventory has neither NSGs nor VNets.

azure.claude2.prowler_app_authentication.description: For an App Service site whose kind starts with app, FAIL means App Service Authentication platform.enabled is false or omitted.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_authentication.pass_when: PASS when App Service Authentication platform.enabled is true.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_authentication.fail_when: FAIL when platform.enabled is false or omitted.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_authentication.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with app.

azure.claude2.prowler_app_client_certifi.description: For an App Service app, FAIL is reported when clientCertEnabled is false or clientCertMode differs from Required. Clients may access the app without presenting a certificate.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_client_certifi.pass_when: PASS when client certificates are enabled with mode Required.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_client_certifi.fail_when: FAIL when clientCertEnabled is false or clientCertMode differs from Required.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_client_certifi.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with app.

azure.claude2.prowler_app_http_logs.description: For an App Service site whose kind starts with app, FAIL means no diagnostic setting enables AppServiceHTTPLogs or the allLogs category group.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_http_logs.pass_when: PASS when any setting enables AppServiceHTTPLogs or allLogs.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_http_logs.fail_when: FAIL when no setting enables either log category or group.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_http_logs.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with app.

azure.claude2.prowler_app_identity.description: For an App Service app whose kind starts with app, FAIL is reported when identity.type is None or identity is absent. The app may rely on persistent secrets to access Azure services.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_identity.pass_when: PASS when a system or user managed identity is assigned.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_identity.fail_when: FAIL when identity.type is None or identity is absent.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_identity.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with app.

azure.claude2.prowler_function_ftp_ftps_.description: For a function app whose kind starts with functionapp, FAIL means ftpsState is FtpsOnly or AllAllowed; only Disabled turns off both FTP and FTPS publishing.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_ftp_ftps_.fail_when: FAIL when ftpsState is FtpsOnly or AllAllowed.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_ftp_ftps_.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with functionapp.

azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity.description: For a function app whose kind starts with functionapp, FAIL is reported when identity.type is None or identity is absent. The function may rely on persistent secrets to access Azure services.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity.pass_when: PASS when a system or user managed identity is assigned.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity.fail_when: FAIL when identity.type is None or identity is absent.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with functionapp.

azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity_.description: For a function app with a managed identity, FAIL is reported when its principal has a subscription visible Owner, Contributor, User Access Administrator, or RBAC Administrator role assignment. Compromise of the function may grant broad Azure control.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity_.pass_when: PASS when none of those role definitions is assigned to its principal.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity_.fail_when: FAIL when its principal has a subscription visible Owner, Contributor, User Access Administrator, or RBAC Administrator role assignment.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity_.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when kind does not start with functionapp or the function has no managed identity.

azure.claude2.prowler_function_not_publi.description: For a function app whose kind starts with functionapp, FAIL means publicNetworkAccess is Enabled. Disabled passes; unset mode yields UNKNOWN.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_not_publi.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with functionapp.

azure.claude2.prowler_function_vnet_inte.description: For a function app whose kind starts with functionapp, FAIL means virtualNetworkSubnetId is null or empty, so no VNet integration subnet is declared.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_vnet_inte.pass_when: PASS when virtualNetworkSubnetId is a nonempty string.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_vnet_inte.fail_when: FAIL when virtualNetworkSubnetId is null or empty.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_vnet_inte.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with functionapp.

azure.claude2.sql_server_threat_detectio.description: For an Azure SQL server, FAIL is reported when any security alert policy is disabled or excludes a named alert category. Excluded SQL attack signatures may never raise an alert.
azure.claude2.sql_server_threat_detectio.pass_when: PASS when every collected policy is enabled and has no disabled alert category.
azure.claude2.sql_server_threat_detectio.fail_when: FAIL when any security alert policy is disabled or excludes a named alert category.

azure.claude2.vm_encryption_at_host.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when properties.securityProfile.encryptionAtHost is false or omitted. Temporary disks and caches may lack host encryption.
azure.claude2.vm_encryption_at_host.fail_when: FAIL when properties.securityProfile.encryptionAtHost is false or omitted.

azure.claude2.vm_linux_ssh_key_only_gues.description: For a Linux virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no LinuxNoPasswordForSSH guest assignment reports Compliant. Password based SSH may remain allowed inside the guest.
azure.claude2.vm_linux_ssh_key_only_gues.pass_when: PASS when at least one such assignment reports Compliant.
azure.claude2.vm_linux_ssh_key_only_gues.fail_when: FAIL when no LinuxNoPasswordForSSH guest assignment reports Compliant.
azure.claude2.vm_linux_ssh_key_only_gues.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Windows.

azure.claude2.vm_nic_ip_forwarding_disab.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when any referenced NIC has enableIPForwarding true. The VM may relay traffic between network segments.
azure.claude2.vm_nic_ip_forwarding_disab.pass_when: PASS when all referenced NICs disable IP forwarding.
azure.claude2.vm_nic_ip_forwarding_disab.fail_when: FAIL when any referenced NIC has enableIPForwarding true.

azure.claude2.vm_trusted_launch_secure_b.description: For a Trusted Launch virtual machine, FAIL is reported when either secureBootEnabled or vTpmEnabled is false. Boot integrity or measured boot protection is incomplete.
azure.claude2.vm_trusted_launch_secure_b.pass_when: PASS when both UEFI secure boot and vTPM are enabled.
azure.claude2.vm_trusted_launch_secure_b.fail_when: FAIL when either secureBootEnabled or vTpmEnabled is false.
azure.claude2.vm_trusted_launch_secure_b.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM has no security profile or securityType is not TrustedLaunch.

azure.claude2.vmss_encryption_at_host.description: For a VM scale set, FAIL means virtualMachineProfile.securityProfile.encryptionAtHost is false, so host encryption is not declared for instances.

azure.claude2.vnet_flow_log_retention_90.description: For a VNet, subnet, or NIC flow log, FAIL is reported when logging is disabled or retentionPolicy.days is below 90 and not zero. Network evidence may expire before delayed incident response.
azure.claude2.vnet_flow_log_retention_90.pass_when: PASS when logging is enabled with at least 90 days or unlimited zero day retention.
azure.claude2.vnet_flow_log_retention_90.fail_when: FAIL when logging is disabled or retentionPolicy.days is below 90 and not zero.
azure.claude2.vnet_flow_log_retention_90.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the flow log targets another resource type.

azure.claude2.vnet_flow_logs_to_log_anal.description: For a subscription containing a VNet, FAIL means no VNet or NIC flow log has Traffic Analytics enabled with a Log Analytics workspace ID.
azure.claude2.vnet_flow_logs_to_log_anal.pass_when: PASS when at least one targeted VNet or NIC flow log has enabled Traffic Analytics and a workspace ID.
azure.claude2.vnet_flow_logs_to_log_anal.fail_when: FAIL when no such targeted flow log exists.
azure.claude2.vnet_flow_logs_to_log_anal.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the subscription has no VNet.

azure.claude2.vnet_with_app_gateway_ddos.description: For a virtual network containing an Application Gateway, FAIL is reported when properties.enableDdosProtection is false or omitted. The gateway network may lack the declared DDoS protection.
azure.claude2.vnet_with_app_gateway_ddos.pass_when: PASS when DDoS protection is enabled.
azure.claude2.vnet_with_app_gateway_ddos.fail_when: FAIL when properties.enableDdosProtection is false or omitted.
azure.claude2.vnet_with_app_gateway_ddos.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VNet contains no Application Gateway.

azure.claude2.web_app_always_on.description: For a non-function App Service site, FAIL means alwaysOn is false, allowing the app to unload after inactivity.
azure.claude2.web_app_always_on.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element.

azure.claude2.web_app_authentication_ena.description: For an App Service web app, FAIL is reported when authSettingsV2.properties.platform.enabled is false or omitted. Unauthenticated callers can reach app endpoints if no other gate exists.
azure.claude2.web_app_authentication_ena.pass_when: PASS when the authentication platform switch is true.
azure.claude2.web_app_authentication_ena.fail_when: FAIL when authSettingsV2.properties.platform.enabled is false or omitted.
azure.claude2.web_app_authentication_ena.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element.

azure.claude2.web_app_client_certificate.description: For an App Service web app, FAIL is reported when properties.clientCertEnabled is false. Requests can arrive without the configured client certificate gate.
azure.claude2.web_app_client_certificate.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element starting with app.

azure.claude2.web_app_diagnostic_http_lo.description: For a non-function App Service site, FAIL is reported when no diagnostic setting enables AppServiceHTTPLogs. HTTP request records may not reach the diagnostic destination.
azure.claude2.web_app_diagnostic_http_lo.pass_when: PASS when an enabled AppServiceHTTPLogs category exists.
