azure.claude2.web_app_diagnostic_http_lo.fail_when: FAIL when no diagnostic setting enables AppServiceHTTPLogs.
azure.claude2.web_app_diagnostic_http_lo.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element.

azure.claude2.web_app_diagnostic_logs_en.description: For an explicitly Windows non-function App Service site, checks IIS detailed error, HTTP web-server and failed-request logging declarations; Linux application and Azure Monitor logging are separate.
azure.claude2.web_app_diagnostic_logs_en.pass_when: Explicit Windows evidence and all three IIS diagnostic flags are true.
azure.claude2.web_app_diagnostic_logs_en.fail_when: Explicit Windows evidence and any of the three IIS diagnostic flags is false.
azure.claude2.web_app_diagnostic_logs_en.not_applicable_when: Explicit Linux or a function app; unresolved or conflicting OS facts are UNKNOWN.

azure.claude2.web_app_failed_request_tra.description: For an explicitly Windows non-function App Service site, checks IIS failed-request tracing; Linux application and Azure Monitor logs are separate.
azure.claude2.web_app_failed_request_tra.pass_when: Explicit Windows evidence and failedRequestsTracing.enabled is true.
azure.claude2.web_app_failed_request_tra.fail_when: Explicit Windows evidence and failedRequestsTracing.enabled is false.
azure.claude2.web_app_failed_request_tra.not_applicable_when: Explicit Linux or a function app; unresolved or conflicting OS facts are UNKNOWN.

azure.claude2.web_app_ftps_required.description: For an App Service web app, FAIL is reported when configuration.properties.ftpsState is AllAllowed. Plain FTP can expose deployment credentials and content.
azure.claude2.web_app_ftps_required.pass_when: PASS when the state is FtpsOnly or Disabled.
azure.claude2.web_app_ftps_required.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element starting with app.

azure.claude2.web_app_health_check.description: For a non-function App Service site, FAIL means healthCheckPath is null. The evaluator accepts any string, including an empty path.
azure.claude2.web_app_health_check.pass_when: PASS when healthCheckPath is a string, including empty.
azure.claude2.web_app_health_check.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element.

azure.claude2.web_app_incoming_client_ce.description: For a non-function App Service site, FAIL is reported when properties.clientCertEnabled is false. Requests can arrive without a client certificate.
azure.claude2.web_app_incoming_client_ce.pass_when: PASS when incoming client certificates are enabled.
azure.claude2.web_app_incoming_client_ce.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element.

azure.claude2.web_app_managed_identity.description: For an App Service web app, FAIL is reported when identity.type is None or no identity is declared. The app may rely on long lived secrets to call Azure services.
azure.claude2.web_app_managed_identity.pass_when: PASS when a system or user assigned identity is declared.
azure.claude2.web_app_managed_identity.fail_when: FAIL when identity.type is None or no identity is declared.
azure.claude2.web_app_managed_identity.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element starting with app.

azure.claude2.web_app_register_with_entr.description: For a non-function App Service site, FAIL means no system or user managed identity is declared. This check does not inspect an Entra app registration.
azure.claude2.web_app_register_with_entr.pass_when: PASS when a managed identity type is declared.
azure.claude2.web_app_register_with_entr.fail_when: FAIL when no system or user managed identity is declared.
azure.claude2.web_app_register_with_entr.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element.

azure.claude2.web_app_remote_debugging_d.description: For an App Service web app, FAIL is reported when configuration.properties.remoteDebuggingEnabled is true. A remote debugger may expose process state and secrets.
azure.claude2.web_app_remote_debugging_d.pass_when: PASS when remote debugging is false.
azure.claude2.web_app_remote_debugging_d.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind is not exactly api.

azure.claude2.web_app_slot_https_only.description: For an App Service deployment slot, FAIL is reported when properties.httpsOnly is false. Clients may send slot requests over cleartext HTTP.
azure.claude2.web_app_slot_https_only.pass_when: PASS when the slot requires HTTPS.

azure.claude2.web_app_vnet_connection.description: For a non-function App Service site, checks an observed regional subnet ARM ID or native VNet connection reference; configuration does not prove outbound reachability.
azure.claude2.web_app_vnet_connection.pass_when: A valid regional subnet or native VNet connection reference is observed.
azure.claude2.web_app_vnet_connection.fail_when: The regional subnet is explicitly empty, a complete native VNet connection inventory is empty, and vnetName is empty or null.
azure.claude2.web_app_vnet_connection.not_applicable_when: A function app; a legacy vnetName alone or incomplete/denied connection facts are UNKNOWN.

azure.defender.standard_tier.description: For the Defender pricing plan, FAIL means `properties.pricingTier` is `Free`. The listed resource plan lacks paid Defender threat detection coverage.
azure.defender.standard_tier.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the pricing plan name is outside the reviewed list of Defender resource plans.

azure.disk.entra_export_auth.description: For the disk, FAIL means `properties.dataAccessAuthMode` is `None`.

azure.disk.private_export.description: For a managed disk, FAIL means publicNetworkAccess is Enabled or networkAccessPolicy is AllowAll. Export networking is restricted only when public access is Disabled and policy is AllowPrivate or DenyAll.
azure.disk.private_export.pass_when: PASS when publicNetworkAccess is Disabled and networkAccessPolicy is AllowPrivate or DenyAll.
azure.disk.private_export.fail_when: FAIL when publicNetworkAccess is Enabled or networkAccessPolicy is AllowAll.

azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_http.description: For a network security group, FAIL is reported when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering TCP 80. The declared rule permits unsolicited TCP 80 traffic; rule priority and shadowing Deny rules are ignored.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_http.pass_when: PASS when no custom inbound internet Allow declaration covers TCP 80.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_http.fail_when: FAIL when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering TCP 80.

azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_http_htt.description: For a network security group, FAIL is reported when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering TCP 80 or 443. The declared rule permits unsolicited TCP 80 or 443 traffic; rule priority and shadowing Deny rules are ignored.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_http_htt.pass_when: PASS when no custom inbound internet Allow declaration covers TCP 80 or 443.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_http_htt.fail_when: FAIL when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering TCP 80 or 443.

azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_rdp.description: For a network security group, FAIL is reported when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering TCP 3389. The declared rule permits unsolicited TCP 3389 traffic; rule priority and shadowing Deny rules are ignored.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_rdp.pass_when: PASS when no custom inbound internet Allow declaration covers TCP 3389.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_rdp.fail_when: FAIL when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering TCP 3389.

azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_remote_a.description: For a network security group, FAIL is reported when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering TCP 22 or 3389. The declared rule permits unsolicited TCP 22 or 3389 traffic; rule priority and shadowing Deny rules are ignored.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_remote_a.pass_when: PASS when no custom inbound internet Allow declaration covers TCP 22 or 3389.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_remote_a.fail_when: FAIL when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering TCP 22 or 3389.

azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_ssh.description: For a network security group, FAIL is reported when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering TCP 22. The declared rule permits unsolicited TCP 22 traffic; rule priority and shadowing Deny rules are ignored.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_ssh.pass_when: PASS when no custom inbound internet Allow declaration covers TCP 22.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_ssh.fail_when: FAIL when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering TCP 22.

azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_udp_any.description: For a network security group, FAIL is reported when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering any UDP port. The declared rule permits unsolicited any UDP port traffic; rule priority and shadowing Deny rules are ignored.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_udp_any.pass_when: PASS when no custom inbound internet Allow declaration covers any UDP port.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_udp_any.fail_when: FAIL when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering any UDP port.

azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_udp_serv.description: For a network security group, FAIL is reported when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering UDP 53, 123, 161, 389, or 1900. The declared rule permits unsolicited UDP 53, 123, 161, 389, or 1900 traffic; rule priority and shadowing Deny rules are ignored.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_udp_serv.pass_when: PASS when no custom inbound internet Allow declaration covers UDP 53, 123, 161, 389, or 1900.
azure.gap.nsg_declared_internet_udp_serv.fail_when: FAIL when any custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source and a destination covering UDP 53, 123, 161, 389, or 1900.

azure.htbp.acr.anonymous_pull_disabled.description: For a container registry, FAIL is reported when properties.anonymousPullEnabled is true. Anyone may pull repository images without authenticating.

azure.htbp.appconfig.local_auth_disabled.description: For the app configuration, FAIL means `properties.disableLocalAuth` is false.

azure.htbp.appservice.ftp_basic_auth_dis.description: For an App Service site with FTP or FTPS enabled, FAIL means FTP basic-auth publishing credentials are allowed. Disabled FTP/FTPS is outside this check.

azure.htbp.appservice.scm_basic_auth_dis.description: For the App Service site, FAIL means `scmBasicAuthPolicy.properties.allow` is true.

azure.htbp.appservice.scm_site_restricte.description: For an App Service site with restricted main access, FAIL is reported when the SCM site neither inherits main site restrictions nor has its own restrictive rules. The Kudu deployment and command endpoint may remain open while the app is restricted.
azure.htbp.appservice.scm_site_restricte.pass_when: PASS when SCM inherits the main rules or has its own restrictive rules.
azure.htbp.appservice.scm_site_restricte.fail_when: FAIL when the SCM site neither inherits main site restrictions nor has its own restrictive rules.
azure.htbp.appservice.scm_site_restricte.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when public access is disabled or the main site has no access restrictions.

azure.htbp.automation.webhook_expiry_bou.description: For an Automation account webhook, FAIL is reported when an enabled webhook has no expiry or an expiry beyond the evaluator’s allowed horizon. A leaked webhook URL may trigger runbooks long after issuance.
azure.htbp.automation.webhook_expiry_bou.pass_when: PASS when every enabled webhook expires within the allowed horizon.
azure.htbp.automation.webhook_expiry_bou.fail_when: FAIL when an enabled webhook has no expiry or an expiry beyond the evaluator’s allowed horizon.

azure.htbp.batch.shared_key_auth_disable.description: For a Batch account, FAIL is reported when allowedAuthenticationModes contains SharedKey. A leaked account key can authenticate independently of Entra policy.
azure.htbp.batch.shared_key_auth_disable.pass_when: PASS when the modes exclude SharedKey.

azure.htbp.entra.app_fic_github_not_pull.description: For an Entra application federated credential, FAIL is reported when a GitHub Actions issuer trusts a pull_request subject. Untrusted pull request code may obtain an Azure workload token.
azure.htbp.entra.app_fic_github_not_pull.pass_when: PASS when the GitHub subject is restricted to a non-pull request context.
azure.htbp.entra.app_fic_github_not_pull.fail_when: FAIL when a GitHub Actions issuer trusts a pull_request subject.
azure.htbp.entra.app_fic_github_not_pull.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the issuer is not GitHub Actions.

azure.htbp.entra.app_no_tier0_graph_appl.description: For an Entra application, FAIL is reported when requiredResourceAccess requests any high privilege Microsoft Graph application role from the evaluator’s Tier 0 list. Application credentials may authorize tenant wide directory changes.
azure.htbp.entra.app_no_tier0_graph_appl.pass_when: PASS when none of its requested Graph application roles is in the Tier 0 list.
azure.htbp.entra.app_no_tier0_graph_appl.fail_when: FAIL when requiredResourceAccess requests any high privilege Microsoft Graph application role from the evaluator’s Tier 0 list.

azure.htbp.entra.service_principal_no_pa.description: For a non-SAML Entra service principal, FAIL means it has an unexpired password credential (or one with no endDateTime) at the snapshot time. Expired credentials do not fail.
azure.htbp.entra.service_principal_no_pa.pass_when: PASS when no password credentials are present or every credential is expired at the snapshot time.
azure.htbp.entra.service_principal_no_pa.fail_when: FAIL when at least one password credential is active or has no expiration.

azure.htbp.entra.temporary_access_pass_o.description: For an enabled Temporary Access Pass method policy, FAIL is reported when isUsableOnce is false or maximumLifetimeInMinutes exceeds 480. A captured TAP may be reused or remain valid for many hours.
azure.htbp.entra.temporary_access_pass_o.pass_when: PASS when isUsableOnce is true and maximum lifetime is at most 480 minutes.
azure.htbp.entra.temporary_access_pass_o.fail_when: FAIL when isUsableOnce is false or maximumLifetimeInMinutes exceeds 480.
azure.htbp.entra.temporary_access_pass_o.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when Temporary Access Pass is disabled.

azure.htbp.eventgrid.domain_local_auth_d.description: For the eventgrid domain, FAIL means `properties.disableLocalAuth` is false.

azure.htbp.eventgrid.topic_local_auth_di.description: For the eventgrid topic, FAIL means `properties.disableLocalAuth` is false.

azure.htbp.eventhub.local_auth_disabled.description: For the eventhub namespace, FAIL means `properties.disableLocalAuth` is false.

azure.htbp.iothub.local_auth_disabled.description: For the iot hub, FAIL means `properties.disableLocalAuth` is false.

azure.htbp.keyvault.template_deployment_.description: For a Key Vault, FAIL is reported when properties.enabledForTemplateDeployment is true. An ARM template deployment principal may retrieve vault secrets.
azure.htbp.keyvault.template_deployment_.pass_when: PASS when template deployment access is disabled.

azure.htbp.logicapp.request_trigger_call.description: For an enabled Logic App with an HTTP Request trigger, FAIL means trigger access control has neither an allowedCallerIpAddresses field nor any openAuthenticationPolicies.policies. The rule checks workflow-level trigger controls, not each trigger separately.
azure.htbp.logicapp.request_trigger_call.pass_when: PASS when allowedCallerIpAddresses is present (even empty) or an OAuth policy is declared.
azure.htbp.logicapp.request_trigger_call.fail_when: FAIL when neither control is declared.
azure.htbp.logicapp.request_trigger_call.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when there is no Request trigger or the workflow is not Enabled.

azure.htbp.managed_identity.fic_github_n.description: For an Entra managed identity federated credential, FAIL is reported when a GitHub Actions issuer trusts a pull_request subject. Untrusted pull request code may obtain an Azure workload token.
azure.htbp.managed_identity.fic_github_n.pass_when: PASS when the GitHub subject is restricted to a non-pull request context.
azure.htbp.managed_identity.fic_github_n.fail_when: FAIL when a GitHub Actions issuer trusts a pull_request subject.
azure.htbp.managed_identity.fic_github_n.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the issuer is not GitHub Actions.

azure.htbp.postgresql.password_auth_disa.description: For the postgresql flexible server, FAIL means `properties.authConfig.passwordAuth` is `Enabled`.

azure.htbp.redis.access_key_auth_disable.description: For the redis cache, FAIL means `properties.disableAccessKeyAuthentication` is false.

azure.htbp.search.api_key_auth_disabled.description: For the search service, FAIL means `properties.disableLocalAuth` is false.

azure.htbp.signalr.local_auth_disabled.description: For the signalr service, FAIL means `properties.disableLocalAuth` is false.

azure.htbp.sql.entra_only_authentication.description: For a SQL server with an ActiveDirectory administrator, FAIL means at least one such administrator has azureADOnlyAuthentication false. Other administrator types are ignored.
azure.htbp.sql.entra_only_authentication.pass_when: PASS when every ActiveDirectory administrator has azureADOnlyAuthentication true.
azure.htbp.sql.entra_only_authentication.fail_when: FAIL when any ActiveDirectory administrator has azureADOnlyAuthentication false.
azure.htbp.sql.entra_only_authentication.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when no ActiveDirectory administrator is collected.

azure.htbp.storage.sftp_local_users_disa.description: For a storage account, FAIL means SFTP is enabled while local users remain enabled. The evaluator does not read hierarchical namespace or shared-key access settings.
azure.htbp.storage.sftp_local_users_disa.pass_when: PASS when SFTP is disabled or local users are disabled.
azure.htbp.storage.sftp_local_users_disa.fail_when: FAIL when isSftpEnabled and isLocalUserEnabled are both true.

azure.htbp.synapse.firewall_no_allow_all.description: For a Synapse workspace with public network access, FAIL means any firewall rule covers at least half the IPv4 address space. A 0.0.0.0-only Azure-services rule does not fail.
azure.htbp.synapse.firewall_no_allow_all.pass_when: PASS when every firewall range covers fewer than 2^31 IPv4 addresses.
azure.htbp.synapse.firewall_no_allow_all.fail_when: FAIL when any firewall range covers 2^31 or more IPv4 addresses.

azure.htbp.webpubsub.local_auth_disabled.description: For the web pubsub, FAIL means `properties.disableLocalAuth` is false.

azure.iam.no_full_custom_role.description: Reviews declared custom-role permission blocks. A wildcard with no exclusions in its own permission plane yields FAIL, even when a separate block or the other plane contains exclusions. This does not establish an assigned principal or effective authorization.
azure.iam.no_full_custom_role.fail_when: FAIL when any readable block declares actions=[*] without notActions exclusions, or dataActions=[*] without notDataActions exclusions. Exclusions in a different block or permission plane do not remove that finding.
azure.iam.no_full_custom_role.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the role is built in.
azure.iam.no_full_custom_role.pass_when: PASS when complete readable permission blocks contain no wildcard actions or dataActions. Wildcards with corresponding exclusions require MANUAL review; unavailable relevant facts produce UNKNOWN.

azure.iam.review_owner_assignment.description: For an Azure role assignment, FAIL is reported when roleDefinitionId refers to the Owner role. A principal with Owner rights can grant itself or others broad resource control.
azure.iam.review_owner_assignment.pass_when: PASS when the assigned role is not Owner.
azure.iam.review_owner_assignment.fail_when: FAIL when roleDefinitionId refers to the Owner role.

azure.network.ddos_configured.description: For the virtual network, FAIL means `properties.enableDdosProtection` is false.

azure.network.load_balancer_standard.description: Evaluates the load balancer SKU name and flags Basic load balancers, which lack the security and resiliency features required by the Standard tier.

azure.network.nic_no_ip_forwarding.description: For the network interface, FAIL means `properties.enableIPForwarding` is true.

azure.network.public_ip_standard.description: Evaluates the public IP SKU name and flags Basic public IP resources, whose default exposure and feature limits differ from the Standard tier.

azure.network.restrict_internet_ingress.description: For a network security group, FAIL is reported when a custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source. Unsolicited internet traffic may reach protected subnets or network interfaces.
azure.network.restrict_internet_ingress.pass_when: PASS when no custom inbound Allow rule has an internet source.
azure.network.restrict_internet_ingress.fail_when: FAIL when a custom inbound Allow rule declares an internet source.

azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_guest.description: For an Entra authorization policy, FAIL means allowInvitesFrom is everyone or adminsGuestInvitersAndAllMembers; only none and adminsAndGuestInviters pass.
azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_guest.pass_when: PASS when allowInvitesFrom is none or adminsAndGuestInviters.
azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_guest.fail_when: FAIL when allowInvitesFrom is adminsGuestInvitersAndAllMembers or everyone.

azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_guest.description: For an Entra tenant authorization policy, FAIL is reported when guestUserRoleId is either recognized role template other than the Restricted Guest User template. Guest users may see more directory data than the restricted guest role permits.
azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_guest.pass_when: PASS when guestUserRoleId is the Restricted Guest User template ID.
azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_guest.fail_when: FAIL when guestUserRoleId is either recognized role template other than the Restricted Guest User template.

azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_user_.description: Checks current Graph defaultUserRolePermissions.permissionGrantPoliciesAssigned for a ManagePermissionGrantsForSelf class identifier, case insensitively. It does not inspect existing grants. Remediation: Remove default-role self-consent policy assignments when the source control requires consent disabled; review existing grants separately.
azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_user_.fail_when: A ManagePermissionGrantsForSelf policy is assigned; malformed identifiers are UNKNOWN.

azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_user_.description: Checks whether the selected default role self-consent policy ID set equals the documented microsoft-user-default-low ID. It does not inspect that policy definition or already granted consents. Remediation: Assign the reviewed low-risk self-consent policy only after verifying its current definition and separately reviewing existing grants.
azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_user_.pass_when: The selected self-consent policy set is exactly microsoft-user-default-low.
azure.port.ad_authorization_policy_user_.fail_when: The selected self-consent policy set differs, including empty or legacy sets; malformed identifiers are UNKNOWN.

azure.port.ad_security_defaults_policy_e.description: For the Entra security defaults policy, FAIL means `isEnabled` is false. Tenant sign ins may lack the default identity protections.

azure.port.apimanagement_service_with_vi.description: For API Management, FAIL means virtualNetworkType is None. Internal and External VNet modes pass; External does not imply an internal-only gateway.
azure.port.apimanagement_service_with_vi.pass_when: PASS when virtualNetworkType is Internal or External.

azure.port.app_configuration_encryption_.description: For an App Configuration store, FAIL means encryption.keyVaultProperties.keyIdentifier is null, so no customer-managed key is declared.
azure.port.app_configuration_encryption_.pass_when: PASS when keyIdentifier is a nonempty string.

azure.port.app_configuration_private_lin.description: For a app configuration, FAIL is reported when no privateEndpointConnections entry has Approved status. The app configuration has no approved private endpoint path.
azure.port.app_configuration_private_lin.pass_when: PASS when at least one connection is Approved.
azure.port.app_configuration_private_lin.fail_when: FAIL when no privateEndpointConnections entry has Approved status.

azure.port.app_configuration_sku_standar.description: For an App Configuration store, FAIL means sku.name is free. The accepted provider enum is lowercase standard.

azure.port.cognitive_account_encrypted_w.description: For a Cognitive Services account with CustomerManagedKey capability, FAIL means encryption.keySource is Microsoft.CognitiveServices instead of Microsoft.KeyVault. Without that capability, the predicate passes without reading keySource.
azure.port.cognitive_account_encrypted_w.pass_when: PASS when CustomerManagedKey capability is absent or keySource is Microsoft.KeyVault.
azure.port.cognitive_account_encrypted_w.fail_when: FAIL when CustomerManagedKey capability exists and keySource is Microsoft.CognitiveServices.

azure.port.cognitive_account_private_lin.description: For a Cognitive Services account with private endpoint connections, FAIL means it lacks VirtualNetworks capability or none of its connections is Approved. No connections yield MANUAL.
azure.port.cognitive_account_private_lin.pass_when: PASS when VirtualNetworks capability exists and at least one private connection is Approved.
azure.port.cognitive_account_private_lin.fail_when: FAIL when connections exist but VirtualNetworks capability is absent or no connection is Approved.

azure.port.cognitive_account_public_netw.description: For the cognitive account, FAIL means `properties.publicNetworkAccess` is `Enabled`.

azure.port.cognitive_account_restrict_pu.description: For the cognitive account, FAIL means `properties.networkAcls.defaultAction` is `Allow`.
azure.port.cognitive_account_restrict_pu.pass_when: PASS when VirtualNetworks capability is absent or networkAcls.defaultAction is Deny.
azure.port.cognitive_account_restrict_pu.fail_when: FAIL when VirtualNetworks capability exists and networkAcls.defaultAction is Allow.

azure.port.cognitive_service_local_auth_.description: For the cognitive account, FAIL means `properties.disableLocalAuth` is false.

azure.port.cosmosdb_account_uses_private.description: For a cosmos account, FAIL is reported when no privateEndpointConnections entry has Approved status. The cosmos account has no approved private endpoint path.
azure.port.cosmosdb_account_uses_private.pass_when: PASS when at least one connection is Approved.
azure.port.cosmosdb_account_uses_private.fail_when: FAIL when no privateEndpointConnections entry has Approved status.

azure.port.cosmosdb_account_virtual_netw.description: For a Cosmos DB account, FAIL means publicNetworkAccess is Enabled and isVirtualNetworkFilterEnabled is false. A Disabled public network passes without checking the filter switch.
azure.port.cosmosdb_account_virtual_netw.pass_when: PASS when publicNetworkAccess is Disabled or the VNet filter is enabled.
azure.port.cosmosdb_account_virtual_netw.fail_when: FAIL when publicNetworkAccess is Enabled and the VNet filter is disabled.

azure.port.data_factory_encrypted_with_c.description: For a Data Factory, FAIL means encryption.vaultBaseUrl is null, so no CMK vault base URL is declared.
azure.port.data_factory_encrypted_with_c.pass_when: PASS when vaultBaseUrl is a nonempty string.

azure.port.data_factory_public_network_a.description: For the data factory, FAIL means `properties.publicNetworkAccess` is `Enabled`.

azure.port.data_factory_uses_git_reposit.description: For a Data Factory, FAIL means repoConfiguration.repositoryName is null, so no source-control repository is declared.
azure.port.data_factory_uses_git_reposit.pass_when: PASS when repositoryName is a nonempty string.

azure.port.data_factory_uses_private_lin.description: For a data factory, FAIL is reported when no privateEndpointConnections entry has Approved status. The data factory has no approved private endpoint path.
azure.port.data_factory_uses_private_lin.pass_when: PASS when at least one connection is Approved.
azure.port.data_factory_uses_private_lin.fail_when: FAIL when no privateEndpointConnections entry has Approved status.

azure.port.databricks_workspace_deployed.description: For a Databricks workspace, FAIL means properties.parameters has no customVirtualNetworkId object. The evaluator tests parameter-object presence, not its value or actual VNet attachment.
azure.port.databricks_workspace_deployed.pass_when: PASS when customVirtualNetworkId is a dict, even if its value is absent.

azure.port.databricks_workspace_no_publi.description: For the databricks workspace, FAIL means `properties.parameters.enableNoPublicIp.value` is false.

azure.port.databricks_workspace_public_n.description: For the databricks workspace, FAIL means `properties.publicNetworkAccess` is `Enabled`.

azure.port.databricks_workspace_uses_pri.description: For a databricks workspace, FAIL is reported when no privateEndpointConnections entry has Approved status. The databricks workspace has no approved private endpoint path.
azure.port.databricks_workspace_uses_pri.pass_when: PASS when at least one connection is Approved.
azure.port.databricks_workspace_uses_pri.fail_when: FAIL when no privateEndpointConnections entry has Approved status.

azure.port.defender_alert_severity_conta.description: For a Defender security contact, FAIL is reported when no Alert notification source has a minimalSeverity below Critical. Responders may miss noncritical alerts that still indicate compromise.
azure.port.defender_alert_severity_conta.pass_when: PASS when an Alert source includes Low, Medium, or High severity.
azure.port.defender_alert_severity_conta.fail_when: FAIL when no Alert notification source has a minimalSeverity below Critical.

azure.port.defender_notify_owner_contact.description: For a Defender security contact, FAIL means notificationsByRole.state is Off or its roles list omits Owner. Owner notifications are not enabled in either case.
azure.port.defender_notify_owner_contact.pass_when: PASS when state is On and roles contains Owner.
azure.port.defender_notify_owner_contact.fail_when: FAIL when state is Off or roles omits Owner.

azure.port.defender_required_mcas.description: For a subscription, FAIL is reported when the named MCAS integration security setting is absent or its properties.enabled is false. The MCAS integration will not provide its configured signal to Defender for Cloud.
azure.port.defender_required_mcas.pass_when: PASS when the unique MCAS setting has properties.enabled true.
azure.port.defender_required_mcas.fail_when: FAIL when the named MCAS integration security setting is absent or its properties.enabled is false.
azure.port.defender_required_mcas.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the anchor is not a subscription.

azure.port.defender_required_wdatp.description: For a subscription, FAIL is reported when the named WDATP integration security setting is absent or its properties.enabled is false. The WDATP integration will not provide its configured signal to Defender for Cloud.
azure.port.defender_required_wdatp.pass_when: PASS when the unique WDATP setting has properties.enabled true.
azure.port.defender_required_wdatp.fail_when: FAIL when the named WDATP integration security setting is absent or its properties.enabled is false.
azure.port.defender_required_wdatp.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the anchor is not a subscription.

azure.port.iam_user_not_allowed_to_creat.description: For the Entra authorization policy, FAIL means `defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToCreateSecurityGroups` is true. Ordinary users can create groups that may later receive privileged access.

azure.port.iam_user_not_allowed_to_regis.description: For the Entra authorization policy, FAIL means `defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToCreateApps` is true. Ordinary users can register applications and request delegated access.

azure.port.keyvault_key_automatic_rotati.description: For a Key Vault key, FAIL is reported when its unique rotation policy has no Rotate lifetime action with timeAfterCreate. Long lived key material may remain in service without automatic rotation.
azure.port.keyvault_key_automatic_rotati.pass_when: PASS when the rotation policy declares Rotate after creation.
azure.port.keyvault_key_automatic_rotati.fail_when: FAIL when its unique rotation policy has no Rotate lifetime action with timeAfterCreate.

azure.port.keyvault_key_expiration_set.description: For an enabled Key Vault key, FAIL is reported when properties.attributes.exp is null. The key can remain valid indefinitely after its intended lifetime.
azure.port.keyvault_key_expiration_set.pass_when: PASS when the metadata is disabled or an expiration timestamp is present.

azure.port.keyvault_logging_enabled.description: For a Key Vault, FAIL means its scoped diagnostic settings do not collectively enable both the audit and allLogs category groups. AuditEvent alone or allLogs alone does not pass.
azure.port.keyvault_logging_enabled.pass_when: PASS when enabled logs across scoped settings include both categoryGroup audit and categoryGroup allLogs.
azure.port.keyvault_logging_enabled.fail_when: FAIL when either audit or allLogs enabled category group is absent.

azure.port.keyvault_public_network_acces.description: For a Key Vault with at least one private endpoint connection, FAIL is reported when networkAcls.defaultAction is Allow. The ACL may admit traffic from unlisted sources; the evaluator does not read publicNetworkAccess.
azure.port.keyvault_public_network_acces.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the complete private endpoint connection list is empty.

azure.port.keyvault_secret_expiration_se.description: For an enabled Key Vault secret, FAIL is reported when properties.attributes.exp is null. The secret can remain valid indefinitely after its intended lifetime.
azure.port.keyvault_secret_expiration_se.pass_when: PASS when the metadata is disabled or an expiration timestamp is present.

azure.port.keyvault_vault_private_link_u.description: For a Key Vault, FAIL is reported when networkAcls.defaultAction is Allow or no private endpoint connection is Approved. The vault lacks a restricted approved private access path.
azure.port.keyvault_vault_private_link_u.pass_when: PASS when the ACL denies by default and an approved private endpoint exists.

azure.storage.blob_soft_delete_retention.fail_when: FAIL when blob soft delete is disabled or days is outside 7 through 365.

azure.storage.container_soft_delete.description: For a blob service, FAIL means properties.containerDeleteRetentionPolicy.enabled is false, so container soft delete is disabled.
azure.storage.container_soft_delete.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the storage service is not blobServices.

azure.storage.cross_tenant_replication.description: For the storage account, FAIL means `properties.allowCrossTenantReplication` is true. Object replication can be configured across tenant boundaries.

azure.storage.default_deny.description: For the storage account, FAIL means `properties.networkAcls.defaultAction` is `Allow`. Unlisted clients may be admitted by the default storage network rule.

azure.storage.default_oauth.description: For a storage account, FAIL means defaultToOAuthAuthentication is false. The setting controls the default authentication choice; it does not itself disable shared keys.

azure.storage.https_only.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when properties.supportsHttpsTrafficOnly is false. HTTP requests can transfer storage data without TLS.

azure.storage.infrastructure_encryption.description: For a storage account, FAIL means requireInfrastructureEncryption is false, so the additional infrastructure encryption layer is not required.

azure.storage.minimum_tls.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when properties.minimumTlsVersion is TLS1_0 or TLS1_1. Clients can negotiate obsolete TLS versions.
azure.storage.minimum_tls.fail_when: FAIL when properties.minimumTlsVersion is TLS1_0 or TLS1_1.

azure.storage.no_blob_public_access.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when properties.allowBlobPublicAccess is true. Containers may be configured for anonymous blob reads.

azure.storage.no_public_network.description: For the storage account, FAIL means `properties.publicNetworkAccess` is `Enabled`.

azure.storage.no_shared_key.description: For the storage account, FAIL means `properties.allowSharedKeyAccess` is true. Shared account keys can bypass per-identity authorization and auditing.

azure.vault.approved_private_endpoint.description: For a Key Vault, FAIL is reported when networkAcls.defaultAction is Allow or no private endpoint is Approved. Unapproved private connectivity may leave the vault reachable only through unintended network paths.
azure.vault.approved_private_endpoint.pass_when: PASS when the ACL action is Deny and at least one private endpoint is Approved.
azure.vault.approved_private_endpoint.fail_when: FAIL when networkAcls.defaultAction is Allow or no private endpoint is Approved.

azure.vault.default_deny.description: For the Key Vault, FAIL means `properties.networkAcls.defaultAction` is `Allow`. Unlisted network sources may reach the vault endpoint.

azure.vault.no_public_network.description: For the Key Vault, FAIL means `properties.publicNetworkAccess` is `Enabled`.

azure.vault.purge_protection.description: For the Key Vault, FAIL means `properties.enablePurgeProtection` is false. An attacker with deletion rights may permanently purge vault objects.

azure.vault.rbac.description: For the Key Vault, FAIL means `properties.enableRbacAuthorization` is false. Legacy vault access policies may be changed outside Azure RBAC governance.

azure.vault.secret_expiration.description: For an enabled Key Vault secret, FAIL is reported when properties.attributes.exp is null. A secret without expiry can remain usable indefinitely.
azure.vault.secret_expiration.pass_when: PASS when a positive expiration timestamp is present.
azure.vault.secret_expiration.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the secret is disabled.

azure.vault.soft_delete.description: For the Key Vault, FAIL means `properties.enableSoftDelete` is false.

azure.vm.encryption_at_host.description: For a VM, FAIL means encryptionAtHost is false, so host encryption is not declared for temporary disks and caches.

azure.vm.linux_ssh_keys.description: For the virtual machine, FAIL means `properties.osProfile.linuxConfiguration.disablePasswordAuthentication` is false. Password based SSH remains permitted on the Linux VM.
azure.vm.linux_ssh_keys.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM OS is Windows.

azure.vm.managed_disks.fail_when: FAIL when any OS or data disk has an explicit null managedDisk or an unmanaged VHD object.
azure.vm.managed_disks.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the OS disk is ephemeral with diffDiskSettings.option Local.

azure.vm.trusted_launch.description: For a virtual machine with securityType TrustedLaunch, FAIL is reported when secureBootEnabled or vTpmEnabled is false. A Trusted Launch VM with a disabled switch lacks the corresponding boot integrity protection.

azure.vm.trusted_launch.fail_when: FAIL when secureBootEnabled or vTpmEnabled is false.

gcp.htbp.function.secret_env_from_secret.fail_when: FAIL when a credential-like environment variable name is declared with a literal value rather than a Secret Manager reference.

gcp.htbp.gke.kubelet_readonly_port_disab.description: For a GCP GKE cluster, this evaluator flags FAIL when any node pool enables the kubelet read-only port. Compromised cluster workloads or nodes may gain more access or evade cluster controls.

gcp.htbp.gke.kubelet_readonly_port_disab.fail_when: FAIL when any node pool enables the kubelet read-only port.

gcp.htbp.iam.policy_no_pool_wide_workloa.description: For a GCP IAM policy, this evaluator flags FAIL when an IAM binding grants a workloadIdentityPools/POOL/* principal set. Any identity in the federated workload pool may satisfy the broad binding and assume unintended access.
gcp.htbp.iam.policy_no_pool_wide_workloa.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: an IAM binding grants a workloadIdentityPools/POOL/* principal set.
gcp.htbp.iam.policy_no_pool_wide_workloa.fail_when: FAIL when an IAM binding grants a workloadIdentityPools/POOL/* principal set.

gcp.htbp.iam.sa_no_pool_wide_workload_pr.description: For a GCP service account, this evaluator flags FAIL when an IAM binding grants a workloadIdentityPools/POOL/* principal set. Any identity in the federated workload pool may satisfy the broad binding and assume unintended access.
gcp.htbp.iam.sa_no_pool_wide_workload_pr.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: an IAM binding grants a workloadIdentityPools/POOL/* principal set.
gcp.htbp.iam.sa_no_pool_wide_workload_pr.fail_when: FAIL when an IAM binding grants a workloadIdentityPools/POOL/* principal set.

gcp.htbp.instance_template.no_default_sa.description: For a GCP Compute Engine instance template, this evaluator flags FAIL when the evaluator finds default accounts with full scope in the collected declarations. Compromised workload code may inherit permissions granted to a shared default service account.
gcp.htbp.instance_template.no_default_sa.pass_when: PASS when no default accounts with full scope are found.
gcp.htbp.instance_template.no_default_sa.fail_when: FAIL when the evaluator finds default accounts with full scope in the collected declarations.

gcp.htbp.kms.destroy_window_not_shortene.description: For a GCP Cloud KMS key, this evaluator flags FAIL when destroyScheduledDuration is shorter than the evaluator’s 30-day minimum. A shortened key destruction window leaves less time to recover from accidental or malicious key deletion.
gcp.htbp.kms.destroy_window_not_shortene.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: destroyScheduledDuration is shorter than the evaluator’s 30-day minimum.
gcp.htbp.kms.destroy_window_not_shortene.fail_when: FAIL when destroyScheduledDuration is shorter than the evaluator’s 30-day minimum.

gcp.htbp.logging.default_sink_not_disabl.description: For a GCP Cloud Logging sink, this evaluator flags FAIL when the project _Default log sink is disabled. Investigators may lack the events needed to detect and reconstruct unauthorized changes.
gcp.htbp.logging.default_sink_not_disabl.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: the project _Default log sink is disabled.
gcp.htbp.logging.default_sink_not_disabl.fail_when: FAIL when the project _Default log sink is disabled.
gcp.htbp.logging.default_sink_not_disabl.not_applicable_when: only the project _Default sink is evaluated.

gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.cross_project_sa_usag.description: For a GCP project, this evaluator flags FAIL when the effective iam.disableCrossProjectServiceAccountUsage policy is not enforced. A compromised workload can attach a service account across project boundaries.
gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.cross_project_sa_usag.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: the effective iam.disableCrossProjectServiceAccountUsage policy is not enforced.
gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.cross_project_sa_usag.fail_when: FAIL when the effective iam.disableCrossProjectServiceAccountUsage policy is not enforced.

gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.default_sa_automatic_.description: For a GCP project, this evaluator flags FAIL when neither effective iam.managed.preventPrivilegedBasicRolesForDefaultServiceAccounts nor its legacy iam.automaticIamGrantsForDefaultServiceAccounts constraint is enforced. Compromised workload code may inherit permissions granted to a shared default service account.
gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.default_sa_automatic_.pass_when: PASS when the managed constraint, or its legacy fallback, is enforced.
gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.default_sa_automatic_.fail_when: FAIL when neither effective iam.managed.preventPrivilegedBasicRolesForDefaultServiceAccounts nor its legacy iam.automaticIamGrantsForDefaultServiceAccounts constraint is enforced.

gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.domain_restricted_sha.description: For a GCP project, this evaluator flags FAIL when the effective iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains organization policy is not enforced. Access or security contact details may be assigned outside the approved organization domain.
gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.domain_restricted_sha.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: the effective iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains organization policy is not enforced.
gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.domain_restricted_sha.fail_when: FAIL when the effective iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains organization policy is not enforced.

gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.essential_contacts_do.description: For a GCP project, this evaluator flags FAIL when the effective essentialcontacts.managed.allowedContactDomains organization policy is not enforced. Access or security contact details may be assigned outside the approved organization domain.
gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.essential_contacts_do.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: the effective essentialcontacts.managed.allowedContactDomains organization policy is not enforced.
gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.essential_contacts_do.fail_when: FAIL when the effective essentialcontacts.managed.allowedContactDomains organization policy is not enforced.

gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.sa_key_creation_and_u.description: For a GCP project, this evaluator flags FAIL when effective organization policies do not block both service-account key creation and upload. Persistent service-account keys may be created or uploaded when either effective constraint is unenforced.
gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.sa_key_creation_and_u.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: effective organization policies do not block both service-account key creation and upload.
gcp.htbp.orgpolicy.sa_key_creation_and_u.fail_when: FAIL when effective organization policies do not block both service-account key creation and upload.

gcp.htbp.pubsub.push_endpoint_not_tunnel.description: For a GCP pubsub subscription, this evaluator flags FAIL when a Pub/Sub push endpoint uses an IP literal or a recognized tunnel/request-capture host. Messages may be delivered to an ephemeral or attacker-controlled receiver.
gcp.htbp.pubsub.push_endpoint_not_tunnel.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: a Pub/Sub push endpoint uses an IP literal or a recognized tunnel/request-capture host.
gcp.htbp.pubsub.push_endpoint_not_tunnel.fail_when: FAIL when a Pub/Sub push endpoint uses an IP literal or a recognized tunnel/request-capture host.

gcp.htbp.scheduler.no_recurring_access_r.description: For a GCP scheduler job, this evaluator flags FAIL when a recurring scheduler job calls a recognized IAM-policy mutation endpoint. The scheduled request can reinstate privileges after they have been revoked.
gcp.htbp.scheduler.no_recurring_access_r.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: a recurring scheduler job calls a recognized IAM-policy mutation endpoint.
gcp.htbp.scheduler.no_recurring_access_r.fail_when: FAIL when a recurring scheduler job calls a recognized IAM-policy mutation endpoint.

gcp.htbp.storage.default_object_acl_not_.description: For a GCP Cloud Storage bucket, this evaluator flags FAIL when the bucket default object ACL contains allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers. A broader set of principals may read data, invoke services, or change resources through the declared grant.
gcp.htbp.storage.default_object_acl_not_.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: the bucket default object ACL contains allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers.
gcp.htbp.storage.default_object_acl_not_.fail_when: FAIL when the bucket default object ACL contains allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers.
gcp.htbp.storage.default_object_acl_not_.not_applicable_when: uniform bucket-level access disables object ACLs.

gcp.htbp.storage.hmac_key_not_stale_or_d.description: For a GCP storage hmac key, this evaluator flags FAIL when an ACTIVE HMAC key is more than 90 whole days old or belongs to a Compute Engine or App Engine default service account. Compromised workload code may inherit permissions granted to a shared default service account.
gcp.htbp.storage.hmac_key_not_stale_or_d.pass_when: PASS when an ACTIVE key is at most 90 whole days old and belongs to a nondefault service account.
gcp.htbp.storage.hmac_key_not_stale_or_d.fail_when: FAIL when an ACTIVE HMAC key is more than 90 whole days old or belongs to a Compute Engine or App Engine default service account.
gcp.htbp.storage.hmac_key_not_stale_or_d.not_applicable_when: HMAC key state is INACTIVE or DELETED.

gcp.htbp.storage.notification_topic_in_b.description: For a GCP bucket notification, this evaluator flags FAIL when the notification topic belongs to a different project from the bucket. Bucket event data can be delivered across an unreviewed project boundary.
gcp.htbp.storage.notification_topic_in_b.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: the notification topic belongs to a different project from the bucket.
gcp.htbp.storage.notification_topic_in_b.fail_when: FAIL when the notification topic belongs to a different project from the bucket.

gcp.htbp.workbench.no_default_compute_sa.description: For a GCP workbench instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when the workload uses its provider default service account instead of a dedicated identity. Workbench code may inherit the shared default Compute Engine service account permissions.
gcp.htbp.workbench.no_default_compute_sa.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: the workload uses its provider default service account instead of a dedicated identity.
gcp.htbp.workbench.no_default_compute_sa.fail_when: FAIL when the workload uses its provider default service account instead of a dedicated identity.

gcp.iam.avoid_basic_roles.description: For a GCP IAM policy, this evaluator flags FAIL when a project IAM binding uses roles/owner or roles/editor. These broad roles can authorize unrelated administrative changes.
gcp.iam.avoid_basic_roles.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: a project IAM binding uses roles/owner or roles/editor.
gcp.iam.avoid_basic_roles.fail_when: FAIL when a project IAM binding uses roles/owner or roles/editor.

gcp.iam.data_access_audit.description: For a GCP IAM policy, this evaluator flags FAIL when the complete effective hierarchy auditConfigs lack DATA_READ or DATA_WRITE for allServices. Investigators may lack the events needed to detect and reconstruct unauthorized changes.
gcp.iam.data_access_audit.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: the complete effective hierarchy auditConfigs lack DATA_READ or DATA_WRITE for allServices.
gcp.iam.data_access_audit.fail_when: FAIL when the complete effective hierarchy auditConfigs lack DATA_READ or DATA_WRITE for allServices.

gcp.iam.no_user_managed_sa_keys.description: For a GCP service account key, this evaluator flags FAIL when collected keyType is USER_MANAGED instead of SYSTEM_MANAGED. A user-managed service-account key can be copied and used as a long-lived credential.

gcp.iam.no_user_managed_sa_keys.fail_when: FAIL when collected keyType is USER_MANAGED instead of SYSTEM_MANAGED.

gcp.iam.restrict_public_members.description: For a GCP IAM policy, this evaluator flags FAIL when a collected access policy contains an allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers grant. A broader set of principals may read data, invoke services, or change resources through the declared grant.
gcp.iam.restrict_public_members.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: a collected access policy contains an allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers grant.
gcp.iam.restrict_public_members.fail_when: FAIL when a collected access policy contains an allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers grant.

gcp.network.custom_subnets.description: For a GCP VPC network, this evaluator flags FAIL when collected autoCreateSubnetworks is true instead of false. Automatically created network paths and firewall defaults can expose workloads unexpectedly.
gcp.network.custom_subnets.fail_when: FAIL when collected autoCreateSubnetworks is true instead of false.

gcp.ports.access_approval_explicit_enrol.description: For a GCP access approval settings, this evaluator flags FAIL when enrolledServices contains no service with enrollmentLevel=BLOCK_ALL. Google personnel access may proceed without the explicit customer approval workflow for the selected products.

gcp.ports.access_approval_explicit_enrol.fail_when: FAIL when enrolledServices contains no service with enrollmentLevel=BLOCK_ALL.

gcp.ports.alloydb_cluster_encrypted_with.description: For a GCP alloydb cluster, this evaluator flags FAIL when collected encryptionInfo.encryptionType is GOOGLE_DEFAULT_ENCRYPTION instead of CUSTOMER_MANAGED_ENCRYPTION. The dataset or storage layer uses provider-managed keys, removing the intended customer key control over decryption.
gcp.ports.alloydb_cluster_encrypted_with.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: collected encryptionInfo.encryptionType is GOOGLE_DEFAULT_ENCRYPTION instead of CUSTOMER_MANAGED_ENCRYPTION.

gcp.ports.alloydb_instance_log_error_ver.description: For a GCP alloydb instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when the explicit log_error_verbosity flag is neither default nor verbose. Relevant database activity may be absent from audit or diagnostic logs.

gcp.ports.alloydb_instance_log_error_ver.fail_when: FAIL when the explicit log_error_verbosity flag is neither default nor verbose.

gcp.ports.alloydb_instance_log_min_error.description: For a GCP alloydb instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when the log_min_error_statement flag is absent from the explicit database flag map. Error events may lack the associated SQL statement needed for investigation.
gcp.ports.alloydb_instance_log_min_error.pass_when: PASS when the log_min_error_statement flag is explicitly present.
gcp.ports.alloydb_instance_log_min_error.fail_when: FAIL when the log_min_error_statement flag is absent from the explicit database flag map.

gcp.ports.alloydb_instance_log_min_messa.description: For a GCP alloydb instance, this evaluator flags FAIL when the explicit log_min_messages flag is neither error nor warning. Overly verbose messages can add sensitive details and drown out significant errors.
gcp.ports.alloydb_instance_log_min_messa.pass_when: PASS when the explicit log_min_messages flag is error or warning.
gcp.ports.alloydb_instance_log_min_messa.fail_when: FAIL when the explicit log_min_messages flag is neither error nor warning.

gcp.ports.api_key_elapsed_age_gt90.description: For a GCP API key, this evaluator flags FAIL when the whole-day difference between captured_at and createTime exceeds 90 days. An old key has had more time to be copied and used outside its intended application.
gcp.ports.api_key_elapsed_age_gt90.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: the whole-day difference between captured_at and createTime exceeds 90 days.
gcp.ports.api_key_elapsed_age_gt90.fail_when: FAIL when the whole-day difference between captured_at and createTime exceeds 90 days.

gcp.ports.api_key_meaningful_restriction.description: For a GCP API key, this evaluator flags FAIL when the key has neither a specific API target list nor a passing caller restriction. A copied key can be used from unapproved callers against a wider API surface.
gcp.ports.api_key_meaningful_restriction.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: the key has neither a specific API target list nor a passing caller restriction.

gcp.ports.apikeys_api_restricted_with_ge.description: For a GCP API key, this evaluator flags FAIL when Gemini API is enabled and the key has no API targets, targets cloudapis.googleapis.com, or combines Gemini with other service targets. gcp.ports.app_engine_application_iap_ena.description: For a GCP app engine application, this evaluator flags FAIL when an identified App Engine application has iap.enabled false or omitted. The application may accept unauthenticated requests through its serving endpoint.

gcp.ports.app_engine_application_iap_ena.fail_when: FAIL when an identified App Engine application has iap.enabled false or omitted.

gcp.ports.artifacts_container_analysis_e.description: For a GCP project, this evaluator flags FAIL when the project service-usage inventory marks containeranalysis.googleapis.com DISABLED. Container vulnerability analysis may be unavailable before images are deployed.
gcp.ports.artifacts_container_analysis_e.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: the project service-usage inventory marks containeranalysis.googleapis.com DISABLED.
gcp.ports.artifacts_container_analysis_e.fail_when: FAIL when the project service-usage inventory marks containeranalysis.googleapis.com DISABLED.

gcp.ports.audit_logging_configured_for_a.description: For a GCP inventory, this evaluator flags FAIL when allServices auditConfigs lack the required ADMIN_READ, DATA_READ, or DATA_WRITE log types, or exempt members. gcp.ports.bigquery_dataset_not_publicly_.description: For a GCP BigQuery dataset, this evaluator flags FAIL when a dataset access entry names specialGroup allAuthenticatedUsers or iamMember allUsers. The dataset may be readable by identities outside the intended project.

gcp.ports.compute_firewall_rule_ssh_acce.description: For a GCP VPC firewall rule, this evaluator flags FAIL when an ingress allow rule permits TCP 22 or all protocols from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0. Internet hosts can probe the VM’s SSH service.

gcp.ports.compute_instance_ip_forwarding.fail_when: FAIL when canIpForward is true on a non-GKE VM.

gcp.ports.compute_instance_shielded_vm_e.description: For a GCP Compute Engine VM, this evaluator flags FAIL when shieldedInstanceConfig lacks either enableVtpm or enableIntegrityMonitoring. The VM lacks one or both evaluated Shielded VM controls.

gcp.ports.compute_instance_shielded_vm_e.fail_when: FAIL when shieldedInstanceConfig lacks either enableVtpm or enableIntegrityMonitoring.

gcp.ports.compute_instance_with_no_defau.description: For a GCP Compute Engine VM, this evaluator flags FAIL when a non-GKE VM attaches a service account whose email ends in -compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com. gcp.ports.compute_instance_with_no_defau.fail_when: FAIL when a non-GKE VM attaches a service account whose email ends in -compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com.

gcp.ports.compute_instance_with_no_defau.description: For a GCP Compute Engine VM, this evaluator flags FAIL when a non-GKE VM attaches the default Compute Engine service account with the cloud-platform OAuth scope. A VM compromise can combine broad API scope with that account’s IAM privileges.

gcp.ports.compute_instance_with_no_defau.fail_when: FAIL when a non-GKE VM attaches the default Compute Engine service account with the cloud-platform OAuth scope.
gcp.ports.compute_instance_with_no_defau.not_applicable_when: An explicitly identified GKE node VM is excluded; node-pool identity is reviewed separately.

gcp.ports.compute_instance_with_no_publi.description: For a GCP Compute Engine VM, this evaluator flags FAIL when any network interface declares a nonempty accessConfigs[].natIP or ipv6AccessConfigs[].externalIpv6. The declared network path may expose the workload or management service to unsolicited internet traffic.
gcp.ports.compute_instance_with_no_publi.pass_when: PASS when no interface declares either external address.
gcp.ports.compute_instance_with_no_publi.fail_when: FAIL when any network interface declares a nonempty accessConfigs[].natIP or ipv6AccessConfigs[].externalIpv6.

gcp.ports.compute_network_contains_no_le.description: For a GCP VPC network, this evaluator flags FAIL when the VPC network declares an IPv4Range for legacy networking. The network uses a legacy IPv4 range rather than an explicit subnet model.

gcp.ports.compute_network_contains_no_le.fail_when: FAIL when the VPC network declares an IPv4Range for legacy networking.

gcp.ports.compute_network_dns_logging_sc.description: For a GCP VPC network, this evaluator flags FAIL when no uniquely attached DNS policy has enableLogging true for the network selfLink. DNS queries from workloads on this VPC may be missing from investigations.

gcp.ports.compute_network_dns_logging_sc.fail_when: FAIL when no uniquely attached DNS policy has enableLogging true for the network selfLink.

gcp.ports.compute_oslogin_metadata_prece.description: For a GCP Compute Engine VM, this evaluator flags FAIL when the effective instance or project enable-oslogin metadata setting is false. SSH access may use metadata-managed keys instead of OS Login.

gcp.ports.compute_ssl_policy_strict_decl.description: For a GCP HTTPS target proxy, this evaluator flags FAIL when an HTTPS/SSL target proxy lacks an explicit SSL policy; or its policy is neither RESTRICTED, nor MODERN/FIPS_202205 with TLS_1_2, nor CUSTOM with TLS_1_2 and no listed weak cipher. Clients may negotiate weak TLS settings on the public endpoint.

gcp.ports.compute_ssl_policy_strict_decl.fail_when: FAIL when an HTTPS/SSL target proxy lacks an explicit SSL policy; or its policy is neither RESTRICTED, nor MODERN/FIPS_202205 with TLS_1_2, nor CUSTOM with TLS_1_2 and no listed weak cipher.

gcp.ports.compute_url_map_backend_loggin.description: For a GCP url map, this evaluator flags FAIL when any backend service referenced by the URL map has logConfig.enable false or absent. Requests routed through that backend may leave no load-balancer access record.

gcp.ports.compute_url_map_backend_loggin.not_applicable_when: The URL map is redirect-only, or all referenced backends are backend buckets with no backend service to assess.

gcp.ports.dataproc_cluster_encryption_wi.description: For a GCP dataproc cluster, this evaluator flags FAIL when config.encryptionConfig.gcePdKmsKeyName is empty or absent. Dataproc persistent disks use provider-managed keys instead of the intended customer key.

gcp.ports.dataproc_cluster_encryption_wi.fail_when: FAIL when config.encryptionConfig.gcePdKmsKeyName is empty or absent.

gcp.ports.dns_managed_zone_dnssec_enable.description: For a GCP Cloud DNS zone, this evaluator flags FAIL when a public Cloud DNS zone has dnssecConfig.state off or absent. DNS answers lack the zone’s cryptographic authenticity checks.

gcp.ports.dns_managed_zone_key_signing_n.description: For a GCP Cloud DNS zone, this evaluator flags FAIL when a public zone has no DNSSEC state or declares an RSASHA1 key-signing key spec. Weak DNSSEC signing material reduces confidence in DNS answer authenticity.
gcp.ports.dns_managed_zone_key_signing_n.pass_when: PASS when the collected facts do not satisfy this condition: a public zone has no DNSSEC state or declares an RSASHA1 key-signing key spec.

gcp.ports.dns_managed_zone_key_signing_n.not_applicable_when: DNSSEC source control excludes private zones.

gcp.ports.dns_managed_zone_zone_signing_.description: For a GCP Cloud DNS zone, this evaluator flags FAIL when a public zone has no DNSSEC state or declares an RSASHA1 zone-signing key spec. Weak DNSSEC signing material reduces confidence in DNS answer authenticity.

gcp.ports.dns_managed_zone_zone_signing_.fail_when: FAIL when a public zone has no DNSSEC state or declares an RSASHA1 zone-signing key spec.
gcp.ports.dns_managed_zone_zone_signing_.not_applicable_when: DNSSEC source control excludes private zones.

gcp.ports.firewall_http_lb_proxy_source_.description: For a GCP VPC firewall rule, this evaluator flags FAIL when a firewall rule for HTTP load-balancer proxies includes a source outside the approved proxy and health-check ranges. Direct traffic can bypass the load balancer’s intended ingress path.

gcp.ports.firewall_iap_tcp_proxy_source_.description: For a GCP VPC firewall rule, this evaluator flags FAIL when a firewall rule for IAP TCP forwarding includes a source outside the approved IAP proxy ranges. Direct traffic can bypass IAP authentication for the target service.

gcp.ports.function_active_public_binding.description: For a GCP Cloud Function, this evaluator flags FAIL when a collected access policy contains an allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers grant. A broader set of principals may read data, invoke services, or change resources through the declared grant.

gcp.ports.function_basic_role_declaratio.description: For a GCP Cloud Function, this evaluator flags FAIL when the function runtime service account has a project, folder, or organization IAM binding for roles/editor or roles/owner. gcp.ports.iam_service_account_gcp_manage.description: For a GCP service account, this evaluator flags FAIL when the complete key inventory links a USER_MANAGED key to the service account. A long-lived exported private key can be reused if leaked.

gcp.ports.iam_user_separation_of_duty_sc.description: For a GCP IAM policy, this evaluator flags FAIL when the same project-root IAM user has both roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin and roles/iam.serviceAccountUser. One user can both administer and use service accounts, weakening separation of duties.

gcp.ports.kms_key_separation_of_duties_e.description: For a GCP IAM policy, this evaluator flags FAIL when the same project-root IAM user has roles/cloudkms.admin and any Cloud KMS encrypt/decrypt use role.
