k8s.namespace.restricted_admission.description: Flags a Namespace whose pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce label is set to privileged or baseline instead of restricted. Below restricted, Pod Security Admission admits Pods running as root, with added capabilities or without seccomp, so a namespace writer can deploy escape-prone workloads.
k8s.namespace.restricted_admission.fail_when: The enforce label is privileged or baseline.
k8s.namespace.restricted_admission.not_applicable_when: When the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); an absent enforce label (cluster defaults unknown) is UNKNOWN.

k8s.network.namespace_policy_inventory.description: Flags a Namespace that has zero NetworkPolicy objects in a complete NetworkPolicy inventory; if policies exist the result is MANUAL, never PASS. With no NetworkPolicy every Pod in the namespace accepts traffic from and sends traffic to any Pod in the cluster, enabling lateral movement after one compromise.
k8s.network.namespace_policy_inventory.pass_when: Never PASS automatically: one or more policies yields MANUAL coverage review.
k8s.network.namespace_policy_inventory.fail_when: The complete inventory contains no NetworkPolicy in the namespace.
k8s.network.namespace_policy_inventory.not_applicable_when: When the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); incomplete NetworkPolicy inventory is UNKNOWN.

k8s.pod.default_proc_mount.description: Flags a Pod where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) sets securityContext.procMount to Unmasked. An unmasked /proc exposes kernel interfaces (e.g. /proc/sys, /proc/kcore) normally hidden by the runtime, aiding information leaks and container escape.
k8s.pod.default_proc_mount.pass_when: All containers use procMount Default (or omit it).
k8s.pod.default_proc_mount.not_applicable_when: When spec.os.name is windows (Linux-only control), or the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results). Unknown procMount values are UNKNOWN.

k8s.pod.drop_capabilities.description: Flags a Pod where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) does not list the literal 'ALL' in securityContext.capabilities.drop. Without dropping ALL, the container keeps the runtime's default capability set (NET_RAW, SETUID, CHOWN, DAC_OVERRIDE...), widening the kernel privilege available to an attacker.
k8s.pod.drop_capabilities.not_applicable_when: When spec.os.name is windows (Linux-only control), or the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.pod.no_default_serviceaccount.description: Flags a Pod whose spec.serviceAccountName is omitted, empty or 'default'. Workloads sharing the namespace default ServiceAccount share its token and any RBAC granted to it, so one compromised Pod inherits permissions intended for others and access cannot be scoped per workload.
k8s.pod.no_default_serviceaccount.pass_when: serviceAccountName names a dedicated non-default ServiceAccount.
k8s.pod.no_default_serviceaccount.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.pod.no_host_namespaces.description: Flags a Pod that sets any of spec.hostNetwork, spec.hostPID or spec.hostIPC to true. Sharing any host namespace removes a core isolation boundary: host network exposes node traffic and local services, host PID allows process inspection/ptrace, host IPC exposes shared memory.
k8s.pod.no_host_namespaces.pass_when: All three flags are false or omitted.
k8s.pod.no_host_namespaces.fail_when: Any of hostNetwork, hostPID or hostIPC is true.
k8s.pod.no_host_namespaces.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.pod.no_host_ports.description: Flags a Pod where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) declares a non-zero ports[].hostPort. hostPort publishes the container on the node IP outside Service and NetworkPolicy control and can shadow node services.
k8s.pod.no_host_ports.pass_when: All hostPort values are 0 or omitted.
k8s.pod.no_host_ports.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.pod.no_hostpath.description: Flags a Pod whose spec.volumes includes any hostPath volume. hostPath mounts node directories into the container; paths like /, /etc, /var/lib/kubelet or the container runtime socket allow reading node credentials or full node takeover.
k8s.pod.no_hostpath.fail_when: At least one volume declares hostPath (reported with its path).
k8s.pod.no_hostpath.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.pod.no_privilege_escalation.description: Flags a Pod where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) does not explicitly set securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation: false (the API default is true). With escalation allowed, setuid binaries and file capabilities inside the image can raise the process above its starting privileges (no_new_privs is not set).
k8s.pod.no_privilege_escalation.fail_when: Any container omits it or sets it true.
k8s.pod.no_privilege_escalation.not_applicable_when: When spec.os.name is windows (Linux-only control), or the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.pod.no_privileged_containers.description: Flags a Pod where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) sets securityContext.privileged: true. Privileged containers receive all capabilities, device access and disabled confinement, making escape to the node trivial.
k8s.pod.no_privileged_containers.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.pod.non_root.description: Flags a Pod where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) neither resolves runAsNonRoot: true nor a positive runAsUser, or resolves runAsUser 0 (container value overriding Pod securityContext). Containers that may run as root turn any escape, writable host mount or kernel flaw into root on the node.
k8s.pod.non_root.pass_when: Every container resolves to runAsUser != 0 and either runAsNonRoot: true or runAsUser > 0.
k8s.pod.non_root.fail_when: Any container may run as root (no non-root declaration, or runAsUser 0).
k8s.pod.non_root.not_applicable_when: When spec.os.name is windows (Linux-only control), or the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.pod.read_only_root.description: Flags a Pod where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) does not set securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. A writable root filesystem lets an attacker drop tools, modify binaries or persist inside the container.
k8s.pod.read_only_root.fail_when: Any container omits it or sets false.
k8s.pod.read_only_root.not_applicable_when: When spec.os.name is windows (Linux-only control), or the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.pod.restrict_added_capabilities.description: Flags a Pod where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) adds a capability other than NET_BIND_SERVICE in securityContext.capabilities.add, the Pod Security restricted allowance. Capabilities such as SYS_ADMIN, NET_ADMIN or SYS_PTRACE provide kernel-level powers commonly abused for container escape.
k8s.pod.restrict_added_capabilities.pass_when: capabilities.add is empty or only NET_BIND_SERVICE for every container.
k8s.pod.restrict_added_capabilities.fail_when: Any container adds a capability other than NET_BIND_SERVICE.
k8s.pod.restrict_added_capabilities.not_applicable_when: When spec.os.name is windows (Linux-only control), or the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.pod.restrict_selinux_identity.description: Flags a Pod where the Pod-level or any container securityContext.seLinuxOptions sets a custom user or role. Overriding the SELinux user/role can place the process in a more privileged SELinux identity and defeat the MAC confinement the node policy relies on.
k8s.pod.restrict_selinux_identity.pass_when: No seLinuxOptions.user or .role is set anywhere.
k8s.pod.restrict_selinux_identity.fail_when: Pod or any container sets seLinuxOptions.user or .role.
k8s.pod.restrict_selinux_identity.not_applicable_when: When spec.os.name is windows (Linux-only control), or the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.pod.restrict_token_automount.description: Flags a Pod that explicitly sets spec.automountServiceAccountToken: true. A mounted API token is readable by any process in the Pod, so an application compromise yields Kubernetes API credentials for its ServiceAccount.
k8s.pod.restrict_token_automount.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); an omitted field (inherited from the ServiceAccount) is UNKNOWN.

k8s.pod.seccomp.description: Flags a Pod where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) resolves no seccompProfile.type of RuntimeDefault or Localhost (container value, else Pod value), i.e. Unconfined or unset. Without a seccomp filter the full syscall table is reachable, exposing kernel exploits to the workload.
k8s.pod.seccomp.pass_when: Every container resolves to RuntimeDefault or Localhost (with a localhostProfile).
k8s.pod.seccomp.fail_when: Any container resolves to Unconfined or no profile.
k8s.pod.seccomp.not_applicable_when: When spec.os.name is windows (Linux-only control), or the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.ports.clusterrole.cluster_role_with_.description: Flags a ClusterRole with a rule that literally lists apiGroup admissionregistration.k8s.io, resource validatingwebhookconfigurations or mutatingwebhookconfigurations, and verb create, update or patch. Webhook writers can register admission hooks that see and mutate every API request, e.g. injecting sidecars or exfiltrating Secrets at creation. Exact symbols only; '*' grants are left to the wildcard check.
k8s.ports.clusterrole.cluster_role_with_.pass_when: No rule literally combines that group, a webhook configuration resource and create/update/patch.
k8s.ports.clusterrole.cluster_role_with_.fail_when: A rule literally lists the group, a webhook configuration resource and create/update/patch.
k8s.ports.clusterrole.cluster_role_with_.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.ports.clusterrole.role_with_rbac_app.description: Flags a ClusterRole with a certificates.k8s.io rule granting update/patch on certificatesigningrequests/approval or the approve verb on signers (literal symbols). CSR approval lets the holder issue client certificates for arbitrary identities, including node or administrator groups, for persistent cluster access.
k8s.ports.clusterrole.role_with_rbac_app.pass_when: No rule grants CSR approval or signer approve.
k8s.ports.clusterrole.role_with_rbac_app.fail_when: A rule grants update/patch on certificatesigningrequests/approval or approve on signers.
k8s.ports.clusterrole.role_with_rbac_app.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.ports.clusterrole.role_with_rbac_esc.description: Flags a ClusterRole with an rbac.authorization.k8s.io rule granting the literal escalate verb on roles or clusterroles. escalate disables RBAC's privilege-escalation check, letting the holder edit roles to include permissions it does not possess, up to cluster-admin.
k8s.ports.clusterrole.role_with_rbac_esc.pass_when: No rule grants escalate on roles/clusterroles.
k8s.ports.clusterrole.role_with_rbac_esc.fail_when: A rule grants escalate on roles or clusterroles.
k8s.ports.clusterrole.role_with_rbac_esc.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.ports.clusterrole.role_with_wildcard.description: Flags a ClusterRole where any rule's apiGroups, resources or verbs contains a string with a '*' character. Wildcards in any of the three fields automatically extend the grant to new API groups, resources or verbs, producing over-privileged roles that are hard to audit.

k8s.ports.clusterrole.role_with_wildcard.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

For a copy on every node the DaemonSet schedules to, an unbounded container can monopolise node CPU and starve neighbours.

k8s.ports.daemonset.cpu_limit.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); malformed or missing PodSpec facts are UNKNOWN.

k8s.ports.daemonset.cpu_request.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); malformed or missing PodSpec facts are UNKNOWN.

k8s.ports.daemonset.daemonset_default_na.description: Flags a DaemonSet whose metadata.namespace is 'default'. Running a copy on every node the DaemonSet schedules to in the default namespace mixes it with ad-hoc and legacy objects, so namespace-scoped RBAC, quotas, Pod Security labels and NetworkPolicies cannot isolate it.
k8s.ports.daemonset.daemonset_default_na.pass_when: The DaemonSet lives in a namespace other than default.
k8s.ports.daemonset.daemonset_default_na.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results).

k8s.ports.daemonset.declared_nonroot.description: Flags a DaemonSet where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) does not set container-level securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true (Pod-level runAsNonRoot is not considered) in its Pod template at spec.template.spec. For a copy on every node the DaemonSet schedules to, the image may start as root, so escapes and host mounts operate as node root.

k8s.ports.daemonset.declared_nonroot.fail_when: Any container omits runAsNonRoot or sets it false.
k8s.ports.daemonset.declared_nonroot.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); malformed or missing PodSpec facts are UNKNOWN.

k8s.ports.daemonset.drop_all.description: Flags a DaemonSet where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) lacks 'ALL'/'all' in securityContext.capabilities.drop in its Pod template at spec.template.spec. For a copy on every node the DaemonSet schedules to, the runtime default capability set stays available to an attacker.

k8s.ports.daemonset.drop_all.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); malformed or missing PodSpec facts are UNKNOWN.

k8s.ports.daemonset.drop_net_raw.description: Flags a DaemonSet where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) drops neither NET_RAW nor ALL/all in securityContext.capabilities.drop in its Pod template at spec.template.spec. For a copy on every node the DaemonSet schedules to, NET_RAW enables raw-socket ARP/DNS spoofing against other Pods on the node.

k8s.ports.daemonset.drop_net_raw.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); malformed or missing PodSpec facts are UNKNOWN.

k8s.ports.daemonset.no_added_capabilitie.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); malformed or missing PodSpec facts are UNKNOWN.

k8s.ports.daemonset.no_sys_admin.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); malformed or missing PodSpec facts are UNKNOWN.

k8s.ports.daemonset.pinned_image.description: Flags a DaemonSet where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) has an empty image, an untagged image or the :latest tag (any @ reference or a tag other than latest counts as pinned; this predicate does not validate digest syntax) in its Pod template at spec.template.spec. k8s.ports.daemonset.pinned_image.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); malformed or missing PodSpec facts are UNKNOWN.

k8s.ports.deployment.always_pull.description: Flags a Deployment where any container (regular, init or ephemeral) would not pull on every start: imagePullPolicy is explicitly IfNotPresent/Never, or omitted on a tagged non-latest image; content-addressed sha256 digests with IfNotPresent/omitted/Always are accepted in its Pod template at spec.template.spec. For every replica the Deployment rolls out, cached images on the node can be reused by other tenants without registry authorization, and a node-cached poisoned image is trusted.
k8s.ports.deployment.always_pull.pass_when: Every container uses Always, an untagged/latest image with no explicit policy, or a valid sha256 digest with policy unset/IfNotPresent/Always.
k8s.ports.deployment.always_pull.fail_when: Any container has an empty image; any container uses Never, or a tagged image with IfNotPresent or no policy.
k8s.ports.deployment.always_pull.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); malformed or missing PodSpec facts are UNKNOWN.

k8s.ports.deployment.container_admission.description: Flags a Deployment whose Pod template (spec.template.spec) contains a container identified as kube-apiserver whose captured command-line flags show a failing value: FAIL when the --enable-admission-plugins list does not include AlwaysPullImages. Without AlwaysPullImages, Pods in a multi-tenant cluster can run private images already cached on the node without registry credentials. Only explicit flag declarations in the collected component projection are compared; config files and defaults are not inferred.
k8s.ports.deployment.container_admission.pass_when: Every captured kube-apiserver container: the comma-separated --enable-admission-plugins list includes AlwaysPullImages.
k8s.ports.deployment.container_admission.fail_when: Any captured kube-apiserver container: the --enable-admission-plugins list does not include AlwaysPullImages.
k8s.ports.deployment.container_admission.not_applicable_when: When no container in the Deployment template is captured as kube-apiserver (component metadata), or the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); a flag omitted from the projection is UNKNOWN.

k8s.ports.deployment.container_admission.pass_when: Every captured kube-apiserver container: the --enable-admission-plugins list does not include AlwaysAdmit.
k8s.ports.deployment.container_admission.fail_when: Any captured kube-apiserver container: the --enable-admission-plugins list includes AlwaysAdmit.

k8s.ports.replicationcontroller.containe.pass_when: At least one applicable captured kubelet declaration is observed; every observed declaration has complete projected flags and every captured --client-ca-file value is nonempty; no applicable declaration has missing configuration.
k8s.ports.replicationcontroller.containe.fail_when: At least one applicable captured kubelet declaration has complete projected flags and at least one captured --client-ca-file value is empty. A missing required flag or incomplete projection raises UNKNOWN even if a different declaration failed; missing component identification alone yields UNKNOWN only when no declaration failed.
k8s.ports.replicationcontroller.containe.not_applicable_when: No applicable kubelet declaration is observed and there is no potentially applicable declaration with missing or ambiguous component/configuration metadata. On a positively identified provider- or control-plane-managed object, the registration wrapper changes an underlying FAIL, MANUAL, UNKNOWN, or DENIED to NOT_APPLICABLE; an underlying PASS remains PASS.

k8s.ports.replicationcontroller.containe.pass_when: At least one applicable captured kube-apiserver declaration is observed; every observed declaration has complete projected flags and --tls-cipher-suites is nonempty and every comma-separated cipher is in the evaluator allowlist; no applicable declaration has missing configuration.
k8s.ports.replicationcontroller.containe.fail_when: At least one applicable captured kube-apiserver declaration has complete projected flags and --tls-cipher-suites is empty or has a cipher outside the evaluator allowlist. A missing required flag or incomplete projection raises UNKNOWN even if a different declaration failed; missing component identification alone yields UNKNOWN only when no declaration failed.
k8s.ports.replicationcontroller.containe.not_applicable_when: No applicable kube-apiserver declaration is observed and there is no potentially applicable declaration with missing or ambiguous component/configuration metadata. On a positively identified provider- or control-plane-managed object, the registration wrapper changes an underlying FAIL, MANUAL, UNKNOWN, or DENIED to NOT_APPLICABLE; an underlying PASS remains PASS.

aws.bedrock.agent_role_not_shared_across.pass_when: Complete enabled-Region, agent draft and alias-routed-version coverage shows that none of the agent roles is held by another agent.

aws.bedrock.api_key_no_administrative_pr.description: Bedrock API key owner has no administrative permissions. Checks collected configuration only; unreadable, missing, ambiguous or incomplete evidence remains UNKNOWN. It does not establish effective access or runtime enforcement.
aws.bedrock.api_key_no_administrative_pr.fail_when: A resolved owner policy matches pinned administrative, escalation or full Bedrock service permission algebra.
evaluated: Bedrock service-specific credential UserName and complete IAM user inline/attached policy documents
aws.bedrock.api_key_no_administrative_pr.not_applicable_when: The service-specific credential belongs to another service.
aws.bedrock.api_key_no_administrative_pr.pass_when: The credential owner and every attached/inline policy are resolved and none matches the prohibited policy algebra.

aws.nist.acm_all_certificates_expiry_30_.description: Checks issued ACM certificates from a complete regional inventory against the scan capture instant, regardless of RenewalEligibility; nonissued certificates are not applicable.
aws.nist.acm_all_certificates_expiry_30_.fail_when: This issued certificate expires at or before the capture instant plus 30 days.
aws.nist.acm_all_certificates_expiry_30_.not_applicable_when: The certificate Status is a recognized value other than ISSUED.
aws.nist.acm_all_certificates_expiry_30_.pass_when: Every applicable issued certificate has readable expiry detail and this certificate expires more than 30 days after capture.

aws.nist.all_cloudtrail_destination_buck.description: Checks S3 server access logging on the identity-joined, in-account destination bucket of each home-Region CloudTrail trail.
aws.nist.all_cloudtrail_destination_buck.fail_when: The complete owned bucket GetBucketLogging response has no LoggingEnabled configuration.
evaluated: cloudtrail:DescribeTrails S3BucketName across home regions; s3:GetBucketLogging per distinct destination bucket
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws.nist.all_cloudtrail_destination_buck.not_applicable_when: Shadow trails are assessed from their home Region; foreign or unresolved destination buckets remain UNKNOWN.
aws.nist.all_cloudtrail_destination_buck.pass_when: The complete owned bucket GetBucketLogging response contains LoggingEnabled.

aws.nist.all_iam_policies_no_star_star.description: Detects failure of iam managed and inline policies avoid full administrator grants. Full inventory includes unattached AWS-managed default documents. This is a policy configuration observation; attachments and effective access are evaluated separately.
aws.nist.all_iam_policies_no_star_star.fail_when: FAIL iff any managed or inline IAM policy has an Allow statement whose Action is * or *:* and Resource is *; PASS iff all policy documents were read and none match; UNKNOWN on incomplete collection or unparsed policy documents.
evaluated: iam_managed_policy: paged ListPolicies Scope=All OnlyAttached=false and GetPolicyVersion default Document
complete account-global IAM inventories, ARN identities and source operation provenance
aws.nist.all_iam_policies_no_star_star.pass_when: All required managed defaults and inline documents are readable, identity-bound and parseable; no Allow statement matches the signed star predicate.

aws.nist.all_managed_policies_no_service.description: Detects failure of managed iam policies avoid service-wide wildcard grants. Full inventory includes unattached AWS-managed default documents. This is a policy configuration observation; attachments and effective access are evaluated separately.
aws.nist.all_managed_policies_no_service.fail_when: FAIL iff any customer-managed or AWS-managed policy default version has an Allow statement with Action=* or service:* and Resource=*; PASS iff all managed policies were read and none match; UNKNOWN on incomplete inventory or unparsed policy documents.
evaluated: iam_managed_policy: paged ListPolicies Scope=All OnlyAttached=false and GetPolicyVersion default Document
complete account-global IAM inventories, ARN identities and source operation provenance
aws.nist.all_managed_policies_no_service.pass_when: All required managed defaults are readable, identity-bound and parseable; no Allow statement matches the signed managed_service predicate.

aws.nist.apigateway_stage_valid_client_c.description: Detects failure of rest api stages use a valid required client certificate. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.nist.apigateway_stage_valid_client_certificate.
aws.nist.apigateway_stage_valid_client_c.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: UNKNOWN if require_client_certificate is unspecified because the source text conflicts about an absent certificate; when true, FAIL if any REST API stage lacks clientCertificateId or its referenced client certificate is missing or expired, otherwise PASS; when false, PASS iff clientCertificateId is absent on every REST API stage, otherwise FAIL.
evaluated: apigateway:GetStages clientCertificateId; apigateway:GetClientCertificate clientCertificateId, expirationDate; policy input require_client_certificate
aws.nist.apigateway_stage_valid_client_c.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: UNKNOWN if require_client_certificate is unspecified because the source text conflicts about an absent certificate; when true, FAIL if any REST API stage lacks clientCertificateId or its referenced client certificate is missing or expired, otherwise PASS; when false, PASS iff clientCertificateId is absent on every REST API stage, otherwise FAIL.

aws.nist.cloudtrail_cloudwatch_destinati.description: Detects failure of cloudtrail and its cloudwatch log destination use customer-managed kms keys. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.nist.cloudtrail_cloudwatch_destination_kms.
aws.nist.cloudtrail_cloudwatch_destinati.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every in-scope trail that declares a CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn, FAIL if that ARN does not resolve to a log group with a nonempty kmsKeyId or if the trail has no KmsKeyId; PASS iff both KMS key references resolve to enabled customer-managed keys; UNKNOWN when the intended CloudTrail versus CloudWatch scope is unspecified or joins are incomplete.
evaluated: cloudtrail:DescribeTrails CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn, KmsKeyId; logs:DescribeLogGroups arn,kmsKeyId; kms:DescribeKey key metadata
aws.nist.cloudtrail_cloudwatch_destinati.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every in-scope trail that declares a CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn, FAIL if that ARN does not resolve to a log group with a nonempty kmsKeyId or if the trail has no KmsKeyId; PASS iff both KMS key references resolve to enabled customer-managed keys; UNKNOWN when the intended CloudTrail versus CloudWatch scope is unspecified or joins are incomplete.

aws.nist.cloudtrail_cloudwatch_integrati.description: Joins every home-Region CloudTrail trail to its exact same-account, same-Region CloudWatch log group and current logging status.
aws.nist.cloudtrail_cloudwatch_integrati.fail_when: Logging is disabled, the destination ARN is empty, or the complete log-group inventory has no match.
evaluated: cloudtrail:DescribeTrails CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn; cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus IsLogging and LatestCloudWatchLogsDeliveryTime; logs:DescribeLogGroups logGroupArn
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws.nist.cloudtrail_cloudwatch_integrati.not_applicable_when: Shadow trails are assessed in their home Region; incomplete GetTrailStatus or log-group inventory is UNKNOWN.
aws.nist.cloudtrail_cloudwatch_integrati.pass_when: The trail is logging and its declared CloudWatch log group resolves in complete inventory.

aws.nist.codebuild_exact_aws_key_env_nam.description: Checks CodeBuild project variable names for plaintext AWS access key declarations.
aws.nist.codebuild_exact_aws_key_env_nam.fail_when: A PLAINTEXT variable name case-insensitively matches either key name.
evaluated: identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws.nist.codebuild_exact_aws_key_env_nam.pass_when: No PLAINTEXT variable name case-insensitively matches AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.

aws.nist.ec2_instance_effective_public_r.description: Detects failure of ec2 instances have no effective public ingress path. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.nist.ec2_instance_effective_public_reachability.
aws.nist.ec2_instance_effective_public_r.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL iff an instance has a directly internet-routable public IPv4 or IPv6 address with a matching permitted ingress path, or is an active target of an internet-facing load balancer listener; PASS iff complete network and target inventory proves neither path; UNKNOWN if any route, rule, ENI, or target join is incomplete.
evaluated: ec2:DescribeInstances public IPv4/IPv6, ENI addresses, security groups; ec2:DescribeRouteTables routes and gateways; elbv2:DescribeTargetGroups/DescribeLoadBalancers public listeners and targets
aws.nist.ec2_instance_effective_public_r.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL iff an instance has a directly internet-routable public IPv4 or IPv6 address with a matching permitted ingress path, or is an active target of an internet-facing load balancer listener; PASS iff complete network and target inventory proves neither path; UNKNOWN if any route, rule, ENI, or target join is incomplete.

aws.nist.emr_master_nodes_no_public_ip.description: Detects failure of emr master instances have no public ip addresses. Resolves only current native EMR master instance IDs to same-account EC2 interfaces; it does not infer public exposure from a DNS name or unrelated instances.
aws.nist.emr_master_nodes_no_public_ip.fail_when: A required, identity-bound current master instance has a public IPv4 or global IPv6 address.
evaluated: complete paged ListInstances MASTER/RUNNING and exact primary identity where required
aws.nist.emr_master_nodes_no_public_ip.not_applicable_when: The EMR cluster is in a recognized state other than running or waiting.
aws.nist.emr_master_nodes_no_public_ip.pass_when: Every required current master EC2 instance has complete interface metadata with no public IPv4 or global IPv6 address.

aws.nist.rds_cluster_member_enhanced_mon.description: Checks every member instance of each complete in-account, same-Region RDS cluster for a valid Enhanced Monitoring interval and same-partition/account IAM role ARN; it does not infer log exports or operational monitoring effectiveness.
aws.nist.rds_cluster_member_enhanced_mon.fail_when: At least one identity-resolved member has MonitoringInterval=0 or an empty MonitoringRoleArn; malformed or foreign role identity is UNKNOWN.
evaluated: rds:DescribeDBClusters DBClusterIdentifier, DBClusterMembers[].DBInstanceIdentifier; rds:DescribeDBInstances DBInstanceIdentifier, MonitoringInterval, MonitoringRoleArn, Engine
complete identity-bound scoped native inventory and matching resource projection
scope/provider/tenant or account/Region provenance and dependency collection status
aws.nist.rds_cluster_member_enhanced_mon.not_applicable_when: No inferred exemption; incomplete, denied, missing, malformed or foreign facts remain UNKNOWN.
aws.nist.rds_cluster_member_enhanced_mon.pass_when: Every resolved cluster member has a valid positive MonitoringInterval and a readable same-partition/account IAM role ARN.

aws.nist.sc_36_coverage.description: Processing and storage groups span distinct Availability Zones for the approved scope. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.nist.sc_36_coverage.
aws.nist.sc_36_coverage.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each approved recovery group has at least two active processing or storage resources in distinct Availability Zones; FAIL if any group has fewer than two zones; UNKNOWN when scope or placement metadata is unavailable.
evaluated: approved recovery-group inventory joined to EC2 DescribeInstances Placement.AvailabilityZone and RDS DescribeDBInstances AvailabilityZone/MultiAZ metadata
aws.nist.sc_36_coverage.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each approved recovery group has at least two active processing or storage resources in distinct Availability Zones; FAIL if any group has fewer than two zones; UNKNOWN when scope or placement metadata is unavailable.

aws.nist.sc_5_2_coverage.description: Capacity and redundancy meet approved thresholds for the approved scope. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.nist.sc_5_2_coverage.
aws.nist.sc_5_2_coverage.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff every approved capacity group has configured capacity at least its documented minimum and at least two independent AvailabilityZone values; FAIL for any group below minimum or without two zones; UNKNOWN when group scope or capacity facts are absent.
evaluated: approved capacity-group inventory joined to Auto Scaling DescribeAutoScalingGroups MinSize/DesiredCapacity/AvailabilityZones and RDS DescribeDBInstances MultiAZ
aws.nist.sc_5_2_coverage.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every approved capacity group has configured capacity at least its documented minimum and at least two independent AvailabilityZone values; FAIL for any group below minimum or without two zones; UNKNOWN when group scope or capacity facts are absent.

aws.nist.sc_8_1_coverage.description: Transmitted data uses approved TLS on all endpoints for the approved scope. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.nist.sc_8_1_coverage.
aws.nist.sc_8_1_coverage.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff every in-scope external endpoint uses an approved TLS protocol and policy; FAIL for any HTTP or unapproved policy; UNKNOWN if inventory or protocol configuration is missing.
evaluated: approved endpoint inventory joined to ELBv2 DescribeListeners Protocol/SSLPolicy, API Gateway GetDomainName SecurityPolicy, CloudFront GetDistribution ViewerCertificate.MinimumProtocolVersion
aws.nist.sc_8_1_coverage.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every in-scope external endpoint uses an approved TLS protocol and policy; FAIL for any HTTP or unapproved policy; UNKNOWN if inventory or protocol configuration is missing.

aws.nist.sc_8_coverage.description: Transmitted data uses approved TLS on all endpoints for the approved scope. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.nist.sc_8_coverage.
aws.nist.sc_8_coverage.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff every in-scope external endpoint uses an approved TLS protocol and policy; FAIL for any HTTP or unapproved policy; UNKNOWN if inventory or protocol configuration is missing.
evaluated: approved endpoint inventory joined to ELBv2 DescribeListeners Protocol/SSLPolicy, API Gateway GetDomainName SecurityPolicy, CloudFront GetDistribution ViewerCertificate.MinimumProtocolVersion
aws.nist.sc_8_coverage.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every in-scope external endpoint uses an approved TLS protocol and policy; FAIL for any HTTP or unapproved policy; UNKNOWN if inventory or protocol configuration is missing.

aws.nist.waf_classic_regional_acl_loggin.description: Detects failure of regional waf classic web acls have logging destinations. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.nist.waf_classic_regional_acl_logging.
aws.nist.waf_classic_regional_acl_loggin.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL iff any regional WAF Classic web ACL lacks a logging configuration with a nonempty LogDestinationConfigs entry; PASS iff all regional ACLs have one; UNKNOWN if regional ACL or logging inventory is incomplete.
aws.nist.waf_classic_regional_acl_loggin.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL iff any regional WAF Classic web ACL lacks a logging configuration with a nonempty LogDestinationConfigs entry; PASS iff all regional ACLs have one; UNKNOWN if regional ACL or logging inventory is incomplete.

aws.pci.apigateway.all_methods_cache_enc.description: Checks declared GetStages method cache settings for an enabled, AVAILABLE stage cache cluster. A covering wildcard and explicit encryption on every declared enabled cache can pass; an explicitly enabled, unencrypted method override fails as a configured weakness. Absent wildcard coverage without a stage-bound deployment-route inventory, incomplete or malformed stage facts, omitted required cache fields with unproved inheritance, and unavailable or transitional cluster state remain UNKNOWN. This check does not prove deployed-route coverage or encryption of cached responses.
aws.pci.apigateway.all_methods_cache_enc.fail_when: An explicit method override declares cachingEnabled=true and cacheDataEncrypted=false.
evaluated: complete scoped rest_api_stage inventory with unique stage identity
aws.pci.apigateway.all_methods_cache_enc.not_applicable_when: The stage cache cluster is disabled with no conflicting status, or every declared method cache is explicitly disabled under a covering wildcard.
aws.pci.apigateway.all_methods_cache_enc.pass_when: The stage cache is AVAILABLE, a covering wildcard explicitly establishes cache state, and each declared enabled method setting explicitly states cacheDataEncrypted=true.

aws.pci.apigateway.all_methods_logging.description: Checks declared GetStages method settings for a REST API stage. A safe wildcard and explicit ERROR or INFO on every override can pass; an explicit OFF override is a configured weakness, not evidence of deployed traffic. Missing wildcard coverage, incomplete or malformed stage facts, omitted or unrecognized override levels, and unproved method-field inheritance remain UNKNOWN. This check does not prove deployed-route coverage or CloudWatch log delivery.
aws.pci.apigateway.all_methods_logging.fail_when: An explicit method override declares loggingLevel OFF; the finding is about configuration, not observed traffic.
evaluated: complete scoped rest_api_stage inventory with unique stage identity
aws.pci.apigateway.all_methods_logging.pass_when: A complete stage wildcard declares ERROR or INFO and every explicit method override declares ERROR or INFO.

aws.pci.appsync.waf_web_acl.description: Detects an AppSync GraphQL API whose API ARN has no WAFv2 web ACL association; this weakens request protection, change control or forensic visibility at the application edge. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.appsync.waf_web_acl.
aws.pci.appsync.waf_web_acl.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Every in-scope AppSync GraphQL API ARN is associated with a WAFv2 web ACL
evaluated: new read-only API calls appsync:ListGraphqlApis and wafv2:ListResourcesForWebACL; apiArn and associated resource ARNs
aws.pci.appsync.waf_web_acl.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Every in-scope AppSync GraphQL API ARN is associated with a WAFv2 web ACL

aws.pci.backup.plan_frequency_retention.description: Detects an AWS Backup plan whose rule schedule is too infrequent or DeleteAfterDays too short; this can prevent reliable recovery or erase retained evidence after an incident. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.backup.plan_frequency_retention.
aws.pci.backup.plan_frequency_retention.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Each enabled backup-plan rule has a valid schedule no less frequent than the policy threshold and DeleteAfterDays greater than or equal to the configured retention threshold
evaluated: existing collected type backup_plan + Plan.BackupPlan.Rules[].ScheduleExpression and Lifecycle.DeleteAfterDays; configurable required frequency and retention
aws.pci.backup.plan_frequency_retention.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Each enabled backup-plan rule has a valid schedule no less frequent than the policy threshold and DeleteAfterDays greater than or equal to the configured retention threshold

aws.pci.classic_elb.custom_ssl_policy.description: Detects a Classic ELB whose HTTPS listener lacks the approved custom SSL policy; this can leave connections or stored data without the required cryptographic protection. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.classic_elb.custom_ssl_policy.
aws.pci.classic_elb.custom_ssl_policy.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each HTTPS or SSL ListenerDescriptions[].PolicyNames references a policy whose PolicyTypeName is SSLNegotiationPolicy and whose attributes match the configured custom policy; UNKNOWN without the approved policy.
evaluated: elb:DescribeLoadBalancers ListenerDescriptions[].Listener.Protocol, PolicyNames; elb:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies PolicyDescriptions[].PolicyTypeName, PolicyAttributeDescriptions
aws.pci.classic_elb.custom_ssl_policy.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each HTTPS or SSL ListenerDescriptions[].PolicyNames references a policy whose PolicyTypeName is SSLNegotiationPolicy and whose attributes match the configured custom policy; UNKNOWN without the approved policy.

aws.pci.classic_elb.predefined_ssl_polic.description: Detects a Classic ELB whose HTTPS listener lacks an AWS predefined SSL policy; this can leave connections or stored data without the required cryptographic protection. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.classic_elb.predefined_ssl_policy.
aws.pci.classic_elb.predefined_ssl_polic.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each HTTPS or SSL ListenerDescriptions[].PolicyNames references an AWS predefined SSL negotiation policy; FAIL otherwise.
evaluated: elb:DescribeLoadBalancers ListenerDescriptions[].Listener.Protocol, PolicyNames; elb:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies PolicyDescriptions[].PolicyTypeName, PolicyAttributeDescriptions
aws.pci.classic_elb.predefined_ssl_polic.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each HTTPS or SSL ListenerDescriptions[].PolicyNames references an AWS predefined SSL negotiation policy; FAIL otherwise.

aws.pci.client_vpn.no_authorize_all_grou.description: Detects a Client VPN endpoint with an active authorization rule setting AuthorizeAllGroups=true; this can create an unapproved network or resource access path. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.client_vpn.no_authorize_all_groups.
aws.pci.client_vpn.no_authorize_all_grou.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: No active authorization rule has AuthorizeAllGroups true unless the endpoint is in an explicit approved exception list
aws.pci.client_vpn.no_authorize_all_grou.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: No active authorization rule has AuthorizeAllGroups true unless the endpoint is in an explicit approved exception list

aws.pci.cloudfront.min_tls_policy.description: Detects a CloudFront distribution whose ViewerCertificate.MinimumProtocolVersion is below the approved TLS floor; this weakens request protection, change control or forensic visibility at the application edge. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.cloudfront.min_tls_policy.
aws.pci.cloudfront.min_tls_policy.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Each in-scope distribution viewer MinimumProtocolVersion is TLSv1 or higher according to the configured baseline
aws.pci.cloudfront.min_tls_policy.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Each in-scope distribution viewer MinimumProtocolVersion is TLSv1 or higher according to the configured baseline

aws.pci.cloudwatch.metric_alarm_settings.description: Detects a CloudWatch alarm whose period, threshold, comparison, evaluation count or action differs from the approved metric specification; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.cloudwatch.metric_alarm_settings.
aws.pci.cloudwatch.metric_alarm_settings.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Every alarm matching the configured metric name also matches the configured period, threshold, comparison, evaluation periods and actions
evaluated: cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms and caller-supplied metric name, namespace, dimensions, thresholds and actions
aws.pci.cloudwatch.metric_alarm_settings.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Every alarm matching the configured metric name also matches the configured period, threshold, comparison, evaluation periods and actions

aws.pci.cloudwatch.resource_metric_alarm.description: Detects a CloudWatch alarm for which no enabled alarm matches the required namespace, metric and resource dimension; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.cloudwatch.resource_metric_alarm.
aws.pci.cloudwatch.resource_metric_alarm.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Each in-scope resource has an enabled alarm for the requested namespace, metric and resource dimension
evaluated: cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms and caller-supplied resource type, dimension and metric name
aws.pci.cloudwatch.resource_metric_alarm.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Each in-scope resource has an enabled alarm for the requested namespace, metric and resource dimension

aws.pci.codebuild.aws_key_environment_va.description: Checks CodeBuild projects for exact AWS access key variable names regardless of storage type.
aws.pci.codebuild.aws_key_environment_va.fail_when: An exact AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY variable name is declared.

identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws.pci.codebuild.aws_key_environment_va.pass_when: Neither exact AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID nor AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY variable name is declared.

aws.pci.codecommit.pr_review_approval.description: Detects a CodeCommit pull request whose merged pull requests lack a premerge non-author security approval; this weakens request protection, change control or forensic visibility at the application edge. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.codecommit.pr_review_approval.
aws.pci.codecommit.pr_review_approval.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each merged pull request has an approval state APPROVE from an approver whose ARN differs from the author ARN and whose approval timestamp precedes merge; UNKNOWN if reviewer classification is unavailable.

aws.pci.codecommit.pr_review_approval.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each merged pull request has an approval state APPROVE from an approver whose ARN differs from the author ARN and whose approval timestamp precedes merge; UNKNOWN if reviewer classification is unavailable.

aws.pci.codepipeline.first_stage_single_.description: Checks the identity-bound CodePipeline GET for the first stage containing Deploy category actions.
aws.pci.codepipeline.first_stage_single_.fail_when: The first deployment stage has more than one Deploy action.
evaluated: new read-only API call codepipeline:GetPipeline; Stages[].Actions[].ActionTypeId.Category
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws.pci.codepipeline.first_stage_single_.not_applicable_when: No pipeline subtype exclusion; incomplete GET, stage or action projection is UNKNOWN.

aws.pci.fms.web_acl_rule_priority.description: Detects a Firewall Manager policy whose WAF rule groups have duplicate or out-of-order Priority values; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.fms.web_acl_rule_priority.
aws.pci.fms.web_acl_rule_priority.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each Firewall Manager managed web ACL, rule groups appear at the approved unique priority numbers and order

aws.pci.fms.web_acl_rule_priority.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each Firewall Manager managed web ACL, rule groups appear at the approved unique priority numbers and order

aws.pci.iam.configured_password_policy.description: Detects an IAM password policy whose password policy fields fall below approved thresholds; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. evaluated: iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy PasswordPolicy.MinimumPasswordLength, RequireSymbols, RequireNumbers, RequireUppercaseCharacters, RequireLowercaseCharacters, MaxPasswordAge, PasswordReusePrevention, HardExpiry; configured thresholds
aws.pci.iam.configured_password_policy.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy PasswordPolicy.MinimumPasswordLength, RequireSymbols, RequireNumbers, RequireUppercaseCharacters, RequireLowercaseCharacters, MaxPasswordAge, PasswordReusePrevention and HardExpiry each meet their named configured thresholds; UNKNOWN without the threshold set.

aws.pci.iam.generic_user_ids.description: Detects an IAM user with active shared-name console or access-key credentials and no service exception; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.iam.generic_user_ids.
aws.pci.iam.generic_user_ids.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL iff an iam_user with enabled login profile or active access key has a UserName matching a configured shared-account pattern and is absent from approved_service_identity_ids; UNKNOWN without patterns or inventory.
