aws.pci.iam.generic_user_ids.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL iff an iam_user with enabled login profile or active access key has a UserName matching a configured shared-account pattern and is absent from approved_service_identity_ids; UNKNOWN without patterns or inventory.

aws.pci.iam.nonconsole_mfa_policy.description: Detects an IAM policy whose administrative API Allow path does not enforce aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.iam.nonconsole_mfa_policy.
aws.pci.iam.nonconsole_mfa_policy.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each in-scope administrative Allow path in PolicyDocument.Statement[] requires Condition.Bool.aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent=true or is overridden by an applicable Deny when that value is false; UNKNOWN if effective permissions are incomplete.
evaluated: existing collected type iam_policy + PolicyDocument.Statement[].Condition and IAM principal MFA devices
aws.pci.iam.nonconsole_mfa_policy.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each in-scope administrative Allow path in PolicyDocument.Statement[] requires Condition.Bool.aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent=true or is overridden by an applicable Deny when that value is false; UNKNOWN if effective permissions are incomplete.

aws.pci.iam.policy_arn_attachment.description: Detects an IAM identity missing the configured PolicyArn attachment on a scoped identity; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.iam.policy_arn_attachment.
aws.pci.iam.policy_arn_attachment.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each in-scope IAM identity, the configured policy ARN is attached exactly as required by the benchmark parameter
evaluated: new read-only API calls iam:ListAttachedUserPolicies, iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies and iam:ListAttachedGroupPolicies; PolicyArn compared with caller supplied target ARN
aws.pci.iam.policy_arn_attachment.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each in-scope IAM identity, the configured policy ARN is attached exactly as required by the benchmark parameter

aws.pci.iam.policy_attached_to_active_pr.description: Detects an IAM policy whose configured policy is attached only to inactive or unpopulated principals; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.iam.policy_attached_to_active_principal.
aws.pci.iam.policy_attached_to_active_pr.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: The configured policy ARN is attached to an IAM user, populated IAM group or role with a trusted principal
evaluated: Complete inventories: iam_policy, iam_user, iam_group, iam_role
aws.pci.iam.policy_attached_to_active_pr.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: The configured policy ARN is attached to an IAM user, populated IAM group or role with a trusted principal

aws.pci.iam.role_required_managed_polici.description: Detects an IAM role missing a required AttachedManagedPolicies PolicyArn; the role can operate without the controls granted by that policy. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.iam.role_required_managed_policies.
aws.pci.iam.role_required_managed_polici.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Every in-scope IAM role has every configured managed policy ARN attached
aws.pci.iam.role_required_managed_polici.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Every in-scope IAM role has every configured managed policy ARN attached

aws.pci.iam.third_party_temporary_access.description: Detects an IAM role whose partner trust remains active beyond the approved access window; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.iam.third_party_temporary_access.
aws.pci.iam.third_party_temporary_access.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each third-party iam_role trust statement has a DateLessThan.aws:CurrentTime condition no later than the approved access-window end, or the partner Principal is absent after that date; UNKNOWN without the third-party inventory and window.
evaluated: existing collected type iam_role + AssumeRolePolicyDocument, attached policies and role LastUsed; caller supplied third-party principal inventory and approved access window
aws.pci.iam.third_party_temporary_access.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each third-party iam_role trust statement has a DateLessThan.aws:CurrentTime condition no later than the approved access-window end, or the partner Principal is absent after that date; UNKNOWN without the third-party inventory and window.

aws.pci.iam.wildcard_action_scoped_resou.description: Checks every customer-managed IAM policy default document for a declared broad Allow action on an individual resource ARN.
aws.pci.iam.wildcard_action_scoped_resou.fail_when: An Allow statement pairs a broad action or NotAction equivalent with an individual ARN.
evaluated: existing collected type iam_policy + PolicyDocument.Statement[].Action and Resource
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws.pci.iam.wildcard_action_scoped_resou.not_applicable_when: No policy exclusion; malformed versions, NotResource targets or incomplete account-global inventory are UNKNOWN.
aws.pci.iam.wildcard_action_scoped_resou.pass_when: No Allow statement pairs Action=* or service:* or a NotAction equivalent with an individual ARN.

aws.pci.kms.cryptoperiod_rotation.description: Detects a KMS key whose RotationPeriodInDays exceeds the approved cryptoperiod; excessive key age increases exposure if key material is compromised. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.kms.cryptoperiod_rotation.
aws.pci.kms.cryptoperiod_rotation.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each eligible cardholder-data KMS key has KeyRotationEnabled=true and RotationPeriodInDays <= approved_cryptoperiod_days; imported or externally rotated keys are UNKNOWN without a documented replacement date.
evaluated: new read-only API calls kms:GetKeyRotationStatus and kms:DescribeKey; RotationPeriodInDays, KeyMetadata.CreationDate, customer supplied cryptoperiod
aws.pci.kms.cryptoperiod_rotation.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each eligible cardholder-data KMS key has KeyRotationEnabled=true and RotationPeriodInDays <= approved_cryptoperiod_days; imported or externally rotated keys are UNKNOWN without a documented replacement date.

aws.pci.kms.enclave_attestation_events.description: Detects a CloudTrail event whose KMS attestation event has zero or unapproved PCR measurements; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.kms.enclave_attestation_events.
aws.pci.kms.enclave_attestation_events.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: No KMS attestation event in the review window has all-zero debug PCR values or a PCR value absent from the customer approved golden image set
evaluated: new read-only API call cloudtrail:LookupEvents; KMS attestation event requestParameters recipient attestation PCR values, compared with customer supplied golden values
aws.pci.kms.enclave_attestation_events.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: No KMS attestation event in the review window has all-zero debug PCR values or a PCR value absent from the customer approved golden image set

aws.pci.kms.enclave_attestation_policy.description: Detects a KMS key whose decrypt or unwrap Allow statement lacks an approved attestation condition; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.kms.enclave_attestation_policy.
aws.pci.kms.enclave_attestation_policy.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For enclave-scoped KMS keys, every decrypt/unwrap Allow statement requires approved RecipientAttestation image or PCR conditions, with no equivalent unconditioned Allow path
evaluated: new read-only API call kms:GetKeyPolicy; Statement[].Condition with kms:RecipientAttestation:ImageSha384 or PCR keys
aws.pci.kms.enclave_attestation_policy.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For enclave-scoped KMS keys, every decrypt/unwrap Allow statement requires approved RecipientAttestation image or PCR conditions, with no equivalent unconditioned Allow path

aws.pci.kms.key_custodian_access.description: Detects a KMS key granting key operations to principals outside the approved custodian set; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.kms.key_custodian_access.
aws.pci.kms.key_custodian_access.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff every effective principal in kms:GetKeyPolicy Statement[], kms:ListGrants Grants[] and attached IAM policies with kms:Decrypt, ReEncrypt*, ScheduleKeyDeletion or PutKeyPolicy is in approved_custodian_arns; UNKNOWN on incomplete policy inventory.
evaluated: new read-only API calls kms:GetKeyPolicy, kms:ListGrants and iam:GetPolicyVersion; compare principals with approved custodian inventory
aws.pci.kms.key_custodian_access.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every effective principal in kms:GetKeyPolicy Statement[], kms:ListGrants Grants[] and attached IAM policies with kms:Decrypt, ReEncrypt*, ScheduleKeyDeletion or PutKeyPolicy is in approved_custodian_arns; UNKNOWN on incomplete policy inventory.

aws.pci.lambda.expected_configuration.description: Detects a Lambda function whose Runtime, Role, Timeout or MemorySize differs from approved values; this can leave the workload exposed to preventable compromise or service loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.lambda.expected_configuration.
aws.pci.lambda.expected_configuration.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each in-scope Lambda function, Runtime, Role, Timeout and MemorySize equal its approved expected values
evaluated: existing collected type lambda_function + Configuration.Runtime, Role, Timeout, MemorySize; caller supplied expected configuration
aws.pci.lambda.expected_configuration.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each in-scope Lambda function, Runtime, Role, Timeout and MemorySize equal its approved expected values

aws.pci.redshift.expected_settings.description: Detects a Redshift cluster whose named cluster setting differs from its approved value; this can leave the workload exposed to preventable compromise or service loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.redshift.expected_settings.
aws.pci.redshift.expected_settings.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff every configured Redshift ClusterParameterGroupName parameter and each named redshift:DescribeClusters field equals its corresponding approved value; UNKNOWN without the expected name/value map.
evaluated: redshift:DescribeClusters Clusters[].ClusterParameterGroups[].ParameterGroupName and named cluster fields; redshift:DescribeClusterParameters Parameters[].ParameterName, ParameterValue; approved setting name/value map
aws.pci.redshift.expected_settings.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every configured Redshift ClusterParameterGroupName parameter and each named redshift:DescribeClusters field equals its corresponding approved value; UNKNOWN without the expected name/value map.

aws.pci.s3.allowed_policy_principals.description: Detects a S3 bucket whose bucket policy allows unapproved principals or source networks; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.s3.allowed_policy_principals.
aws.pci.s3.allowed_policy_principals.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Every effective bucket policy Allow is confined to the configured principal, federated principal, service principal, IP or VPC allowlist
evaluated: collected bucket.Policy.Statement[].Principal, Action, Condition; configured approved principals, IP CIDRs and VPC IDs
aws.pci.s3.allowed_policy_principals.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Every effective bucket policy Allow is confined to the configured principal, federated principal, service principal, IP or VPC allowlist

aws.pci.s3.bucket_backup_plan.description: Detects a S3 bucket whose bucket ARN is absent from active AWS Backup selections; this can prevent reliable recovery or erase retained evidence after an incident. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.s3.bucket_backup_plan.
aws.pci.s3.bucket_backup_plan.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Each in-scope S3 bucket ARN is covered by an active Backup selection
evaluated: existing collected type bucket + Name and AWS Backup selections from backup:ListBackupSelections
aws.pci.s3.bucket_backup_plan.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Each in-scope S3 bucket ARN is covered by an active Backup selection

aws.pci.s3.sensitive_auth_data_findings.description: Detects a Macie finding with active Macie CVV, PIN or track-data findings on scoped S3 objects; retaining authentication data can expose payment credentials and increase breach impact. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.s3.sensitive_auth_data_findings.
aws.pci.s3.sensitive_auth_data_findings.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: No active Macie finding for an in-scope S3 object matches configured CVV, PIN or track-data identifiers after authorization
evaluated: new read-only API call macie2:ListFindings and macie2:GetFindings; S3Object details and custom identifiers for prohibited sensitive authentication data
aws.pci.s3.sensitive_auth_data_findings.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: No active Macie finding for an in-scope S3 object matches configured CVV, PIN or track-data identifiers after authorization

aws.pci.secretsmanager.kms_encryption_an.description: Resolves an authoritative DescribeSecret KmsKeyId through complete scoped ListKeys identity and the selected key DescribeKey metadata; unrelated key-detail denials do not erase a known target result, and no secret value is read.
aws.pci.secretsmanager.kms_encryption_an.fail_when: The exact referenced key has an allowed KeyManager and a recognized non-Enabled state; missing/default/alias or unresolved identity remains UNKNOWN.
evaluated: complete identity-bound scoped native inventory and matching resource projection
scope/provider/tenant or account/Region provenance and dependency collection status
aws.pci.secretsmanager.kms_encryption_an.not_applicable_when: No inferred exemption; incomplete, denied, missing, malformed or foreign facts remain UNKNOWN.
aws.pci.secretsmanager.kms_encryption_an.pass_when: The exact referenced same-account/Region/partition key has KeyManager AWS or CUSTOMER and KeyState Enabled.

aws.pci.shield.protection_all_internet_r.description: Detects a Shield protection whose public endpoint ARN lacks a Shield Advanced protection; this can create an unapproved network or resource access path. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.shield.protection_all_internet_resources.
aws.pci.shield.protection_all_internet_r.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff every inventoried internet-facing ALB, Classic ELB, CloudFront distribution and Elastic IP ARN appears as ResourceArn in shield:ListProtections; UNKNOWN on incomplete resource inventory.
evaluated: Complete inventories: shield_protection, load_balancer, classic_load_balancer, cloudfront_distribution, elastic_ip
aws.pci.shield.protection_all_internet_r.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every inventoried internet-facing ALB, Classic ELB, CloudFront distribution and Elastic IP ARN appears as ResourceArn in shield:ListProtections; UNKNOWN on incomplete resource inventory.

aws.pci.shield.srt_access.description: Detects a Shield protection whose Shield DRT access lacks a usable RoleArn; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.shield.srt_access.
aws.pci.shield.srt_access.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff shield:DescribeDRTAccess returns nonempty RoleArn and the required LogBucketList entries when Shield Advanced is enabled; UNKNOWN if the required log-bucket list is unavailable.
evaluated: new read-only API call shield:DescribeDRTAccess; RoleArn and LogBucketList
aws.pci.shield.srt_access.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff shield:DescribeDRTAccess returns nonempty RoleArn and the required LogBucketList entries when Shield Advanced is enabled; UNKNOWN if the required log-bucket list is unavailable.

aws.pci.sns.delivery_status_logging.description: Detects a SNS topic without protocol-specific failure and sampled success feedback role ARNs; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.sns.delivery_status_logging.
aws.pci.sns.delivery_status_logging.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every configured delivery protocol, FailureFeedbackRoleArn is set and SuccessFeedbackRoleArn is set with SuccessFeedbackSampleRate greater than zero
evaluated: new read-only API call sns:GetTopicAttributes; *FailureFeedbackRoleArn, *SuccessFeedbackRoleArn, *SuccessFeedbackSampleRate by endpoint protocol
aws.pci.sns.delivery_status_logging.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every configured delivery protocol, FailureFeedbackRoleArn is set and SuccessFeedbackRoleArn is set with SuccessFeedbackSampleRate greater than zero

aws.pci.ssm.antimalware_inventory.description: Detects an SSM managed instance missing an approved current antimalware package in AWS:Application inventory; this can leave the workload exposed to preventable compromise or service loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.ssm.antimalware_inventory.
aws.pci.ssm.antimalware_inventory.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff every scoped ssm_managed_instance has an AWS:Application entry whose Name is in approved_antimalware_packages and Version meets its configured minimum; UNKNOWN without package baseline.
evaluated: new read-only API call ssm:ListInventoryEntries for AWS:Application; compare with approved anti-malware package names and versions
aws.pci.ssm.antimalware_inventory.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every scoped ssm_managed_instance has an AWS:Application entry whose Name is in approved_antimalware_packages and Version meets its configured minimum; UNKNOWN without package baseline.

aws.pci.ssm.required_applications.description: Detects an SSM managed instance missing a required package name or minimum version in AWS:Application inventory; this can leave the workload exposed to preventable compromise or service loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.ssm.required_applications.
aws.pci.ssm.required_applications.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff every scoped managed instance AWS:Application Entries[] contains each required (Name, minimum Version) pair; UNKNOWN without required applications.
evaluated: new read-only API call ssm:ListInventoryEntries (AWS:Application), compared with a caller supplied required application list
aws.pci.ssm.required_applications.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every scoped managed instance AWS:Application Entries[] contains each required (Name, minimum Version) pair; UNKNOWN without required applications.

aws.pci.vpc.antispoofing_ingress.description: Detects a Network Firewall policy whose ingress firewall permits protected internal source CIDRs from the internet; this can create an unapproved network or resource access path. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.vpc.antispoofing_ingress.
aws.pci.vpc.antispoofing_ingress.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each internet-facing Network Firewall policy has a stateless or stateful DROP rule matching Source CIDRs in protected_internal_cidrs before any matching PASS rule into the CDE; UNKNOWN without the CIDR inventory.
evaluated: new read-only API calls network-firewall:DescribeFirewallPolicy and network-firewall:DescribeRuleGroup; stateless/stateful ingress rules and protected CIDR inventory
aws.pci.vpc.antispoofing_ingress.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each internet-facing Network Firewall policy has a stateless or stateful DROP rule matching Source CIDRs in protected_internal_cidrs before any matching PASS rule into the CDE; UNKNOWN without the CIDR inventory.

aws.pci.vpc.approved_egress.description: Detects a security group whose CDE egress permissions exceed approved CIDRs, protocols or ports; this can create an unapproved network or resource access path. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.vpc.approved_egress.
aws.pci.vpc.approved_egress.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: Every egress rule on a CDE security group is a subset of the approved destination CIDRs, protocols and ports, with no unrestricted all-traffic rule
evaluated: existing collected type security_group + IpPermissionsEgress[].IpRanges, Ipv6Ranges, UserIdGroupPairs, IpProtocol and port ranges; caller supplied CDE egress allowlist
aws.pci.vpc.approved_egress.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: Every egress rule on a CDE security group is a subset of the approved destination CIDRs, protocols and ports, with no unrestricted all-traffic rule

aws.pci.vpc.authorized_igw_attachment.description: Detects an internet gateway attached in available state to a VPC outside the approved VPC ID list; this can create an unapproved network or resource access path. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.vpc.authorized_igw_attachment.
aws.pci.vpc.authorized_igw_attachment.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL iff ec2:DescribeInternetGateways InternetGateways[].Attachments[] contains State=available and VpcId outside approved_vpc_ids; PASS iff complete inventory contains no such attachment; UNKNOWN without allowlist or complete inventory.
evaluated: existing collected type internet_gateway + Attachments[].VpcId; caller supplied authorized VPC inventory
aws.pci.vpc.authorized_igw_attachment.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL iff ec2:DescribeInternetGateways InternetGateways[].Attachments[] contains State=available and VpcId outside approved_vpc_ids; PASS iff complete inventory contains no such attachment; UNKNOWN without allowlist or complete inventory.

aws.pci.vpc.igw_routes_reviewed.description: Detects a route table with an active igw-* route outside the approved destination inventory; this can create an unapproved network or resource access path. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.vpc.igw_routes_reviewed.
aws.pci.vpc.igw_routes_reviewed.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL iff a route_table.Routes[] item has State=active, GatewayId beginning igw-, and its (RouteTableId, DestinationCidrBlock or DestinationIpv6CidrBlock, GatewayId) tuple is absent from approved_public_routes; UNKNOWN without route inventory or approved routes.
evaluated: existing collected type route_table + Routes[].GatewayId, DestinationCidrBlock, DestinationIpv6CidrBlock; caller supplied approved public route inventory
aws.pci.vpc.igw_routes_reviewed.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL iff a route_table.Routes[] item has State=active, GatewayId beginning igw-, and its (RouteTableId, DestinationCidrBlock or DestinationIpv6CidrBlock, GatewayId) tuple is absent from approved_public_routes; UNKNOWN without route inventory or approved routes.

aws.pci.vpc.peering_dns_resolution.description: Checks the signed VPC peering resolves remote private DNS predicate on identity-bound read-only AWS snapshot facts; unavailable detail or unresolved applicability remains UNKNOWN.
aws.pci.vpc.peering_dns_resolution.fail_when: Either endpoint on an active connection explicitly disables DNS resolution.
evaluated: new read-only API call ec2:DescribeVpcPeeringConnections; requester/accepter PeeringOptions.AllowDnsResolutionFromRemoteVpc
same-account and same-Region resource inventory and per-field collection coverage
aws.pci.vpc.peering_dns_resolution.not_applicable_when: Connections in known nonactive states are outside the signed active-connection predicate.
aws.pci.vpc.peering_dns_resolution.pass_when: Both endpoint DNS resolution options on the active scoped connection are explicitly true.

aws.pci.vpc.world_ingress_authorized_por.description: Detects a security group with ::/0 or 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on an unapproved TCP or UDP port; this can create an unapproved network or resource access path. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws.pci.vpc.world_ingress_authorized_ports.
aws.pci.vpc.world_ingress_authorized_por.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 ingress rule, the protocol and full port range are in the approved list; unrestricted -1 fails
evaluated: collected security_group.IpPermissions[].IpProtocol, FromPort, ToPort, IpRanges[].CidrIp, Ipv6Ranges[].CidrIpv6; approved_ports
aws.pci.vpc.world_ingress_authorized_por.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 ingress rule, the protocol and full port range are in the approved list; unrestricted -1 fails

aws.pci.wafv2.rule_group_metrics.description: Detects a WAFv2 rule group whose rule VisibilityConfig disables CloudWatch metrics; this weakens request protection, change control or forensic visibility at the application edge.
aws.pci.wafv2.rule_group_metrics.fail_when: A same-account, same-Region rule group has complete GetRuleGroup detail with CloudWatchMetricsEnabled false.
evaluated: complete or partial scoped wafv2_rule_group collection
rule-group ARN, Scope and exact GetRuleGroup.RuleGroup.ARN
aws.pci.wafv2.rule_group_metrics.pass_when: The collection is complete and the exact scoped rule group has CloudWatchMetricsEnabled true.

aws.pci.wafv2.rule_group_nonempty.description: Detects a WAFv2 rule group whose Rules list is empty; this weakens request protection, change control or forensic visibility at the application edge.
aws.pci.wafv2.rule_group_nonempty.fail_when: A same-account, same-Region rule group has complete GetRuleGroup detail with an empty Rules list.
evaluated: complete or partial scoped wafv2_rule_group collection
rule-group ARN, Scope and exact GetRuleGroup.RuleGroup.ARN
aws.pci.wafv2.rule_group_nonempty.pass_when: The collection is complete and the exact scoped rule group has at least one uniquely named rule.

aws.review.amplify_app.configuration_sec.description: Observes selected high-confidence secret indicators in Amplify app environment variable contents. Only app environment maps returned by ListApps are inspected; backend metadata supplies no variable contents. Build specifications, custom headers and backend-stack contents are omitted and unclaimed. A negative result means no selected indicator in complete bound returned evidence, not absence of all secrets.
aws.review.amplify_app.configuration_sec.fail_when: Complete bound Amplify app environment variable contents evidence contains a private-key marker, paired AWS credentials or literal password assignment.
evaluated: AdditionalSecretIndicators bound to appId and appArn
complete matching amplify_app native collection and AWS context account/region
aws.review.amplify_app.configuration_sec.not_applicable_when: No automatic exclusion; denied, malformed, incomplete, foreign, unknown-type or unsupported evidence is UNKNOWN.
aws.review.amplify_app.configuration_sec.pass_when: Complete bound Amplify app environment variable contents evidence contains no selected high-confidence indicator.

aws.review.batch_job_definition.configur.description: Observes selected high-confidence secret indicators in Batch classic container environment entries. Classic containerProperties environment entries are scanned; command content is discarded without inspection. Multi-node, ECS and EKS Batch variants remain UNKNOWN rather than receiving a negative scan. A negative result means no selected indicator in complete bound returned evidence, not absence of all secrets.
aws.review.batch_job_definition.configur.fail_when: Complete bound Batch classic container environment entries evidence contains a private-key marker, paired AWS credentials or literal password assignment.
evaluated: complete matching batch_job_definition native collection and AWS context account/region
aws.review.batch_job_definition.configur.not_applicable_when: No automatic exclusion; denied, malformed, incomplete, foreign, unknown-type or unsupported evidence is UNKNOWN.
aws.review.batch_job_definition.configur.pass_when: Complete bound Batch classic container environment entries evidence contains no selected high-confidence indicator.

aws.review.cloudformation.output_secret_.description: Checks CloudFormation output values for private-key, AWS credential-pair and literal password indicators before discarding their contents. Stack parameters are excluded from this output assessment.
aws.review.cloudformation.output_secret_.fail_when: A complete, matching native response contains at least one selected high-confidence indicator.
aws.review.cloudformation.output_secret_.not_applicable_when: No automatic applicability exception; unavailable, malformed, partial, foreign or empty-status evidence is UNKNOWN.
aws.review.cloudformation.output_secret_.pass_when: A complete, matching native response has no selected high-confidence indicator.

aws.review.cloudwatch.sampled_log_secret.description: Kingfisher and TruffleHog inspect a bounded sample of CloudWatch messages without validating credentials. Equal secret values share one finding and message text is discarded before caching. Unseen events and older windows are outside scope.
aws.review.cloudwatch.sampled_log_secret.fail_when: Bound native content includes a high-confidence category, even on a partial sample.
aws.review.cloudwatch.sampled_log_secret.not_applicable_when: Never inferred from disabled or missing content; these remain UNKNOWN.
aws.review.cloudwatch.sampled_log_secret.pass_when: Complete declared bounded scope contains no supported category.

aws.review.codebuild.selected_inline_bui.description: Scans the inline buildspec returned for an explicitly selected CodeBuild project with both offline detectors. Source files, S3 references, build artifacts and executed bytes are not inspected.
aws.review.codebuild.selected_inline_bui.fail_when: A supported secret is detected in coherently bound selected inline source.
evaluated: Exact selected project identity and returned inline buildspec

aws_acm_certificate_lifecycle.description: For an in-use ACM certificate, compares issuance and expiration against the snapshot clock and checks renewal eligibility inside the 30-day window. The result describes certificate metadata and does not prove the renewed certificate is already deployed.
aws_acm_certificate_lifecycle.fail_when: An in-use certificate is not ISSUED, expired, or within 30 days of expiry and INELIGIBLE for renewal.
aws_acm_certificate_lifecycle.not_applicable_when: The complete ACM certificate metadata has an empty InUseBy list.
aws_acm_certificate_lifecycle.pass_when: An in-use certificate is ISSUED, unexpired, and has more than 30 days remaining or is renewal eligible within 30 days.

aws_api_customer_log_delivery.description: Detects an API Gateway stage whose API stage lacks the required access or execution log destination; this weakens request protection, change control or forensic visibility at the application edge. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_api_customer_log_delivery.
aws_api_customer_log_delivery.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each in-scope REST API stage has effective loggingLevel=INFO or ERROR and a nonempty accessLogSettings.destinationArn and format containing requestId, requestTime and status; FAIL otherwise.
aws_api_customer_log_delivery.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each in-scope REST API stage has effective loggingLevel=INFO or ERROR and a nonempty accessLogSettings.destinationArn and format containing requestId, requestTime and status; FAIL otherwise.

aws_autoscaling_userdata_plaintext_aws_k.description: Detects an Auto Scaling launch configuration whose launch user data contains static AWS access key material; embedded credentials can be copied from build, launch or task configuration and reused outside the workload. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_autoscaling_userdata_plaintext_aws_key.
aws_autoscaling_userdata_plaintext_aws_k.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when decoded UserData contains an AWS access key ID (AKIA or ASIA plus 16 capitals/digits) paired with a nearby nonempty aws_secret_access_key assignment; PASS otherwise; UNKNOWN when UserData cannot be decoded or read; never persist the raw value.
evaluated: extend existing autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations collector to inspect UserData in memory and project boolean UserDataIndicators.HasAwsKeyPair; raw UserData remains redacted
aws_autoscaling_userdata_plaintext_aws_k.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when decoded UserData contains an AWS access key ID (AKIA or ASIA plus 16 capitals/digits) paired with a nearby nonempty aws_secret_access_key assignment; PASS otherwise; UNKNOWN when UserData cannot be decoded or read; never persist the raw value.

aws_backup_copy_encrypted.description: Detects an AWS Backup vault whose copied recovery point uses an unencrypted destination vault; unencrypted remote copies can disclose backup data if a vault is accessed. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_backup_copy_encrypted.
aws_backup_copy_encrypted.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each designated remote copy vault has EncryptionKeyArn pointing to a KMS key with KeyState=Enabled and each recovery point created by a copy job has IsEncrypted=true; UNKNOWN without designated remote vaults.
aws_backup_copy_encrypted.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each designated remote copy vault has EncryptionKeyArn pointing to a KMS key with KeyState=Enabled and each recovery point created by a copy job has IsEncrypted=true; UNKNOWN without designated remote vaults.

aws_backup_cross_region_copy.description: For each collected AWS Backup plan in a complete same-Region inventory, inspects every valid rule in the full GetBackupPlan response. A rule satisfies the signed declaration only if at least one CopyAction names a backup vault ARN in another Region of the caller-proven AWS partition. This checks configured copy actions, not completed copies or recovery capability.
aws_backup_cross_region_copy.fail_when: At least one valid plan rule has no copy action or only proven same-Region copy destinations. An empty or missing rule list is UNKNOWN.
evaluated: complete scoped backup_plan inventory and BackupPlanArn
aws_backup_cross_region_copy.pass_when: Every backup rule declares at least one same-partition destination backup vault in a different Region.

aws_backup_failure_notification.description: Checks each AWS Backup vault's complete native notification detail for failure events and an owned SNS topic ARN.
aws_backup_failure_notification.fail_when: Native detail confirms no notification or lacks the failure event or topic.
evaluated: new read-only backup:ListBackupVaults and backup:GetBackupVaultNotifications; SNSTopicArn, BackupVaultEvents
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_backup_failure_notification.not_applicable_when: No vault subtype exclusion; denied or malformed notification reads are UNKNOWN.
aws_backup_failure_notification.pass_when: BACKUP_JOB_FAILED is selected and a same-account topic ARN is configured.

aws_backup_plan_rule_required_frequency.description: Detects an AWS Backup plan whose ScheduleExpression is less frequent than the approved backup interval; this can prevent reliable recovery or erase retained evidence after an incident.
aws_backup_plan_rule_required_frequency.fail_when: At least one resolved rule schedule exceeds the required frequency and continuous backup does not resolve that gap.
aws_backup_plan_rule_required_frequency.pass_when: Every parsed rule schedule meets the operator supplied frequency and no rule has unresolved continuous-backup semantics.

aws_backup_recent_restore_test.description: Detects an AWS Backup restore job whose protected resource type lacks a completed restore job within 365 days; this can prevent reliable recovery or erase retained evidence after an incident. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_backup_recent_restore_test.
aws_backup_recent_restore_test.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff each ResourceType selected by a restore testing plan has a restore job with Status=COMPLETED and CompletionDate >= now-365 days; UNKNOWN if plans or jobs are incomplete.
aws_backup_recent_restore_test.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each ResourceType selected by a restore testing plan has a restore job with Status=COMPLETED and CompletionDate >= now-365 days; UNKNOWN if plans or jobs are incomplete.

aws_backup_restore_tests_recent.description: Detects a protected resource without a completed AWS Backup restore-testing job within its test interval; application recovery still requires separate validation. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_backup_restore_tests_recent.
aws_backup_restore_tests_recent.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each inventoried protected source resource ARN, PASS iff a restore-testing job for that SourceResourceArn has Status=COMPLETED, a nonempty CreatedBy.RestoreTestingPlanArn, and CompletionDate within its configured interval; UNKNOWN if job history or the protected-resource inventory is incomplete. Application recovery validation remains manual.
evaluated: backup:ListRestoreJobs RestoreJobs[].SourceResourceArn, Status, CompletionDate, CreatedBy.RestoreTestingPlanArn; approved protected-resource ARN inventory and test interval.
aws_backup_restore_tests_recent.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each inventoried protected source resource ARN, PASS iff a restore-testing job for that SourceResourceArn has Status=COMPLETED, a nonempty CreatedBy.RestoreTestingPlanArn, and CompletionDate within its configured interval; UNKNOWN if job history or the protected-resource inventory is incomplete. Application recovery validation remains manual.

aws_bedrock_automated_reasoning_policy_a.description: Detects a Bedrock automated reasoning policy whose Bedrock automated-reasoning policy is not attached to the scoped guardrail; a guardrail without reasoning policy cannot validate model output against the approved rules. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_bedrock_automated_reasoning_policy_attached.
aws_bedrock_automated_reasoning_policy_a.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each in-scope Bedrock application with a known guardrail identifier, fail if the referenced guardrail version has no configured automated reasoning policy ARN or the policy cannot be resolved as active; UNKNOWN when the application-to-guardrail binding is unavailable.
evaluated: new read-only bedrock:ListAutomatedReasoningPolicies and bedrock:GetGuardrail (including versioned automatedReasoningPolicyConfig); application guardrail identifiers require workload inventory
aws_bedrock_automated_reasoning_policy_a.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each in-scope Bedrock application with a known guardrail identifier, fail if the referenced guardrail version has no configured automated reasoning policy ARN or the policy cannot be resolved as active; UNKNOWN when the application-to-guardrail binding is unavailable.

aws_budgets_stop_action.description: Detects a Budgets action whose budget threshold has no service-stopping Budgets Action; unexpected spend may continue without timely action or notification. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_budgets_stop_action.
aws_budgets_stop_action.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: PASS iff the configured budget has a Budgets Action with ActionStatus=STANDBY or EXECUTION_IN_PROGRESS, ActionType=RUN_SSM_DOCUMENTS, an approved stop document ARN, threshold and target roles; UNKNOWN without approved targets.
aws_budgets_stop_action.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff the configured budget has a Budgets Action with ActionStatus=STANDBY or EXECUTION_IN_PROGRESS, ActionType=RUN_SSM_DOCUMENTS, an approved stop document ARN, threshold and target roles; UNKNOWN without approved targets.

aws_cis_ami_name_policy.description: Detects an owned EC2 AMI whose Name fails the approved naming expression; operators may launch an unreviewed image by mistake. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_ami_name_policy.
aws_cis_ami_name_policy.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL for an owned AMI whose Name does not match the configured organization naming expression; UNKNOWN without that expression.
evaluated: existing ec2_instance_image from ec2:DescribeImages Name, OwnerId, ImageId plus configured organization AMI naming expression
aws_cis_ami_name_policy.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL for an owned AMI whose Name does not match the configured organization naming expression; UNKNOWN without that expression.

aws_cis_aws_resource_policy_unrestricted.description: Detects an AWS resource policy whose resource policy grants an unrestricted Principal without a boundary; this can create an unapproved network or resource access path. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_aws_resource_policy_unrestricted_principal.
aws_cis_aws_resource_policy_unrestricted.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if an Allow statement has Principal=* without an effective restrictive organization, source account, source ARN, or principal condition; UNKNOWN when a resource policy cannot be read.
evaluated: existing resource policy documents plus read-only s3:GetBucketPolicy Policy, lambda:GetPolicy Policy, events:DescribeEventBus Policy, secretsmanager:GetResourcePolicy ResourcePolicy, sns:GetTopicAttributes Policy, sqs:GetQueueAttributes Policy, kms:GetKeyPolicy Policy, apigateway:GetRestApi policy
aws_cis_aws_resource_policy_unrestricted.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if an Allow statement has Principal=* without an effective restrictive organization, source account, source ARN, or principal condition; UNKNOWN when a resource policy cannot be read.

aws_cis_backup_recovery_point_isolation.description: Detects an AWS Backup recovery point whose recovery point lacks an isolated protected copy; this can prevent reliable recovery or erase retained evidence after an incident. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_backup_recovery_point_isolation.
aws_cis_backup_recovery_point_isolation.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each recovery point, FAIL if IsEncrypted=false or its vault has no active Vault Lock when the configured backup policy requires locked copies; UNKNOWN if vault state or independent offline copy evidence is unavailable. Physical security and offline custody remain manual.
aws_cis_backup_recovery_point_isolation.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each recovery point, FAIL if IsEncrypted=false or its vault has no active Vault Lock when the configured backup policy requires locked copies; UNKNOWN if vault state or independent offline copy evidence is unavailable. Physical security and offline custody remain manual.

aws_cis_batch_job_cloudwatch_logging.description: Checks every projected container in an active AWS Batch job definition for the awslogs driver and group option.
aws_cis_batch_job_cloudwatch_logging.fail_when: At least one active job container lacks the driver or group.
evaluated: identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_cis_batch_job_cloudwatch_logging.not_applicable_when: Inactive job definitions are excluded; an unreadable container projection is UNKNOWN.
aws_cis_batch_job_cloudwatch_logging.pass_when: Every container has logDriver=awslogs and a nonempty awslogs-group option.

aws_cis_beanstalk_persistent_logs_s3.description: Detects an Elastic Beanstalk environment whose Beanstalk log option does not persist logs to S3; ephemeral instance logs can disappear when the environment is replaced. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_beanstalk_persistent_logs_s3.
aws_cis_beanstalk_persistent_logs_s3.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if LogPublicationControl is not true for an active environment or no configured S3 log destination can be resolved; UNKNOWN if log publication evidence is unavailable.
evaluated: elasticbeanstalk:DescribeConfigurationSettings aws:elasticbeanstalk:hostmanager LogPublicationControl, plus s3:ListObjectsV2 in configured log bucket
aws_cis_beanstalk_persistent_logs_s3.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if LogPublicationControl is not true for an active environment or no configured S3 log destination can be resolved; UNKNOWN if log publication evidence is unavailable.

aws_cis_ec2_default_security_group_not_a.description: For a stable nonterminated EC2 instance in a complete native DescribeInstances inventory, joins every attached network interface security-group ID to the same-Region DescribeSecurityGroups inventory by exact VPC ID and group ID. It detects attachment of the VPC's default security group; it does not infer ingress reachability from the group name alone.
aws_cis_ec2_default_security_group_not_a.fail_when: At least one attached interface group resolves to the same-VPC default security group.
aws_cis_ec2_default_security_group_not_a.pass_when: Every attached interface group resolves to a same-VPC group whose GroupName is not default.

aws_cis_ec2_instance_approved_ami.description: Detects an EC2 instance whose ImageId or AMI OwnerId is outside the approved inventory; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_ec2_instance_approved_ami.
aws_cis_ec2_instance_approved_ami.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when a running instance ImageId or image owner is absent from the configured approved AMI allowlist; UNKNOWN if the AMI metadata or allowlist is missing.
evaluated: collected instance.ImageId; ec2_instance_image.ImageId, OwnerId, Tags; approved_image_ids and approved_owner_ids
aws_cis_ec2_instance_approved_ami.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when a running instance ImageId or image owner is absent from the configured approved AMI allowlist; UNKNOWN if the AMI metadata or allowlist is missing.

aws_cis_ec2_tag_policy.description: Detects an Organizations TAG_POLICY that omits approved EC2 tag keys or values; resource ownership and classification become unreliable. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_ec2_tag_policy.
aws_cis_ec2_tag_policy.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if no attached TAG_POLICY contains the organization-approved EC2 tag keys and permitted values; UNKNOWN until required EC2 tag keys and values are configured.
aws_cis_ec2_tag_policy.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if no attached TAG_POLICY contains the organization-approved EC2 tag keys and permitted values; UNKNOWN until required EC2 tag keys and values are configured.

aws_cis_ec2_userdata_embedded_secrets.description: Detects an EC2 instance whose decoded user data contains credential-like literals; embedded credentials can be copied from build, launch or task configuration and reused outside the workload. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_ec2_userdata_embedded_secrets.
aws_cis_ec2_userdata_embedded_secrets.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if decoded user data contains a high-confidence private key, cloud credential, or password assignment with a non-placeholder literal; UNKNOWN if user data cannot be read.
evaluated: new read-only ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute Attribute=userData; decode UserData then inspect literal content locally without persisting it
aws_cis_ec2_userdata_embedded_secrets.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if decoded user data contains a high-confidence private key, cloud credential, or password assignment with a non-placeholder literal; UNKNOWN if user data cannot be read.

aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_https_listener.description: Detects an Elastic Beanstalk environment whose Beanstalk load balancer has an HTTP-only listener; this weakens request protection, change control or forensic visibility at the application edge. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_https_listener.
aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_https_listener.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a Beanstalk-associated load balancer has no HTTPS/TLS listener with a nonempty certificate ARN/ID, or has a plaintext listener without an HTTPS redirect action; UNKNOWN if listener or association inventory is missing.
aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_https_listener.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a Beanstalk-associated load balancer has no HTTPS/TLS listener with a nonempty certificate ARN/ID, or has a plaintext listener without an HTTPS redirect action; UNKNOWN if listener or association inventory is missing.

aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_load_balancer_a.description: Detects an Elastic Beanstalk environment whose Beanstalk load balancer has no enabled access logs; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_load_balancer_access_logs.
aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_load_balancer_a.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a Beanstalk environment names an ALB/NLB with access_logs.s3.enabled=false or a Classic ELB with AccessLog.Enabled=false; UNKNOWN if load-balancer association or attributes cannot be read.
aws_cis_elasticbeanstalk_load_balancer_a.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a Beanstalk environment names an ALB/NLB with access_logs.s3.enabled=false or a Classic ELB with AccessLog.Enabled=false; UNKNOWN if load-balancer association or attributes cannot be read.

aws_cis_elbv2_only_tls_listeners.description: Detects a load balancer whose public ALB or NLB listener uses HTTP or TCP where TLS is required; this weakens request protection, change control or forensic visibility at the application edge.
aws_cis_elbv2_only_tls_listeners.fail_when: At least one ALB listener accepts HTTP without a redirect or one NLB listener accepts TCP without TLS.
aws_cis_elbv2_only_tls_listeners.not_applicable_when: The resource is a gateway load balancer rather than an ALB or NLB.
aws_cis_elbv2_only_tls_listeners.pass_when: Every complete ALB listener uses HTTPS or every complete NLB listener uses TLS, with no unresolved listeners.

aws_cis_lambda_config_recorded.description: Checks whether a running customer-managed AWS Config recorder includes Lambda functions in its regional recording group.
aws_cis_lambda_config_recorded.fail_when: No customer-managed recorder exists, it is stopped, or its explicit recording group excludes Lambda.
evaluated: existing lambda_function FunctionArn and config_recorder inventories; config:DescribeConfigurationRecorders and DescribeConfigurationRecorderStatus
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_cis_lambda_config_recorded.not_applicable_when: No Lambda subtype exclusion; unresolved service-linked recorder coverage remains UNKNOWN.
aws_cis_lambda_config_recorded.pass_when: One running customer-managed recorder includes AWS::Lambda::Function.

aws_cis_lambda_database_secrets_manager.description: Detects a Lambda function whose database credential variables contain literal secrets instead of a secret ARN; embedded credentials can be copied from build, launch or task configuration and reused outside the workload. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lambda_database_secrets_manager.
aws_cis_lambda_database_secrets_manager.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every Lambda with an approved database connection environment-variable name, FAIL if no environment-variable value resolves to an inventoried Secrets Manager ARN, or its execution role has no Allow secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on that ARN; UNKNOWN if role policy or environment values are unavailable. Runtime use remains manual.
evaluated: lambda:ListFunctions Functions[].FunctionName,Role,Environment.Variables; iam:GetRolePolicy/GetPolicyVersion PolicyDocument.Statement; secretsmanager:ListSecrets SecretList[].ARN; approved database connection environment-variable names
aws_cis_lambda_database_secrets_manager.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every Lambda with an approved database connection environment-variable name, FAIL if no environment-variable value resolves to an inventoried Secrets Manager ARN, or its execution role has no Allow secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on that ARN; UNKNOWN if role policy or environment values are unavailable. Runtime use remains manual.

aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_exists.description: For each Lambda function in a complete regional ListFunctions inventory, compares the declared Role ARN to an exact ARN in the complete account-global IAM RoleDetailList. The account and AWS partition must match the audited caller identity. This proves declared role existence only, not trust policy, permissions, current credentials, or invocation success. The existing IAM GetAccountAuthorizationDetails inventory supplies the full-role equivalent of the signed proposed GetRole lookup.
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_exists.fail_when: The valid declared execution Role ARN is absent from a complete account-global IAM role inventory.
evaluated: regional and global collection envelope scope/account_id/global markers
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_exists.pass_when: The function's exact same-account, same-partition Role ARN is present in the complete account-global IAM role inventory.

aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_no_admin.description: Detects a Lambda function whose execution role policy grants administrator-level actions; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_no_admin.
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_no_admin.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a Lambda execution role has unconditional effective Action=* and Resource=* or AdministratorAccess; UNKNOWN if policy documents are incomplete. Absence of administrator access is only a lower bound on least privilege; approved action/resource scope requires owner review.
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_no_admin.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a Lambda execution role has unconditional effective Action=* and Resource=* or AdministratorAccess; UNKNOWN if policy documents are incomplete. Absence of administrator access is only a lower bound on least privilege; approved action/resource scope requires owner review.

aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_unique.description: For each proven active Lambda function, compares its execution Role ARN against distinct active FunctionArns observed across the account's enabled Regions. A duplicate role produces a finding even with partial peer coverage; a clean result needs complete paginated regional inventories, collected configuration State, and caller-proven account and partition. This checks declared role reuse, not effective access or privilege escalation.
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_unique.fail_when: At least two distinct observed active functions in the audited account and partition have the same exact execution role ARN; the current function is one of them.
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_unique.not_applicable_when: The function has a collected, recognized nonactive State.
aws_cis_lambda_execution_role_unique.pass_when: An active function's exact role ARN is absent from the account-wide shared-role set and the account summary proves complete enabled-Region coverage.

aws_cis_lambda_resource_policy_trusted_a.description: Detects a Lambda function whose resource policy permits invocation from an untrusted account ID; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lambda_resource_policy_trusted_accounts.
aws_cis_lambda_resource_policy_trusted_a.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if an Allow statement names an AWS account principal outside the trusted account set, considering PrincipalOrgID and SourceAccount conditions; UNKNOWN without the trusted set.
evaluated: existing lambda_function Policy from lambda:GetPolicy plus configured trusted account IDs
aws_cis_lambda_resource_policy_trusted_a.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if an Allow statement names an AWS account principal outside the trusted account set, considering PrincipalOrgID and SourceAccount conditions; UNKNOWN without the trusted set.

aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_access_logging.description: Checks whether each Lightsail source bucket delivers request logs to a named destination bucket.
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_access_logging.fail_when: Access logging is disabled or has no destination.
evaluated: new read-only lightsail:GetBuckets response buckets[].accessLogConfig.enabled, destination, prefix
identity-bound read-only detail and dependency status
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_access_logging.pass_when: Access logging is enabled with a destination bucket name.

aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_iam_policy.description: Detects a Lightsail bucket whose bucket IAM policy grants broader actions or resources than approved; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_iam_policy.
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_iam_policy.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a bucket required to use IAM-managed access has no policy attached to an approved principal granting only configured Lightsail bucket actions on its ARN; UNKNOWN without approved principals/actions or complete identity-policy inventory.
evaluated: new read-only lightsail:GetBuckets arn plus iam:GetAccountAuthorizationDetails and iam:GetPolicyVersion policy documents and principal attachments
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_iam_policy.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a bucket required to use IAM-managed access has no policy attached to an approved principal granting only configured Lightsail bucket actions on its ARN; UNKNOWN without approved principals/actions or complete identity-policy inventory.

aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_instance_access.description: Detects a Lightsail bucket missing the intended instance ARN in resourcesReceivingAccess; the application may lose access to required objects. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_instance_access.
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_instance_access.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a bucket required by a Lightsail instance has no intended instance ARN in resourcesReceivingAccess; UNKNOWN without a configured required instance-to-bucket relation.
evaluated: new read-only lightsail:GetBuckets resourcesReceivingAccess and lightsail:GetBucketAccessKeys accessKeys
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_instance_access.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a bucket required by a Lightsail instance has no intended instance ARN in resourcesReceivingAccess; UNKNOWN without a configured required instance-to-bucket relation.

aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_private.description: Detects a Lightsail bucket whose Lightsail bucket access rules permit public reads; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_private.
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_private.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a bucket has accessRules.getObject=public and effective BlockPublicPolicy/RestrictPublicBuckets do not block it, or any enumerated object has AllUsers/AuthenticatedUsers READ grant when public overrides are effective; UNKNOWN if account controls or object ACL inventory is incomplete.
evaluated: lightsail:GetBuckets buckets[].name,accessRules.getObject,accessRules.allowPublicOverrides; s3control:GetPublicAccessBlock PublicAccessBlockConfiguration; s3:ListObjectsV2 Contents[].Key and s3:GetObjectAcl Grants[].Grantee,Permission when public overrides are permitted
aws_cis_lightsail_bucket_private.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a bucket has accessRules.getObject=public and effective BlockPublicPolicy/RestrictPublicBuckets do not block it, or any enumerated object has AllUsers/AuthenticatedUsers READ grant when public overrides are effective; UNKNOWN if account controls or object ACL inventory is incomplete.

aws_cis_lightsail_ssm_patch_compliance.description: Detects a Lightsail instance whose Lightsail instance patch-compliance status is noncompliant; this can leave the workload exposed to preventable compromise or service loss. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_lightsail_ssm_patch_compliance.
aws_cis_lightsail_ssm_patch_compliance.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if a Lightsail instance matched to a managed SSM instance has MissingCount>0 or FailedCount>0 or InstalledRejectedCount>0; UNKNOWN if no reliable Lightsail-to-SSM match or patch state exists.
aws_cis_lightsail_ssm_patch_compliance.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if a Lightsail instance matched to a managed SSM instance has MissingCount>0 or FailedCount>0 or InstalledRejectedCount>0; UNKNOWN if no reliable Lightsail-to-SSM match or patch state exists.

aws_cis_organization_account_guardrails.description: Detects an Organizations account whose account lacks the required effective SCP guardrail; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_cis_organization_account_guardrails.
aws_cis_organization_account_guardrails.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL if an active organization account has no effective attached SCP beyond FullAWSAccess, or an attached explicit guardrail policy does not cover configured prohibited actions; UNKNOWN when policy inheritance is incomplete.
evaluated: existing organization_account and scp_policy inventories from organizations:ListAccounts, ListPoliciesForTarget, DescribePolicy
aws_cis_organization_account_guardrails.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL if an active organization account has no effective attached SCP beyond FullAWSAccess, or an attached explicit guardrail policy does not cover configured prohibited actions; UNKNOWN when policy inheritance is incomplete.

aws_config_recorder_all_supported_resour.pass_when: allSupported is true under the legacy or ALL_SUPPORTED_RESOURCE_TYPES strategy, or EXCLUSION_BY_RESOURCE_TYPES has an empty exclusion list.

aws_g6_iam_all_policy_service_wildcard.description: Read-only assessment of all IAM policy types avoid service-wide grants to resources. aws_g6_iam_all_policy_service_wildcard.fail_when: FAIL iff any Allow statement in an in-scope identity policy grants a service-wide Action such as service:* to a concrete individual Resource ARN, including equivalent NotAction semantics; PASS only after complete policy inventory with no matching statement; UNKNOWN for incomplete or unparseable documents.

aws_g6_iam_all_policy_star_star.description: Read-only assessment of iAM policies avoid full administrator statements. Full inventory includes unattached AWS-managed default documents. This is a policy configuration observation; attachments and effective access are evaluated separately.

aws_g6_rds_cluster_members_enhanced_moni.description: Checks Enhanced Monitoring configuration on each resolvable RDS cluster member.

aws_guardduty_doh_threat_list.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each detector has an ACTIVE custom threat-intelligence set referencing the approved DoH server list

aws_guardduty_high_finding_alert.description: Detects an EventBridge rule whose GuardDuty severity >= 7 findings have no notification target; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. aws_guardduty_no_active_high_findings.not_applicable_when: The complete scoped detector inventory has no enabled detector.
aws_guardduty_no_active_high_findings.pass_when: At least one enabled detector exists and complete scoped finding facts contain no unarchived finding in the signed high interval for the requested account/Region.

aws_guardduty_siem_forwarding.description: Detects an EventBridge rule whose GuardDuty finding rule lacks the approved SIEM target; this can hide or delay detection of security events and operational failures. aws_guardduty_siem_forwarding.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff the union of ENABLED EventPattern rules covers aws.guardduty GuardDuty Finding events without severity exclusion and at least one target ARN is in the approved AWS SIEM-forwarder ARN inventory; SIEM receipt remains manual.

aws_iam_departed_identity_disabled.description: Detects an IAM user with active IAM keys or login profile after the approved departure date; this can grant access beyond the approved identities, scope or lifetime. aws_iam_departed_identity_disabled.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every IAM user on the approved departure roster has password_enabled=false and both access_key_*_active=false by the recorded termination deadline; UNKNOWN without the roster or deadline.

aws_iam_inactive_accounts_disabled_after.description: Detects IAM users whose credentials remain active beyond the approved inactivity interval. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: aws_iam_inactive_accounts_disabled_after_policy_days.
aws_iam_inactive_accounts_disabled_after.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For every non-excluded IAM user, compute last activity as the latest real password or access-key use date; for never-used active credentials use the later of user creation and key rotation as the start date. aws_iam_inactive_accounts_disabled_after.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For every non-excluded IAM user, compute last activity as the latest real password or access-key use date; for never-used active credentials use the later of user creation and key rotation as the start date. aws_incident_evidence_retention.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff the approved incident-evidence bucket has versioning and Object Lock retention meeting the evidence policy; UNKNOWN without the designated bucket.

aws_incident_workflow_sla.description: Reviews HIGH and CRITICAL Security Hub finding metadata and the explicitly supplied response window. ASFF UpdatedAt is a provider timestamp: BatchUpdateFindings can change Workflow without changing UpdatedAt, and NEW can be a reset state. Current finding metadata cannot establish the first workflow response time; expired windows remain UNKNOWN until complete workflow transition history is available.
aws_incident_workflow_sla.fail_when: Not emitted by the current metadata-only implementation: current Workflow.Status and provider UpdatedAt cannot prove a missed first-response deadline.
evaluated: Own-account, own-Region Security Hub finding Id, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt, Workflow.Status and Severity.Label
Snapshot created_at and explicitly supplied compliance_parameters.approved_response_hours (stored as metadata.parameters)
Workflow transition history is not currently collected; UpdatedAt does not substitute for that history.
aws_incident_workflow_sla.not_applicable_when: The finding is below HIGH severity or its approved response window has not elapsed.
aws_incident_workflow_sla.pass_when: Not emitted by the current metadata-only implementation: complete workflow transition history is required to prove an in-time first response.

aws_inspector2_ec2_no_high_critical_find.description: Checks the complete regional ACTIVE ListFindings inventory for HIGH or CRITICAL findings on AWS_EC2_INSTANCE resources at the snapshot capture time. A clean result also requires complete BatchGetAccountStatus evidence showing the assessed account and EC2 scanning ENABLED in the same Region. Missing, denied, partial, malformed, duplicate or foreign required inventory facts, and a missing or invalid timezone-aware capture time, remain UNKNOWN; disabled coverage makes a clean result UNKNOWN. An observed qualifying finding can FAIL without enabled coverage evidence. This check does not certify each instance's scan freshness or remediation.

evaluated: complete scoped inspector2_finding inventory from paginated ACTIVE ListFindings
findingArn, status, severity, awsAccountId and resources[].type
aws_inspector2_ec2_no_high_critical_find.pass_when: With a valid timezone-aware capture time, complete valid same-account regional ACTIVE findings contain no HIGH or CRITICAL EC2 finding, and a complete unique same-account regional status record explicitly shows both account and EC2 coverage ENABLED.

aws_kms_compromised_key_restricted.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff every key tagged Compromised=true is disabled or its policy denies Encrypt and GenerateDataKey while retaining only scoped Decrypt/Verify grants; FAIL otherwise.

aws_kms_customer_key_control.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: PASS iff each designated customer-data key has KeyManager=CUSTOMER and KeyState=Enabled, and no policy Allow or grant gives Decrypt, GenerateDataKey or ScheduleKeyDeletion to an unapproved principal; UNKNOWN for IAM delegation or missing approved inventories.
