approved project and service bound gcp_data_access_required_principals: principals[] and source_ref
gcp_pci_iam_policy_9a8ce875703d.not_applicable_when: Nonproject IAM policy resources are outside this project-root check; missing owner input, incomplete or malformed ancestry, and unresolved principal membership are UNKNOWN.
gcp_pci_iam_policy_9a8ce875703d.pass_when: Both types are configured in the complete inherited policy, approved required principals are direct valid user or serviceAccount identities, and no known or ambiguous exemption covers them.

gcp_pci_iam_policy_ca1281da7ab2.fail_when: The complete effective policy omits DATA_READ or DATA_WRITE for the service, or explicitly exempts an approved required principal from either type.
evaluated: project-root iam_policy.effectiveAuditConfigs across complete project and ancestor chain

gcp_pci_iam_policy_ca1281da7ab2.not_applicable_when: Nonproject IAM policy resources are outside this project-root check; missing owner input, incomplete or malformed ancestry, and unresolved principal membership are UNKNOWN.
gcp_pci_iam_policy_ca1281da7ab2.pass_when: Both types are configured in the complete inherited policy, approved required principals are direct valid user or serviceAccount identities, and no known or ambiguous exemption covers them.

gcp_pci_instance_template_2e26bed500fc.description: For a Compute Engine instance template, checks every declared network interface for an external access configuration. The template setting does not establish whether a running VM is currently publicly reachable.
gcp_pci_instance_template_2e26bed500fc.fail_when: At least one complete template network interface contains an access configuration.
gcp_pci_instance_template_2e26bed500fc.pass_when: Every complete template network interface omits accessConfigs or declares an empty list.

gcp_pci_kms_key_a3927a5f3b84.description: Counts effective cryptographic-use principals, including inherited grants; key-local bindings alone cannot establish the total. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: gcp_pci_kms_key_a3927a5f3b84.
gcp_pci_kms_key_a3927a5f3b84.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: FAIL when the resolved union of effective cryptographic-use principals exceeds three or includes a public principal; PASS only when all inherited and key-local grants, custom roles, groups and conditions are resolved and the union is at most three; UNKNOWN otherwise.
evaluated: Complete CryptoKey.getIamPolicy plus complete ancestor IAM policies, role permission resolution, group memberships and IAM condition evaluation for effective cryptographic-use principals.
gcp_pci_kms_key_a3927a5f3b84.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: FAIL when the resolved union of effective cryptographic-use principals exceeds three or includes a public principal; PASS only when all inherited and key-local grants, custom roles, groups and conditions are resolved and the union is at most three; UNKNOWN otherwise.

gcp_pci_url_map_9ed56c323a05.description: HTTP forwarding rules are joined through HTTP target proxies to the URL map and every enumerated route. Unresolved joins or incomplete route coverage are UNKNOWN. Unreadable, partial, structurally malformed, or foreign-scope required facts produce UNKNOWN; a confirmed absence in a complete inventory is graded by the stated predicate.
gcp_pci_url_map_9ed56c323a05.fail_when: An HTTP frontend reaches at least one enumerated route without httpsRedirect=true.
gcp_pci_url_map_9ed56c323a05.not_applicable_when: No HTTP frontend targets this URL map.

gcp_pubsub_topic_cmek.description: For a complete Pub/Sub topic resource, checks whether it names a customer-managed Cloud KMS key. An omitted kmsKeyName indicates Pub/Sub's default Google-managed encryption and fails a CMEK requirement.
gcp_pubsub_topic_cmek.fail_when: The complete topic omits kmsKeyName or sets it empty.
gcp_pubsub_topic_cmek.pass_when: The complete topic names a nonempty Cloud KMS key in kmsKeyName.

gcp_resource_approved_location.description: Checks Cloud asset name, assetType, location and approved_locations. Asset location is outside the approved list. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
gcp_resource_approved_location.fail_when: Asset location is outside the approved list.
evaluated: Cloud asset name, assetType, location and approved_locations
gcp_resource_approved_location.pass_when: Asset location is in the approved list.

gcp_resource_label_inventory.description: Checks Cloud asset labels and required_label_keys policy. At least one required label is absent or empty. gcp_resource_label_inventory.fail_when: At least one required label is absent or empty.
evaluated: Cloud asset labels and required_label_keys policy
gcp_resource_label_inventory.pass_when: Every required label key has a nonempty string value.

gcp_source_repo_access_restricted.description: Complete repository IAM bindings are checked for reader, writer and admin grants against the approved developer list. gcp_source_repo_access_restricted.fail_when: A repository read/write/admin role grants public or unapproved access.
gcp_source_repo_access_restricted.pass_when: All repository access principals are approved and nonpublic.

gcp_sql_instance_sql_instance_does_have_.description: Checks Cloud SQL engine and complete settings.databaseFlags name/value list. The flag is absent from the complete list or explicitly off. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
gcp_sql_instance_sql_instance_does_have_.fail_when: The flag is absent from the complete list or explicitly off.
evaluated: Cloud SQL engine and complete settings.databaseFlags name/value list
gcp_sql_instance_sql_instance_does_have_.pass_when: The engine-specific IAM authentication flag is on.

gcp_sql_trace3625_off.description: Evaluates the signed historical SQL Server off expectation for flag 3625, accepting native names 3625 and 3625 (trace flag). Explicit on fails and explicit off passes. Missing effective/default evidence, conflicting alias entries or malformed flags return UNKNOWN; PostgreSQL and MySQL are not applicable. This does not endorse disabling error-message masking: current security guidance recommends on and the signed expectation needs owner review.
evaluated: SQL Server engine and settings.databaseFlags name/value list
gcp_sql_trace3625_off.not_applicable_when: The engine is PostgreSQL or MySQL.

gcp_vpc_peering_allowlist.description: Checks Complete network peerings network/state and approved_peer_networks. An ACTIVE peering target is outside the allowlist. Incomplete, denied, malformed, unrecognized, foreign-scope, missing required input or unresolved join evidence returns UNKNOWN. This checks declared snapshot facts only.
gcp_vpc_peering_allowlist.fail_when: An ACTIVE peering target is outside the allowlist.
evaluated: Complete network peerings network/state and approved_peer_networks
gcp_vpc_peering_allowlist.pass_when: Every ACTIVE peering target is approved.

gcp_workbench_approved_image.description: Compares one declared Workbench v2 VM or container image with the project-bound allowlist. VM identities use vm:<project>/family/<family> or vm:<project>/name/<name>; container identities use container:<repository>/<tag>. Conflicting unions, v1 imageFamily/imageName fields, digest-only container metadata, missing explicit tag, and incomplete or foreign inventories return UNKNOWN. Family approval is a declaration and does not prove an immutable image or runtime content.
gcp_workbench_approved_image.fail_when: The one valid declared image identity is outside the explicit allowlist, including an empty allowlist.

gcp_workbench_approved_vpc.description: Compares all reported Workbench interface networks with the project-bound approved network list. Missing network metadata or policy returns UNKNOWN.

gcp_workbench_download_disabled.description: Checks the declared download-disable metadata only for policy-classified sensitive Workbench instances. Missing classification, flag, or policy returns UNKNOWN.
gcp_workbench_download_disabled.fail_when: A sensitive instance explicitly sets notebook-disable-downloads to false.

gcp_workbench_no_public_ip.description: Checks the declared public-IP disable flag only for policy-classified sensitive Workbench instances. gcp_workbench_root_disabled.description: Checks the declared root-disable flag against sensitivity and explicit nonsensitive exception decisions. k8s.cis.avoid_use_of_system_masters_grou.description: Detects RBAC bindings with a Group subject named system:masters; this group bypasses ordinary authorization controls. This is a declaration-level signal; runtime enforcement and operational outcomes require separate evidence.
k8s.cis.avoid_use_of_system_masters_grou.fail_when: A collected RBAC binding has a Group subject named system:masters.
k8s.cis.avoid_use_of_system_masters_grou.pass_when: No global PASS is emitted; the absence of observed system:masters bindings is UNKNOWN because certificate and provider group memberships are unobserved.

k8s.cis.configure_image_provenance_using.description: Detects API servers without an enabled ImagePolicyWebhook and admission configuration; unverified images could be admitted. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: k8s.cis.configure_image_provenance_using_imagepolicywebhook_admission_controller.
k8s.cis.configure_image_provenance_using.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each kube-apiserver Pod, _component_config.flags.enable-admission-plugins contains ImagePolicyWebhook, _component_config.flags.disable-admission-plugins excludes it, and _component_config.flags.admission-control-config-file is a nonempty path; UNKNOWN until the admission file content is verified.
evaluated: Collected pod._component_config.flags.enable-admission-plugins/disable-admission-plugins; proposed safe projection of admission-control-config-file from GET /api/v1/pods and operator-supplied read-only admission file metadata.
k8s.cis.configure_image_provenance_using.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each kube-apiserver Pod, _component_config.flags.enable-admission-plugins contains ImagePolicyWebhook, _component_config.flags.disable-admission-plugins excludes it, and _component_config.flags.admission-control-config-file is a nonempty path; UNKNOWN until the admission file content is verified.

k8s.cis.consider_external_secret_storage.description: Identifies Pods using CSI secret-store volumes or Kubernetes Secret references; local Secret storage can expand credential exposure. Evaluates collected declarations only; runtime behavior is not proved. Missing required facts, malformed observed facts, incomplete inventories, mismatched scope/provider/cluster identity and unavailable coverage return UNKNOWN before provider-managed handling. Documented omission defaults are used only with full native read-only LIST provenance. The shared registry wrapper changes FAIL or UNKNOWN on positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources to NOT_APPLICABLE, preserving the underlying result.
k8s.cis.consider_external_secret_storage.fail_when: A Pod with a native Secret reference declares no secrets-store.csi.k8s.io CSI volume.
evaluated: complete pod inventories; matching collection and wrapper scope/type; context.provider=k8s and nonempty context.metadata.cluster_id; native provenance.cluster_id when present
typed, nonempty observed Secret reference names and CSI driver; valueFrom/Secret/CSI coverage honored; only regular-container reference paths in the signed spec
k8s.cis.consider_external_secret_storage.not_applicable_when: The complete PodSpec declares no native Secret reference. Shared registry handling also marks positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources NOT_APPLICABLE when the underlying result is FAIL or UNKNOWN.
k8s.cis.consider_external_secret_storage.pass_when: A Pod with a native Secret reference also declares at least one secrets-store.csi.k8s.io CSI volume.

k8s.cis.controller_manager_rotate_kubele.description: Detects controller-manager Pods without RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true; kubelet serving certificates may not rotate. Evaluates collected declarations only; runtime behavior is not proved. Missing required facts, malformed observed facts, incomplete inventories, mismatched scope/provider/cluster identity and unavailable coverage return UNKNOWN before provider-managed handling. Documented omission defaults are used only with full native read-only LIST provenance. The shared registry wrapper changes FAIL or UNKNOWN on positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources to NOT_APPLICABLE, preserving the underlying result. This observes the controller-manager flag only; kubelet serverTLSBootstrap, CSR approval, issued serving certificates and runtime rotation need separate evidence.
k8s.cis.controller_manager_rotate_kubele.fail_when: The unique declaration explicitly sets RotateKubeletServerCertificate=false.
evaluated: complete pod inventories; matching collection and wrapper scope/type; context.provider=k8s and nonempty context.metadata.cluster_id; native provenance.cluster_id when present
k8s.cis.controller_manager_rotate_kubele.not_applicable_when: The Pod has a complete component projection and is not kube-controller-manager. Shared registry handling also marks positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources NOT_APPLICABLE when the underlying result is FAIL or UNKNOWN.
k8s.cis.controller_manager_rotate_kubele.pass_when: The unique explicit kube-controller-manager Pod declaration sets RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true.

k8s.cis.cronjob_effective_runtime_defaul.description: Examines each regular and init container in a collected cronjob PodSpec, using a container seccomp profile before the Pod-level profile. This is declaration evidence for Linux; runtime enforcement is outside this check.
k8s.cis.cronjob_effective_runtime_defaul.fail_when: A regular or init container has an explicit effective Localhost or Unconfined profile on Linux; an absent profile stays UNKNOWN because kubelet seccompDefault may apply.
k8s.cis.cronjob_effective_runtime_defaul.not_applicable_when: An explicitly Windows Pod is outside Linux seccomp applicability.
k8s.cis.cronjob_effective_runtime_defaul.pass_when: Each assessed Linux regular and init container resolves to RuntimeDefault.

k8s.cis.job_effective_runtime_default_se.description: Examines each regular and init container in a collected job PodSpec, using a container seccomp profile before the Pod-level profile. This is declaration evidence for Linux; runtime enforcement is outside this check.
k8s.cis.job_effective_runtime_default_se.fail_when: A regular or init container has an explicit effective Localhost or Unconfined profile on Linux; an absent profile stays UNKNOWN because kubelet seccompDefault may apply.
k8s.cis.job_effective_runtime_default_se.not_applicable_when: An explicitly Windows Pod is outside Linux seccomp applicability.
k8s.cis.job_effective_runtime_default_se.pass_when: Each assessed Linux regular and init container resolves to RuntimeDefault.

k8s.cis.kubelet_rotate_kubelet_server_ce.description: Checks one operator-supplied kubelet configuration declaration for an explicit RotateKubeletServerCertificate feature gate. A true value is a declaration only; serverTLSBootstrap, CSR approval, issued serving certificates, runtime enforcement and all-node coverage require separate evidence.
k8s.cis.kubelet_rotate_kubelet_server_ce.fail_when: A supported observed kubelet declaration explicitly sets RotateKubeletServerCertificate=false.
evaluated: cluster-bound operator-supplied component_configuration with exact kubelet/node identity
k8s.cis.kubelet_rotate_kubelet_server_ce.not_applicable_when: The observed component is not kubelet or the reviewed version predates the gate.
k8s.cis.kubelet_rotate_kubelet_server_ce.pass_when: A supported observed kubelet declaration explicitly sets RotateKubeletServerCertificate=true.

k8s.cis.namespace_has_networkpolicy.description: Evaluates each collected Kubernetes namespace against a complete same-cluster NetworkPolicy inventory and an explicit cluster-bound operator declaration of system namespaces. A stored policy proves declaration presence only; CNI enforcement, default deny, Pod coverage, and reachability remain unverified.
k8s.cis.namespace_has_networkpolicy.fail_when: A nonexempt namespace has zero NetworkPolicy objects in an authoritative complete same-cluster inventory.
k8s.cis.namespace_has_networkpolicy.not_applicable_when: The namespace is named in the explicit cluster-bound system_namespaces operator declaration.
k8s.cis.namespace_has_networkpolicy.pass_when: A nonexempt namespace has at least one NetworkPolicy object declared in its own namespace in a complete same-cluster inventory.

k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_e.description: Examines a namespace-wide NetworkPolicy declaration for egress allow rules with omitted or empty peer lists; it does not assess ports, other policies or CNI enforcement.
k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_e.fail_when: An applicable namespace-wide egress rule has an omitted or empty peer list.
k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_e.not_applicable_when: The policy does not select all Pods or does not affect egress.
k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_e.pass_when: The observed policy has an explicit empty podSelector, explicit Egress policyType, complete egress rules and no rule with omitted or empty peers.

k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_i.description: Examines a namespace-wide NetworkPolicy declaration for ingress allow rules with omitted or empty peer lists; it does not assess ports, other policies or CNI enforcement.
k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_i.fail_when: An applicable namespace-wide ingress rule has an omitted or empty peer list.
k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_i.not_applicable_when: The policy does not select all Pods or does not affect ingress.
k8s.cis.networkpolicy_no_default_allow_i.pass_when: The observed policy has an explicit empty podSelector, explicit Ingress policyType, complete ingress rules and no rule with omitted or empty peers.

k8s.cis.psp_binding_enforced.description: On Kubernetes versions before 1.25, joins complete PSP and RBAC inventories by effective namespace and checks that each ServiceAccount subject with Pod create authorization also has use authorization for an observed PSP. Missing joins or inventories stay UNKNOWN.

evaluated: complete podsecuritypolicy, role, clusterrole, rolebinding and clusterrolebinding inventories
RBAC roleRef, subjects, rules and PSP resourceNames

k8s.cis.psp_binding_enforced.pass_when: Every ServiceAccount subject with Pod create permission in each effective namespace has use permission on at least one observed PSP.

k8s.cis.the_eventrecordqps_argument_is_s.description: Detects kubelets with eventRecordQPS below the approved capture rate; throttling can hide security events. Evaluates collected declarations only; runtime behavior is not proved. Missing required facts, malformed observed facts, incomplete inventories, mismatched scope/provider/cluster identity and unavailable coverage return UNKNOWN before provider-managed handling. Documented omission defaults are used only with full native read-only LIST provenance. The shared registry wrapper changes FAIL or UNKNOWN on positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources to NOT_APPLICABLE, preserving the underlying result. The signed predicate compares the numeric QPS value literally, including zero; it does not infer the special runtime meaning of zero.
k8s.cis.the_eventrecordqps_argument_is_s.fail_when: The kubelet declaration has integer eventRecordQPS below the approved threshold.
evaluated: complete component_configuration inventories; matching collection and wrapper scope/type; context.provider=k8s and nonempty context.metadata.cluster_id; native provenance.cluster_id when present
context.metadata.component_configuration_coverage has attested_complete status, matching cluster_id, positive integer node_count/max_age_seconds, and UTC observed_at fresh against context.created_at
eventRecordQPS is a nonnegative signed int32; approved_min_event_qps is a nonnegative signed int64
k8s.cis.the_eventrecordqps_argument_is_s.not_applicable_when: The component_configuration is not a kubelet declaration. Shared registry handling also marks positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources NOT_APPLICABLE when the underlying result is FAIL or UNKNOWN.

Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: k8s_networkpolicy_network_policy_associated_podselectors_that_92dbc93b4c.
k8s_networkpolicy_network_policy_associa.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each networkpolicy, spec.podSelector.matchLabels or spec.podSelector.matchExpressions is nonempty; UNKNOWN on incomplete inventory.
k8s_networkpolicy_network_policy_associa.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each networkpolicy, spec.podSelector.matchLabels or spec.podSelector.matchExpressions is nonempty; UNKNOWN on incomplete inventory.

k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ingress.description: Examines a collected NetworkPolicy ingress allow rule for an omitted/empty source list or unexcepted IPv4/IPv6 /0 ipBlock. An empty peer is invalid in the Kubernetes API and stays UNKNOWN pending signed proposal correction; this is not CNI or connection evidence.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ingress.fail_when: At least one observed ingress allow rule declares all sources through an omitted/empty from list or an unexcepted IPv4/IPv6 /0 ipBlock.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ingress.not_applicable_when: The observed policy explicitly selects Egress but not Ingress.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ingress.pass_when: No observed ingress rule has an omitted/empty source list or unexcepted IPv4/IPv6 /0 ipBlock, and no malformed peer leaves the result unresolved.

k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ssh_rdp.description: Examines one collected NetworkPolicy ingress allow rule for all-source TCP 22 or 3389, including documented omitted source/port defaults and numeric endPort ranges. This does not prove a listener or reachability.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ssh_rdp.fail_when: An observed ingress allow rule pairs an omitted/empty source list or unexcepted /0 ipBlock with TCP port 22 or 3389, a containing numeric endPort range, or an omitted/empty all-ports list.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ssh_rdp.not_applicable_when: The observed policy explicitly selects Egress but not Ingress.
k8s_networkpolicy_no_world_ssh_rdp.pass_when: No observed ingress rule pairs an omitted/empty source list or unexcepted /0 ipBlock with TCP 22/3389 or an all-port default, and no relevant named or malformed port/peer leaves the result unresolved.

k8s_networkpolicy_world_ingress_authoriz.description: Checks ingress rules admitting all sources against a mandatory approved protocol and port list. Missing allowlist, incomplete inventory, ambiguous IP blocks and malformed ports stay UNKNOWN.
k8s_networkpolicy_world_ingress_authoriz.fail_when: An all-source ingress rule omits ports or declares an unapproved protocol/port.
k8s_networkpolicy_world_ingress_authoriz.pass_when: Each all-source ingress rule has a nonempty ports list containing only approved protocol/port pairs, or no all-source rule exists.

k8s_node_nodes_publicly_accessible_rule_.description: Classifies collected Node ExternalIP addresses for global routability; the address status does not prove inbound internet reachability.
k8s_node_nodes_publicly_accessible_rule_.fail_when: An observed ExternalIP is globally routable.
k8s_node_nodes_publicly_accessible_rule_.not_applicable_when: No node-level exemption; missing status is UNKNOWN.
k8s_node_nodes_publicly_accessible_rule_.pass_when: No observed ExternalIP is globally routable.

k8s_persistentvolume_persistentvolumecla.description: Resolves RBAC bindings and PVC verbs to detect ServiceAccounts granted PVC access across namespaces outside the approved control set. Missing role joins, namespace coverage or owner policy stays UNKNOWN.
k8s_persistentvolume_persistentvolumecla.fail_when: An effective binding grants a ServiceAccount a PVC verb in another namespace outside approved_control_namespaces.
evaluated: complete role, clusterrole, rolebinding, clusterrolebinding and namespace inventories
RBAC roleRef, ServiceAccount subjects, rules apiGroups/resources/verbs
k8s_persistentvolume_persistentvolumecla.pass_when: No effective binding grants a ServiceAccount PVC verbs in a different, non-control namespace.

k8s_pod_direct_internet_access_disabled_.description: Classifies assigned Pod IP status for global routability; this is an address signal and does not prove any route or access path.
k8s_pod_direct_internet_access_disabled_.fail_when: An observed assigned Pod IP is globally routable.
k8s_pod_direct_internet_access_disabled_.not_applicable_when: No Pod-level exemption; no assigned or collected IP is UNKNOWN.
k8s_pod_direct_internet_access_disabled_.pass_when: Every observed assigned Pod IP is not globally routable.

k8s_pod_effective_run_as_user_nonzero.description: Checks declared runAsUser values for regular and init containers in an explicitly Linux Pod. A missing value leaves image USER and runtime identity unknown.
k8s_pod_effective_run_as_user_nonzero.fail_when: At least one container resolves an explicit runAsUser of zero.
k8s_pod_effective_run_as_user_nonzero.not_applicable_when: An explicitly Windows Pod; missing OS or UID is UNKNOWN.
k8s_pod_effective_run_as_user_nonzero.pass_when: Every regular and init container resolves a positive integer runAsUser from its own or the Pod securityContext.

k8s_pod_pod_deployed_specific_namespace_.description: Detects Pods outside approved namespaces or scheduled on nodes without approved pool labels; misplaced workloads can cross isolation boundaries. Evaluates collected declarations only; runtime behavior is not proved. Missing required facts, malformed observed facts, incomplete inventories, mismatched scope/provider/cluster identity and unavailable coverage return UNKNOWN before provider-managed handling. Documented omission defaults are used only with full native read-only LIST provenance. The shared registry wrapper changes FAIL or UNKNOWN on positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources to NOT_APPLICABLE, preserving the underlying result.
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_specific_namespace_.fail_when: The Pod namespace is outside the approved set or its bound Node has a mismatching pool label.
evaluated: complete pod, node inventories; matching collection and wrapper scope/type; context.provider=k8s and nonempty context.metadata.cluster_id; native provenance.cluster_id when present
omitted nodeSelector or labels maps mean empty only on their full native resource; observed label key/value syntax is validated
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_specific_namespace_.not_applicable_when: Shared registry handling also marks positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources NOT_APPLICABLE when the underlying result is FAIL or UNKNOWN.
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_specific_namespace_.pass_when: The Pod namespace is approved and its unique bound Node satisfies the approved pool labels.

k8s_pod_pod_deployed_within_specific_nam.description: Detects Pods in namespaces outside the approved set; workload placement may violate isolation policy. This is a declaration-level signal; runtime enforcement and operational outcomes require separate evidence. Namespace membership alone does not prove tenant isolation.
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_within_specific_nam.fail_when: This Pod is in a namespace outside the explicit approved set.
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_within_specific_nam.pass_when: This Pod's namespace belongs to the explicit approved set.

omitted nodeSelector or labels maps mean empty only on their full native resource; observed label key/value syntax is validated
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_within_specific_nam.not_applicable_when: Shared registry handling also marks positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources NOT_APPLICABLE when the underlying result is FAIL or UNKNOWN.
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_within_specific_nam.pass_when: The Pod namespace is approved and its nodeSelector contains every approved selector pair.

k8s_pod_pod_deployed_within_specific_nam.fail_when: The Pod namespace is outside the approved set or a required label mismatches.
evaluated: complete pod inventories; matching collection and wrapper scope/type; context.provider=k8s and nonempty context.metadata.cluster_id; native provenance.cluster_id when present
omitted nodeSelector or labels maps mean empty only on their full native resource; observed label key/value syntax is validated
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_within_specific_nam.not_applicable_when: Shared registry handling also marks positively identified provider/control-plane-managed resources NOT_APPLICABLE when the underlying result is FAIL or UNKNOWN.
k8s_pod_pod_deployed_within_specific_nam.pass_when: The Pod namespace is approved and its labels contain every approved selector pair.

k8s_pod_pod_running_within_specific_name.fail_when: The Pod has a recognized non-Running phase, unapproved namespace or mismatching label.
evaluated: complete pod inventories; matching collection and wrapper scope/type; context.provider=k8s and nonempty context.metadata.cluster_id; native provenance.cluster_id when present

k8s_pod_secret_pod_rule_non_compliant_fc.description: Detects Pods without an imagePullSecrets reference; private registry pulls may fail or use unintended credentials. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: k8s_pod_secret_pod_rule_non_compliant_fcdc38e543.
k8s_pod_secret_pod_rule_non_compliant_fc.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each pod, spec.imagePullSecrets contains at least one entry with a nonempty name; UNKNOWN if PodSpec is incomplete.
k8s_pod_secret_pod_rule_non_compliant_fc.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each pod, spec.imagePullSecrets contains at least one entry with a nonempty name; UNKNOWN if PodSpec is incomplete.

k8s_pod_serviceaccount_has_rbac_binding.description: Detects Pod ServiceAccounts that do not appear in a RoleBinding or ClusterRoleBinding; expected workload permissions may be missing. Evaluates collected declarations only; runtime behavior is not proved. Missing required facts, malformed observed facts, incomplete inventories, mismatched scope/provider/cluster identity and unavailable coverage return UNKNOWN before provider-managed handling. k8s_pod_serviceaccount_has_rbac_binding.fail_when: No matching subject is present in complete RBAC binding inventories.
evaluated: complete pod, rolebinding, clusterrolebinding inventories; matching collection and wrapper scope/type; context.provider=k8s and nonempty context.metadata.cluster_id; native provenance.cluster_id when present
pod.metadata.namespace and spec.serviceAccountName, default only on full native LIST

native omitted/empty Pod serviceAccountName defaults to default; native omitted RoleBinding ServiceAccount subject namespace defaults to binding namespace; ClusterRoleBinding ServiceAccount namespace is required; valid nonempty subject kind/name

k8s_pod_serviceaccount_has_rbac_binding.pass_when: An observed RoleBinding or ClusterRoleBinding names the Pod ServiceAccount subject in its namespace.

k8s_privileged_utility_access.description: Checks effective RBAC bindings for unauthorized exec and ephemeral-container grants and owner-designated privileged utility Pods for unauthorized namespaces. Missing role joins, utility identity declaration or authorization lists stay UNKNOWN.
k8s_privileged_utility_access.fail_when: An unauthorized subject receives pods/exec:create or pods/ephemeralcontainers:update, or a designated privileged utility Pod is outside approved namespaces.
evaluated: complete role, clusterrole, rolebinding, clusterrolebinding and pod inventories
Pod namespace, name and container securityContext.privileged
k8s_privileged_utility_access.pass_when: No unauthorized subject receives the specified RBAC grants and each designated privileged utility Pod is in an approved namespace.

k8s_response_team_required_binding.description: Detects absence of the specified response team RBAC binding; responders may lack the permissions needed for incident action. This is a declaration-level signal; runtime enforcement and operational outcomes require separate evidence. A required ServiceAccount namespace cannot be selected by the existing owner policy, so that subject kind is UNKNOWN.
k8s_response_team_required_binding.fail_when: Complete RBAC inventories lack the exact owner-required User or Group subject and role binding in every allowed namespace.
evaluated: current cluster-bound required subject and role policy
k8s_response_team_required_binding.pass_when: A valid declared User or Group subject and role binding exists in an allowed namespace; effective access is unverified.

k8s_secret_no_deletion_timestamp.description: Uses only metadata-only Secret LIST facts to identify a server-recorded deletion request; it never reads Secret values or claims dependent workload failure.
k8s_secret_no_deletion_timestamp.fail_when: A valid timezone-aware deletionTimestamp is present.
k8s_secret_no_deletion_timestamp.not_applicable_when: No per-Secret exemption; missing or denied metadata is UNKNOWN.
k8s_secret_no_deletion_timestamp.pass_when: The observed Secret metadata has a null or omitted deletionTimestamp.

k8s_service_external_traffic_policy_matc.description: Detects selected LoadBalancer Services whose externalTrafficPolicy differs from the required value; traffic routing may bypass the expected source IP or node behavior. Complete scoped evidence is required; unavailable native projections or omitted operator inputs remain UNKNOWN. Signed check: k8s_service_external_traffic_policy_matches_required.
k8s_service_external_traffic_policy_matc.fail_when: Complete evidence conclusively violates the signed predicate: For each service whose metadata.name belongs to in_scope_service_names and spec.type="LoadBalancer", spec.externalTrafficPolicy=required_external_traffic_policy; UNKNOWN without policy inputs or complete inventory.
evaluated: Collected service.metadata.name/namespace, spec.type, spec.externalTrafficPolicy; mandatory in_scope_service_names and required_external_traffic_policy.
k8s_service_external_traffic_policy_matc.pass_when: Complete evidence satisfies the signed predicate: For each service whose metadata.name belongs to in_scope_service_names and spec.type="LoadBalancer", spec.externalTrafficPolicy=required_external_traffic_policy; UNKNOWN without policy inputs or complete inventory.

k8s_service_loadbalancers_associated_aut.description: For a LoadBalancer Service declaration, compares its Namespace with an owner-approved namespace set. No listener reachability is inferred. The owner policy must be bound to the captured cluster and current when expiry metadata is supplied.
k8s_service_loadbalancers_associated_aut.fail_when: LoadBalancer Service is outside the owner-authorized namespace set.
k8s_service_loadbalancers_associated_aut.not_applicable_when: Non-LoadBalancer Services; missing policy or type is UNKNOWN.
k8s_service_loadbalancers_associated_aut.pass_when: LoadBalancer Service is in the owner-authorized namespace set.

k8s_service_service_uses_ftp_endpoint_co.description: Checks whether a collected ClusterIP Service declares conventional FTP port TCP/21; it does not identify the application protocol or probe the endpoint.
k8s_service_service_uses_ftp_endpoint_co.fail_when: A ClusterIP Service explicitly declares TCP port 21.
k8s_service_service_uses_ftp_endpoint_co.not_applicable_when: The Service type is a recognized type other than ClusterIP.
k8s_service_service_uses_ftp_endpoint_co.pass_when: A ClusterIP Service has no TCP port 21 entry.

k8s_service_services_type_specified_rule.description: Compares each collected Service type to an explicitly supplied owner-required Service type. This does not prove endpoint availability. The owner policy must be bound to the captured cluster and current when expiry metadata is supplied.
k8s_service_services_type_specified_rule.fail_when: Observed Service type differs from the owner-required type.
k8s_service_services_type_specified_rule.not_applicable_when: No universal exemption; missing/conflicting policy or type is UNKNOWN.
k8s_service_services_type_specified_rule.pass_when: Observed Service type equals the owner-required type.

k8s_service_spec_type_loadbalancer.description: At assessed scope, compares every exact owner-selected Namespace/name/UID Service with complete Service inventory. A definite observed wrong type fails even if another selected Service is missing or recreated; otherwise unresolved identities stay UNKNOWN. External reachability is untested. The owner policy must be bound to the captured cluster and current when expiry metadata is supplied.
k8s_service_spec_type_loadbalancer.fail_when: At least one observed selected Namespace/name/UID Service declares another supported type.
k8s_service_spec_type_loadbalancer.not_applicable_when: No automatic exemption: missing or changed selected identity, incomplete Service inventory, or selected Services outside a restricted scan are UNKNOWN unless another selected Service has a definite observed wrong type.
k8s_service_spec_type_loadbalancer.pass_when: Every owner-selected Service identity is observed with matching UID and LoadBalancer type across the complete assessed scope.

k8s.iam.serviceaccount_has_declared_cons.description: Identifies ServiceAccounts without a captured workload, RBAC, legacy-token or workload-identity association. Complete controller and identity inventories are required; external client authentication is not inferred.
k8s.iam.serviceaccount_has_declared_cons.fail_when: Complete inventories contain no recorded consumer for the ServiceAccount.
evaluated: RBAC ServiceAccount and universal group subjects
legacy-token UID association and cloud workload-identity annotations
k8s.iam.serviceaccount_has_declared_cons.not_applicable_when: Provider-managed objects follow the existing managed-object policy; ordinary assessed objects with missing evidence remain UNKNOWN.
k8s.iam.serviceaccount_has_declared_cons.pass_when: At least one captured declaration consumes or grants this identity.

k8s.iam.role_has_declared_consumers.description: Identifies namespaced Roles without a nonempty RoleBinding that references their exact name and namespace. This identifies leftover permission definitions, not measured authentication inactivity.
k8s.iam.role_has_declared_consumers.fail_when: No valid nonempty RoleBinding references this namespaced Role.
evaluated: roleRef API group, kind and name
k8s.iam.role_has_declared_consumers.not_applicable_when: Provider-managed objects follow the existing managed-object policy; ordinary assessed objects with missing evidence remain UNKNOWN.
k8s.iam.role_has_declared_consumers.pass_when: A nonempty valid RoleBinding in the same namespace references this Role.

k8s.iam.clusterrole_has_declared_consume.description: Identifies ClusterRoles without a nonempty RoleBinding, ClusterRoleBinding or aggregation selector consumer. Complete cluster-wide inventories and valid selector expressions are required; aggregated roles are retained.
k8s.iam.clusterrole_has_declared_consume.fail_when: Complete cluster-wide inventory has no binding or aggregation consumer for this ClusterRole.
evaluated: valid nonempty RoleBinding and ClusterRoleBinding roleRef
k8s.iam.clusterrole_has_declared_consume.not_applicable_when: Provider-managed objects follow the existing managed-object policy; ordinary assessed objects with missing evidence remain UNKNOWN.
k8s.iam.clusterrole_has_declared_consume.pass_when: A declared binding or another ClusterRole aggregation selector consumes this ClusterRole.

k8s.iam.rolebinding_subjects_exist.description: Identifies RoleBindings with no subjects or references to ServiceAccounts absent from a complete captured namespace inventory. External User and Group existence requires separate identity-provider evidence and remains unresolved.
k8s.iam.rolebinding_subjects_exist.fail_when: The binding has no subjects or a ServiceAccount subject is absent from a complete applicable inventory.
evaluated: exact subject namespace and ServiceAccount names
complete ServiceAccount inventory in the assessed scope
k8s.iam.rolebinding_subjects_exist.not_applicable_when: Provider-managed objects follow the existing managed-object policy; ordinary assessed objects with missing evidence remain UNKNOWN.
k8s.iam.rolebinding_subjects_exist.pass_when: All declared subjects are ServiceAccounts present in the complete scoped inventory.

k8s.iam.clusterrolebinding_subjects_exis.description: Identifies ClusterRoleBindings without subjects or with references to absent ServiceAccounts. Explicit ServiceAccount namespaces and complete cluster-wide inventory are required; external directory users and groups are not guessed.
k8s.iam.clusterrolebinding_subjects_exis.fail_when: The binding has no subjects or a ServiceAccount subject is absent from complete cluster inventory.
evaluated: subject API group, kind, name and explicit namespace
k8s.iam.clusterrolebinding_subjects_exis.not_applicable_when: Provider-managed objects follow the existing managed-object policy; ordinary assessed objects with missing evidence remain UNKNOWN.
k8s.iam.clusterrolebinding_subjects_exis.pass_when: All declared ServiceAccount subjects exist in the complete captured cluster inventory.

k8s.iam.legacy_serviceaccount_token_rece.description: Identifies automatically generated legacy ServiceAccount tokens whose recorded last-used day is more than 90 days before capture. Requires matching ServiceAccount UID and reciprocal Secret reference; Secret contents are never read.
k8s.iam.legacy_serviceaccount_token_rece.fail_when: The matching automatically generated legacy token has a recorded last-use day older than 90 days with sufficient native evidence.
evaluated: metadata-only Secret type, UID, creation time and last-used calendar date
matching ServiceAccount name, namespace and UID
k8s.iam.legacy_serviceaccount_token_rece.not_applicable_when: Provider-managed objects follow the existing managed-object policy; ordinary assessed objects with missing evidence remain UNKNOWN.
k8s.iam.legacy_serviceaccount_token_rece.pass_when: The tracked legacy token was used within 90 days or was created within that interval.

azure.iam.static_group_has_members.description: Identifies static directory groups without direct members after a complete Graph beta membership read. The beta confirmation avoids the documented v1.0 service-principal membership omission. Dynamic, hidden, denied or incomplete empty memberships remain unresolved.
azure.iam.static_group_has_members.fail_when: A static non-hidden group has a complete empty beta membership list.
evaluated: current tenant and capture-bound group metadata
complete beta group member IDs for candidate empty static groups
explicit dynamic and hidden membership treatment
azure.iam.static_group_has_members.not_applicable_when: Disabled service principals or objects with no active password or certificate credentials, where applicable; absent usage evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
azure.iam.static_group_has_members.pass_when: A current direct member is observed, including a member retained in an incomplete read.

azure.iam.service_principal_recent_activ.description: Reviews the latest tenant report activity for a current enabled service principal, including managed identities when the report supplies them. Requires the object creation date to reject predecessor activity. Recent attempts without successful-use evidence remain unresolved; report absence is never proof of inactivity.
azure.iam.service_principal_recent_activ.fail_when: The current principal has a valid last recorded activity date more than 90 days old, without a contradictory newer flow.
evaluated: current service principal object ID, app ID, enabled state and creation date
Graph servicePrincipalSignInActivities last aggregate activity and flow dates
successful-use timestamps when supplied by the native report
90-day interval measured from the captured observation
azure.iam.service_principal_recent_activ.not_applicable_when: Disabled service principals or objects with no active password or certificate credentials, where applicable; absent usage evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
azure.iam.service_principal_recent_activ.pass_when: A current successful-use timestamp is within 90 days, or the principal was created within that interval.

azure.iam.application_credentials_recent.description: Reviews password and certificate metadata on application registrations against exact tenant activity records. Origin, app ID, application object ID, key ID, credential type and available lifetime metadata must match. Missing reports or recent attempts without successful-use evidence remain unresolved; no credential value is requested.
azure.iam.application_credentials_recent.fail_when: At least one current unexpired application credential has matching recorded activity older than 90 days; unrelated unresolved credentials do not hide it.
evaluated: current application passwordCredentials and keyCredentials metadata
Graph appCredentialSignInActivities application origin and appObjectId
exact keyId, keyType, creation and expiry association
last recorded activity and successful-use timestamps when available
azure.iam.application_credentials_recent.not_applicable_when: Disabled service principals or objects with no active password or certificate credentials, where applicable; absent usage evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
azure.iam.application_credentials_recent.pass_when: Every active credential has recent successful use or was created within 90 days, with no unresolved credential evidence.

azure.iam.service_principal_credentials_.description: Reviews service-principal password and certificate metadata against exact native activity records. Service-principal-origin credentials are kept distinct from application-origin credentials even when an app ID is shared. Expired credentials are identified separately and never described as active unused access.
azure.iam.service_principal_credentials_.fail_when: At least one current unexpired service-principal credential has matching recorded activity older than 90 days.
evaluated: current service principal passwordCredentials and keyCredentials metadata
Graph appCredentialSignInActivities servicePrincipal origin and servicePrincipalObjectId
exact appId, keyId, keyType and credential lifetime
azure.iam.service_principal_credentials_.not_applicable_when: Disabled service principals or objects with no active password or certificate credentials, where applicable; absent usage evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
azure.iam.service_principal_credentials_.pass_when: Every active service-principal credential has recent successful use or was created within 90 days, with no unresolved evidence.

azure.iam.single_tenant_application_has_.description: Identifies single-tenant application registrations without a matching local enterprise application in a complete tenant inventory. Multi-tenant applications without a local consumer remain unresolved because other tenants may still use them. A local declaration does not establish recent authentication.
azure.iam.single_tenant_application_has_.fail_when: A single-tenant application has no matching service principal in a complete current tenant inventory.
evaluated: current application object ID, appId and signInAudience
exact appId association without display-name matching
azure.iam.single_tenant_application_has_.not_applicable_when: Disabled service principals or objects with no active password or certificate credentials, where applicable; absent usage evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
azure.iam.single_tenant_application_has_.pass_when: A current local service principal has the same app ID.

gcp.iam.service_account_no_active_unused.description: Reviews explicit ACTIVE SERVICE_ACCOUNT_USAGE insights from Google IAM Recommender. The current service account email and immutable numeric unique ID must both match, with at least 90 days of observation and a fresh insight. This captures provider-classified unused accounts even when no authentication timestamp exists; recent bound authentication contradicts an unused classification.
gcp.iam.service_account_no_active_unused.fail_when: A fresh ACTIVE unused-service-account insight names the current immutable service account identity with at least 90 days of observation and no contradictory bound recent authentication.
evaluated: current service account email, numeric unique ID and disabled state
ACTIVE SECURITY SERVICE_ACCOUNT_USAGE identity and target project
observationPeriod of at least 90 days and lastRefreshTime within three days
gcp.iam.service_account_no_active_unused.not_applicable_when: The service account is disabled; missing, denied or inconsistent insight evidence remains unresolved.
gcp.iam.service_account_no_active_unused.pass_when: A complete current insight inventory has no ACTIVE unused-usage insight matching the current service account identity.

gcp.iam.static_group_has_members.description: Identifies static Cloud Identity groups with a complete empty direct membership list. Each group retains its own paginated read authority, so unrelated directory or transitive-list failures do not erase a confirmed empty group. Dynamic or external identity-mapped groups remain unresolved.
gcp.iam.static_group_has_members.fail_when: A static Google directory group has a complete empty direct membership list.
evaluated: current complete Google directory group resource name and parent
per-group direct membership names, pagination completion and scope
exact successful Cloud Identity membership read requests
gcp.iam.static_group_has_members.pass_when: At least one bound direct membership is observed.

gcp.iam.role_grant_has_observed_permissi.description: Reviews ACTIVE Google PERMISSIONS_USAGE insights against currently captured IAM grants. The resource, principal, role and condition expression must match. A fresh insight covering at least 90 days and listing neither exercised nor inferred permissions identifies a grant with no provider-observed permission use; it is not a claim that every role permission can safely be removed.
gcp.iam.role_grant_has_observed_permissi.fail_when: The current matching grant has a fresh ACTIVE insight with at least 90 days of observation and no exercised or inferred permissions.
evaluated: exact native google.iam.policy.Insight request and identity
ACTIVE SECURITY PERMISSIONS_USAGE and 90-day observation duration
provider refresh within three days of capture
current resource IAM role, principal and condition expression
gcp.iam.role_grant_has_observed_permissi.not_applicable_when: A non-ACTIVE insight or another insight subtype is outside the permission-use predicate; missing or inconsistent evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
gcp.iam.role_grant_has_observed_permissi.pass_when: The current matching grant has at least one permission recorded as exercised in this insight.

gcp.iam.directory_user_recent_recorded_l.description: Reviews the latest recorded login on an individual enabled Google Directory user, using the immutable user ID rather than the potentially inaccurate users-list login field. The current project-to-organization-to-directory-customer chain, individual metadata request, user ID, email, creation time and account state must match. Missing, sentinel or contradictory dates remain unresolved.
gcp.iam.directory_user_recent_recorded_l.fail_when: The enabled individual Directory user has a valid last recorded login older than 90 days, within the current user lifetime.
evaluated: current Directory user ID, email, customer, suspended and archived state
independent CRM project and ancestor GET chain to directoryCustomerId
individual Directory users.get metadata projection and source request
creationTime and lastLoginTime with a 90-day recorded-login threshold
gcp.iam.directory_user_recent_recorded_l.not_applicable_when: Suspended or archived accounts are not active unused-account candidates.
gcp.iam.directory_user_recent_recorded_l.pass_when: The individual user has a recorded login within 90 days, or the user was created within that interval.

gcp.iam.workload_identity_pool_has_enabl.description: Identifies active federation-only workload identity pools without an enabled provider after complete current provider enumeration. Pool project identity, native IAM list authority, provider parent, ACTIVE/deleted state and disabled flags are checked. Trust-domain pools are excluded because they use managed workload identities and cannot have external federation providers. Provider presence is structural evidence, not token-use history.
gcp.iam.workload_identity_pool_has_enabl.fail_when: An active federation-only pool has no enabled provider in a complete current provider list.
evaluated: current selected-project workload pool name and exact project ID/number binding
unfiltered complete IAM pool and provider lists and source receipts
pool mode: federation-only versus managed workload trust domain
gcp.iam.workload_identity_pool_has_enabl.not_applicable_when: Disabled or deleted pools and managed-workload trust-domain pools are outside this external-provider predicate.
gcp.iam.workload_identity_pool_has_enabl.pass_when: At least one current ACTIVE provider is enabled for the pool.

gcp.iam.workforce_pool_has_enabled_provi.description: Identifies active workforce identity pools without an enabled provider after complete current provider enumeration. The workforce pool parent must match the selected organization, and IAM list receipts must retain that organization parent and exact provider-list path. This identifies a structurally obsolete federation namespace without asserting that any token or IAM permission has never been used.
gcp.iam.workforce_pool_has_enabled_provi.fail_when: An active workforce pool has no enabled provider in a complete current provider list.
evaluated: current workforce pool name and parent organization
exact complete provider enumeration and provider parent
gcp.iam.workforce_pool_has_enabled_provi.not_applicable_when: Disabled or deleted pools are not active federation candidates.
gcp.iam.workforce_pool_has_enabled_provi.pass_when: At least one current ACTIVE provider is enabled for the workforce pool.

gcp.iam.api_key_recent_recorded_successf.description: Reviews the latest recorded successful Service Runtime API requests identified by the current API key UID in its verified owner project. Current credential identity, active/deleted state, creation time, project bindings, exact native metric query, daily aggregation and observation interval must match. An old recorded successful interval with complete selected views fails as a cleanup-review candidate; it does not establish universal credential inactivity. Empty metrics, failed requests alone and incomplete observations remain unresolved. Recent positive use can survive another selected view failure.
gcp.iam.api_key_recent_recorded_successf.fail_when: Complete selected metric views contain an older successful request interval and no newer successful interval within 90 days; empty series alone cannot fail and this is a recorded-activity review signal.
evaluated: current credential metadata identifier, owning project, creation time and active/deleted state
verified project ID/number bindings and selected project views
exact native Cloud Monitoring request filter, interval and aggregation
matching metric/resource/credential/project labels and successful response class
nonnegative daily request counts and timestamp bounds
gcp.iam.api_key_recent_recorded_successf.not_applicable_when: The HMAC key is inactive/deleted or the API key has a valid past deletion time; unknown usage remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
gcp.iam.api_key_recent_recorded_successf.pass_when: A matching successful request interval lies within the 90-day review period, or the credential was created within that period.

gcp.iam.hmac_key_recent_recorded_success.description: Reviews the latest recorded successful Cloud Storage HMAC requests across every selected project, since HMAC metrics belong to the bucket project rather than necessarily the key owner. Current credential identity, active/deleted state, creation time, project bindings, exact native metric query, daily aggregation and observation interval must match. An old recorded successful interval with complete selected views fails as a cleanup-review candidate; it does not establish universal credential inactivity. Empty metrics, failed requests alone and incomplete observations remain unresolved. Recent positive use can survive another selected view failure.
gcp.iam.hmac_key_recent_recorded_success.fail_when: Complete selected metric views contain an older successful request interval and no newer successful interval within 90 days; empty series alone cannot fail and this is a recorded-activity review signal.
evaluated: current credential metadata identifier, owning project, creation time and active/deleted state
verified project ID/number bindings and selected project views
exact native Cloud Monitoring request filter, interval and aggregation
matching metric/resource/credential/project labels and successful response class
nonnegative daily request counts and timestamp bounds
gcp.iam.hmac_key_recent_recorded_success.not_applicable_when: The HMAC key is inactive/deleted or the API key has a valid past deletion time; unknown usage remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
gcp.iam.hmac_key_recent_recorded_success.pass_when: A matching successful request interval lies within the 90-day review period, or the credential was created within that period.

gcp.iam.custom_role_has_declared_grants.description: Reviews current custom-role definitions for declared consumers in the owning project or organization. The role metadata must be fully read, project-number aliases independently verified, and the exact role must have no principal-bearing grant in the complete direct root policy and unfiltered paginated Cloud Asset scoped IAM search before it can fail. Scope restrictions and Cloud Asset supported-resource coverage remain explicit. This is structural cleanup evidence, not authentication history or a safe-deletion assertion.
gcp.iam.custom_role_has_declared_grants.fail_when: A current non-deleted custom role has no principal-bearing grant in the complete owning-scope version-3 IAM policy and unfiltered complete Cloud Asset IAM search.
evaluated: current role name, owner scope, deletion state and full includedPermissions metadata
exact native IAM roles.list FULL or roles.get source receipt
complete current owning-scope IAM policy requested with conditional policy version 3
unfiltered, unprojected paginated Cloud Asset searchAllIamPolicies and exact binding role/principals
gcp.iam.custom_role_has_declared_grants.not_applicable_when: Google predefined roles, soft-deleted definitions, or roles referenced outside their owning scope; unproven project aliases remain UNKNOWN or DENIED.
gcp.iam.custom_role_has_declared_grants.pass_when: A successful captured scoped IAM policy contains the current role with at least one declared principal; conditional grants remain declared consumers.

aws.iam.group_inline_policies_have_membe.description: Reviews inline policies embedded in current IAM groups for declared user consumers. A group with inline policies fails only when a complete account-wide GetAccountAuthorizationDetails user inventory contains no member of that group. The current group ARN, stable identity, native source, complete policy documents and membership projection are checked. A known current member is positive structural evidence even when unrelated user enumeration is partial. This is not authentication or action-use history, and no unused-day count is inferred.
aws.iam.group_inline_policies_have_membe.fail_when: A current group has inline policies but a complete, valid account-wide IAM user inventory contains no member of that group.
evaluated: native group name, ARN, stable GroupId and matching account-wide projection
inline policy names and complete policy documents with action/resource clauses
native IAM user IDs, ARNs and complete GroupList values
complete user enumeration before absence; independent positive membership survives partial reads
aws.iam.group_inline_policies_have_membe.not_applicable_when: The current native group has no inline policy; missing or denied policy/membership evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
aws.iam.group_inline_policies_have_membe.pass_when: At least one current IAM user declares membership in the exact group with inline policies.

azure.iam.custom_directory_role_has_decl.description: Reviews current custom Entra role definitions for declared consumers through directory role assignments and PIM assignment or eligibility schedules. Complete unfiltered paginated sources from the same verified tenant and capture are required before absence can fail. Future and unexpired PIM consumers count, while expired, canceled, denied, failed or revoked schedules do not. Missing or contradictory lifetime evidence remains unresolved. Permission declarations and exact principal scopes are retained. This structural cleanup review does not establish permission-use history, business approval or safe deletion; Azure Resource Manager roles are a separate inventory.
azure.iam.custom_directory_role_has_decl.fail_when: A current custom Entra role has no declared consumer in the complete native directory role assignments and PIM assignment and eligibility schedule inventories.
evaluated: current native role definition, immutable ID, verified directory tenant and scan-local credential/customer binding
unfiltered paginated directory role assignments and both PIM schedule inventories
exact role and principal IDs, declared directory/application scopes, schedule states and lifetimes
azure.iam.custom_directory_role_has_decl.not_applicable_when: Microsoft built-in role definitions. Missing, denied, filtered, partial or inconsistent assignment and PIM evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
azure.iam.custom_directory_role_has_decl.pass_when: A current assignment or unexpired/future assignment or eligibility schedule declares a principal and scope for the exact custom Entra role.

azure.iam.custom_arm_role_has_declared_c.description: Reviews current custom Azure Resource Manager roles for declared assignment or PIM consumers. Complete unfiltered native role assignment and assignment/eligibility schedule reads are required for every declared assignable scope. Management-group scopes additionally require a verified owning tenant and a complete descendant hierarchy whose subscriptions are all selected and tenant-bound, with required descendant scope reads. Native roles with DataActions cannot be assigned directly at management-group scope. Denied, partial, out-of-scope or inconsistent evidence cannot establish absence. Exact Actions, NotActions, DataActions and NotDataActions declarations are retained. This is structural cleanup evidence, not permission-use history, business-need approval or safe deletion.
azure.iam.custom_arm_role_has_declared_c.fail_when: The current custom role has no captured consumer after complete assignment and PIM reads cover all its declared assignable scopes and required management-group descendants.
evaluated: native current role definition ID/name/type and full permission/exclusion declarations
scan-local credential/customer authority, verified authentication tenant and native owning-scope tenant reads
every declared assignable subscription/resource scope and complete management-group descendants
unfiltered paginated ARM role assignments and PIM assignment/eligibility schedules, exact principal/role/scope/conditions and schedule lifetime
azure.iam.custom_arm_role_has_declared_c.not_applicable_when: Microsoft built-in ARM roles. Missing tenant, scope, hierarchy, assignment or PIM evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
azure.iam.custom_arm_role_has_declared_c.pass_when: A verified native assignment or unexpired/future PIM schedule references the exact role definition in the selected verified tenant.

aws.iam.identity_center.permission_set_h.description: Reviews IAM Identity Center permission-set consumers across a complete organization account universe. Native Organizations account lists, instance/permission-set lists, all provisioning states and account assignments must be complete before reporting structural absence. Any verified assignment or provisioned account is a consumer. Denied, incomplete, inconsistent or foreign-scope evidence remains unresolved. This does not measure successful permission use or authorize deletion.
aws.iam.identity_center.permission_set_h.fail_when: Complete native organization-wide account, assignment and provisioning reads found no current consumer.
evaluated: verified organization instance, owner account and native permission-set identity
all organization accounts including accounts without provisioned permission sets
unfiltered native provisioning lists and both latest-provisioning filters
paginated assignments in every organization account
aws.iam.identity_center.permission_set_h.not_applicable_when: Unresolved home region, authority or missing organization account universe remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
aws.iam.identity_center.permission_set_h.pass_when: A current bound assignment or provisioned account consumes this permission set.

aws.iam.saml_provider_has_role_consumer.description: Reviews current IAM SAML provider role consumers using complete account-wide native role trust inventory. An Allow trust statement naming the exact provider ARN with the matching STS federation action establishes a declared consumer even when conditions apply. Complete role enumeration and every valid trust document are required for structural absence; partial, denied, malformed, wildcard or negative-principal semantics leave absence unresolved. This does not measure authentication history or establish safe deletion.
aws.iam.saml_provider_has_role_consumer.fail_when: Complete current native role trust inventory has no declared consumer of this provider.
evaluated: same-account global native provider ARN and resource projection
complete native IAM role enumeration and trust document provenance
Allow Federated principals and compatible STS assume actions
wildcard, negative-principal, malformed or incomplete trust semantics
aws.iam.saml_provider_has_role_consumer.not_applicable_when: Unavailable source or unsupported trust semantics remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
aws.iam.saml_provider_has_role_consumer.pass_when: A current native role trust declares the exact provider and compatible STS federation action.

aws.iam.oidc_provider_has_role_consumer.description: Reviews current IAM OIDC provider role consumers using complete account-wide native role trust inventory. An Allow trust statement naming the exact provider ARN with the matching STS federation action establishes a declared consumer even when conditions apply. Complete role enumeration and every valid trust document are required for structural absence; partial, denied, malformed, wildcard or negative-principal semantics leave absence unresolved. This does not measure authentication history or establish safe deletion.
aws.iam.oidc_provider_has_role_consumer.fail_when: Complete current native role trust inventory has no declared consumer of this provider.
evaluated: same-account global native provider ARN and resource projection
complete native IAM role enumeration and trust document provenance
Allow Federated principals and compatible STS assume actions
wildcard, negative-principal, malformed or incomplete trust semantics
aws.iam.oidc_provider_has_role_consumer.not_applicable_when: Unavailable source or unsupported trust semantics remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
aws.iam.oidc_provider_has_role_consumer.pass_when: A current native role trust declares the exact provider and compatible STS federation action.

gcp.network.address_reserved_without_use.description: Checks a current Compute reserved address for a provider reported attachment. A RESERVED address with no users is a cleanup review candidate; this does not establish traffic inactivity.
gcp.network.address_reserved_without_use.fail_when: PASS when status IN_USE and users is nonempty; FAIL when status RESERVED and users is empty; UNKNOWN on RESERVING, disagreement, partial representation, bad identity or source.
evaluated: Compute addresses aggregatedList full item: selfLink, status, users, native project and GET receipt.
gcp.network.address_reserved_without_use.not_applicable_when: Unsupported or incomplete current source evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED; explicit applicability rules are retained.
gcp.network.address_reserved_without_use.pass_when: PASS when status IN_USE and users is nonempty; FAIL when status RESERVED and users is empty; UNKNOWN on RESERVING, disagreement, partial representation, bad identity or source.

gcp.network.firewall_policy_without_asso.description: Checks whether a project network firewall policy has a current policy association in its full native representation.
gcp.network.firewall_policy_without_asso.fail_when: PASS when associations contains a valid target; FAIL when the complete policy has no associations; UNKNOWN on partial representation, bad identity or source.
evaluated: Compute aggregated firewallPolicies full item: selfLink, associations[].attachmentTarget, native project and GET receipt.
gcp.network.firewall_policy_without_asso.not_applicable_when: Unsupported or incomplete current source evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED; explicit applicability rules are retained.
gcp.network.firewall_policy_without_asso.pass_when: PASS when associations contains a valid target; FAIL when the complete policy has no associations; UNKNOWN on partial representation, bad identity or source.

gcp.network.endpoint_group_without_endpo.description: Checks provider reported endpoint count on applicable Compute network endpoint groups. Zero endpoints is current structural absence; this does not establish load balancer traffic inactivity.
gcp.network.endpoint_group_without_endpo.fail_when: PASS when size is positive; FAIL when size is zero; NOT_APPLICABLE to SERVERLESS and PRIVATE_SERVICE_CONNECT; UNKNOWN on missing count, partial representation, bad identity or source.
evaluated: Compute networkEndpointGroups aggregatedList or global list full item: selfLink, networkEndpointType, size, native project and GET receipt.
gcp.network.endpoint_group_without_endpo.not_applicable_when: Unsupported or incomplete current source evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED; explicit applicability rules are retained.
gcp.network.endpoint_group_without_endpo.pass_when: PASS when size is positive; FAIL when size is zero; NOT_APPLICABLE to SERVERLESS and PRIVATE_SERVICE_CONNECT; UNKNOWN on missing count, partial representation, bad identity or source.

azure.network.route_table_has_subnet_ref.description: A complete current ARM route table GET exposes no subnet association. This is a structural attachment signal, not traffic inactivity.
azure.network.route_table_has_subnet_ref.fail_when: PASS when properties.subnets contains valid subnet ARM IDs; FAIL only when a complete read-only GET and complete native inventory establish an empty collection; UNKNOWN on partial, foreign, malformed or unbound evidence.
evaluated: Native provider inventory; reviewed source contracts: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/templates/microsoft.network/2025-07-01/routetables
azure.network.route_table_has_subnet_ref.not_applicable_when: Unsupported or incomplete current source evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED; explicit applicability rules are retained.
azure.network.route_table_has_subnet_ref.pass_when: PASS when properties.subnets contains valid subnet ARM IDs; FAIL only when a complete read-only GET and complete native inventory establish an empty collection; UNKNOWN on partial, foreign, malformed or unbound evidence.

azure.network.nic_has_owner_reference.description: A complete current ARM NIC GET exposes no VM, private endpoint, private link service or hosted workload owner.
azure.network.nic_has_owner_reference.fail_when: PASS when virtualMachine, privateEndpoint, privateLinkService or hostedWorkloads names an owner; FAIL only when all are absent in a complete read-only GET; UNKNOWN on partial, foreign or malformed evidence.
evaluated: Native provider inventory; reviewed source contracts: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/templates/microsoft.network/2023-09-01/networkinterfaces
azure.network.nic_has_owner_reference.not_applicable_when: Unsupported or incomplete current source evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED; explicit applicability rules are retained.
azure.network.nic_has_owner_reference.pass_when: PASS when virtualMachine, privateEndpoint, privateLinkService or hostedWorkloads names an owner; FAIL only when all are absent in a complete read-only GET; UNKNOWN on partial, foreign or malformed evidence.

k8s.network.service_has_current_backend_.description: A selector-based Service has no currently selected Pod and no same-namespace EndpointSlice declaring its name. This does not prove the Service unused.
k8s.network.service_has_current_backend_.fail_when: PASS on a same-namespace Pod selector match or EndpointSlice service-name label; FAIL only with complete Pod and EndpointSlice inventories and neither match; ExternalName and selectorless Services are NOT_APPLICABLE because external/manual backends are valid; UNKNOWN on incomplete source.
evaluated: Native provider inventory; reviewed source contracts: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/endpoint-slices/
k8s.network.service_has_current_backend_.not_applicable_when: Unsupported or incomplete current source evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED; explicit applicability rules are retained.
k8s.network.service_has_current_backend_.pass_when: PASS on a same-namespace Pod selector match or EndpointSlice service-name label; FAIL only with complete Pod and EndpointSlice inventories and neither match; ExternalName and selectorless Services are NOT_APPLICABLE because external/manual backends are valid; UNKNOWN on incomplete source.

k8s.network.endpointslice_service_refere.description: An EndpointSlice labels a Service name that is absent from the same-namespace native Service inventory.
k8s.network.endpointslice_service_refere.fail_when: PASS on current same-namespace Service match with compatible owner UID; FAIL on missing Service only with complete inventory; unlabeled slices are NOT_APPLICABLE; UNKNOWN on partial or mismatched UID.

k8s.network.endpointslice_service_refere.pass_when: PASS on current same-namespace Service match with compatible owner UID; FAIL on missing Service only with complete inventory; unlabeled slices are NOT_APPLICABLE; UNKNOWN on partial or mismatched UID.

k8s.network.ingress_service_backends_res.fail_when: PASS when every native Service backend resolves; FAIL only when complete Service inventory establishes a missing backend; resource-only or no native Service backend is NOT_APPLICABLE.
evaluated: Native provider inventory; reviewed source contracts: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/
k8s.network.ingress_service_backends_res.not_applicable_when: Unsupported or incomplete current source evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED; explicit applicability rules are retained.
k8s.network.ingress_service_backends_res.pass_when: PASS when every native Service backend resolves; FAIL only when complete Service inventory establishes a missing backend; resource-only or no native Service backend is NOT_APPLICABLE.

k8s.network.networkpolicy_selects_curren.description: A NetworkPolicy podSelector matches no current Pod in the policy namespace. The policy may intentionally target future Pods.
k8s.network.networkpolicy_selects_curren.fail_when: PASS on a same-namespace Pod selector match; FAIL only when complete Pod inventory has no match; UNKNOWN on malformed selectors or incomplete inventory.
evaluated: Native provider inventory; reviewed source contracts: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/network-policies/
k8s.network.networkpolicy_selects_curren.not_applicable_when: Unsupported or incomplete current source evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED; explicit applicability rules are retained.
k8s.network.networkpolicy_selects_curren.pass_when: PASS on a same-namespace Pod selector match; FAIL only when complete Pod inventory has no match; UNKNOWN on malformed selectors or incomplete inventory.

aws.network.route_table_associated.description: Current native Associations records a structural consumer of the route_table; no traffic inactivity is inferred.
aws.network.route_table_associated.fail_when: Associations has a main, subnet, gateway, or VPC consumer => PASS; verified empty Associations => FAIL; incomplete or malformed => UNKNOWN.
aws.network.route_table_associated.not_applicable_when: Unsupported or incomplete current source evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED; explicit applicability rules are retained.
aws.network.route_table_associated.pass_when: Associations has a main, subnet, gateway, or VPC consumer => PASS; verified empty Associations => FAIL; incomplete or malformed => UNKNOWN.

aws.network.internet_gateway_attached.description: Current native Attachments records a structural consumer of the internet_gateway; no traffic inactivity is inferred.
aws.network.internet_gateway_attached.fail_when: Attachments has a main, subnet, gateway, or VPC consumer => PASS; verified empty Attachments => FAIL; incomplete or malformed => UNKNOWN.
aws.network.internet_gateway_attached.not_applicable_when: Unsupported or incomplete current source evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED; explicit applicability rules are retained.
aws.network.internet_gateway_attached.pass_when: Attachments has a main, subnet, gateway, or VPC consumer => PASS; verified empty Attachments => FAIL; incomplete or malformed => UNKNOWN.

azure.network.public_ip_has_network_refe.description: A complete current successful ARM public IP GET is checked for IP configuration, NAT gateway, linked/service public IP and prefix references. Absence is a structural reservation review signal, not traffic inactivity or safe deletion.
azure.network.public_ip_has_network_refe.fail_when: PASS when a current native network attachment or allocation reference is declared; FAIL when all optional reference fields are absent in a verified complete Succeeded GET; UNKNOWN for incomplete, foreign, malformed or denied evidence.
