azure.network.public_ip_has_network_refe.not_applicable_when: Unsupported or incomplete current source evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED; explicit applicability rules are retained.
azure.network.public_ip_has_network_refe.pass_when: PASS when a current native network attachment or allocation reference is declared; FAIL when all optional reference fields are absent in a verified complete Succeeded GET; UNKNOWN for incomplete, foreign, malformed or denied evidence.

aws.network.target_group_has_load_balanc.description: Reviews the current target-group load-balancer association recorded by ELB. A target group without this association is a cleanup review candidate; this does not establish global workload inactivity or the absence of planned deployment and autoscaling dependencies.
aws.network.target_group_has_load_balanc.fail_when: Valid same-account/region associated load balancer => PASS; explicit empty association in complete current native inventory => FAIL; omitted, denied, foreign, partial-negative or malformed evidence => UNKNOWN.

aws.network.target_group_has_load_balanc.pass_when: Valid same-account/region associated load balancer => PASS; explicit empty association in complete current native inventory => FAIL; omitted, denied, foreign, partial-negative or malformed evidence => UNKNOWN.

gcp.network.http_proxy_forwarding_rule_r.description: Checks an exact HTTP target proxy URL against the complete observed project forwarding-rule inventory. An exact reference establishes use. No local match is UNKNOWN because the reviewed documentation does not rule out every cross-project proxy reference.
gcp.network.http_proxy_forwarding_rule_r.fail_when: PASS on an exact canonical forwarding-rule target reference; UNKNOWN on no observed reference, incomplete global or regional inventory, filtered/failed receipts, malformed identity, or partial representation.
evaluated: Unfiltered Compute targetHttpProxies aggregatedList plus forwardingRules aggregatedList and globalForwardingRules list, with full objects, source receipts, and exact project identity.

evaluated: Unfiltered Compute targetHttpsProxies aggregatedList plus forwardingRules aggregatedList and globalForwardingRules list, with full objects, source receipts, and exact project identity.
gcp.network.https_proxy_forwarding_rule_.not_applicable_when: Unsupported or incomplete current source evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED; explicit applicability rules are retained.

gcp.network.backend_service_has_members.fail_when: PASS when a backend group or service binding is present; FAIL when both are empty or omitted on a complete item; UNKNOWN on malformed, partial, or unbound source evidence.

gcp.network.backend_service_has_members.pass_when: PASS when a backend group or service binding is present; FAIL when both are empty or omitted on a complete item; UNKNOWN on malformed, partial, or unbound source evidence.

azure.network.subnet_has_consumer_or_res.description: A complete current subnet ARM GET is checked for native IP configurations, private endpoints, application gateway configurations, delegations, service links and IP allocations. An absence is a structural review signal, not traffic inactivity or safe deletion.

k8s.network.endpoints_controller_service.description: Reviews only legacy Endpoints marked as Kubernetes endpoint-controller managed with one controlling v1 Service owner of the same name and a nonempty UID. A missing Service is a dangling structural reference, not evidence that the Endpoints has no traffic or custom consumers.
k8s.network.endpoints_controller_service.fail_when: NOT_APPLICABLE for unmarked or custom-managed Endpoints, or without a unique controlling v1 Service owner; PASS when the same-namespace, same-name Service has the exact owner UID; FAIL only when a complete Service inventory has no Service by that name; UNKNOWN for partial inventory, malformed owner/identity, or current Service UID disagreement.
evaluated: Read-only core/v1 Endpoints and Service LIST inventories from the same selected cluster and namespace scope, with projected rows and cluster/namespace/UID provenance bound to the native response.
